bafoeg-bw-heidelberg-rate.claim: gives a €934 upper amount beside a correct €992 headline.
bafoeg-bw-heidelberg-rate.quote:
Du bist unsicher, ob du überhaupt BAföG bekommen kannst?

Dein möglicher BAföG-Anspruch kann zwischen 10 Euro und 934 Euro liegen, sofern du bezugsberechtigt bist. Prüfe, ob du berechtigt bist, und stelle einen Antrag über BAföG Digital, denn oft ist mehr drin, als man denkt!
bafoeg-bw-heidelberg-rate.tr:
Are you unsure whether you can receive any BAföG at all?

Your possible BAföG entitlement can be between €10 and €934 if you are eligible. Check whether you qualify and apply through BAföG Digital, because there is often more available than you think!
bafoeg-bw-heidelberg-rate.law: Current ordinary assessed need for a university student living away from parents with qualifying student health/care insurance is €475 + €380 + €102 + €35 = €992 before means testing. The page’s €934 upper end conflicts with that category and with its own correct €992 headline, retained in context. Other categories and supplements can produce different figures.
bafoeg-bw-heidelberg-rate.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise eligible 25-year-old university student lives away from parents, has qualifying student health and compulsory care insurance, and no countable personal, parental or spouse income or assets. The ordinary assessed monthly need is €992.
bafoeg-bw-heidelberg-rate.context: Live original retrieved on 18 October 2026. The current homepage navigation links /bafoeg/bafoeg/. The page includes current BAföGdigital and study-start assistance navigation, with no historical-only label. The same page prominently gives the correct €992 headline; the finding concerns an internal inconsistency, not a uniform €934 ceiling throughout the page.
bafoeg-bw-heidelberg-rate.scope: The example assumes all substantive conditions and zero countable means. It does not promise every student €992 or describe that amount as a universal maximum. Under §66 a(2)–(3), the present ordinary rates apply to all continuing award periods from October 2024. No proposed 2027 reform is treated as current law.

bafoeg-sl-saarland-abroad-prior.claim: says foreign-study applications must arrive before study begins.
bafoeg-sl-saarland-abroad-prior.quote:
Förderung für eine Ausbildung oder Studium im Ausland beantragen

Die Unterlagen und Anträge müssen schon vor dem Start von der Ausbildung oder dem Studium beim Amt für Ausbildungsförderung sein.

Am besten ein halbes Jahr bevor Sie ins Ausland gehen.

Die Studien-Bescheinigung bekommen Sie meistens erst vor Ort im Ausland.

Dann können Sie die Studien-Bescheinigung auch später an das Amt für Ausbildungsförderung schicken.
bafoeg-sl-saarland-abroad-prior.tr:
Applying for funding for training or study abroad

The documents and applications must already be with the funding office before the training or studies begin.

Preferably half a year before you go abroad.

You usually receive the study certificate only once you are abroad.

You can then send the study certificate to the funding office later as well.
bafoeg-sl-saarland-abroad-prior.law: Section 15(1) starts funding no earlier than the application month and the month training begins. It does not impose a before-study-start filing cutoff. Section 46 governs applications to the competent office; foreign-study eligibility under §5 and processing time remain separate.
bafoeg-sl-saarland-abroad-prior.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise eligible student begins qualifying study in Portugal on 1 October 2026 and applies to the competent Saarland office on 15 October. Filing after the first day of study does not itself bar October funding; processing and payment can occur later.
bafoeg-sl-saarland-abroad-prior.context: Live original retrieved on 18 October 2026. Current main-site footer links Leichte Sprache; that current landing page links this finance page. The easy-language page has no historical-only label.
bafoeg-sl-saarland-abroad-prior.scope: An application made in the month study begins can preserve that month, subject to all foreign-study and personal eligibility conditions. A later-month application ordinarily loses earlier months. The six-month lead is sensible processing advice; the narrow allegation concerns the express mandatory pre-start instruction. The text itself permits later submission of the study certificate, retained in the quote.

bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.src: BAföG Allgemein: Die Förderdauer ist zu kurz
bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.claim: calls statutory study-completion assistance an interest-bearing bank loan.
bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.quote:
»Die Förderdauer ist zu kurz!«

Für manche ist sie zu kurz. Aber die Förderdauer richtet sich nach der Regelstudienzeit. In bestimmten Ausnahmefällen gibt es die Möglichkeit, die Förderdauer zu verlängern. Und alle Studierenden können entweder im Bachelor oder im Master ohne Angabe von Gründen ein Semester länger BAföG erhalten und ein Flexibilitätssemester beantragen. Falls es auch danach noch eng werden sollte, gibt es unter Umständen die "Studienabschlusshilfe". Die gibt allen BAföG-Berechtigten auch nach einer Unterbrechung der Förderung von bis zu vier Semestern die Möglichkeit, das Studium mit Hilfe des BAföG abzuschließen, wenn auch nur als verzinsliches Bankdarlehen.
bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.tr:
“The funding period is too short!”

For some people it is too short. But the funding period follows the standard period of study. In certain exceptional cases, the funding period can be extended. All students can also obtain BAföG for one additional semester, either in the Bachelor’s or Master’s course, without giving reasons and can apply for a flexibility semester. If time is still tight after that, study-completion assistance may be available under certain conditions. This gives all BAföG-eligible students the opportunity to finish their studies with BAföG even after a funding interruption of up to four semesters, though only as an interest-bearing bank loan.
bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.law: New qualifying study-completion assistance under §15(5) is paid as a statutory full loan under §17(3), first sentence, no.3. Section 18(1) applies its conditions to these loans and §18(2) makes them interest-free in the ordinary case. Its exception for payment arrears exceeding 45 days does not make every new award interest-bearing from the outset. Section 18 c preserves repayment rules for old bank loans under the July 2019 law, rather than offering a new bank loan in 2026. The source’s current completion-assistance answer still uses the former bank-loan description.
bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.example: Hypothetical: a student reaches the end of their applicable funding duration in 2026 and lawfully qualifies for §15(5) completion assistance, including timely final-examination admission and a certificate that completion is possible within the assistance period. Their assessed award is €500 per month, with no childcare supplement. The award is a statutory full loan normally free of interest; assume every repayment is made on time. No general entitlement to an extra semester or to a €500 award without means testing is claimed.
bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.context: Current homepage navigation directly links this general BAföG guide. The disputed complete answer now includes the post 2024 flexibility semester, so the bank-loan wording is not isolated in a historical archive. A separate answer accurately calls ordinary half-loan BAföG interest-free; retained as context without treating it as an express correction of the specific completion-assistance sentence.
bafoeg-he-kassel-completion-bank-loan.scope: Newly awarded statutory completion assistance in 2026 under the current duration rules, with all individual eligibility conditions met and no payment default. Excludes legacy KfW bank-loan contracts and independent commercial study or bridging loans.

»Aber die ganzen Schulden!«

Erstens: Zurückgezahlt werden muss nur die Hälfte (und zwar als zinsloses Darlehen), die andere Hälfte gibt's geschenkt! Zweitens: Beim BAföG sind die Schulden auf maximal rund 10.000 Euro begrenzt!
ctx.tr:
“But all those debts!”

First, only half has to be repaid, as an interest-free loan; the other half is a gift. Second, BAföG debts are limited to around €10,000 at most.

bafoeg-th-further-master-bank-loan.claim: calls funding for its specified post-Diplom Master route an interest-bearing bank loan.
bafoeg-th-further-master-bank-loan.quote:
Wird ein Master- oder postgradualer Studiengang gefördert?

Dies ist problemlos möglich, sofern vorher ein Bachelor- oder Bakkalaureusstudiengang abgeschlossen wurde! Wurde aber z.B. ein Diplomstudiengang abgeschlossen, so ist eine Förderung nur möglich, wenn eine fachliche Weiterführung durch den Masterstudiengang erfolgt; Förderung kann aber dann auch nur in Form eines verzinslichen Bankdarlehens gewährt werden.
bafoeg-th-further-master-bank-loan.tr:
Is a Master’s or postgraduate course funded?

This is possible without difficulty if a Bachelor’s or Bakkalaureus course was completed beforehand. But if, for example, a Diplom course was completed, funding is possible only if the Master’s course is a continuation in the same field; funding can then also be granted only in the form of an interest-bearing bank loan.
bafoeg-th-further-master-bank-loan.law: For a new further university course that lawfully qualifies under the narrow §7(2) routes, §17(2) ordinarily gives half grant and half statutory loan unless another funding-form ground applies. The loan is normally interest-free under §18(1)–(2); overdue repayments exceeding 45 days can separately attract statutory interest. Section 18 c concerns legacy bank-loan repayments under the July 2019 rules. The source instead calls the stated further-Master funding only an interest-bearing bank loan. This finding does not endorse its broad eligibility summary or promise BAföG for every Master after a Diplom.
bafoeg-th-further-master-bank-loan.example: Hypothetical: in 2026 a student begins a further university course after a Diplom and actually satisfies the narrow statutory further-training criteria under §7(2), as well as all other BAföG requirements. Assume a lawful award within the relevant funding duration, no separate full-loan ground and no repayment arrears. Its statutory loan component is normally interest-free; it is not a newly issued interest-bearing KfW bank loan. Mere continuation in the same field alone is not assumed to establish eligibility.
bafoeg-th-further-master-bank-loan.context: Current home navigation directly links the inspected /finanzen/bafoeg/ overview. The page contains explicit July 2026 digital-delivery information and October 2026 award examples. Its opening ordinary-funding description correctly says interest-free, and is retained as separate context; it does not specifically correct the later further-Master bank-loan answer. The apparent /finanzen/bafoeg/erstantrag.html alias redirects to the same overview and is not counted separately.
bafoeg-th-further-master-bank-loan.scope: The funding-form statement for a new lawfully qualifying further university course, rather than a finding that all post-Diplom Master courses qualify. Historic awards and existing bank-loan contracts are outside scope.

ctx.quote: Für Studierende ist das BAföG ein zinsloses Darlehen, das später zur Hälfte zurückgefordert wird. Ziel ist es dabei, einen ersten berufsqualifizierten Abschluss zu ermöglichen. Schüler-BAföG ist dagegen in der Regel ein Zuschuss, der nicht zurückgezahlt werden muss. Hinweis : Die nachfolgenden Inhalte zum BAföG beziehen sich ausschließlich auf die Studierendenförderung. Für Schüler-BAföG ist das Studierendenwerk Thüringen nicht zuständig (Ausnahme: Schüler-Förderung im Rahmen eines Kanadaaufenthaltes). Informationen zum Schüler-BAföG finden Sie auf dem offiziellen BAföG-Portal des Bundes.
ctx.tr: For students, BAföG is an interest-free loan of which half is later reclaimed. The aim is to enable a first vocational qualification. School BAföG is generally a grant that does not have to be repaid. Note: the following BAföG contents concern only student support. Studierendenwerk Thüringen is not responsible for school BAföG, except school support during a stay in Canada. Information on school BAföG is available on the federal official BAföG portal.

lawMarks: normally interest-free under §18(1)–(2)

bafoeg-th-citizenship-condition.claim: lists German or EU citizenship as a required condition, despite its later broader foreign-student guidance.
bafoeg-th-citizenship-condition.quote:
Welche Voraussetzungen gelten für BAföG?

Um BAföG-berechtigt zu sein, müssen Sie

• höchstens 45 Jahre alt sein.
• die deutsche Staatsbürgerschaft haben

oder

EU-staatsangehörig sein und ein Daueraufenthaltsrecht in Deutschland haben, in Deutschland angestellt oder selbständig sein (für EU-Staatsangehörige gibt es weitere Sonderfälle).

Zudem muss es sich um die Erstausbildung handeln, z. B.:

• Erststudium nach dem Abitur
• Studium nach dem Abitur, das auf dem zweiten Bildungsweg erworben wurde
• Studium nach einer Lehre, die nach dem Abitur absolviert wurde

Das Studium muss

• ein Vollzeitstudium sein,
• an einer staatlich anerkannten Hochschule sein (Universität, Fachhochschule, Akademie – auch private, aber staatlich anerkannt).

Ein Master-Studium ist förderfähig, wenn es auf einem Bachelor-Studium aufbaut.
bafoeg-th-citizenship-condition.law: Section 8(1) no.2 includes non-EU nationals who hold a Niederlassungserlaubnis, a German settlement permit, or a qualifying EU long-term residence permit. They need not acquire German or EU citizenship to satisfy this personal-status condition. The overview’s mandatory-condition summary instead gives German citizenship or specified EU-citizen status. The later foreign-student answer correctly recognises broader residence/protection categories and is retained as material countercontext. This is an internal published eligibility-summary inconsistency, not a claim that the office actually rejects these applicants.
bafoeg-th-citizenship-condition.example: Hypothetical: a 24-year-old Japanese national holds a valid German Niederlassungserlaubnis and begins an otherwise qualifying full-time first degree in 2026. Assume all other BAföG conditions, including means testing, are met. Section 8(1) no.2 satisfies the personal-status condition; German or EU citizenship is unnecessary. The worked example does not treat every temporary study visa or foreign nationality as sufficient.
bafoeg-th-citizenship-condition.context: The current homepage directly links this overview. Both the complete mandatory-condition unit and the complete later correcting answer are retained. Its parenthetical special-cases qualification specifically concerns EU citizens; it does not include non-EU settlement-permit holders in that initial either/or summary. Same publisher/page as the further-Master loan finding; no independent drafting origin implied.
bafoeg-th-citizenship-condition.scope: Only the nationality/residence condition for a new otherwise qualifying applicant with an actual German settlement permit. Not all foreign students qualify, and no full award is promised without other conditions. The source’s separate age statement is retained unmarked and not treated as another finding.

• Studium nach einer Lehre, die nach dem Abitur absolviert wurde

Das Studium muss

• ein Vollzeitstudium sein,
• an einer staatlich anerkannten Hochschule sein (Universität, Fachhochschule, Akademie – auch private, aber staatlich anerkannt).

Ein Master-Studium ist förderfähig, wenn es auf einem Bachelor-Studium aufbaut.

Unionsbürger*innen mit Daueraufenthaltsrecht oder Niederlassungserlaubnis, Flüchtlinge mit Aufenthaltsrecht aus humanitären Gründen, Geduldete), können sie unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen auch BAföG erhalten. Weitere Informationen erhalten Sie beim Service-Team oder in den Service-Büros.
ctx.tr:
Can foreign students also receive BAföG?

If foreign students have residence status — for example EU citizens with a permanent right of residence or a settlement permit, refugees with a humanitarian right of residence, or people with tolerated status — they can also receive BAföG under certain conditions. You can obtain more information from the service team or service offices.

Die Förderung erfolgt im Regelfall

bafoeg-hb-service-completion-bank-loan.law: New qualifying study-completion assistance under §15(5) is a statutory full loan under §17(3), first sentence, no. 3. Section 18(1) applies its conditions and §18(2) makes it interest-free in the ordinary case. The exception for repayment arrears exceeding 45 days does not make every new award interest-bearing from the outset. Section 18c instead preserves repayment rules for old bank loans under the July 2019 law; it is not a new bank-loan route in 2026. Section 66a transitions do not convert a new 2026 completion award into the former bank loan.
bafoeg-hb-service-completion-bank-loan.example: Hypothetical: a student at a covered Bremen university reaches their applicable funding-duration limit in 2026 and actually qualifies for §15(5) completion assistance, including timely final-examination admission and a certificate that completion is possible within the assistance period. Their means-tested award is €500 monthly with no childcare supplement; all repayments are made on time. This new award is an ordinarily interest-free statutory full loan. No automatic entitlement to €500, extra funding or course eligibility is inferred from the webpage.
bafoeg-hb-service-completion-bank-loan.context: The current official portal home links its School, training and study category, which directly offers this student application service. The finding concerns the separately named completion assistance, rather than ordinary funding or repayment of a pre-2019 bank loan.
bafoeg-hb-service-completion-bank-loan.scope: Guidance on a new 2026 statutory study-completion award with actual §15(5) eligibility and no repayment default. Not old bank-loan repayment, a separate KfW study credit, new degree eligibility, or an allegation about actual decisions.

bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-assets.claim: caps the higher asset allowance at age 45.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-assets.quote: Das Vermögen zum Zeitpunkt der Antragstellung wird bis zu einer Höhe von 15.000 € bis zum 30. Lebensjahr und 45.000 € bis zum 45. Lebensjahr nicht angerechnet. Darüber hinaus vorhandenes Vermögen wird auf die Monate des Bewilligungszeitraums verteilt und mindert den BAföG-Anspruch.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-assets.tr: Assets at the time of application are disregarded up to €15,000 until age 30 and €45,000 until age 45. Assets above that amount are divided over the months of the approval period and reduce the BAföG entitlement.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-assets.law: Section 29(1) exempts €15,000 for applicants under 30 and €45,000 for applicants who have reached 30; there is no upper age limit on that €45,000 allowance. Section 29(1), final sentence, fixes relevant circumstances at application. Further €2,300 allowances for a spouse or civil partner and each child, and hardship protection under §29(3), remain available. Excess assets reduce assessed monthly funding under §30.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-assets.example: Hypothetical: a 46-year-old began a qualifying educational phase at 44 and now reapplies with€40,000 countable assets. The ordinary age rule was satisfied at phase start. The€45,000 basic allowance at this application covers those assets; turning 45 during the phase does not remove it. All other conditions and means tests remain.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-assets.context: The current application page directly links this WS 2025/26-labelled PDF, whose internal reference date is 20 August 2024. The original and current incoming page were captured on 20 October 2026.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-assets.scope: The finding concerns the basic asset allowance for applicants aged 45 or older who otherwise qualify for BAföG. This includes students who began the same educational phase before 45 and qualifying entrants under §10(3) exceptions. The ordinary requirement to start a phase before 45 remains. The correctly linked 2023 FAQ says €45,000 applies to students older than 30 and supplies material counterevidence. Additional spouse/child allowances, qualifying debts and hardship protection remain relevant. Excess assets reduce funding across the approval period; this is not a guaranteed-payment or automatic-exclusion finding. The same allowance also applies to a qualifying continuation application after 45 where the phase began before 45; an age exception is not required merely for that birthday.

bafoeg-mvp-bw-freiburg-childcare.law: Section 14b(1) increases assessed monthly need by €160 for each own child who has not reached 14 and lives in the applicant's household. bafoeg-mvp-bw-heidelberg-subject.quote:
5) Meine Begründung des Fachwechsels/Abbruchs der früheren Ausbildung (nicht auszufüllen bei einem ersten Wechsel bis zum Beginn des 4. Fachsemesters)
(Bitte auch erläutern, warum Sie sich für die frühere Fachrichtung entschieden hatten, wann und auf Grund welcher Umstände im Einzelnen festgestellt wurde, dass die bisherige Ausbildung nicht der Eignung oder Neigung entsprach und warum Sie sich für die neue Fachrichtung / Ausbildung entschieden hatten).
Bei einem Fachrichtungswechsel / Ausbildungsabbruch bis zum Beginn des 5. Fachsemesters oder im Master-Studium ist ein unabweisbarer Grund erforderlich und entsprechend ausführlich darzulegen. In allen übrigen Fällen reicht für einen Wechsel ein sog. wichtiger Grund.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-heidelberg-subject.tr:
5) My reasons for changing subject / abandoning the previous course (do not complete for a first change before the start of the fourth subject semester)
(Please also explain why you chose the previous subject, when and in what specific circumstances it was established that the previous course did not suit your aptitude or inclination, and why you chose the new subject / course).
For a change of subject / abandonment of training before the start of the fifth subject semester or in a Master’s course, an unavoidable reason is necessary and must be explained in appropriate detail. In all other cases, a so-called important reason is sufficient for a change.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-heidelberg-subject.law: Under BAföG §7(3), an important reason can support a qualifying undergraduate change before the fifth subject semester begins; later changes normally require an unavoidable reason. The first-change presumption applies before the fourth semester begins; actually credited semesters are deducted. For qualifying Master courses §7(1a) excludes the important-reason route. §66a(8) preserves old rules for specified changes completed/deemed completed by a semester start before 25July 2024. The form reverses the ordinary before/after distinction while correctly retaining the Master restriction.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-heidelberg-subject.example: Hypothetical: a first Bachelor student changes after three completed subject semesters in October 2026, with no credited semesters or previous changes, promptly after recognizing a legally important reason. An unavoidable reason is not required merely because the change occurs before semester 5; remaining eligibility and means conditions determine funding.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-heidelberg-subject.context: Current download page links the retained form as an application aid; no evidence of decisions or applicant harm.
bafoeg-mvp-bw-heidelberg-subject.scope: For a new 2026 undergraduate change with no credited semesters, an important reason can suffice before semester 5 begins; the quoted before 5 demand for unavoidable reason reverses that rule. Actually credited semesters under an institution's decision must be deducted; form question 3 separately asks about creditability, and page 2 discusses full-credit Schwerpunktverlagerung, earlier changes and evidentiary duties. This finding makes no separate allegation about that creditability wording. Previous changes and promptness matter. The first-change presumption before 4 is rebuttable; relevant Master courses cannot use the important-reason route. Former law remains for the changes identified in §66a(8), including deemed semester-start changes before 25July 2024. Other eligibility and means tests remain.

bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-age.claim: still links a parents brochure giving ordinary starting ages below 30 or 35 for a Master.
bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-age.quote:
Altersgrenze und BAföG

Normalerweise können nur Studierende Förderung bekommen, die bei Beginn ihres Ausbildungsabschnittes das 30. Lebensjahr und bei einem Masterstudiengang das 35. Lebensjahr noch nicht vollendet haben (ein Ausbildungsabschnitt ist die Zeit, die in einer Ausbildungsstättenart fortlaufend verbracht wird).

Eine wichtige Ausnahmeregelung gilt für Studierende, die wegen der Erziehung eines Kindes unter 14 Jahren ihr Studium zurückgestellt haben. Diese Ausnahmeregelung gilt ebenso für Studierende, die sich für eine Ausbildung über den zweiten Bildungsweg (Fachoberschule, Kolleg, Abendgymnasium) entschieden haben. Sie können auch nach Überschreiten der Altersgrenze BAföG erhalten. Die Erziehung von Kindern bis zu 14 Jahren kann nur der Elternteil geltend machen, der tatsächlich das Kind / die Kinder erzogen hat und wenn dieser nicht mehr als 30 Wochenstunden nebenbei gearbeitet hat. Alleinerziehende dürfen auch mehr als 30 Stunden pro Woche beschäftigt sein.

TIPP: Ob bei Ihnen eine Ausnahme hinsichtlich der Altersgrenze möglich ist, können Sie durch einen Antrag auf Vorabentscheidung nach § 46 Abs. 5 Satz 1 Nr 4 BAföG rechtzeitig vor Aufnahme der Ausbildung beim örtlich zuständigen BAföG-Amt klären lassen.
bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-age.tr:
Age limit and BAföG

Normally only students who have not yet turned 30 at the beginning of their phase of education, or 35 for a Master’s programme, can receive funding (a phase of education is the time spent continuously in one type of educational institution).

An important exception applies to students who postponed their studies to raise a child under 14. This exception also applies to students who chose education through the second-chance route (Fachoberschule, Kolleg or evening grammar school). They can receive BAföG even after exceeding the age limit. Raising children up to 14 can be claimed only by the parent who actually raised the child/children and worked no more than 30 hours per week alongside this. Single parents may work more than 30 hours per week.

TIP: You can clarify in good time before starting education whether an age-limit exception applies to you by applying to the local competent BAföG office for an advance decision under §46(5), first sentence, no.4 BAföG.
bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-age.law: Under BAföG §10(3), the ordinary age condition concerns starting the relevant educational phase before 45. The qualifying Master phase is assessed separately. Specified exceptions can apply from 45; a birthday during an already-started phase is not itself disqualifying. The current 45 threshold applies from 1 August 2022; no current transition preserves 30/35 for a new 2026 phase. Other personal, course and means-test conditions remain.
bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-age.example: Hypothetical: a 40-year-old starts a qualifying Master in 2026, has no need for an age exception and meets the separate Master course rules. They satisfy the ordinary age condition. The brochure suggests a 35 threshold; payment still depends on all other conditions and the means test.
bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-age.context: Current Studieren mit Kind service links this exactJanuary 2021 brochure alongside a newer DSW flyer. No historical-only warning appears at the link. The current FAQ gives 45 for age. The booklet edition is disclosed; no claim of recent editorial updating.
bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-age.scope: Finding limited to the ordinary phase-start age stated in a January 2021 brochure currently linked as parents guidance. Current FAQ correctly states 45 and must be displayed as counterguidance. Statutory exceptions under §10(3), including qualifying later education, professional admission, certain further education, immediate qualifying Master and personal/family impediments or major personal change, remain conditional; specified routes require prompt commencement. The booklet’s own childcare exceptions and tip are retained. The immediate-Master age exception applies when the applicant reached 45 during the completed preceding Bachelor and then begins the qualifying Master immediately.

bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-childc.claim: still links a parents brochure stating a 140-euro monthly childcare supplement.
bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-childc.quote:
Kinderbetreuungszuschlag

BAföG-Empfänger, die mit eigenen Kindern (bis zum 14. Lebensjahr) in einem Haushalt leben, erhalten einen zusätzlichen monatlichen Zuschuss, den sogenannten Kinderbetreuungszuschlag. Studierende, die mit mindestens einem eigenen Kind, welches das 14. Lebensjahr noch nicht vollendet hat, in einem Haushalt leben, erhalten zusätzliche 140 Euro für jedes Kind. Der Kinderbetreuungszuschlag wird für denselben Zeitraum nur einem Elternteil gewährt. Sind beide Elternteile nach dem BAföG förderungsfähig und leben in einem gemeinsamen Haushalt, bestimmen sie untereinander, wer den Kinderbetreuungszuschlag erhält. Der Kinderbetreuungszuschlag wird als Zuschuss gewährt, auf den Einkommen und Vermögen erst nachrangig anzurechnen sind. Das bedeutet, der Zuschlag wird auch dann als Zuschuss gewährt, wenn die Förderung im Übrigen als Darlehen erfolgt.

bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-childc.tr:
Childcare supplement

BAföG recipients who live in one household with their own children (up to age 14) receive an additional monthly grant, the childcare supplement. Students living in one household with at least one own child who has not yet turned 14 receive an additional 140 euros for each child. The supplement is granted to only one parent for the same period. If both parents are eligible for BAföG and live in a shared household, they decide between themselves who receives the childcare supplement. The childcare supplement is a grant, against which income and assets are offset only after the other components. This means that the supplement remains a grant even if the rest of the funding is a loan.

Further information about the childcare supplement is available at www.bafoeg-aktuell.de/bafoeg/kinderbetreuungszuschlag.html. You must submit your application for the childcare supplement to the BAföG office no later than the final day of the current award period—but preferably always as soon as possible!

Only one parent receives it for the same child and period; eligible cohabiting parents choose the recipient. bafoeg-mvp-by-muenchen-oberbayern-childc.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise eligible student lives with their own six-year-old child in 2026 and is the designated recipient. With no income or asset offsets reducing the supplement, the assessed need addition is 160 euros monthly,20 euros above the brochure figure. No actual loss or guaranteed award inferred.

bafoeg-mvp-bb-ost-brandenburg-age.src: Current English BAföG FAQ — differences between Bachelor and Master funding
bafoeg-mvp-bb-ost-brandenburg-age.claim: says a Master’s course cannot be funded if the student turned 35 before starting.
bafoeg-mvp-bb-ost-brandenburg-age.quote:
Are there differences in funding between bachelor and master programs?

Bachelor’s degree programs are usually eligible for funding if no other degree has yet been completed and the funding requirements have been met. BAföG can be granted for the period of the standard period of study.

To support a master’s degree, it is a prerequisite that no degree other than a bachelor’s degree has been completed. Funding is excluded if the student has reached the age of 35 before the start of the master’s course.

If you intend to switch from the diploma course or course with state examination to a bachelor’s / master’s course, you should definitely contact our clerks for advice.
bafoeg-mvp-bb-ost-brandenburg-age.law: BAföG §10(3) ordinarily requires the relevant educational phase to begin before reaching 45, including a Master’s phase. Statutory exceptions can permit later starts, including specified later-entry qualifications, vocational admission, qualifying further training, a qualifying immediate Master after reaching 45 during the previous Bachelor, personal/family impediments and qualifying new need after a major personal change. Prompt-start requirements apply to specified exceptions. Turning 45 during an already-started phase is not automatically disqualifying. The English FAQ’s 35 boundary excludes starts allowed by the ordinary 45 rule. The 27th amendment made the 45 rule applicable from 1August 2022; no saved older approval-period rule justifies 35 for a new 2026 Master.
bafoeg-mvp-bb-ost-brandenburg-age.example: Hypothetical: a 40-year-old begins a qualifying full-time Master’s in 2026 with a qualifying Bachelor and no disqualifying further degree. The ordinary age condition is met. Assume the other course, personal and means-test requirements are satisfied; this example does not guarantee a payment. The English page says funding is excluded because 35 was reached.
bafoeg-mvp-bb-ost-brandenburg-age.context: Current German BAföG page directly links its English version; both originals captured. German equivalent says 45. Finding concerns outdated English wording still offered as current guidance; language versions are one institution and drafting origin.
bafoeg-mvp-bb-ost-brandenburg-age.scope: Only ordinary age condition at start of a new 2026 domestic higher-education Master. English version still 35 while German version 45. General eligibility requirements, statutory exceptions and individualized means testing remain applicable; no actual refusal or loss alleged. Essential qualifications are included here because separate context quotes are not relied on for display. The currently linked January 2025 DSW flyer says applicants may be no older than 44 at study start, which correctly means before turning 45, and mentions exceptions. This is additional current counterguidance to the English Master-age 35 statement.

bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.src: Information on BAföG (English navigation route serving German guidance)
bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.claim: retains an unavoidable-reason requirement from semester 4 on its English navigation route.
bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.quote:
Sofern Sie feststellen, dass der gewählte Studiengang nicht Ihren Neigungen und Interessen entspricht oder Leistungsprobleme auftreten, sollten Sie unverzüglich den Studiengang wechseln, da sonst der Anspruch auf Leistungen nach dem BAföG verloren werden kann.
Während der ersten zwei Semester muss bei einem ersten Fachrichtungswechsel noch keine Begründung vorgelegt werden, da ein wichtiger Grund für den Wechsel angenommen wird.
Bei einem zweiten Wechsel des Studienganges oder einem Wechsel nach Beginn des dritten Fachsemesters ist eine schriftliche Begründung einzureichen. Wichtige anzuerkennende Gründe für einen Fachrichtungswechsel sind ein Neigungs- und / oder Interessenwandel oder Leistungsprobleme.
Nach Beginn des vierten Fachsemesters ist ein Fachrichtungswechsel ohne Verlust des BAföG-Anspruchs nur unter Nachweis eines unabweisbaren Grundes möglich. Unabweisbar ist ein Grund, der eine Wahl zwischen der Fortsetzung der bisherigen Ausbildung und ihrem Abbruch oder dem Wechsel aus der bisherigen Fachrichtung nicht zulässt. Ein unabweisbarer Grund ist z.B. eine unerwartete – etwa als Unfallfolge eingetretene – Behinderung oder Allergie gegen bestimmte Stoffe, die die Ausbildung oder die Ausübung des bisher angestrebten Berufs unmöglich macht. Das endgültige Nichtbestehen der Zwischen- oder Abschlussprüfung ist kein unabweisbarer Grund.
Werden bei einem Fachrichtungswechsel bereits erbrachte Leistungen auf den neuen Studiengang angerechnet und es erfolgt eine Einstufung in ein höheres als das erste Fachsemester, wird dies bei der Bestimmung des Zeitpunktes des Fachrichtungswechsels nach dem BAföG berücksichtigt.
Lassen Sie sich dazu von Ihrem/Ihrer Sachbearbeiter*in beraten.
Bei einem Abbruch eines früheren Studienganges gilt das gleiche Prinzip wie bei einem Fachrichtungswechsel.
bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.tr:
If you discover that the chosen course does not suit your inclinations and interests or that you have performance problems, you should change courses promptly, otherwise entitlement to BAföG may be lost.
For a first subject change during the first two semesters, no explanation need yet be submitted, as an important reason for the change is assumed.
For a second course change or a change after the start of the third subject semester, a written explanation must be submitted. Recognized important reasons for changing subject include a change of inclination and/or interest or performance problems.
After the start of the fourth subject semester, changing subject without losing BAföG entitlement is possible only on proof of an unavoidable reason. A reason is unavoidable if it leaves no choice between continuing the previous course and abandoning it or changing the previous subject. An unavoidable reason includes, for example, an unexpected disability—such as following an accident—or an allergy to certain substances that makes the course or intended profession impossible. Definitively failing the intermediate or final examination is not an unavoidable reason.
If previously completed work is credited to the new course and the student is placed in a higher than first subject semester, this is considered when determining the time of the subject change under BAföG.
Seek advice from your caseworker.
Abandoning an earlier course follows the same principle as changing subject.
bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.law: BAföG §7(3) permits an established important reason before the fifth subject semester begins, and normally presumes it for a first change before the fourth subject semester begins. Actual credited semesters are deducted; earlier changes and promptness matter. Qualifying Master courses have a separate unavoidable-reason restriction under§7(1a). §66a(8) preserves older rules for changes completed or deemed completed by the relevant semester start before 25July 2024. For a new 2026undergraduate change, the stale English-route threshold is too early.
bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.example: Hypothetical: a first Bachelor student changes in semester 4 during 2026, promptly after an established important reason, with no credited semesters or earlier changes. Lack of an unavoidable reason alone does not exclude the important-reason route. Actual funding still depends on all remaining conditions and means assessment.
bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.context: Current German page links English navigation to this exact current route, which actually serves German body text. The German navigation route has corrected before 5/before 4 wording. This is one institution and two conflicting versions, not two independent publisher findings.
bafoeg-mvp-mv-greifswald-subject.scope: Limited to the stale subject-semester cutoffs in the English navigation route's German text. The current German route correctly gives first 3 semesters presumption and unavoidable reason after semester 5begins. Credit, prior changes, promptness, applicable 2024transition and Master restrictions remain. No actual refusal or guaranteed payment inferred.

bafoeg-mvp-nw-paderborn-subject.claim: requires reasons for a routine first subject change from the third subject semester.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-paderborn-subject.quote:
Fachrichtungswechsel

Nach einem Fachrichtungswechsel wird die Förderung einer anderen Ausbildung über das BAföG nur dann gewährleistet, wenn für den Fachrichtungswechsel ein „wichtiger“ oder „unabweisbarer Grund“ besteht.

Bitte beachte hierzu unser Infoblatt.
Infoblatt – Hinweis über den Fachrichtungswechsel (PDF)

Bei einem erstmaligen Fachrichtungswechsel innerhalb der ersten beiden Fachsemester ist keine Begründung erforderlich, sondern nur eine Erklärung (PDF) über den Fachrichtungswechsel. Ab Beginn des dritten Fachsemesters und bei weiteren Wechseln ist ein Begründung erforderlich!
bafoeg-mvp-nw-paderborn-subject.tr:
Change of subject

After a change of subject, funding for another course under BAföG is ensured only if there is an important or unavoidable reason for the change.

Please see our information sheet.
Information sheet—guidance on changing subject (PDF)

For a first change of subject within the first two subject semesters, no statement of reasons is required, only a declaration (PDF) about the change. A statement of reasons is required from the beginning of the third subject semester and for further changes!
bafoeg-mvp-nw-paderborn-subject.law: BAföG §7(3) normally presumes an important reason for a first change or abandonment before the fourth subject semester begins. This is rebuttable, not a guarantee that no facts may ever need clarification. An established important reason can support a qualifying undergraduate change before semester 5 begins; actually credited semesters must be deducted. §7(1a) separately excludes the important-reason route for the relevant Master courses. §66a(8) preserves former law for specified changes completed/deemed completed at a semester beginning before 25July 2024; a new 2026 change is outside that transition.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-paderborn-subject.example: Hypothetical: a student makes their first undergraduate subject change during the third subject semester in 2026, has no credited semesters and no evidence rebutting the statutory presumption, and acts promptly. The ordinary first-change presumption remains available. The FAQ instead imposes a routine statement-of-reasons requirement from semester 3. The example establishes no guaranteed payment; all other conditions and means tests remain.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-paderborn-subject.context: The old URL redirects to the current stwpb.de BAföG page. The main FAQ still expressly requires reasons from the third semester. Current incoming links to both the August 2019 information sheet and newer first-change form are in the retained original HTML.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-paderborn-subject.scope: Limited to the routine first-change presumption for a new 2026 undergraduate change before semester 4, with no contrary evidence. Master changes, earlier changes, credited semesters and promptness can alter assessment. Current FAQ links an August 2019 leaflet repeating the old rule; the downloads section also links a newer form correctly mentioning first-three-semester presumption and before 5 important-reason route, although it contains other inconsistent timing wording. This conflicting newer form is material counterguidance; no office-wide refusal or actual loss is inferred. The older leaflet's separate before 4 important-reason cutoff is retained as a review concern, not a separately counted case.

bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-age.claim: states ordinary starting-age limits of 30 for Bachelor’s and 35 for Master’s courses.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-age.quote:
Wer wird gefördert?

Für deutsche Studierende besteht dem Grunde nach ein Rechtsanspruch auf Förderung nach dem BAföG, unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen aber auch für ausländische Studierende, z. B. Staatsangehörigkeit anderer EU-Staaten, Studierende mit Niederlassungserlaubnis oder bei langjähriger eigener Erwerbstätigkeit oder der eines Elternteils in Deutschland vor Aufnahme des Studiums.

Anspruchsberechtigt ist grundsätzlich, wer bei Beginn des Bachelorstudiums das 30. Lebensjahr bzw. das 35. Lebensjahr bei Aufnahme eines Masterstudiums noch nicht vollendet hat. Unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen kann auch ein später aufgenommenes Studium noch gefördert werden.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-age.tr:
Who receives funding?

German students have a legal entitlement in principle to support under BAföG; under certain conditions this also applies to foreign students, for example nationals of other EU states, students with a settlement permit, or where the student or a parent worked in Germany for many years before the course began.

In principle, those who have not yet reached the age of 30 when beginning a Bachelor’s course, or the age of 35 when beginning a Master’s course, are eligible. Under certain conditions, a course begun later can also still be funded.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-age.law: BAföG § 10(3) ordinarily requires the relevant educational phase, including a Bachelor’s or Master’s phase, to begin before turning 45. Turning 45 during that phase does not itself end eligibility. Statutory exceptions allow specified later starts, including qualifying later-entry qualifications, vocational admission, qualifying further training, an immediate qualifying Master after reaching 45 during the previous Bachelor, personal or family impediments and qualifying new need following a major personal change; specified exceptions require a prompt start. The 27th amendment replaced the old 30/35 boundaries from 1 August 2022. The main page therefore presents outdated ordinary boundaries for a new 2026 phase even though it acknowledges exceptions. The linked January 2025 DSW flyer correctly describes starting before 45.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-age.example: Hypothetical: a 40-year-old begins a first qualifying domestic Bachelor’s course in October 2026. The ordinary age condition is met without needing an age exception. Assume the other personal, course and means-test requirements are satisfied; payment is not guaranteed. The quoted main-page rule instead puts this person outside its ordinary 30-year limit.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-age.context: Current main BAföG page, not labelled historical. The same page currently links a January 2025 DSW BAföG flyer with the correct age rule. The 2024/25 reform page addresses other changes but does not correct the main page’s 30/35 age wording. These conflicting publications are retained.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-age.scope: Only the ordinary starting-age boundary for a new domestic higher-education phase in 2026. The passage’s express possibility of later funding is preserved. Statutory exceptions remain conditional, and eligibility does not guarantee payment. This is a publication finding, with no claim about actual administrative decisions. Shared DSW flyer is counterevidence, not a separate institution or additional case. The January 2025 DSW flyer linked from this same current page correctly says before 45. The finding concerns the main page’s contrary ordinary 30/35 statement.

bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-subject.claim: states the old important-reason limit before semester four and requires reasons after semester three begins.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-subject.quote:
Für eine andere Ausbildung nach einem Fachrichtungswechsel wird gem. § 7 Abs. 3 BAföG
Ausbildungsförderung nur geleistet, wenn der/die Auszubildende

1.          aus wichtigem Grund (gilt nur bis zum Beginn des 4. Fachsemesters) oder
2.          aus unabweisbarem Grund

die Ausbildung abgebrochen oder die Fachrichtung gewechselt hat.

Das gilt auch dann, wenn vor dem Abbruch der bisherigen Ausbildung oder dem Wechsel der
Fachrichtung Ausbildungsförderung nicht geleistet wurde.

Für die Anzeige eines Fachrichtungswechsels hält Ihr/e Sachbearbeiter/in einen Erklärungsvordruck
bereit. Die Anzeige kann aber auch formlos erfolgen.

Bei einem Fachrichtungswechsel nach Beginn des 3. Fachsemesters und einem zweiten Fachwechsel
wird eine ausführliche schriftliche Begründung benötigt.

Ein erstmaliger Fachrichtungswechsel oder Ausbildungsabbruch bis zum Beginn des 3. Fachsemesters
oder bei Vorliegen eines wichtigen Grundes nach Beginn des 3. Fachsemesters hat keine
Auswirkungen auf die Förderungsart für den neuen Studiengang.

Ein mehrmaliger Fachrichtungswechsel kann jedoch Auswirkungen auf die Förderungsart für die
andere Ausbildung haben. Für die ab dem zweiten Fachrichtungswechsel verlorenen Semester (volle
Verwaltungssemester) kommt die Gewährung von Ausbildungsförderung nur in Form zinslosen
Staatsdarlehens in Betracht (§ 17 Abs. 3 Nr. 2) BAföG). Bei mehrmaligem Fachrichtungswechsel bleibt
der erstmalige Fachrichtungswechsel aus wichtigem Grund für die Berechnung der Dauer der
Normalförderung unberücksichtigt.

Die Förderungssemester mit zinslosen Staatsdarlehen liegen am Ende der Förderungszeit vor dem
Erreichen der Förderungshöchstdauer. Bei einem Fachrichtungswechsel aus unabweisbaren Gründen
wird die Ausbildungsförderung für die volle Förderungshöchstdauer der anderen Ausbildung in Form

bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-subject.tr:
For a different course following a change of subject, § 7(3) BAföG provides support only if the trainee

1. for an important reason (applies only until the beginning of the fourth subject semester), or
2. for an unavoidable reason,

has abandoned the course or changed subject.

This also applies if no educational support was received before abandoning the previous course or changing subject.

Your caseworker has a declaration form for reporting a change of subject. The report can also be made informally.

A detailed written explanation is required for a change of subject after the beginning of the third subject semester and for a second change of subject.

A first change of subject or abandonment of a course up to the beginning of the third subject semester, or where there is an important reason after the beginning of the third subject semester, has no effect on the form of support for the new course.

Repeated changes of subject can, however, affect the form of support for the other course. For semesters lost from the second change of subject onwards (full administrative semesters), educational support can be granted only as an interest-free state loan (§ 17(3) no. 2 BAföG). Where there are repeated changes of subject, the first change for an important reason is disregarded when calculating the duration of normal support.

The semesters funded through an interest-free state loan come at the end of the funding period before the maximum funding duration is reached. Where the subject is changed for unavoidable reasons, educational support is granted for the full maximum funding duration of the other course as a grant and interest-free state loan.

Subject-change information (06/2019)
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-subject.law: BAföG § 7(3) permits a change for an important reason before the fifth subject semester begins. For a first change, that reason is normally presumed before the fourth begins; the presumption is rebuttable and does not guarantee payment. Semesters actually credited to the new course by the institution are deducted for both boundaries. Earlier changes and prompt action after recognising the reason require individual consideration. The important-reason route does not apply to the qualifying Master courses covered by § 7(1a), sentence 2. Under § 66a(8), the old version remains relevant to changes completed, or deemed completed, by the applicable semester start before 25 July 2024. It does not govern the new 2026 example. The current main page links this 2019 PDF as subject-change information, although the newer reform page and January 2025 DSW leaflet give the extended boundaries.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-subject.example: Hypothetical: a student first changes subject during the fourth subject semester in winter 2026, immediately after recognising and substantiating an important reason; no semesters are credited to the new Bachelor’s course. The § 7(3) important-reason route remains available because semester five has not begun. The PDF’s semester-four boundary wrongly closes that route. All other requirements and individual assessment still apply; no payment is guaranteed.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-subject.context: PDF footer says 06/2019. Current main BAföG page links it as Fachrichtungswechsel (80 KB), alongside other current procedural leaflets, without a historical-use label. Newer reform guidance on the same site correctly says first-change presumption before four and important-reason route before five; both are saved as counterevidence.
bafoeg-mvp-nw-wuppertal-subject.scope: Only obsolete semester boundaries in a leaflet currently offered for domestic higher-education subject changes. Full relevant PDF passage retains important/unavoidable reason, previous support, notification, earlier changes and funding-form qualifications. The broader claims about aid form are outside this finding. Qualifying Master changes, actually credited semesters and § 66a(8) transitions require separate treatment. The hypothetical is a new 2026 Bachelor’s change, with no credited semesters. Newer correct material is prominently disclosed; this is not a finding of an administrative refusal. For a first change before the fourth subject semester begins, the important reason is presumed only rebuttably. Previous changes, actually credited semesters and prompt action after recognising the reason matter. The PDF’s second-page administrative text likewise requires prompt action and a legally sufficient reason. The same site’s newer reform page correctly gives the before-four/before-five boundaries; this finding concerns the older leaflet still linked for use.

jobcenter-tk1.claim: gives the old 20% band alongside correct 30% guidance and a correct worked calculation.
jobcenter-tk1.quote:
Ein Grundfreibetrag von 100 Euro gilt für alle Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit. Das heißt: Jeder Bürgergeld oder Sozialgeld-Bezieher kann 100 Euro verdienen, ohne dass seine Leistung gekürzt wird. Dabei ist nicht von der Einzeleinnahme auszugehen, sondern von der Gesamtsumme aller im Monat zufließenden, anrechenbaren Einkommen. Deshalb sind auch Einkommen unter 100 Euro anzuzeigen.

Dieser Grundfreibetrag deckt alle mit der Erzielung des Einkommens verbundenen Werbungskosten ab (z.B. Beiträge zu Versicherungen oder Fahrtkosten). Erst bei einem Bruttoeinkommen von über 400 Euro monatlich können – bei Nachweisführung – höhere Aufwendungen anerkannt werden.

Übersteigt das Bruttoeinkommen 100 Euro, so werden für den Bereich von 100,01 Euro bis 520 Euro zusätzlich 20% Freibetrag gewährt (max. 84 Euro).

Übersteigt das Bruttoeinkommen auch 520 Euro, so werden für den Bereich von 520,01 Euro bis 1.000 Euro zusätzlich 30% Freibetrag gewährt (max. 144 Euro).

Übersteigt dass Bruttoeinkommen 1.000 Euro, so werden für Bürgergeldempfänger ohne Kinder für den Bereich von 1.000,01 Euro bis 1.200 Euro zusätzlich 10% Freibetrag gewährt (max. 20 Euro).

Bei Bürgergeldempfängern mit Kindern wird für ein Bruttoeinkommen über 1.000 Euro für den Bereich von 1.000,01 Euro bis 1.500 Euro zusätzlich ein Freibetrag von 10% gewährt (max. 50 Euro).

Von Bruttoeinkommen, die zwischen 100 Euro und 1.000 Euro liegen, beläuft sich der Freibetrag auf 20 Prozent. Liegt das Einkommen über 1.000 Euro, ist für den übersteigenden Betrag ein Freibetrag von 10 Prozent zu gewähren.

Bei einem Bruttoeinkommen von 1.100 Euro würde ein Bürgergeldempfänger ohne Kinder also insgesamt 338 Euro Freibetrag erhalten:

100 Euro Grundfreibetrag
84 Euro Freibetrag für Einkommen bis 520 Euro
144 Euro Freibetrag für Einkommen bis 1.000 Euro
10 Euro Freibetrag für Einkommen bis 1.200 Euro
jobcenter-tk1.tr:
A basic allowance of 100 euros applies to all income from employment. This means every Bürgergeld or Sozialgeld recipient can earn 100 euros without their benefit being reduced. The relevant figure is not an individual receipt but the total of all countable income received in the month. Income below 100 euros must therefore also be reported.

This basic allowance covers all work-related expenses associated with earning the income (for example, insurance contributions or travel costs). Higher expenditure can be recognised, with evidence, only where gross monthly earnings exceed 400 euros.

If gross income exceeds 100 euros, an additional 20% allowance is granted on the portion from 100.01 to 520 euros (maximum 84 euros).

If gross income also exceeds 520 euros, an additional 30% allowance is granted on the portion from 520.01 to 1,000 euros (maximum 144 euros).

If gross income exceeds 1,000 euros, Bürgergeld recipients without children receive an additional 10% allowance on the portion from 1,000.01 to 1,200 euros (maximum 20 euros).

For Bürgergeld recipients with children and gross earnings above 1,000 euros, an additional 10% allowance is granted on the portion from 1,000.01 to 1,500 euros (maximum 50 euros).

For gross earnings between 100 and 1,000 euros, the allowance is 20 percent. If income exceeds 1,000 euros, a 10 percent allowance must be granted on the excess.

With gross earnings of 1,100 euros, a Bürgergeld recipient without children would therefore receive a total allowance of 338 euros:

100 euros basic allowance
84 euros allowance for income up to 520 euros
144 euros allowance for income up to 1,000 euros
10 euros allowance for income up to 1,200 euros
jobcenter-tk1.example: An ordinary employee aged 35 earns €900 gross a month, with the standard €100 base deduction and no special or higher deductions. The allowance is €298; the old formula gives €260. This compares deductions, not the final benefit award.
jobcenter-tk1.context: The very same page correctly lists 20% above €100 to €520, 30% above €520 to €1,000, 10% above €1,000 and a correct €338 example for €1,100 earnings. Thus this is also an internal contradiction, not a claim that all numerical guidance on the page is wrong.
jobcenter-tk1.scope: Current statutory text rechecked through the official law site's indexed full text on 17 October 2026. Special §11b(2b) education/volunteer rules excluded from hypothetical example.

jobcenter-rastatt-earnings.claim: says 20% stays free on all earnings from €100 to €1,000.
jobcenter-rastatt-earnings.quote: Grundsätzlich gilt: Je höher Ihr Verdienst aus einem Arbeitsverhältnis ist, desto höher ist der Freibetrag. Die ersten 100 Euro sind anrechnungsfrei. Der Verdienst zwischen 100 und 1.000 Euro bleibt um 20 % anrechnungsfrei, zwischen 1.000 und 1.200 Euro (1.500 bei Personen mit Kindern) bleiben weitere 10 % anrechnungsfrei.
jobcenter-rastatt-earnings.tr: As a rule, the higher your earnings from employment, the higher the allowance. The first 100 euros are exempt. Earnings between 100 and 1,000 euros remain 20% exempt; between 1,000 and 1,200 euros (1,500 for people with children), a further 10% remains exempt.
jobcenter-rastatt-earnings.example: An ordinary employee aged 35 earns €900 gross a month, with the standard €100 base deduction and no special or higher deductions. The allowance is €298; the old formula gives €260. This compares deductions, not the final benefit award.
jobcenter-rastatt-earnings.context: The answer begins with the principle that larger earnings generate a larger allowance, gives the €100 base deduction, the obsolete 20% band and the 10% upper band, then an example at €450 and an obligation to report income. Nothing in the complete answer limits it to pre-July-2023 law or provides the current 30% band. The €450 example's €170 allowance is correct for that income and does not test the affected €520–€1,000 slice. The current homepage has a June 2026 reform item, so the overall website is maintained. The FAQ collection still contains older ALG-II terminology, but the answer is currently offered through the main FAQ navigation rather than labelled archived.
jobcenter-rastatt-earnings.scope: For the ordinary employed claimant, 30% of monthly gross earnings above €520 and through €1,000 is deducted in addition to the applicable base deduction. The €100–€520 slice remains 20%. 2023-07-01; retained in current October 2026 version

jobcenter-st-jc-01.claim: says 20% stays free on all earnings from €100 to €1,000.
jobcenter-st-jc-01.quote: Grundsätzlich gilt: Die ersten 100 Euro sind immer anrechnungsfrei. Außerdem wird für Erwerbstätige ein Freibetrag bei Erwerbstätigkeit abgesetzt. Über 100 Euro monatlich hinausgehendes Bruttoeinkommen bis 1.000 Euro monatlich ist zu 20 Prozent anrechnungsfrei. Weiteres Bruttoeinkommen bis 1.200 Euro monatlich wird noch zu 10 Prozent anrechnungsfrei gestellt. Für Beschäftigte mit Kindern beträgt die Grenze 1.500 Euro. Zusätzlich können bei Erwerbseinkommen über 400 Euro nach § 11b Absatz 2 SGB II weitere Beträge abgesetzt werden, wenn die notwendigen Aufwendungen für die Erwerbstätigkeit 100 Euro übersteigen und nachgewiesen werden. Durch die Arbeitslosengeld II Verordnung (AlgIIV) werden einige der Absetzbeträge, z. B. Fahrtkosten zur Arbeitsstätte pauschaliert.
jobcenter-st-jc-01.tr: As a rule, the first 100 euros are always exempt. An employment allowance is also deducted for people in work. Gross monthly earnings above 100 euros and up to 1,000 euros are 20 percent exempt. Further gross earnings up to 1,200 euros per month are still 10 percent exempt. For employees with children, the limit is 1,500 euros. In addition, for earnings above 400 euros, further amounts may be deducted under section 11b(2) SGB II if necessary work-related expenses exceed 100 euros and are proven. The Unemployment Benefit II Regulation (AlgIIV) sets flat rates for some deductions, for example travel costs to the workplace.
jobcenter-st-jc-01.example: An ordinary employee aged 35 earns €900 gross a month, with the standard €100 base deduction and no special or higher deductions. The allowance is €298; the old formula gives €260. This compares deductions, not the final benefit award.
jobcenter-st-jc-01.context: The page explicitly credits the BMAS FAQ dated January 2018. The live Bürgergeld menu nevertheless links the exact FAQ as Was muss ich wissen? outside an archive section. The body retains ALG II language and old examples. The finding concerns current supply of that dated text; no actual administrative practice is inferred.
jobcenter-st-jc-01.scope: The ordinary employed adult aged 25 or older and the €520–€1,000 earnings slice only. The source is January 2018 BMAS-derived FAQ text currently supplied through the live Bürgergeld menu. Special under-25 education and voluntary-service cases and actual administrative practice are outside the finding.

jobcenter-ni-jc-01.claim: states a €520 base deduction for qualifying under-25 pupils and trainees, rather than the 2026 linked €603 amount.
jobcenter-ni-jc-01.quote:
Sollten Sie noch keine 25 Jahre alt sein und in Schul- oder Berufsausbildung stehen, profitieren Sie von einem Grundfreibetrag von 520 €, d.h. dieser Betrag wird nicht auf Ihre Leistungen angerechnet, egal ob Sie alleine leben oder noch im elterlichen Haushalt.

Für Schüler, die im Rahmen eines Ferienjobs Einkommen erzielen, gilt ab dem 01.07.2023, dass dieser Verdienst gar nicht auf die Leistungen angerechnet wird.
jobcenter-ni-jc-01.tr:
If you are not yet 25 and are in school or vocational training, you benefit from a basic allowance of €520; this means the amount is not counted against your benefits, regardless of whether you live alone or still in your parents' household.

For pupils earning income from a holiday job, from 1 July 2023 these earnings are not counted against benefits at all.
jobcenter-ni-jc-01.law: For the eligible under-25 groups in §11b(2b), the base deduction is linked to the minijob threshold: €603 in 2026. Further deductions and the school-holiday exclusion are separate.
jobcenter-ni-jc-01.example: An otherwise eligible 19-year-old general-school pupil earns €603 monthly outside school holidays. The base deduction is €603, compared with the page's €520; this €83 base difference is not a calculation of the final award.
jobcenter-ni-jc-01.context: Current page refers to Grundsicherungsgeld and sits under Geld - NEU. It gives a 2023 earnings change, a €520 under-25 school/training base disregard, first-year assets €40,000 plus €15,000 per additional person, and a general €15,000 asset allowance. Nearby navigation also offers Neue Grundsicherung. No explicit sunset for the stated figures. Generic statement says the Jobcenter decides under law; that is preserved as context. The directly linked Neue Grundsicherung companion explicitly supplies the new asset amounts and removal of the asset Karenzzeit; it does not discuss the under-25 earnings base. Both pages remain supplied.
jobcenter-ni-jc-01.scope: An otherwise eligible under-25 general-school pupil working outside school holidays in 2026. No assertion that all students or trainees qualify for ordinary benefits, or that all young workers receive this allowance.

jobcenter-be-c1.claim: says benefits start on the day you apply.
jobcenter-be-c1.quote:
Diese Leistung muss beantragt werden. Anträge können schriftlich oder mündlich gestellt werden. Erforderliche Unterlagen sind ggf. nachzureichen. Der Anspruch auf Leistung beginnt mit dem Tag der Antragstellung.

Der Antrag für einen gemeinsamen Haushalt gilt für alle Mitglieder dieser Bedarfsgemeinschaft (z.B. Ehegatten und Kinder).
jobcenter-be-c1.tr:
This benefit must be applied for. Applications can be made in writing or orally. Required documents may be submitted later. Entitlement to benefit begins on the day the application is made.

An application for a shared household applies to all members of that benefit unit (for example, spouses and children).
jobcenter-be-c1.example: Someone eligible throughout October applies for ordinary living-cost support on 20 October without requesting a later start. The application normally takes effect from 1 October.
jobcenter-be-c1.context: The paragraph says the benefit must be applied for, applications may be written or oral, and necessary documents may be submitted later. No first-of-month correction appears in the remaining benefits explanation.
jobcenter-be-c1.scope: Current statutory text rechecked 17 October 2026. The general first-of-month rule has applied since 1 January 2011; official Jobcenter Wuppertal legal work aid corroborates the historic start date.

jobcenter-m-c1.claim: says you can keep €40,000 in your first year.
jobcenter-m-c1.quote: Nein, Sie müssen Ihre Ersparnisse nicht vollständig aufbrauchen. Im ersten Jahr des Grundsicherungsbezug dürfen Sie 40.000 € behalten und Personen in Ihrem Haushalt können 15.000 € behalten. Dazu zählen verwertbares Vermögen im In- sowie Ausland, wie z.B. Bargeld und verfügbare Mittel auf Girokonten, Sparbüchern aber auch Schmuck, Aktien oder Lebensversicherungen. Selbstgenutztes Wohneigentum ist in der Regel nicht sofort verwertbar und wird daher nicht als erhebliches Vermögen gewertet. Auch Vermögen, das der Altersvorsorge dient (insbesondere Kapitallebensversicherungen und Kapitalrentenversicherungen), sind kein erhebliches Vermögen, das gilt unabhängig vom Wert.
jobcenter-m-c1.tr: No, you do not have to use up all your savings. In the first year of receiving basic income support, you may keep €40,000 and people in your household may keep €15,000. This includes realisable assets in Germany and abroad, such as cash and available funds in current and savings accounts, but also jewellery, shares and life insurance. Owner-occupied residential property is generally not immediately realisable and is therefore not counted as substantial assets. Assets serving as retirement provision (particularly endowment life insurance and capital-funded pension insurance) are also not substantial assets, irrespective of their value.
jobcenter-m-c1.example: A single 35-year-old starts a new approval period in October 2026 with €20,000 of ordinary accessible bank savings and no separate asset protection. The ordinary allowance is €10,000, rather than the old first-year €40,000 threshold.
jobcenter-m-c1.context: Savings need not always be exhausted: protected categories and households still matter. Older approval periods are specifically exempted by transition.
jobcenter-m-c1.scope: Current §12 applies to approval periods beginning 1 July 2026 or later. Old first-year treatment can still apply to earlier-starting periods under §65a(1).

jobcenter-mainz-savings.quote: Ab dem 1. Januar 2023 wird mit der Grundsicherung eine Karenzzeit für Vermögen für die ersten 12 Monate eingeführt. Das bedeutet: Vermögen ist erheblich, wenn es für die erste in der Bedarfsgemeinschaft (BG) lebende Person 40.000 € und für jede weitere Person in der BG 15.000 € übersteigt. Neben der Erklärung, dass kein erhebliches Vermögen vorhanden ist, ist die Vorlage einer Selbstauskunft Anlage_VM erforderlich. Selbst genutztes Wohneigentum (Hausgrundstück, Eigentumswohnung) bleibt bei der Ermittlung des erheblichen Vermögens bei angemessener Größe unberücksichtigt
jobcenter-mainz-savings.tr: From 1 January 2023, basic income support introduces a grace period for assets for the first 12 months. This means: assets are substantial if they exceed €40,000 for the first person in the benefit unit (BG) and €15,000 for each further person in the BG. In addition to declaring that no substantial assets exist, an asset declaration, Anlage_VM, must be submitted. Owner-occupied residential property (a house and plot or condominium) of an appropriate size is disregarded when determining substantial assets
jobcenter-mainz-savings.example: A single 35-year-old starts a new approval period in October 2026 with €20,000 of ordinary accessible bank savings and no separate asset protection. The ordinary allowance is €10,000, rather than the old first-year €40,000 threshold.
jobcenter-mainz-savings.context: Full page checked. The assets section introduces the January 2023 grace period for the first 12 months, defines substantial assets using €40,000/€15,000, requests the VM asset declaration and mentions owner-occupied housing. No new age-based regime, §65a transition or old-cohort restriction appears in the passage or elsewhere on the page. The homepage announces that rules change from 1 July 2026 and links the BMAS reform FAQ, which correctly describes age-based allowances. That general link is useful but does not qualify or correct the detailed local assets page itself. The old rule remains applicable to certain earlier-starting approval periods under §65a(1); those cases are not treated as errors.
jobcenter-mainz-savings.scope: For a 35-year-old living alone with an approval period beginning on or after 1 July 2026, the ordinary age-based assets allowance is €10,000, without the old one-year cash-assets grace period. Other protected asset categories under §12(1) remain separate. Unused allowances can transfer within a benefit household. 2026-07-01 for the new regime; §65a(1) preserves old §12 for approval periods that began before 1 July 2026 until the period ends.

jobcenter-m-c2.claim: says help is only available for your first own home.
jobcenter-m-c2.quote:
Ich ziehe um. Kann ich finanzielle Unterstützung für die Wohnungseinrichtung bekommen?

Eine Hilfe hierfür können Sie nur bekommen, wenn Sie das erste Mal in eine eigene Wohnung ziehen. Schreiben Sie genau auf, welche Möbel oder Haushaltsgeräte Sie dringend brauchen und warum Sie diese brauchen. Das Jobcenter prüft dann, für was eine sogenannte „Einmalige Beihilfe“ gezahlt werden kann. Bitte denken Sie auch an die Mietobergrenze:
https://stadt.muenchen.de/infos/mietobergrenzen.html
jobcenter-m-c2.tr:
I am moving. Can I receive financial support for furnishing my home?

You can receive help for this only if you are moving into a home of your own for the first time. Write down precisely which furniture or household appliances you urgently need and why. The Jobcenter then examines what a so-called ‘one-off grant’ can be paid for. Please also remember the rent ceiling:
https://stadt.muenchen.de/infos/mietobergrenzen.html
jobcenter-m-c2.example: A pregnant claimant leaves a furnished shared home after separation without essential household items. A qualifying initial need can be assessed despite her previous home, subject to means and any required move approval.
jobcenter-m-c2.context: Full p4 continues with the need to list items and explain urgent need and says Jobcenter examines payment; these do not undo the preceding categorical only-first-home condition. Pages2–3 correctly permit baby/pregnancy one-off help without ordinary monthly benefits. Under25 cases may require housing approval under §24(6)/§22(5); findings do not disregard this.
jobcenter-m-c2.scope: Applies under current §24; same substantive initial-equipment rule also applied in June2025. No birth-date or first-home transitional exception identified.

jobcenter-jcx-03.claim: says you must be unable to cover your living costs for the next six months.
jobcenter-jcx-03.quote:
Voraussetzungen

Sie sind erwerbsfähig.

Sie können Ihren Lebensunterhalt momentan und auch in den nächsten 6 Monaten wahrscheinlich nicht finanziell decken.

Fristen

Stellen Sie den Antrag, bevor Sie die Anschaffungen tätigen, da einmalige Leistungen nur erbracht werden, wenn der Bedarf noch nicht gedeckt ist.
jobcenter-jcx-03.tr:
Conditions

You are capable of working.

You cannot financially cover your living costs at present and probably will not be able to do so over the next 6 months either.

Deadlines

Submit the application before making the purchases, because one-off benefits are provided only if the need has not yet been met.
jobcenter-jcx-03.example: A pregnant applicant can cover rent and food but cannot meet a qualifying initial need for baby clothes. Ongoing ordinary living-cost need is not required, though resources and the other statutory conditions must still be assessed.
jobcenter-jcx-03.context: Possible consideration of future income is different from a requirement for six months of continuing ordinary living-cost need. Opening description says previous receipt is immaterial, which does not expressly resolve present ongoing-need eligibility. This is a shared service-text appearance, not independently authored local advice or proof of local adjudication practice.

jobcenter-jcx-01.claim: caps pupils’ holiday-job earnings at €2,400 a year.
jobcenter-jcx-01.quote: Schüler unter 25 Jahren, die in einer Bedarfsgemeinschaft leben und Arbeitslosengeld II erhalten, dürfen im Rahmen von Ferienjobs bis zu 2.400 Euro kalenderjährlich anrechnungsfrei hinzuverdienen. Voraussetzung ist, dass der Job nur in den Ferien ausgeübt wird. Außerdem dürfen sie in dieser Zeit keinen Anspruch auf Ausbildungsvergütung haben. Für den Rest des Jahres außerhalb der Ferienzeit gilt der Grundfreibetrag von 100 Euro pro Monat , den alle Empfänger der Grundsicherung erhalten. Das bedeutet: Ein Schüler aus einer Familie mit Arbeitslosengeld II darf also außerhalb der Ferienzeit monatlich 100 Euro anrechnungsfrei hinzuverdienen und dazu im Kalenderjahr nochmals 2.400 Euro für den Ferienjob. Erst wenn das Schüler-Einkommen diesen Freibetrag übersteigt, wird es bei der Berechnung der staatlichen Grundsicherung berücksichtigt.
jobcenter-jcx-01.tr: Pupils under 25 who live in a benefit unit and receive Unemployment Benefit II may earn up to 2,400 euros per calendar year from holiday jobs without it being counted. The job must be performed only during the holidays. They must also have no entitlement to training remuneration during this period. For the rest of the year outside the holidays, the basic allowance of 100 euros per month received by all recipients of basic income support applies. This means: a pupil from a family receiving Unemployment Benefit II may therefore earn 100 euros per month outside the holidays without it being counted, plus another 2,400 euros in the calendar year for the holiday job. Only when the pupil's earnings exceed this allowance are they taken into account in calculating state basic income support.
jobcenter-jcx-01.example: An eligible 17-year-old general-school pupil earns €3,000 from a school-holiday job, with no contractual training remuneration. Those earnings are excluded under §11a(7), without the stated €2,400 ceiling.
jobcenter-jcx-01.context: For a qualifying pupil's EUR3,000 holiday earnings the stated EUR2,400 ceiling wrongly implies part is countable. This is a rule-level contradiction, not evidence of an actual incorrect award. Only pupil holiday earnings under section 11a(7). Do not conflate employment-law time limits with the income exemption. Page's other obsolete claims are not separately adjudicated.
jobcenter-jcx-01.scope: Only pupil holiday earnings under section 11a(7). Do not conflate employment-law time limits with the income exemption. Page's other obsolete claims are not separately adjudicated.

jobcenter-jcx-02.claim: says support is for people aged 15 to under 65.
jobcenter-jcx-02.quote:
Anspruch haben alle erwerbsfähigen leistungsberechtigten Personen im Alter von 15 bis unter 65 Jahren, wenn sie sich gewöhnlich in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland aufhalten und ihren Bedarf nicht aus eigenen Einkommen oder Vermögen decken können.

Erwerbsfähigkeit liegt dann vor, wenn du nicht wegen Krankheit oder Behinderung außerstande bist, mindestens drei Stunden unter den üblichen Bedingungen des Arbeitsmarktes tätig zu sein. Nicht erwerbsfähige Personen, die mit anspruchsberechtigten Antragstellern in einer Bedarfsgemeinschaft zusammenleben, erhalten Sozialgeld.

Du musst deinen gewöhnlichen Aufenthalt in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland haben. Als Ausländer kannst du Grundsicherungsgeld erhalten, wenn dir die Aufnahme einer Beschäftigung erlaubt ist oder diese Erlaubnis möglich wäre, und du dich nicht nur zum Zweck der Arbeitssuche in Deutschland aufhältst (diese Ausnahme gilt dann auch für die Familienangehörigen). Bist du nach § 1 Asylbewerberleistungsgesetz anspruchsberechtigt, so schließt das Ansprüche nach dem SGB II aus.
jobcenter-jcx-02.tr:
All people capable of work and entitled to benefits aged 15 to under 65 are eligible if they habitually reside in the Federal Republic of Germany and cannot cover their needs from their own income or assets.

You are capable of work if illness or disability does not prevent you from working at least three hours under the usual conditions of the labour market. People unable to work who live in a benefit unit with eligible applicants receive Sozialgeld.

You must habitually reside in the Federal Republic of Germany. As a foreign national, you can receive basic income support if taking up employment is permitted or permission would be possible, and you are not in Germany solely to seek work (this exclusion then also applies to family members). If you are eligible under section 1 of the Asylum Seekers Benefits Act, this excludes entitlement under SGB II.
jobcenter-jcx-02.example: An otherwise eligible 65-year-old born in 1961, receiving no old-age pension and with no other exclusion, remains below the SGB II age boundary. The page's under-65 description could suggest otherwise.
jobcenter-jcx-02.context: An otherwise eligible 65-year-old born in 1961 has not reached that age boundary. The published age description can prematurely exclude them. All other eligibility requirements remain; receipt of an old-age pension can exclude benefits under section 7(4). This is an explicit scope extension beyond the earlier ten-question panel, not a retroactive change to that panel's results.
jobcenter-jcx-02.scope: All other eligibility requirements remain; receipt of an old-age pension can exclude benefits under section 7(4). This is an explicit scope extension beyond the earlier ten-question panel, not a retroactive change to that panel's results.
