jobcenter-maerkischer-kreis-old-leaflet-.quote:
9.2 Welche Beträge können vom Einkommen abgezogen werden?

Anhand des von Ihnen angegebenen Einkommens ermittelt Ihr Jobcenter die hiervon abzuziehenden Absetzungs- und Freibeträge und errechnet so Ihr anzurechnendes Einkommen.

Je nach Einkommensart und Einkommenshöhe werden verschiedene Absetzungs- und Freibeträge sowie Ausgaben vom Einkommen abgezogen.

Vom Einkommen abzuziehende Beträge und Freibeträge sind unter anderem:
• die darauf entfallenden Steuern,
• Pflichtbeiträge zur gesetzlichen Sozialversicherung,
• gesetzlich vorgeschriebene und angemessene private Versicherungen,
• nach Einkommenssteuergesetz geförderte Beiträge zur Altersvorsorge,
• Werbungskosten (z. B. Fahrkosten, doppelte Haushaltsführung),
• Aufwendungen zur Erfüllung gesetzlicher Unterhaltspflichten,
• Freibeträge bei Erwerbstätigkeit.

ZUSAMMENFASSUNG
Die Ermittlung der Absetzbeträge bei der Einkommensberechnung erfolgt immer individuell.

Ihr Freibetrag bei Erwerbstätigkeit:
Wenn Sie aus einer Erwerbstätigkeit Einkommen erzielen, wird dieses grundsätzlich auf die Grundsicherungsleistungen angerechnet.

Die Freibeträge sorgen aber dafür, dass Sie am Ende mehr Geld zur Verfügung haben als ohne Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit.

Wichtig:
Für die Höhe Ihres Freibetrags ist das Bruttoeinkommen (Einkommen vor Steuern und Abgaben) entscheidend.
• Die ersten 100 Euro aus Erwerbseinkommen werden nicht angerechnet (Grundabsetzungsbetrag).
• Zusätzlich bleiben 20 % des über 100 Euro bis einschließlich 1.000 Euro liegenden Teils des Bruttoeinkommens anrechnungsfrei.
• Zusätzlich zu den beiden anderen Beträgen werden 10 % von Ihrem Bruttolohn über 1.000 Euro bis zur Verdienstobergrenze nicht angerechnet. Bei Leistungsberechtigten ohne Kind liegt die Verdienstobergrenze bei einem Bruttoeinkommen von 1.200 Euro, bei Leistungsberechtigten, die mit mindestens einem minderjährigen Kind in Bedarfsgemeinschaft leben, bei 1.500 Euro.

BEISPIEL
Sie erzielen Einkünfte in Höhe von 1.900 Euro brutto. Angenommen, nach Abzug von Steuern und Sozialversicherungsbeiträgen würden 1.500 Euro verbleiben.
Davon bleiben frei: 100 €
von 100 bis 1.000 Euro = 900 Euro bleiben zusätzlich 20 % frei = 180 €
von 1.000 bis 1.200 Euro = 200 Euro bleiben nochmals 10 % frei = 20 €
Zusammen bleiben anrechnungsfrei: 300 €
Haben Sie ein minderjähriges Kind, kommen maximal nochmals 30 Euro Freibetrag hinzu (von 1.200 bis 1.500 Euro)

BEISPIEL
Üben Sie eine geringfügige Beschäftigung aus (bis 450 Euro), dann zahlen Sie in der Regel keine Steuern und Sozialversicherungsbeiträge.

Vom Einkommen können dann abgezogen werden:
Der Grundabsetzungsbetrag von 100 €
dazu 20 % von verbleibenden 350 Euro 70 €
Zusammen bleiben anrechnungsfrei 170 €
jobcenter-maerkischer-kreis-old-leaflet-.tr:
9.2 Which amounts can be deducted from income?

Using the income you have declared, your Jobcenter determines the deductions and allowances and calculates your countable income.

Different deductions, allowances and expenses are deducted depending on the type and amount of income.

Amounts and allowances deducted from income include:
• taxes payable on it,
• compulsory statutory social-insurance contributions,
• legally required and reasonable private insurance,
• retirement-provision contributions subsidised under income tax law,
• work-related expenses (for example travel costs and maintaining two households),
• expenditure to meet statutory maintenance obligations,
• employment allowances.

SUMMARY
Deductions in the income calculation are always determined individually.

Your employment allowance:
If you earn employment income, it is generally counted against basic-security benefits.

However, the allowances ensure you have more money available than without employment income.

Important:
Your gross income (income before taxes and contributions) determines your allowance.
• The first 100 euros of employment income are not counted (basic deduction).
• An additional 20% of the portion of gross income above 100 euros through and including 1,000 euros is disregarded.
• In addition to the other two amounts, 10% of your gross pay above 1,000 euros up to the earnings ceiling is not counted. For beneficiaries without a child, the ceiling is gross income of 1,200 euros; for beneficiaries living in a benefit household with at least one minor child, it is 1,500 euros.

EXAMPLE
You earn gross income of 1,900 euros. Assume 1,500 euros remain after taxes and social-insurance contributions.
Of that, the following is exempt: €100
From 100 through 1,000 euros = 900 euros, an additional 20% is exempt = €180
From 1,000 through 1,200 euros = 200 euros, another 10% is exempt = €20
Total exempt: €300
If you have a minor child, up to another 30 euros of allowance is added (from 1,200 through 1,500 euros).

EXAMPLE
If you have marginal employment (up to 450 euros), you generally pay no taxes or social-insurance contributions.

The following can then be deducted from income:
The basic deduction of €100
Plus 20% of the remaining 350 euros: €70
Total exempt: €170
jobcenter-maerkischer-kreis-old-leaflet-.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, §11b(3) disregards 30% of the gross monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The lower slice above €100 through €520 retains 20%; the upper slice and the standard €100 deduction are separate. Taxes, mandatory contributions, eligible expenses and special pupil/training rules are also separate. The quoted 20% band incorrectly includes the €520–€1,000 slice.
jobcenter-maerkischer-kreis-old-leaflet-.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed claimant aged 30 earns €1,000 gross monthly. Before separately applicable deductions, the statutory employment disregard is €100 + 20%×€420 + 30%×€480 = €328. Applying the page’s 20% to the entire €100–€1,000 slice produces €280, a €48 difference. Neither amount alone determines the final benefit award.
jobcenter-maerkischer-kreis-old-leaflet-.context: Current local benefits page announces the July 2026 reform and directly offers this old BA leaflet as detailed benefit information, without restricting its use to a historical claim period. The original local PDF is live; BA’s former canonical URL now fails, so no identity of bytes is inferred from that dead URL.
jobcenter-maerkischer-kreis-old-leaflet-.scope: Only the currently offered old local mirror and the ordinary monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000 for employed claimants aged 25 or over. The January 2020 imprint is disclosed; other bands, deductions, training and pupil rules remain separate. The whole relevant income-deduction section and both its worked examples are retained. This is copied central guidance, not proof of independent local drafting or an actual calculation. The separate €450-to-€170 example is correct lower-band arithmetic and does not cure the erroneous middle-band percentage.

jobcenter-moenchengladbach-earnings-twen.claim: states a 20% earned-income disregard for the entire monthly gross band €100.01–€1,000.
jobcenter-moenchengladbach-earnings-twen.quote:
Grundsicherungsgeld (ehemals Bürgergeld) und Sozialgeld werden nur an den gezahlt, der seinen eigenen Lebensunterhalt und den der mit ihm in einer Bedarfsgemeinschaft lebenden Angehörigen aus eigener Kraft nicht oder nicht ausreichend sichern kann. Deshalb werden vor allem Einkommen und Vermögen aller Mitglieder der Bedarfsgemeinschaft unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen berücksichtigt. Zu einer Bedarfsgemeinschaft gehören neben Ihnen und Ihrem Partner Ihre unverheirateten Kinder oder die Kinder Ihres Partners oder Ihrer Partnerin bis zum 25. Lebensjahr. Deshalb werden im Antrag sowie der Einkommenserklärung und Verdienstbescheinigung auch die Einkommensverhältnisse der im Haushalt lebenden weiteren Personen erfragt.

Zum Einkommen gehören beispielsweise Einnahmen aus einer nicht selbständigen oder selbständigen Erwerbstätigkeit, Entgeltersatzleistungen wie Arbeitslosengeld oder Krankengeld, Kapital- und Zinserträge oder Einnahmen aus Vermietung und Verpachtung, Unterhaltsleistungen, Kindergeld, Renten und Einnahmen aus Aktienbesitz.
Bei erwerbsfähigen Leistungsberechtigten, die neben dem Bezug von Grundsicherungsgeld erwerbstätig sind, ist von dem um die Absetzbeträge (siehe §11b SGB II) bereinigten monatlichen Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit ein Betrag abzusetzen. Der abzusetzende Betrag vom bereinigten monatlichen Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit richtet sich nach der Höhe des Bruttoverdienstes.

Von diesem Bruttobetrag werden die entsprechenden Steuern, die Sozialversicherungsbeiträge, gesetzlich vorgeschriebene Pflichtbeiträge (Kfz-Haftpflichtversicherung) und ein angemessener Betrag für private Versicherungen (pauschal 30 Euro), Beiträge zur Riesterrente, notwendige Kosten für die Einkommenserzielung (Werbungskosten) und titulierte Unterhaltsansprüche, die tatsächlich gezahlt werden, abgezogen.

Bei Personen, die bis zu 400 Euro als Erwerbseinkommen beziehen, werden pauschal 100 Euro als Grundfreibetrag abgezogen. Höhere Beträge können nicht mindernd geltend gemacht werden. Bei Einkommen über 400 Euro können im Einzelfall aber höhere Beträge berücksichtigt werden.

Dazu kommt noch ein Freibetrag bei Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit.

Die Berechnung des Freibetrages richtet sich nach dem Bruttoeinkommen. Diese wird in zwei Schritten vorgenommen:

100,01 Euro – 1000 Euro = 20 Prozent

1000,01 Euro – 1200 Euro = 10 Prozent

Sollten in der Bedarfsgemeinschaft minderjährige Kinder leben oder hat der Einkommensbezieher außerhalb der Bedarfsgemeinschaft minderjährige Kinder, erhöht sich der Maximalbetrag auf 1500 Euro brutto im Monat. Daher wäre ein Freibetrag in Höhe von 10 Prozent für Beträge von 1000,01 bis 1500 Euro monatlich möglich.
jobcenter-moenchengladbach-earnings-twen.tr:
Basic support (formerly Bürgergeld) and social allowance are paid only to people unable, or insufficiently able, to secure their own living costs and those of relatives in their benefit unit. Income and assets of all members are therefore considered under certain conditions. In addition to you and your partner, the unit includes your unmarried children or your partner’s children up to age 25. The application, income declaration and earnings certificate therefore ask about other household members’ income.

Income includes, for example, earnings from employment or self-employment, wage-replacement benefits such as unemployment benefit or sickness benefit, capital income and interest, letting/leasing income, maintenance, child benefit, pensions and income from shares.
For employable beneficiaries working while receiving basic support, an amount is deducted from monthly earned income after deductions under §11b SGB II. This amount depends on gross earnings.

Taxes, social-insurance contributions, legally compulsory contributions (vehicle liability insurance), a reasonable private-insurance amount (a flat €30), Riester pension contributions, necessary employment expenses and actual payments of maintenance under an enforceable title are deducted from gross income.

For earned income up to €400, a flat €100 basic allowance is deducted. Higher amounts cannot be claimed. Above €400, higher deductions may be considered individually.

An additional earned-income allowance is also provided.

This allowance is calculated from gross income in two steps:

€100.01–€1,000 = 20 per cent

€1,000.01–€1,200 = 10 per cent

If minor children live in the benefit unit, or the earner has minor children outside it, the maximum increases to €1,500 gross monthly. A 10 per cent allowance is therefore possible on monthly amounts from €1,000.01 through €1,500.
jobcenter-moenchengladbach-earnings-twen.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, §11b(3) disregards 30% of the monthly gross earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The 20% rate remains correct only for the slice above €100 through €520; separate base deductions, actual expenses and special youth/student rules must be distinguished. The July 2026 reform does not restore the obsolete single 20% band.
jobcenter-moenchengladbach-earnings-twen.example: Hypothetical: a 30-year-old employed claimant earns €1,000 gross monthly, with no special disregard regime and no higher deductible expenses. The ordinary €100 base plus 20% of €420 and 30% of €480 totals €328. Applying the lexicon’s 20% across €100–€1,000 gives €280, understating the allowance by €48. Other deductions and net-income calculation remain separate.
jobcenter-moenchengladbach-earnings-twen.context: The current local benefit pages link the income lexicon through their explanation of resources. The lexicon uses the current Grundsicherungsgeld name and presents the two-step calculation without a historical period restriction. Full surrounding income definition and deductions are included. Separate linked central guidance may explain current law correctly; this is a narrow local-lexicon finding.
jobcenter-moenchengladbach-earnings-twen.scope: Ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, limited to the 30% earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The base allowance, actual expense deductions and 10% upper slice are distinct. Special student/youth regimes, other income types and other assertions in the lexicon are not separately assessed; no actual benefit calculation is inferred.

jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.pub: Jobcenter Stadt Kassel / Bundesagentur für Arbeit
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.src: BA Merkblatt Arbeitslosengeld II / Sozialgeld, January 2018, Kassel mirror
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.claim: currently offers a January 2018 central leaflet using the old 20% earnings slice up to €1,000.
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.quote:
Die Freibeträge sorgen aber dafür, dass Sie am Ende auch mehr Geld zur Verfügung haben als ohne Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit.

Wichtig: Für die Höhe Ihres Freibetrags ist das Bruttoeinkommen (Einkommen vor Steuern und Abgaben) entscheidend.
• Die ersten 100 Euro aus Erwerbseinkommen werden nicht angerechnet (Grundabsetzbetrag).
• Zusätzlich bleiben 20 % des über 100 Euro bis einschließlich 1.000 Euro liegenden Teils des Bruttoeinkommens anrechnungsfrei.
• Zusätzlich zu den beiden anderen Beträgen werden 10 % von Ihrem Bruttolohn über 1.000 Euro bis zur Verdienstobergrenze nicht angerechnet. Bei Leistungsberechtigten ohne Kind liegt die Verdienstobergrenze bei einem Bruttoeinkommen von 1.200 Euro, bei Leistungsberechtigten, die mit mindestens einem minderjährigen Kind in Bedarfsgemeinschaft leben, bei 1.500 Euro.

BEISPIEL

Sie haben 1.900 Euro Bruttoeinkommen. Angenommen, nach Abzug von Steuern und Sozialversicherungsbeiträgen würden 1.500 Euro verbleiben.

Davon bleiben frei: 100 €

von 100 bis 1.000 Euro = 900 Euro bleiben zusätzlich 20 % frei = 180 €

von 1.000 bis 1.200 Euro = 200 Euro bleiben nochmals 10 % frei = 20 €

Zusammen bleiben anrechnungsfrei: 300 €

Haben Sie ein minderjähriges Kind, kommen maximal nochmals 30 Euro Freibetrag hinzu (von 1.200 bis 1.500 Euro)
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.tr:
The allowances ensure that you have more money available in the end than without employment income.

Important: gross income (income before taxes and contributions) determines the amount of your allowance.

• The first 100 euros of employment income is not counted (basic deduction).
• In addition, 20% of the gross-income portion above 100 euros up to and including 1,000 euros remains exempt.
• In addition to the other two amounts, 10% of gross wages above 1,000 euros up to the earnings ceiling is not counted. The ceiling is 1,200 euros gross for claimants without a child, and 1,500 euros for claimants living in a benefit household with at least one minor child.

Example: You have gross income of 1,900 euros. Assume that 1,500 euros remains after taxes and social-insurance contributions.

Of this, 100 euros is exempt.
Of the 900 euros between 100 and 1,000 euros, a further 20% is exempt: 180 euros.
Of the 200 euros between 1,000 and 1,200 euros, another 10% is exempt: 20 euros.
Total exempt: 300 euros.

If you have a minor child, up to a further 30 euros of allowance is added (from 1,200 to 1,500 euros).
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, SGB II §11 b(3) uses 30% for the monthly gross-earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The base deduction, lower 20% band, upper 10% band and other expense/tax deductions are distinct.
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed 35-year-old earns €900 gross and uses the €100 base deduction with no higher or special deductions. The relevant total is €100 + €84 + €114 = €298; the old formula yields €260. This compares deductions rather than final entitlement.
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.context: Copied central BA publication hosted locally. Do not count this as an independently drafted Jobcenter policy text. Full earnings list and illustrative calculation retained; other source-era figures are outside scope.
jobcenter-kassel-stadt-earnings-old-leaf.scope: Current ordinary employed claimants aged 25 or over, only the slice above €520 through €1,000. The source is expressly dated January 2018; the current applicant page still offers it without a historical-use warning. The same site also offers BMAS A 430 with the correct July 2023 transition and 30% rule; the finding concerns the conflicting older PDF only.

jobcenter-rhein-hunsrueck-application-da.claim: says benefits generally start only on the application day in its current application glossary entry, omitting the subsistence-benefit month exception.
jobcenter-rhein-hunsrueck-application-da.quote:
Um Leistungen zu erhalten müssen Sie einen Antrag stellen.
Diese Leistungen werden grundsätzlich erst ab dem Tag der Antragstellung gezahlt.
Stellen Sie den Antrag deshalb schnellstmöglich bei Ihrem Jobcenter.
Sie können Ihren Antrag formlos, also schriftlich, online, telefonisch oder auch persönlich stellen.
Den Antrag stellen Sie auch für die mit Ihnen in der Bedarfsgemeinschaft lebenden weiteren Personen.
jobcenter-rhein-hunsrueck-application-da.tr:
To receive benefits, you must submit an application.
These benefits are generally paid only from the day of application.
Therefore submit the application to your Jobcenter as soon as possible.
You may apply informally, meaning in writing, online, by telephone or in person.
You also submit the application for the other people living with you in the benefit household.
jobcenter-rhein-hunsrueck-application-da.law: For an ordinary SGB II subsistence-benefit application, §37(2) sentence 2 normally takes the application back to the first of the application month. Eligibility still has to exist during the period concerned; §41(1) allows a proportionate award for part-month eligibility. The quoted categorical exclusion omits this same-month effect.
jobcenter-rhein-hunsrueck-application-da.example: Hypothetical: a person meets all ordinary SGB II subsistence-benefit conditions throughout October 2026 and applies on 20 October. Their application normally covers 1 October onward. The page would exclude the eligible days from 1 to 19 October. This does not guarantee payment where eligibility was absent during those days.
jobcenter-rhein-hunsrueck-application-da.context: The currently offered glossary entry contains no application-month exception. Its current glossary index repeats the claim. A separate July 2026-updated local eligibility page correctly states first-of-month effect; that contrary guidance is expressly displayed in scope. This is a discrepancy between current offered pages.
jobcenter-rhein-hunsrueck-application-da.scope: Ordinary SGB II subsistence benefits where eligibility exists during the relevant application-month days. Earlier months, SGB III insurance benefit and separately applied-for special needs are excluded. Important contrary material: the separate current local eligibility page correctly states that subsistence applications take effect from the first of the month. The finding is limited to the misleading application glossary entry and its current index excerpt; no uniform local policy or actual benefit decision is inferred.

jobcenter-koblenz-deposit-move-form.claim: describes the ordinary monthly rental-deposit loan offset as 10% rather than 5% of the applicable standard need.
jobcenter-koblenz-deposit-move-form.quote:
3d Mietkaution/Genossenschaftsanteile

Für die neue Wohnung beantrage ich die darlehensweise Gewährung der Mietkaution/Genossenschaftsanteile ja nein

Wenn ja, Höhe der Mietkaution/Genossenschaftsanteile _____________ Euro

Hinweis: Darlehen sind in monatlichen Raten von 10 Prozent der maßgebenden Regelbedarfe aller im Mietvertrag stehenden Personen nach dem Monat der Auszahlung aufzurechnen. Ein Ermessen besteht hier nicht.
jobcenter-koblenz-deposit-move-form.tr:
3 d Rental deposit/cooperative shares

For the new apartment I apply for a loan for the rental deposit/cooperative shares: yes / no.

If yes, amount of rental deposit/cooperative shares: __________ euros.

Note: loans must be offset in monthly instalments of 10% of the applicable standard needs of all persons named in the tenancy agreement after the month of payment. There is no discretion here.
jobcenter-koblenz-deposit-move-form.law: Under SGB II §42 a(2), repayment during continuing benefit receipt ordinarily uses 5% of the applicable standard need from the month following payment. Statutory exceptions and offset/sanction limits remain. Immediate maturity after benefits end or after the landlord returns the deposit is separate.
jobcenter-koblenz-deposit-move-form.example: Hypothetical: an adult single claimant continues receiving an ordinary subsistence award with a €563 standard need after a deposit loan is paid. With no statutory exception, conflicting offset or sanction, the ordinary monthly deduction is €28.15 (5%), rather than €56.30 (10%). Benefit exit and a landlord refund have not occurred.
jobcenter-koblenz-deposit-move-form.context: Current official incoming link: https://jobcenter-koblenz.de/geld/geld-zum-wohnen/. Complete relevant unit and any material qualifications are retained.
jobcenter-koblenz-deposit-move-form.scope: The current housing page links this three-page application form. The repayment statement sits directly in the rental-deposit/cooperative-share section. The page also links newer housing-cost information but no replacement 5% repayment rule was located. The finding concerns only the ordinary percentage during continuing benefit receipt; eligibility for the deposit, borrower allocation, approval conditions, statutory exceptions, other offsets/sanctions, and maturity after benefit exit or a landlord refund are separate.

jobcenter-worms-faq-earnings-twenty-perc.claim: applies 20% to the whole €100–€1,000 earnings slice in its current FAQ, including the slice where 30% applies.
jobcenter-worms-faq-earnings-twenty-perc.quote:
Ich nehme Arbeit auf. Was wird mir von meinem Verdienst abgezogen?

Grundsätzlich gilt: Je höher Ihr Verdienst aus einem Arbeitsverhältnis ist, desto höher ist der Freibetrag.

Die ersten 100 Euro sind anrechnungsfrei. Der Verdienst zwischen 100 und 1.000 Euro bleibt um 20% anrechnungsfrei, zwischen 1.000 und 1.200 Euro (1.500 Euro bei Personen mit Kindern) bleiben weitere 10% anrechnungsfrei.

Beispiel: Wenn Sie einen Mini-Job mit einem Verdienst von 450 Euro annehmen, bleiben hiervon 170 Euro anrechnungsfrei. Das heißt, Sie hätten monatlich 170 Euro mehr zur Verfügung.
jobcenter-worms-faq-earnings-twenty-perc.tr:
I am taking up work. What will be deducted from my earnings?

As a general rule, the higher your earnings from employment, the higher the allowance.

The first 100 euros are disregarded. Earnings between 100 and 1,000 euros are 20% disregarded; a further 10% of earnings between 1,000 and 1,200 euros (1,500 euros for people with children) is disregarded.

Example: If you take a mini-job earning 450 euros, 170 euros are disregarded. This means you would have 170 euros more available each month.
jobcenter-worms-faq-earnings-twenty-perc.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, §11b(3) disregards 30% of the gross monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The lower slice above €100 through €520 retains 20%; the upper slice and the standard €100 deduction are separate. Taxes, mandatory contributions, eligible expenses and special pupil/training rules are also separate. The quoted 20% band incorrectly includes the €520–€1,000 slice.
jobcenter-worms-faq-earnings-twenty-perc.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed claimant aged 30 earns €1,000 gross monthly. Before separately applicable deductions, the statutory employment disregard is €100 + 20%×€420 + 30%×€480 = €328. Applying the page’s 20% to the entire €100–€1,000 slice produces €280, a €48 difference. Neither amount alone determines the final benefit award.
jobcenter-worms-faq-earnings-twenty-perc.context: The current homepage/footer links this FAQ, which mixes older and updated terminology without limiting this earnings answer to historical claims. Full answer states no 30% middle band. The €450 example is correct lower-band arithmetic. No error is inferred merely from the benefit name or from other income bands.
jobcenter-worms-faq-earnings-twenty-perc.scope: Ordinary employed claimants aged 25 or over, monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. Other bands and deductions, special pupil/training rules and actual awards are separate. The source’s €450-to-€170 example is correct and does not reach the disputed middle slice. Correct separate central guidance reachable through the Jobcenter’s official BA entity is contrary material; this finding concerns the local FAQ only.

The first 100 euros are disregarded. Earnings between 100 and 1,000 euros are 20% disregarded; a further 10% of earnings between 1,000 and 1,200 euros (1,500 euros for people with children) is disregarded.

Example: If you take a mini-job earning 450 euros, 170 euros are disregarded. This means you would have 170 euros more available each month.

jobcenter-saarbruecken-faq-earnings-twen.claim: applies a 20% disregard to the earnings slice above €100 through €1,000, including the slice that requires 30%.
jobcenter-saarbruecken-faq-earnings-twen.quote:
Wie viel meines Erwerbseinkommens darf ich behalten?

Grundsätzlich gilt: Je höher ihr Verdienst aus einem Arbeitsverhältnis, desto höher ist der Freibetrag.

Ein Betrag von 100 Euro ist grundsätzlich anrechnungsfrei. Neben diesem Grundfreibetrag bleiben vom Bruttolohn jeweils zusätzlich frei:

bei einem Verdienst zwischen 100,01 € und 1.000,00 €  - 20%

bei einem Verdienst zwischen 1.000,01 € und 1.200,00 € (1.500 € bei Personen mit Kindern - 10%

Beispiel

Wenn Sie zum Beispiel einen Minijob mit einem Verdienst von 450 Euro annehmen, bleiben hiervon 170 Euro anrechnungsfrei. Das heißt, Sie hätten monatlich 170 Euro mehr zu Verfügung.
jobcenter-saarbruecken-faq-earnings-twen.tr:
How much of my employment income may I keep?

In principle: the higher your earnings from employment, the higher the allowance.

An amount of 100 euros is generally disregarded. In addition to this basic allowance, the following portions of gross pay are exempt:

for earnings between €100.01 and €1,000.00 — 20%

for earnings between €1,000.01 and €1,200.00 (€1,500 for people with children — 10%

Example

If, for example, you take a mini-job earning 450 euros, 170 euros is disregarded. This means you would have 170 euros more available each month.
jobcenter-saarbruecken-faq-earnings-twen.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, §11b(3) disregards 30% of the gross monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The lower slice above €100 through €520 retains 20%; the upper slice and the standard €100 deduction are separate. Taxes, mandatory contributions, eligible expenses and special pupil/training rules are also separate. The quoted 20% band incorrectly includes the €520–€1,000 slice.
jobcenter-saarbruecken-faq-earnings-twen.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed claimant aged 30 earns €1,000 gross monthly. Before separately applicable deductions, the statutory employment disregard is €100 + 20%×€420 + 30%×€480 = €328. Applying the page’s 20% to the entire €100–€1,000 slice produces €280, a €48 difference. Neither amount alone determines the final benefit award.
jobcenter-saarbruecken-faq-earnings-twen.context: Current local site navigation links this complete money-benefits FAQ. Its full ordinary employment-income question and answer include base deduction, both percentage bands and the 450-to-170 worked example. The source contains no historical restriction or 30% correction in this unit. Other old monetary figures on the page do not create an earlier-period limitation.
jobcenter-saarbruecken-faq-earnings-twen.scope: Ordinary employed claimants aged 25 or over, monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The local FAQ currently gives 20% for that slice. Its €450 example remains correct within the lower band and is not the alleged error. Other bands, deductions, pupil/training special rules and actual awards are outside this finding. Separately linked central guidance correctly gives 30%; confirmation concerns this local answer only.

jobcenter-freiburg-earnings-flyer.claim: retains the old 20% earnings band in a currently linked flyer while its FAQ correctly gives 30%.
jobcenter-freiburg-earnings-flyer.quote:
Welche Beträge und Freibeträge sind vom Einkommen abzuziehen?

Vom Brutto-Erwerbseinkommen wird anstelle der Kosten für private Versicherungen, für die Vorsorge für Krankheit und Alter und für notwendige Ausgaben, ein Pauschalbetrag von 100 Euro abgezogen.

Sind die Aufwendungen höher, können die höheren Beträge abgesetzt werden, sofern das Bruttoeinkommen 450 euro monatlich übersteigt.

Bei Aufwandsentschädigungen für ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten z.B. Übungsleiter (steuerfreie Einnahmen nach dem Einkommenssteuergesetz) und für das Einkommen bei Teilnahme an einem Bundes- oder Jugendfreiwilligendienst gilt statt des Pauschalbetrages von 100 Euro ein Grundfreibetrag von 200 Euro.

Darüberhinaus gibt es weitere Freibeträge:

Vom Bruttoeinkommen von 100,01 bis 1.000 € sind 20% frei.

Vom Bruttoeinkommen von 1.000,01 bis 1.200 € sind nochmals 10% frei.

Wenn Sie ein minderjähriges Kind haben oder mit einem minderjährigem Kind in einer Bedarfsgemeinschaft leben, erhöht sich der Betrag von 1.200 auf 1.500 €.
jobcenter-freiburg-earnings-flyer.tr:
Which amounts and allowances must be deducted from income?

A flat amount of 100 euros is deducted from gross employment income instead of the costs of private insurance, provision for illness and old age, and necessary expenses.

If expenditure is higher, the higher amounts can be deducted provided gross income exceeds 450 euros a month.

For expense allowances for voluntary activities, for example instructors (tax-exempt income under income tax law), and income from a federal or youth voluntary service, a basic allowance of 200 euros applies instead of the flat 100 euros.

There are also further allowances:

20% of gross income from 100.01 through 1,000 euros is exempt.

A further 10% of gross income from 1,000.01 through 1,200 euros is exempt.

If you have a minor child or live with a minor child in a benefit household, the amount increases from 1,200 to 1,500 euros.
jobcenter-freiburg-earnings-flyer.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, SGB II §11 b(3) disregards 30% of the gross monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The lower 20% band, upper 10% band and base/expense deductions are separate.
jobcenter-freiburg-earnings-flyer.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed 35-year-old earns €900 gross per month, uses the standard €100 base deduction and has no special or higher expense deduction. The relevant deductions total €100+€84+€114=€298; the old formula gives €260. This compares deductions, not final benefit entitlement.
jobcenter-freiburg-earnings-flyer.context: The Downloadcenter currently offers this April 2018 flyer under Einkommen und Freibeträge. Its first-page example likewise uses the old formula. The same website FAQ correctly states 30% above €520 through €1,000. This is mixed guidance; the claim targets this linked flyer only.
jobcenter-freiburg-earnings-flyer.scope: Ordinary employed claimants aged 25 or over, current monthly earnings above €520 through €1,000, with other deductions separate. The flyer is dated April 2018 and no historical-use restriction accompanies its current download link. Contrary current FAQ: the 520–1000 slice is correctly given as 30%. The source’s separate expense threshold and voluntary-service figures are outside this finding.

jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.src: Schwanger & Bürgergeld: Welche Hilfen gibt es?
jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.claim: requires current monthly benefits for initial pregnancy/baby equipment and says nonrecipient applications must be rejected.
jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.quote: Die auf dem Flyer aufgeführten Leistungen (Mehrbedarf Schwangerschaft, Erstausstattung) können Sie nur bekommen, wenn Sie Bürgergeld erhalten. Sollten Sie kein Bürgergeld vom Jobcenter bekommen, muss Ihr Antrag auf Erstausstattung abgelehnt werden. Sie können natürlich jederzeit auch Antrag auf Bürgergeld stellen.
jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.tr: You can only receive the benefits listed in this flyer (additional need during pregnancy, initial equipment) if you receive Bürgergeld. If you do not receive Bürgergeld from the Jobcenter, your application for initial equipment must be rejected. Of course, you can also apply for Bürgergeld at any time.
jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.law: Specified initial needs for pregnancy/birth clothing and household equipment under SGB II §24(3) can qualify even without ongoing subsistence benefits when the particular need cannot be fully met from the applicant’s own resources. Income for up to six months after the decision month may be considered; all other eligibility conditions remain.
jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise eligible 35-year-old expecting a first baby covers ordinary monthly living costs from earnings but cannot fully meet a qualifying initial pregnancy/birth-equipment need, even after permissible resources and future income are considered. Absence of a monthly subsistence award alone does not require rejection under§24(3); this does not guarantee a particular item or amount.
jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.context: The current Downloadcenter directly links this March 2025 flyer. Its inside panel identifies initial pregnancy clothing and baby equipment. The quoted complete bullet combines pregnancy Mehrbedarf with initial equipment; only the latter is the subject of this finding.
jobcenter-freiburg-oneoff-prior-receipt.scope: Only specified initial needs under§24(3), subject the particular unmet need, means testing, a separate application and other statutory conditions. The finding does not challenge a prior-receipt condition for a separate pregnancy Mehrbedarf under§21. The hypothetical concerns a genuine initial need for a first baby, so the flyer’s separate statement about reuse for later children does not affect it.

jobcenter-esslingen-holiday.claim: currently links application notes imposing a €2,400 annual ceiling on qualifying school-holiday earnings.
jobcenter-esslingen-holiday.quote:
Einnahmen aus sogenannten „Ferienjobs” werden unter folgenden Voraussetzungen nicht angerechnet:
• Die Schülerin oder der Schüler ist jünger als 25 Jahre.
• Die Schülerin oder der Schüler besucht eine allgemein- oder berufsbildende Schule und erhält keine Ausbildungsvergütung.
• Die Tätigkeiten werden in den Schulferien, d. h. zwischen zwei Schulabschnitten, ausgeübt.
• Die Einnahmen sind nicht höher als 2.400 Euro brutto im Kalenderjahr.
jobcenter-esslingen-holiday.tr:
Income from so-called “holiday jobs” is not counted under the following conditions:
• The pupil is younger than 25.
• The pupil attends a general or vocational school and does not receive training remuneration.
• The work is performed during school holidays, meaning between two periods of schooling.
• Gross earnings do not exceed €2,400 in the calendar year.
jobcenter-esslingen-holiday.law: Under SGB II section 11a(7), income from work carried out during school holidays by pupils under 25 at general or vocational schools is excluded as income without an annual euro ceiling. The exemption does not cover training remuneration to which the pupil is contractually entitled. Outside-holiday work and training remuneration follow separate rules. The 2026 reform and its transitional provisions do not restore the former €2,400 ceiling.
jobcenter-esslingen-holiday.example: Hypothetical: a 20-year-old pupil at a general school earns €3,000 from work performed entirely during school holidays. The earnings are not contractual training remuneration. Section 11a(7) excludes the qualifying income without a €2,400 annual ceiling; other eligibility requirements remain.
jobcenter-esslingen-holiday.context: The current application package for Ukrainian refugees expressly instructs readers to use the German completion notes and links this ten-page PDF as Ausfüllhinweis auf Deutsch. The PDF footer identifies Jobcenter-AH.08.2021; the webpage presents it as part of the application package without confining it to past application periods. The row is a complete self-contained holiday-job list, with no July 2023 sunset qualification. This is a locally hosted copy of a central-style application publication, not evidence of independent local drafting. Only the German version was assessed for this finding.
jobcenter-esslingen-holiday.scope: Qualifying school-holiday employment earnings of pupils under 25 at general or vocational schools; contractual training remuneration and work outside school holidays are excluded. The finding concerns the currently linked German application notes, dated August 2021, in the current Ukrainian-refugee application package. It does not allege an error from the benefit name, independent local authorship, or actual benefit decisions.

jobcenter-rhein-neckar-holiday-leaflet-c.src: Bürgergeld — Grundsicherung für Arbeitsuchende, current local mirror
jobcenter-rhein-neckar-holiday-leaflet-c.claim: currently offers a BA leaflet imposing an annual €3,000 ceiling on pupil school-holiday earnings.
jobcenter-rhein-neckar-holiday-leaflet-c.law: SGB II §11a(7) excludes employment income earned during school holidays by pupils under 25 at general or vocational schools, except training remuneration to which they are contractually entitled. The exemption has no annual euro ceiling. Non-holiday employment, older pupils, contractual training remuneration and other income remain subject to their own rules. The July 2026 reforms did not restore an annual cap.
jobcenter-rhein-neckar-holiday-leaflet-c.example: Hypothetical: an eligible 18-year-old general-school pupil earns €3,500 from an ordinary summer-holiday job, without contractual training remuneration. Qualifying holiday employment income is excluded in full under §11a(7); the leaflet’s annual €3,000 ceiling would wrongly limit that exemption. This does not decide entitlement where another eligibility condition is absent.
jobcenter-rhein-neckar-holiday-leaflet-c.context: The current Formularcenter directly offers this precise locally mirrored PDF under the heading Grundsicherung; its adjacent July 2026 insert does not amend the holiday-income cap. The entire governing §9.1.2 heading, lead-in and list are retained. It is copied central BA guidance, not independent local authorship.
jobcenter-rhein-neckar-holiday-leaflet-c.scope: Only qualifying school-holiday employment of pupils under 25 at general or vocational schools, excluding contractual training remuneration. The current Formularcenter provides this old mirror together with a July 2026 insert, without restricting the leaflet to historical claims. The insert was read in full: it covers other reforms and does not remove this cap. The PDF has a composite August 2023/January 2021 imprint. Other privileged-income list items and actual benefit decisions are outside the finding. Harburg offers substantively matching BA content in different PDF bytes; this is a shared publication family, not an independent policy text.

jobcenter-rastatt-application-day.claim: says ordinary subsistence benefits are unavailable for days before the application, without the application-month exception.
jobcenter-rastatt-application-day.quote:
Damit Ihr Lebensunterhalt gesichert ist,erhalten Sie und alle in Ihrer Bedarfsgemeinschaft („Familie“) lebenden Personen folgende Geldleistungen:

Grundsicherungsgeld für Erwerbsfähige oder Sozialgeld für nicht erwerbsfähige Personen sowie zusätzliche Leistungen bei bestimmten Mehrbedarfen.

Daneben können Sie Leistungen für Unterkunft und Heizung und die Übernahme von besonderem, einmaligem Bedarf beantragen.

Um Leistungen nach dem SGB II erhalten zu können, müssen die folgenden Grundvoraussetzungen erfüllt sein:

- Sie müssen das 15. Lebensjahr vollendet und das 65. Lebensjahr noch nicht vollendet haben

- Sie müssen erwerbsfähig sein

- Sie müssen hilfebedürftig sein, d. h. Ihr Lebensunterhalt wird nicht durch anderweitiges vorrangig einzusetzendes Einkommen und/oder Vermögen gesichert

- Sie müssen einen gewöhnlichen Aufenthalt in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland haben

Bitte beachten Sie, dass Sie für die Tage vor der Antragstellung keine Leistungen erhalten.

Sie können den Antrag ohne Einhaltung einer Form schriftlich, telefonisch oder auch persönlich stellen, um erst einmal keinen Verlust zu riskieren.

Die erforderlichen Antragsunterlagen können Sie, möglichst vollständig und zeitnah bei einer erstmaligen und persönlichen Vorsprache nachreichen.
jobcenter-rastatt-application-day.tr:
To secure your livelihood, you and all persons living in your benefit household ("family") receive the following cash benefits:

Basic subsistence allowance for people capable of work, or social allowance for people not capable of work, and additional benefits for certain additional needs.

You can also apply for accommodation and heating benefits and coverage of particular one-off needs.

To receive benefits under SGB II, the following basic conditions must be met:

- You must have reached age 15 and not yet reached age 65.

- You must be capable of work.

- You must be in need of assistance, meaning that your livelihood is not secured by other income and/or assets that must be used first.

- You must habitually reside in the Federal Republic of Germany.

Please note that you receive no benefits for the days before your application.

You can apply without a prescribed form in writing, by telephone or in person, to avoid risking a loss in the first instance.

You can submit the required application documents later, as completely and promptly as possible, at an initial personal visit.
jobcenter-rastatt-application-day.law: SGB II §37(2) provides that an application for ordinary subsistence benefits takes effect from the first day of the application month. Entitlement still depends on eligibility during the relevant period; specified separately requested one-off benefits and other statutory exceptions are distinct.
jobcenter-rastatt-application-day.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise eligible 35-year-old has an unmet subsistence need throughout October and first applies on 20 October. The application normally takes effect from 1 October; entitlement is not limited to 20–31 October merely because the application arrived on the 20 th.
jobcenter-rastatt-application-day.context: The main application page uses the current Grundsicherungsgeld name and the site publishes the July 2026 reform news. No earlier-period label accompanies the local statement. The complete relevant eligibility/application unit is quoted, including formless applications and later documents.
jobcenter-rastatt-application-day.scope: Only ordinary SGB II subsistence benefits and eligibility during the application month. The page explicitly introduces ordinary living costs before the day-only statement. Its linked central BA leaflet correctly explains month backdating; this is conflicting guidance, and the finding targets the local page only. The quoted age ceiling is faithfully retained but is outside this five-rule assessment.

Grundsicherungsgeld für Erwerbsfähige oder Sozialgeld für nicht erwerbsfähige Personen sowie zusätzliche Leistungen bei bestimmten Mehrbedarfen.

Daneben können Sie Leistungen für Unterkunft und Heizung und die Übernahme von besonderem, einmaligem Bedarf beantragen.

Um Leistungen nach dem SGB II erhalten zu können, müssen die folgenden Grundvoraussetzungen erfüllt sein:

- Sie müssen das 15. Lebensjahr vollendet und das 65. Lebensjahr noch nicht vollendet haben

- Sie müssen erwerbsfähig sein

- Sie müssen hilfebedürftig sein, d. h. Ihr Lebensunterhalt wird nicht durch anderweitiges vorrangig einzusetzendes Einkommen und/oder Vermögen gesichert

- Sie müssen einen gewöhnlichen Aufenthalt in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland haben

Bitte beachten Sie, dass Sie für die Tage vor der Antragstellung keine Leistungen erhalten.

Sie können den Antrag ohne Einhaltung einer Form schriftlich, telefonisch oder auch persönlich stellen, um erst einmal keinen Verlust zu riskieren.

Die erforderlichen Antragsunterlagen können Sie, möglichst vollständig und zeitnah bei einer erstmaligen und persönlichen Vorsprache nachreichen.
versions.tr:
To secure your livelihood, you and all persons living in your benefit household ("family") receive the following cash benefits:

Basic subsistence allowance for people capable of work, or social allowance for people not capable of work, and additional benefits for certain additional needs.

You can also apply for accommodation and heating benefits and coverage of particular one-off needs.

To receive benefits under SGB II, the following basic conditions must be met:

- You must have reached age 15 and not yet reached age 65.

- You must be capable of work.

- You must be in need of assistance, meaning that your livelihood is not secured by other income and/or assets that must be used first.

- You must habitually reside in the Federal Republic of Germany.

Please note that you receive no benefits for the days before your application.

You can apply without a prescribed form in writing, by telephone or in person, to avoid risking a loss in the first instance.

You can submit the required application documents later, as completely and promptly as possible, at an initial personal visit.

Freibeträge bei Erwerbstätigkeit
Vom monatlichen Einkommen wird ein Pauschalbetrag in Höhe von 100 Euro abgezogen.
Sind die Aufwendungen höher, können die höheren Beträge abgesetzt werden, sofern das Einkommen 400 Euro monatlich übersteigt.

Darüber hinaus wird ein weiterer Teil nicht angerechnet:
Vom Bruttoeinkommen zwischen 100,01 bis 1000 Euro sind 20 Prozent frei,
vom Bruttoeinkommen zwischen 1000,01 und 1200 Euro sind nochmals 10 Prozent frei.

jobcenter-boeblingen-earnings-twenty-per.tr:
2. Amounts and allowances to deduct from income

Deduct from income:

Taxes payable on it, such as:
• wage/income tax
• solidarity surcharge
• church tax
• trade tax
• capital-gains tax

Compulsory statutory social-insurance contributions. These are contributions to:
• health insurance
• long-term care insurance
and the compulsory contributions paid by compulsorily insured self-employed people within social insurance for:
• farmers’ old-age assistance
• craftspeople’s insurance
• accident insurance
• compulsory long-term care contributions of voluntarily health-insured people

Since 1 January 2011, periods receiving SGB II benefits are no longer compulsory statutory pension contribution periods. In future the period is recognised as a credited period under certain conditions.

Necessary expenditure to acquire, secure and maintain income (work-related expenses), for example:
• maintaining two households
• professional-association and trade-union contributions
• work materials and work clothing
• travel costs

Employment allowances
A flat 100 euros is deducted from monthly income. If expenditure is higher, higher amounts may be deducted provided income exceeds 400 euros a month.

A further portion is also disregarded:
20 percent of gross income between 100.01 and 1,000 euros is exempt;
a further 10 percent of gross income between 1,000.01 and 1,200 euros is exempt.
If you live with a minor child in the benefit household, the amount increases from 1,200 to 1,500 euros.
jobcenter-boeblingen-earnings-twenty-per.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, §11b(3) disregards 30% of the gross monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The lower slice above €100 through €520 retains 20%; the upper slice and the standard €100 deduction are separate. Taxes, mandatory contributions, eligible expenses and special pupil/training rules are also separate. The quoted 20% band incorrectly includes the €520–€1,000 slice.
jobcenter-boeblingen-earnings-twenty-per.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed claimant aged 30 earns €1,000 gross monthly. Before separately applicable deductions, the statutory employment disregard is €100 + 20%×€420 + 30%×€480 = €328. Applying the page’s 20% to the entire €100–€1,000 slice produces €280, a €48 difference. Neither amount alone determines the final benefit award.
jobcenter-boeblingen-earnings-twenty-per.context: Current Leistungsangebot navigation offers this complete income section without a historical-period restriction. All governing deductions and ordinary employment-allowance paragraphs are retained; there is no 30% correction in the unit.
jobcenter-boeblingen-earnings-twenty-per.scope: Ordinary employed claimants aged 25 or over, monthly slice above €520 through €1,000. Other deductions and bands, pupil/training special rules and actual awards are separate. The source’s separate expense threshold, insurance and pension assertions are outside this finding. Correct separate central guidance linked by the Jobcenter is contrary material; the finding concerns this local income section.

jobcenter-boeblingen-application-day.claim: categorically excludes benefits for periods before applying, without the ordinary application-month exception.
jobcenter-boeblingen-application-day.quote:
Wer Leistungen nach dem SGB II beziehen will, muss einen Antrag stellen.

Sämtliche Antragsvordrucke und Merkblätter zum Thema Bürgergeld finden Sie auf den Seiten der Bundesagentur für Arbeit. Auch finden Sie hier einen Musterbescheid und einen Musterberechnungsbogen, der Ihnen den Aufbau und einzelne Begriffe näher erklärt.

Außerdem werden im Formularcenter der Bundesagentur für Arbeit auch einige Begriffe in den Vordrucken in verschiedenen Sprachen neben Deutsch erläutert (Englisch, Türkisch, Russisch, Arabisch, Polnisch, Griechisch, Kroatisch, Spanisch, Serbisch, Italienisch, Französisch, Portugiesisch, Bulgarisch und Rumänisch).

Stellen Sie den Antrag rechtzeitig und verwenden Sie bitte stets die Originalvordrucke. Bei Ihrer ersten Vorsprache im Regionalen Jobcenter werden Ihnen im Rahmen der Eingangsberatung selbstverständlich sämtliche Antragsunterlagen ausgehändigt.

Bürgergeld erhalten Sie nur, wenn Sie den Antrag ausfüllen und abgeben. Ein bloßes Herunterladen der im Internet eingestellten Antragsformulare stellt keine Antragstellung dar. Maßgebend für einen eventuellen Leistungsanspruch ist der Tag des Posteingangs bzw. der persönlichen Abgabe des Antrages beim Regionalen Jobcenter.

Bitte beachten Sie: Für Zeiten vor der Antragstellung werden keine Leistungen erbracht
jobcenter-boeblingen-application-day.tr:
Anyone wishing to receive SGB II benefits must submit an application.

All application forms and leaflets about Bürgergeld can be found on the Federal Employment Agency’s pages. There is also a model decision and model calculation sheet explaining their structure and individual terms.

The Federal Employment Agency’s form centre also explains some terms in the forms in languages besides German (English, Turkish, Russian, Arabic, Polish, Greek, Croatian, Spanish, Serbian, Italian, French, Portuguese, Bulgarian and Romanian).

Submit the application in good time and always use the original forms. At your first visit to the regional Jobcenter you will of course receive all application documents as part of the initial advice.

You receive Bürgergeld only if you complete and submit the application. Merely downloading the online application forms does not constitute an application. The date the regional Jobcenter receives the application by post or it is submitted in person determines any potential benefit entitlement.

Please note: No benefits are provided for periods before applying
jobcenter-boeblingen-application-day.law: For an ordinary SGB II subsistence-benefit application, §37(2) sentence 2 normally takes the application back to the first of the application month. Eligibility still has to exist during the period concerned; §41(1) allows a proportionate award for part-month eligibility. The quoted categorical exclusion omits this same-month effect.
jobcenter-boeblingen-application-day.example: Hypothetical: a person meets all ordinary SGB II subsistence-benefit conditions throughout October 2026 and applies on 20 October. Their application normally covers 1 October onward. The page would exclude the eligible days from 1 to 19 October. This does not guarantee payment where eligibility was absent during those days.
jobcenter-boeblingen-application-day.context: Current service navigation directly links the form instructions. The complete substantive page text is quoted, including its links to central forms and leaflets. There is no same-page first-month exception or historical restriction.
jobcenter-boeblingen-application-day.scope: Ordinary current SGB II subsistence-benefit applications and actual eligibility during the application month. Earlier months and separately applied-for special needs are excluded. Correct separate central leaflet guidance linked from this page gives first-of-month effect and is contrary material. This finding concerns the categorical local exclusion; original-form requirements and actual decisions are not assessed.

jobcenter-lichtenfels-faq-earnings-twent.claim: gives the old 20% band for ordinary earnings from €100 through €1,000 in its current FAQ.
jobcenter-lichtenfels-faq-earnings-twent.quote:
Darf ich überhaupt eine Nebentätigkeit ausüben, wenn ich Bürgergeld beziehe? Wie viel darf ich dazu verdienen?

Ja, Sie dürfen. Sie sollen sogar jede Möglichkeit nutzen, Einkommen zu erzielen, um Ihren Bedarf selbst zu decken. Wenn Sie neben dem Bezug von Bürgergeld erwerbstätig sind, ist von Ihrem Verdienst aus der Erwerbstätigkeit ein bestimmter Betrag anzurechnen. Der Anrechnungsbetrag richtet sich nach der Höhe des Bruttoverdienstes, das heißt konkret:

Vom Bruttobetrag werden die entsprechenden Steuern, die Sozialversicherungsbeiträge, gesetzlich vorgeschriebene Pflichtbeiträge (Kfz-Haftpflichtversicherung) und ein angemessener Betrag für private Versicherungen (pauschal 30 Euro), Beiträge zur Riesterrente, notwendige Kosten für die Einkommenserzielung (Werbungskosten) und titulierte Unterhaltsansprüche, die tatsächlich gezahlt werden, abgezogen.

Bei Personen, die bis zu 400 Euro als Erwerbseinkommen beziehen, werden pauschal 100 Euro als Grundfreibetrag abgezogen. Höhere Beträge können nicht mindernd geltend gemacht werden. Bei Einkommen über 400 Euro können im Einzelfall aber höhere Beträge berücksichtigt werden.

Dazu kommt noch ein Freibetrag bei Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit.

Die Berechnung des Freibetrages richtet sich nach dem Bruttoeinkommen. Diese wird in zwei Schritten vorgenommen:

100 Euro bis 1.000 Euro = 20 Prozent als Freibetrag

1.000,01 Euro bis 1.200 Euro = 10 Prozent als Freibetrag

Sollten in der Bedarfsgemeinschaft minderjährige Kinder leben oder hat die Einkommensbezieherin beziehungsweise der Einkommensbezieher außerhalb der Bedarfsgemeinschaft minderjährige Kinder, erhöht sich der Maximalbetrag auf 1.500 Euro brutto im Monat. Daher wäre ein Freibetrag in Höhe von 10 Prozent für Beträge von 1.000,01 bis 1.500 Euro monatlich möglich.

Vom Einkommen werden also die Abzugsbeträge und Freibetrage abgezogen. Der Rest ist der Anrechnungsbetrag, das heißt um diesen Betrag wird der Auszahlungsbetrag des Bürgergeld in dem Monat, in dem das Einkommen zufließt, verringert.
jobcenter-lichtenfels-faq-earnings-twent.tr:
Am I allowed to have a side job at all if I receive Bürgergeld? How much may I earn in addition?

Yes, you are. You should even use every opportunity to earn income to cover your own needs. If you work while receiving Bürgergeld, a certain amount of your earnings must be taken into account. The countable amount depends on gross earnings, specifically:

The relevant taxes, social-insurance contributions, legally required compulsory contributions (motor-vehicle liability insurance), a reasonable amount for private insurance (a flat 30 euros), Riester pension contributions, necessary expenses of earning income (work-related expenses), and legally established maintenance obligations actually paid are deducted from gross income.

For people receiving up to 400 euros in employment income, a flat 100-euro basic allowance is deducted. Higher amounts cannot be claimed as deductions. For income over 400 euros, higher amounts may be taken into account in individual cases.

An allowance for income from employment is added.

The allowance is calculated from gross earnings. This is done in two steps:

100 euros through 1,000 euros = 20 percent as an allowance

1,000.01 euros through 1,200 euros = 10 percent as an allowance

If minor children live in the benefit household, or the person earning the income has minor children outside that household, the maximum amount rises to 1,500 euros gross a month. An allowance of 10 percent would therefore be possible for amounts from 1,000.01 through 1,500 euros a month.

The deductions and allowances are therefore deducted from income. The remainder is the countable amount: the Bürgergeld payment is reduced by that amount in the month the income is received.
jobcenter-lichtenfels-faq-earnings-twent.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over,30% of the gross monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000 is disregarded under SGB II §11 b(3). The 20% lower band,10% upper band, basic deduction and any other eligible deductions are separate.
jobcenter-lichtenfels-faq-earnings-twent.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed 35-year-old earns €900 gross a month with the standard €100 basic deduction and no special or higher expense deduction. The relevant deduction is €100+€84+€114=€298; the old formula gives €260. This compares deductions, not the final benefit award.
jobcenter-lichtenfels-faq-earnings-twent.context: The complete FAQ answer is quoted, including expense deductions and the minor-child upper-band qualification. The current local income overview also mentions only 20%/10%, without supplying a 30% middle band. Current navigation links both pages. A separately linked central BA leaflet gives the correct rule; the allegation concerns this local FAQ, not every publication the Jobcenter links.
jobcenter-lichtenfels-faq-earnings-twent.scope: Ordinary employed claimants aged 25 or over in the current period, gross monthly slice above €520 through €1,000. Special education/voluntary-service allowances are excluded. The source has no historical period restriction for this answer. A correct linked central leaflet is contrary material; it does not change the explicit local FAQ calculation.

Sollten in der Bedarfsgemeinschaft minderjährige Kinder leben oder hat die Einkommensbezieherin beziehungsweise der Einkommensbezieher außerhalb der Bedarfsgemeinschaft minderjährige Kinder, erhöht sich der Maximalbetrag auf 1.500 Euro brutto im Monat. Daher wäre ein Freibetrag in Höhe von 10 Prozent für Beträge von 1.000,01 bis 1.500 Euro monatlich möglich.

Vom Einkommen werden also die Abzugsbeträge und Freibetrage abgezogen. Der Rest ist der Anrechnungsbetrag, das heißt um diesen Betrag wird der Auszahlungsbetrag des Bürgergeld in dem Monat, in dem das Einkommen zufließt, verringert.
versions.tr:
Am I allowed to have a side job at all if I receive Bürgergeld? How much may I earn in addition?

Yes, you are. You should even use every opportunity to earn income to cover your own needs. If you work while receiving Bürgergeld, a certain amount of your earnings must be taken into account. The countable amount depends on gross earnings, specifically:

The relevant taxes, social-insurance contributions, legally required compulsory contributions (motor-vehicle liability insurance), a reasonable amount for private insurance (a flat 30 euros), Riester pension contributions, necessary expenses of earning income (work-related expenses), and legally established maintenance obligations actually paid are deducted from gross income.

For people receiving up to 400 euros in employment income, a flat 100-euro basic allowance is deducted. Higher amounts cannot be claimed as deductions. For income over 400 euros, higher amounts may be taken into account in individual cases.

An allowance for income from employment is added.

The allowance is calculated from gross earnings. This is done in two steps:

100 euros through 1,000 euros = 20 percent as an allowance

1,000.01 euros through 1,200 euros = 10 percent as an allowance

If minor children live in the benefit household, or the person earning the income has minor children outside that household, the maximum amount rises to 1,500 euros gross a month. An allowance of 10 percent would therefore be possible for amounts from 1,000.01 through 1,500 euros a month.

The deductions and allowances are therefore deducted from income. The remainder is the countable amount: the Bürgergeld payment is reduced by that amount in the month the income is received.

jobcenter-nuernberger-land-deposit-movin.claim: The currently linked moving leaflet says rental-deposit loans are repaid through monthly withholding of 10% of the benefit household’s standard benefit.
jobcenter-nuernberger-land-deposit-movin.quote:
Merkblatt zu Umzügen

Bei Ihnen steht ein Umzug an, und Sie erhalten Arbeitslosengeld II (ALG II) bzw. möchten diese Leistungen beantragen, dann beachten Sie bitte die nachfolgenden Hinweise, damit Ihnen keine finanziellen Nachteile entstehen.

Erkundigen Sie sich bitte rechtzeitig, ob die Notwendigkeit des Umzuges vom Jobcenter anerkannt wird.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass für die mögliche Erstattung der Kosten im Zusammenhang mit dem Umzug nicht nur die Notwendigkeit eines Umzuges maßgebend ist, sondern auch die Angemessenheit der neuen Wohnung. Diese Angemessenheit bestimmt sich nach der Wohnungsgröße und den monatlichen Mietkosten (Mietobergrenze).

Ob die neue Wohnung angemessen ist, müssen Sie beim Jobcenter erfragen.

Bitte bedenken Sie auch, dass durch eine zu große Wohnung auch weitere, höhere Kosten (Heizkosten) anfallen, die ebenfalls unangemessen sein können und langfristig ggf. nur eingeschränkt übernommen werden können.

Als Empfänger von Leistungen der Grundsicherung für Arbeitssuchende (ALG II) sind Sie verpflichtet, bei Anmietung einer Wohnung auf eine angemessene Miete hinzuwirken (Einhaltung der Mietobergrenze).

Beachten Sie bitte:

=> Notwendig ist ein Nachweis des neuen Vermieters über die Höhe der Kaltmiete und der Mietkaution, sowie der Wohnfläche in Quadratmetern und der zu erwartenden monatlichen Nebenkosten (aufgeschlüsselt in Heizkosten und Betriebskosten wie z. B. Abfallgebühren, Kanal, Wasser etc.).
=> Kautionen können nur in Form eines Darlehens (vom zuständigen Träger der Grundsicherung des neuen Wohnortes) gewährt werden und werden direkt an den Vermieter überwiesen. Darlehen für Kautionen werden bis zur vollständigen Rückzahlung monatlich in Höhe von 10 % der Regelleistung der Bedarfsgemeinschaft einbehalten.
=> Umzugskosten können grundsätzlich nur für Selbstumzüge gewährt werden. Es werden nur angemessene Kosten übernommen.

Unterschreiben Sie bitte keinen Mietvertrag, bevor Sie nicht die Zustimmung des Jobcenters eingeholt haben.
jobcenter-nuernberger-land-deposit-movin.tr:
Moving information leaflet

You are about to move and receive unemployment benefit II (ALG II), or wish to apply for these benefits. Please follow the information below so that you do not suffer financial disadvantages.

Please enquire in good time whether the Jobcenter recognises the move as necessary.

Please note that possible reimbursement of costs connected with the move depends both on the necessity of the move and on the appropriateness of the new home. Appropriateness is determined by the size of the home and the monthly rent (rent ceiling).

You must ask the Jobcenter whether the new home is appropriate.

Please also remember that an excessively large home entails additional, higher costs (heating costs), which may also be inappropriate and may therefore only be covered to a limited extent in the longer term.

As a recipient of basic subsistence benefits for jobseekers (ALG II), you are required to seek an appropriate rent when renting a home (compliance with the rent ceiling).

Please note:

=> Evidence from the new landlord is required showing the basic rent and rental deposit, the floor area in square metres and the expected monthly ancillary costs (broken down into heating costs and operating costs such as waste collection, sewerage, water, etc.).
=> Deposits can only be provided as a loan (by the competent basic subsistence-benefit provider at the new place of residence) and are transferred directly to the landlord. Deposit loans are withheld monthly until fully repaid at a rate of 10% of the benefit household’s standard benefit.
=> Moving costs can generally only be provided for moves carried out by the claimant. Only appropriate costs are covered.

Please do not sign a tenancy agreement before obtaining the Jobcenter’s consent.
jobcenter-nuernberger-land-deposit-movin.law: During continuing subsistence-benefit receipt, the ordinary monthly offset for a rental-deposit loan is 5% of the applicable standard need, beginning in the month after disbursement and declared by written administrative act. Section 42a(2) excludes the ordinary offset insofar as subsistence benefits themselves are loans or an existing section 43 offset exceeds 20%; section 43(3) limits offsets during benefit reductions. Landlord return of the deposit and repayment after benefit receipt ends are separately governed by section 42a(3)–(4). The currently linked moving leaflet instead states 10%. For the hypothetical single-adult benefit household, the comparison does not depend on the leaflet’s separate household-unit terminology.
jobcenter-nuernberger-land-deposit-movin.example: Hypothetical: a single adult claimant in a one-person benefit household with an applicable monthly standard need of €563 receives a qualifying rental-deposit loan in October 2026 and continues to receive subsistence benefits, without a statutory offset exception or sanction restriction. The ordinary offset from November is €28.15 (5% × €563), compared with €56.30 under the leaflet’s 10% wording. €563 is an explicit assumed standard need.
jobcenter-nuernberger-land-deposit-movin.context: The current official county page for the Jobcenter’s subsistence benefits directly offers this two-page leaflet in its documents section, under Merkblatt Umzug. Both original pages were read and rendered. Page 2 addresses moves to another district, people under 25 leaving the parental home, non-essential moves and contact hours; it supplies no correction of the deposit percentage. The HTTP Last-Modified header is 30 June 2022 and the leaflet uses ALG II terminology, but neither the leaflet nor its current incoming card confines the advice to an earlier closed benefit period.
jobcenter-nuernberger-land-deposit-movin.scope: Only the ordinary monthly offset for a rental-deposit loan during continuing SGB II subsistence-benefit receipt is assessed, assuming no statutory offset exception or sanction restriction. Landlord refunds and repayment after benefit receipt ends remain separate. This is a reviewed finding about a currently offered leaflet, not evidence of actual offsets or an operative internal policy. Its older terminology and server modification date are disclosed; naming alone is not the error. Separately linked current central guidance is correct and does not remove the conflicting local leaflet.

jobcenter-straubing-bogen-faq-earnings-t.claim: applies a 20% disregard to the earnings slice above €100 through €1,000, including the slice that requires 30%.
jobcenter-straubing-bogen-faq-earnings-t.quote:
Darf ich überhaupt eine Nebentätigkeit ausüben, wenn ich Bürgergeld beziehe?

Bei erwerbsfähigen Hilfebedürftigen, die neben dem Bezug von Bürgergeld erwerbstätig sind, ist von dem um die Absetzbeträge (siehe § 11 Abs. 2 SGB II) bereinigten monatlichen Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit ein Betrag abzusetzen. Der abzusetzende Betrag vom bereinigten monatlichen Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit richtet sich nach der Höhe des Bruttoverdienstes.

Von diesem Bruttobetrag werden die entsprechenden Steuern, die Sozialversicherungsbeiträge, gesetzlich vorgeschriebene Pflichtbeiträge (Kfz-Haftpflichtversicherung) und ein angemessener Betrag für private Versicherungen (pauschal 30 Euro), Beiträge zur Riesterrente, notwendige Kosten für die Einkommenserzielung (Werbungskosten) und titulierte Unterhaltsansprüche, die tatsächlich gezahlt werden, abgezogen.

Dazu kommt noch ein Freibetrag bei Einkommen aus Erwerbstätigkeit.

Für die Höhe Ihres Freibetrags ist das Bruttoeinkommen (Einkommen vor Steuern und Abgaben) entscheidend.

Die ersten 100 Euro aus Erwerbseinkommen werden nicht angerechnet (Grundabsetzungsbetrag).

Zusätzlich bleiben 20% des Teils des Bruttoeinkommens anrechnungsfrei, der über 100 Euro und nicht mehr als 1.000 Euro beträgt.

Zusätzlich zu den beiden oben genannten Beträgen werden 10% von dem Teil Ihres Bruttolohnes nicht angerechnet, der über 1.000 Euro und nicht mehr als 1.200 Euro beträgt. Bei Leistungsberechtigten,

die mit mindestens einem minderjährigen Kind in Bedarfsgemeinschaft leben oder ein minderjähriges Kind haben, liegt die Obergrenze bei 1.500 Euro.
jobcenter-straubing-bogen-faq-earnings-t.tr:
May I pursue a sideline job at all while receiving Bürgergeld?
For employable people in need who work while receiving Bürgergeld, an amount is deducted from monthly employment income after the deductions (see section 11(2) SGB II). The amount deducted from adjusted monthly employment income depends on gross earnings.
The corresponding taxes, social-insurance contributions, legally required compulsory contributions (motor-vehicle liability insurance), a reasonable amount for private insurance (a flat €30), Riester pension contributions, necessary costs of earning income (work-related expenses), and maintenance obligations established by an enforceable title and actually paid are deducted from this gross amount.
There is also an allowance for employment income.
Your gross income (income before taxes and contributions) determines the size of your allowance.
The first €100 of employment income is not counted (basic deduction).
An additional 20% of the portion of gross income above €100 and no more than €1,000 is disregarded.
In addition to the two amounts above, 10% of the portion of your gross pay above €1,000 and no more than €1,200 is disregarded. For beneficiaries who live in a benefit household with at least one minor child, or have a minor child, the upper limit is €1,500.
jobcenter-straubing-bogen-faq-earnings-t.law: For an ordinary employed claimant aged 25 or over, §11b(3) disregards 30% of the gross monthly earnings slice above €520 through €1,000. The lower slice above €100 through €520 retains 20%; the upper slice and the standard €100 deduction are separate. Taxes, mandatory contributions, eligible expenses and special pupil/training rules are also separate. The quoted 20% band incorrectly includes the €520–€1,000 slice.
jobcenter-straubing-bogen-faq-earnings-t.example: Hypothetical: an ordinary employed claimant aged 30 earns €1,000 gross monthly. Before separately applicable deductions, the statutory employment disregard is €100 + 20%×€420 + 30%×€480 = €328. Applying the page’s 20% to the entire €100–€1,000 slice produces €280, a €48 difference. Neither amount alone determines the final benefit award.
jobcenter-straubing-bogen-faq-earnings-t.context: The current local financial-help navigation links this FAQ. The full ordinary employment answer contains deductions, base €100,20% through €1,000 and upper 10% with minor-child extension, without a historical restriction or 30% correction. Other sections mention current October 2026 housing information. Correct separate central guidance is linked, but does not change this explicit local formula.
jobcenter-straubing-bogen-faq-earnings-t.scope: Ordinary employed claimants aged 25 or over; only the gross monthly slice above €520 through €1,000. Other deductions and bands, special pupil/training/voluntary-service rules and actual awards remain separate. The correctly linked central BA leaflet is contrary material; this finding targets the current local FAQ only.

jobcenter-freising-holiday-leaflet-cap.src: Merkblatt Bürgergeld – Grundsicherung für Arbeitsuchende – SGB II, locally hosted composite edition
jobcenter-freising-holiday-leaflet-cap.claim: currently links a copied BA leaflet with a €3,000 annual pupil holiday-job ceiling, alongside a correct newer copy.
jobcenter-freising-holiday-leaflet-cap.law: Under SGB II section 11a(7), income from work carried out during school holidays by pupils under 25 at general or vocational schools is excluded as income without an annual euro ceiling. The exemption does not cover training remuneration to which the pupil is contractually entitled. Outside-holiday work and training remuneration follow separate rules. The 2026 reform and its transitional provisions do not restore the former €2,400 ceiling.
jobcenter-freising-holiday-leaflet-cap.example: Hypothetical: a 20-year-old pupil at a general school earns €4,000 from work performed entirely during school holidays. This is not contractual training remuneration. Section 11a(7) excludes all qualifying income without a €3,000 annual ceiling, subject to the other eligibility conditions.
jobcenter-freising-holiday-leaflet-cap.context: The current housing page directly links the April 2024 hosted BA composite as Merkblatt SGBII. It also links a June 2025 hosted BA leaflet as Merkblatt zum Umzug; that newer copy correctly excludes pupil holiday earnings without the €3,000 cap. The old composite is currently offered without an archive label. This is copied central text, not an independent locally drafted legal policy.
jobcenter-freising-holiday-leaflet-cap.scope: Only qualifying earnings from work performed during school holidays by pupils under 25 at general or vocational schools are covered by this finding. Contractual training remuneration and work outside school holidays are excluded. The source list omits those detailed qualifications; they are stated here to avoid implying an unlimited exemption for every pupil’s earnings. The finding concerns the current linked copied publication and its stated annual ceiling, not actual benefit decisions or other provisions in the list. Material counterevidence: the same current housing page links the June 2025 BA leaflet, whose pupil holiday-job list correctly contains no annual euro cap. The discrepancy is limited to the older currently linked copy.

lawMarks: without an annual euro ceiling

elterngeld-be-elt-01.claim: bars changes to already-paid Basis months without the statutory hardship exception.
elterngeld-be-elt-01.quote:
Eine Änderung der ursprünglich beantragten Leistungsvariante ist bis zum Ende des Bezugszeitraumes möglich.

Lebensmonate, für die jedoch bereits Basiselterngeld ausgezahlt wurde, können nicht mehr geändert werden.

Die Elterngeldstelle sollte daher immer frühzeitig vorab über Änderungsabsichten im Leistungsbezug informiert werden.

Die Änderung, unter Angabe der betroffenen Lebensmonate ist schriftlich und mit Unterschrift mitzuteilen. Ggf. wird zudem eine geänderte Elternzeitbescheinigung des Arbeitgebers benötigt.
elterngeld-be-elt-01.tr:
The benefit variant originally requested can be changed until the end of the benefit period.

However, life months for which basic parental allowance has already been paid can no longer be changed.

The parental allowance office should therefore always be informed early, in advance, of intended changes in benefit receipt.

The change, specifying the affected life months, must be communicated in writing and signed. An amended employer's certificate of parental leave may also be required.
elterngeld-be-elt-01.example: A parent with established particular hardship asks to change a recently paid Basis life month within the statutory retrospective and overall periods. That exception can be assessed; approval is not automatic.
elterngeld-be-elt-01.context: The complete answer first allows changes until the end of the reference period, then states the absolute ban and advises early contact. No hardship qualification is supplied there. This is an express exclusion of an assessment route, not a finding based solely on absent detail.
elterngeld-be-elt-01.scope: Current 2026 claim, e.g. child born in 2026 and request within §7(2) retrospective window. No relevant transition removes hardship. This is a targeted follow-up extension, outside the original frozen samples. No individual decision, refusal, or financial loss established.
