## Documentos generales – Por favor presentar los documentos en este orden
  * Formulario VIDEX†videx.diplo.de L88:  Importante: Solo aceptamos solicitudes en formato Videx. Nos reservamos el derecho de no aceptar solicitudes en el formato incorrecto.
  * Dos fotos biométricas tamaño: 35x45mm a color con fondo blanco con validez máxima de seis meses.
  * Pasaporte actual, copia del pasaporte (sólo de la página de los datos) y copias de visados schengen o de residencia anteriores (Advertencia: El pasaporte deberá tener una validez de por lo menos 3 meses más que la estadía programada y dos páginas en blanco)
  * Reserva de vuelo a nombre del solicitante (Código de reserva de la aerolínea, no de la agencia de viaje)
  * Seguro Médico Para Visado Schengen (cobertura mínima de 30.000,- Euros sin deducible)
  * Tarifa consular de la solicitud de visado: Deberá pagarse en el momento de presentar la solicitud,en efectivo y en dólares estadounidenses, de acuerdo con el tipo de cambio vigente del día (equivalente a EUR 90,00). Se aceptan únicamente billetes de hasta USD 20,00 de denominación.
## Justificativos acerca del financiamiento y arraigo
  * Para trabajadores en relación de dependencia: Certificado de trabajo (se debe especificar el tiempo de empleo, los ingresos brutos y los días de vacaciones concedidos) y roles de pago de los últimos tres meses.
  * Para estudiantes: certificado vigente del colegio o de la universidad que acredite la matrícula actual. Si el viaje se realiza fuera del período oficial de vacaciones, deberá presentarse adicionalmente un permiso de la institución educativa que autorice la ausencia durante el período de viaje.
  * Para personas independientes pueden presentar RUC, nombramiento y/o tabla de accionistas. No se necesitan las declaraciones del SRI.
  * Para jubilados o pensionistas: Certificado de jubilación del IESS o carnet y tres últimos roles de jubilación.
  * Estados de cuenta bancarios con movimientos bancarios de los últimos tres meses de cuentas corrientes y de ahorro. Los estados de cuenta de tarjetas de crédito son opcionales y, en caso de presentarse, deberán corresponder únicamente al último mes. Los documentos deberán indicar claramente el saldo o cupo disponible y el nombre del titular de la cuenta.En caso de contar con inversiones a plazo fijo, se recomienda presentar también las copias de los documentos correspondientes.
  * En caso de que los fondos personales del solicitante no sean suficientes, podrá presentar una "Garantía Económica Alemana" (Verpflichtungserklärung) emitida por un familiar u otra persona que lo invite y que tenga su domicilio en Alemania. Este es un documento oficial que debe ser solicitado en la Oficina de Extranjería (Ausländerbehörde) más cercana al lugar de residencia en Alemania.Para la solicitud de visa, deberá presentar el documento original de la Verpflichtungserklärung en la Embajada.
De manera excepcional, cuando no sea posible presentar el original, se podrá aceptar una copia del documento.Sin embargo, al momento de viajar, el solicitante deberá llevar consigo el documento original en el equipaje de mano, ya que podrá ser requerido al ingresar al territorio Schengen.
## Justificativos acerca del motivo del viaje

Los justificativos deben ser válidos para toda la estadía en Schengen, no solamente para el período de permanencia en Alemania
### Viajes de negocios

  * Carta(s) de invitación, reserva(s) de hotel o entrada(s) a una feria o evento.En caso de que la empresa cubra los gastos del viaje:
  * Certificado de la empresa en el que se indique que esta asumirá los gastos del viaje.
  * Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) de la empresa.
  * Estados de cuenta bancarios con movimientos de la empresa correspondientes a los últimos tres meses, con indicación de los saldos disponibles.
### Turismo

  * Itinerario detallado del viaje.
  * Reservas de alojamiento (hotel u otros).
  * Reservas o comprobantes de transporte interno, ya sea terrestre o aéreo, cuando corresponda.
  * Entradas o reservas para eventos, museos y otras actividades previstas, de acuerdo con el itinerario planificado.
### Visita de familiares/ amigos

  * Carta de invitación informal, firmada y escrita en alemán
  * Copia de la cedula alemana o titulo de residencia de la persona que invita.
  * Podrá presentar una "Garantía Económica Alemana" (Verpflichtungserklärung) emitida por un familiar u otra persona que lo invite y que tenga su domicilio en Alemania. Este es un documento oficial que debe ser solicitado en la Oficina de Extranjería (Ausländerbehörde) más cercana al lugar de residencia en Alemania.
## Casos excepcionales

  * Cónyuges de ciudadanos alemanes o europeos (provenientes de la UE-/CEE y de ciudadanos suizos): Adicionalmente a los requisitos mencionados arriba, certificado de matrimonio actualizado y copia del pasaporte del cónyuge. No podremos aceptar solicitudes que no cumplan con todos los requsitos que se mencionan en esta página.
  * Ciudadanos no ecuatorianos: Deberán presentarse el visado de residencia vigente y la cédula de identidad para extranjeros.
Se podrán aceptar solicitudes de visado de personas que hayan residido legalmente en Ecuador durante al menos seis meses.
  * Solicitantes menores de 18 años: Deben presentarse acompañados por al menos uno de sus representantes legales. En caso de que sólo se presente una de las partes, deberá estar anexada a la solicitud un poder especial notariado para el trámite de visado firmado y copia de la cédula del representante que no esté presente. No podemos aceptar el documento "Permiso de salida del país". Anexar copias de cédulas y certificado de nacimiento del solicitante de visado.
En caso de haber cedido, suspendido o perdido la patria potestad se debe presentar adicionalmente el extracto judicial en copia certificada a la fecha del juzgado pertinente.
### Info

La Embajada Alemana no podrá recibir solicitudes de visados incompletas. En este caso no se recibirá la solicitud en ventanilla y deberá tomar una nueva cita presentando la documentación completa.

En ciertos casos, la Embajada se reserva el derecho de solicitar mayor documentación de respaldo.
### Info

Aviso Importante:

Por motivos de seguridad, todas las personas que deseen ingresar al edificio Citiplaza deberán dejar en recepción un documento de identidad que no sea necesario para realizar el trámite de visa.

En caso de que la solicitud de visa sea denegada, la tasa de solicitud no será reembolsada, ya que corresponde a una tarifa por gastos administrativos.
Todos los datos de este artículo informativo se basan en conocimientos y valoraciones de la Embajada al momento de la escritura de texto. No se asume responsabilidad por integridad y exactitud, especialmente por cambios interinos.

General documents – Please present the documents in this order
• VIDEX form
Important: We accept only applications in Videx format. We reserve the right not to accept applications in the wrong format.
• Two biometric colour photographs,35x45mm, with a white background, no more than six months old.
• Current passport, copy of the passport (data page only) and copies of previous Schengen visas or residence permits (Warning: the passport must be valid for at least3months beyond the planned stay and have two blank pages).
• Flight reservation in the applicant's name (airline booking code, not the travel agency's).
• Schengen visa medical insurance (minimum cover30,000euros without a deductible).
• Consular visa application fee: it must be paid when submitting the application, in cash and in US dollars at the day's prevailing exchange rate (equivalent to EUR90.00). Only notes with a denomination up to USD20.00 are accepted.
Evidence of financing and ties
• Employees: employment certificate (specifying duration of employment, gross income and days of leave granted) and payslips for the last three months.
• Students: current school or university certificate proving enrolment. If the trip is outside the official holiday period, permission for absence during the trip must additionally be provided.
• Self-employed persons may present their RUC, appointment document and/or shareholder list. SRI declarations are not needed.
• Pensioners: IESS retirement certificate or card and the last three pension slips.
• Current/savings bank statements with transactions for the last three months. Credit-card statements are optional and, if presented, must cover only the latest month. Documents must clearly show the balance or available credit and the account holder's name. Term investments should also be evidenced with corresponding copies.
• If the applicant's personal funds are insufficient, they may provide a German financial guarantee (Verpflichtungserklärung) issued by a relative or other inviter domiciled in Germany. This official document must be requested from the nearest foreigners authority in Germany. The original must be presented at the Embassy for the visa application.
Exceptionally, where the original cannot be presented, a copy may be accepted. However, when travelling the applicant must carry the original in hand luggage because it may be requested upon entry to Schengen.
Evidence of the purpose of travel
The evidence must cover the whole Schengen stay, not only the period in Germany.
Business travel
• Invitation letter(s), hotel booking(s) or ticket(s) to a fair/event. If the company covers the travel costs:
• Company certificate stating that it will assume the travel costs.
• The company's RUC.
• Company bank statements with transactions for the last three months and corresponding balances.
Tourism
• Detailed travel itinerary.
• Accommodation bookings (hotel or other).
• Internal transport bookings or receipts, by land or air as appropriate.
• Event/museum/other planned activity tickets or reservations, according to the itinerary.
Visits to family/friends
• Informal signed invitation letter written in German.
• Copy of the inviter's German identity card or residence permit.
• A German financial guarantee (Verpflichtungserklärung) issued by a relative or other inviter domiciled in Germany may be presented. This official document must be requested from the nearest foreigners authority in Germany.
Exceptional cases
• Spouses of German or European citizens (from the EU/EEA and Swiss citizens): In addition to the requirements mentioned above, an up-to-date marriage certificate and a copy of the spouse's passport. We cannot accept applications that do not meet all the requirements mentioned on this page.
• Non-Ecuadorian citizens: the current residence visa and foreigner's identity card must be presented.
Visa applications from people who have resided legally in Ecuador for at least six months may be accepted.
• Applicants under18 must be accompanied by at least one legal representative. If only one is present, a notarised special authorisation for the visa procedure and copy of the absent representative's identity card must be attached. We cannot accept an exit-permission document. Attach copies of identity cards and the applicant's birth certificate.
If parental authority has been transferred, suspended or lost, an up-to-date certified copy of the court record must additionally be presented.
Info
The German Embassy cannot receive incomplete visa applications. In that case the application will not be received at the counter and a new appointment with complete documentation will be necessary.
In certain cases, the Embassy reserves the right to request additional supporting documentation.
Info
Important notice:
For security reasons, everyone wishing to enter the Citiplaza building must leave an identity document not needed for the visa procedure at reception.
If the visa application is refused, the application fee is not refundable because it is a charge for administrative expenses.
All information in this article is based on the Embassy's knowledge and assessments at the time of drafting. No responsibility is assumed for completeness or accuracy, particularly intervening changes.

airlines-lufthansa-timing.claim: says meeting either time limit is enough to avoid paying.
airlines-lufthansa-timing.quote:
Cancellation
If the flight for which you have a confirmed booking is cancelled, you have the same rights to re-routing, assistance, reimbursement and compensation as described above.
However, you are not entitled to compensation as per the EU Regulation if the incident can be attributed to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken. Such circumstances include bad weather conditions, political instability, strikes by third parties, security risks and unexpected shortcomings in flight safety, for example.
You are also not entitled to compensation if * you were informed of the cancellation at least 14 days before departure, * you were informed of the cancellation between 14 and 7 days before departure and your flight departs no more than two hours before the original departure time and/or you arrive no more than four hours after the scheduled arrival time, * you were informed of the cancellation less than seven days before departure and your flight departs no more than one hour before the original departure time and/or you arrive no more than two hours after the scheduled arrival time.
airlines-lufthansa-timing.example: A Lufthansa-operated Frankfurt–Madrid flight is cancelled ten days ahead for an ordinary operational reason. The replacement leaves at the original time but arrives six hours late. Meeting the departure limit alone does not remove compensation.
airlines-lufthansa-timing.context: The full Cancellation passage, the separate extraordinary-circumstances exception, adjoining compensation amounts and reductions, linked disruption help and carriage terms were checked. None changes the positive “and/or” test into a cumulative one.
airlines-lufthansa-timing.scope: Passengers on covered flights actually operated by Lufthansa, offered rerouting meeting only one safeguard. Confirmed booking and ordinary eligibility rules apply. Notice at least 14 days in advance and a proven extraordinary-circumstances defence can independently remove fixed compensation. Refund, rerouting and care remain distinct.

Annulation
Si le vol pour lequel vous avez une réservation confirmée est annulé, vous disposez des mêmes droits de nouveau trajet, de prise en charge, de remboursement et d’indemnisation décrits ci-dessus.
En revanche, en vertu du Règlement européen, vous n’avez pas le droit à une indemnisation si l’incident peut être imputé à des circonstances extraordinaires qui n’auraient pu être évitées même en prenant toutes les mesures raisonnables. Ces circonstances incluent par exemple de mauvaises conditions météorologiques, une instabilité politique, des grèves menées par des tiers, des risques en matière de sécurité et des défaillances imprévues dans la sécurité des vols.
De même, vous n’avez pas le droit à une indemnisation si * vous avez été informé de l’annulation au moins 14 jours avant le départ ; * vous avez été informé de l’annulation entre 14 et 7 jours avant le départ et que votre vol de départ part au plus tard deux heures avant l’heure de départ d’origine et/ou si vous arrivez au plus tard quatre heures après l’heure d’arrivée prévue ; * vous avez été informé de l’annulation moins de sept jours avant le départ et que votre vol de départ part au plus tard une heure avant l’heure de départ d’origine et/ou si vous arrivez au plus tard deux heures après l’heure d’arrivée prévue.

airlines-emirates-timing.quote: No compensation is awardable if: the cancellation was caused by extraordinary circumstances, despite reasonable measures taken by us to avoid them. Examples of such circumstances include, but are not limited to, cases of political instability, weather conditions including volcanic ash incompatible with operation of the aircraft, security risks, strikes which affect flight operations, and air traffic control or air traffic management decisions concerning your flight; or you have been informed of the cancellation at least two weeks before the scheduled time of departure of your flight; or you have been informed of the cancellation between two weeks and seven days before the scheduled time of departure of your flight and have been offered re-routing on a flight which allows you to depart no more than two hours earlier than the scheduled time of your cancelled flight and allows you to reach your final destination no less than four hours after the scheduled time of arrival of your cancelled flight; or you have been informed of the cancellation less than seven days before the scheduled time of departure of your flight and have been offered re-routing on a flight which allows you to depart no more than one hour earlier than the scheduled time of your cancelled flight and allows you to reach your final destination no less than two hours after the scheduled time of arrival of your cancelled flight.
airlines-emirates-timing.example: Emirates cancels Paris–Dubai three days ahead for an ordinary operational reason. The replacement leaves at the original time and arrives five hours late. The notice’s two-hour-minimum wording excludes compensation; the statutory short-notice exception does not.
airlines-emirates-timing.context: Eligibility, rerouting/refund, assistance, the full compensation exceptions, later 50% reduction provision and overriding-law clause in the carriage conditions were reviewed. The separate reduction provision does not correct the earlier exclusion. French has an additional departure-window difference; the finding relies on the arrival reversal shared by all three versions.
airlines-emirates-timing.scope: Passengers on Emirates-operated departures from the EU. An ordinary separate Dubai–EU inbound flight is outside this finding. Confirmed booking and ordinary eligibility rules apply. Notice at least 14 days in advance and a proven extraordinary-circumstances defence can independently remove fixed compensation. Refund, rerouting and care remain distinct.

Beispiele für solche Umstände sind unter anderem Fälle politischer Instabilität, Wetterbedingungen (wie zum Beispiel Vulkanasche), die mit dem Betrieb des Flugzeugs unvereinbar sind, Sicherheitsrisiken, Streiks, die den Flugbetrieb beeinträchtigen, sowie Entscheidungen der Flugsicherung oder des Flugverkehrsmanagements in Bezug auf Ihren Flug; oder sie mindestens zwei Wochen vor der geplanten Abflugzeit Ihres Flugs über die Annullierung informiert wurden; oder sie zwischen zwei Wochen und sieben Tagen vor der planmäßigen Abflugzeit Ihres Flugs über die Annullierung informiert wurden und Ihnen eine anderweitige Beförderung mit einem Flug angeboten wurde, der es Ihnen ermöglicht, nicht mehr als zwei Stunden früher als die planmäßige Abflugzeit Ihres annullierten Flugs abzufliegen und Ihr Endziel nicht weniger als vier Stunden nach der planmäßigen Ankunftszeit Ihres annullierten Flugs zu erreichen; oder sie weniger als sieben Tage vor der planmäßigen Abflugzeit Ihres Flugs über die Annullierung informiert wurden und Ihnen eine anderweitige Beförderung mit einem Flug angeboten wurde, der es Ihnen ermöglicht, nicht mehr als eine Stunde früher als die planmäßige Abflugzeit Ihres annullierten Flugs abzufliegen und Ihr Endziel nicht weniger als zwei Stunden nach der planmäßigen Ankunftszeit Ihres annullierten Flugs zu erreichen.

airlines-air-france-scope.claim: says EU rights apply only if no local rules exist.
airlines-air-france-scope.quote: You are traveling on a flight departing from an airport within the European Union (EU). Please note: if you are traveling on a flight departing from an airport in a third country (outside the EU), the rights described in this document apply only if you are traveling with a carrier from the EU and arriving at an airport located within the EU, and if no local regulation applies to departures from that third country.
airlines-air-france-scope.example: An Air France-operated non-EU–Paris flight is cancelled. Local law regulates some passenger rights, but equivalent protection has not been established. Those local rules alone do not switch off EU261.
airlines-air-france-scope.context: The complete opening conditions, all cancellation/delay/denied-boarding sections, later statements that local schemes may apply, customer-service referrals, linked PDFs and carriage conditions were reviewed. The later local-scheme references do not restore or qualify the opening blanket restriction.
airlines-air-france-scope.scope: Limited to third-country departures into the EU actually operated by an EU carrier, with the other eligibility conditions met. The statutory third-country benefits/compensation-and-assistance exception and the Court’s equivalence assessment still apply. This does not establish a right to duplicate recovery.

airlines-british-airways-refund.claim: says you must claim used and unused flights at the same time.
airlines-british-airways-refund.quote: If a cancellation or delay of five hours or more disrupts a connecting journey for which you hold a through ticket (with a planned connection time of 24 hours or less) and you no longer wish to continue to your destination, the operating carrier will provide a return flight to the original point of departure at the earliest opportunity as well as refunding the parts of the journey not flown. If you choose not to continue with your journey and decide to return to your point of departure, the purchaser of your ticket is entitled to receive a reimbursement for the part(s) of the journey which were flown, providing that you can prove that the journey no longer serves any purpose in relation to your original travel plans. To obtain a reimbursement of a flown sector, the purchaser of the ticket must make the claim at the same time as claiming the refund of the unflown sectors.
airlines-british-airways-refund.example: A passenger on an EU-departing BA through journey abandons a cancelled connection and qualifies for a refund of an already-flown sector because the journey no longer serves its original purpose. They request the unused-sector refund first, then supplement it within the valid limitation period. Timing alone is not an Article 8 disqualification.
airlines-british-airways-refund.context: The full used-sector paragraph, proof-of-lost-purpose condition, return-flight provision, nearby 24-hour connection wording, linked help and general carriage terms were checked. Help repeats the simultaneity requirement. A general promise to comply with law does not explain that later supplementary requests remain available.
airlines-british-airways-refund.scope: Qualifying passengers on BA-operated EU departures who abandon a disrupted journey and meet the statutory used-sector refund conditions. Not every later request must succeed: journey purpose, standing, valid settlements and limitation rules can matter. The separate 24-hour connection condition is unresolved.

versions.quote: If a cancellation or delay of five hours or more disrupts a connecting journey for which you hold a through ticket (with a planned connection time of 24 hours or less) and you no longer wish to continue to your destination, the operating carrier will provide a return flight to the original point of departure at the earliest opportunity as well as refunding the parts of the journey not flown. To obtain a reimbursement of a flown sector, the purchaser of the ticket must make the claim at the same time as claiming the refund of the unflown sectors.

Im Falle einer Flugstornierung oder Verspätung über fünf Stunden auf einer Reise mit Anschlussflug, für den der Fluggast ein gültiges Ticket besitzt (mit geplantem Anschlussflug innerhalb von 24 Stunden) und infolgedessen seine Weiterreise an den Zielort nicht fortsetzen möchte, erhält der Fluggast so früh wie möglich einen Rückflug durch die zuständige Fluggesellschaft zum ersten Abflugort und die Rückzahlung der nicht geflogenen Strecken. Wenn der Fluggast seine Reise nicht fortsetzen möchte und sich für die Rückkehr zum ersten Abflugort entscheidet, hat der Ticketkäufer das Recht auf Rückerstattung der bereits geflogenen Strecken, vorausgesetzt der Fluggast kann belegen, dass seine Reise infolgedessen im Hinblick auf seinen ursprünglichen Reiseplan keinen Zweck mehr hat. Um die Rückerstattung für geflogene Strecken zu erhalten, muss der Ticketkäufer den entsprechenden Antrag gleichzeitig mit seiner Forderung auf Rückzahlung der nicht geflogenen Strecken stellen.
versions.tr: If cancellation or a delay of five hours or more disrupts a connecting journey for which the passenger holds a through ticket (with a planned connection within 24 hours) and the passenger no longer wishes to continue to the destination, the operating carrier provides a return flight to the first point of departure as soon as possible and refunds the unflown sectors. If the passenger chooses not to continue and returns to the first point of departure, the ticket purchaser is entitled to reimbursement of the flown sectors, provided the passenger can prove that the journey no longer serves any purpose in relation to the original travel plan. To obtain reimbursement for flown sectors, the ticket purchaser must submit the claim at the same time as the claim for reimbursement of the unflown sectors.

versions.quote: Si l’annulation ou le retard de cinq heures ou plus perturbe la correspondance d’un voyage pour lequel vous détenez un billet de bout en bout (avec un temps de correspondance inférieur ou égal à 24 heures) et que vous ne souhaitez pas poursuivre votre voyage jusqu’à destination, la compagnie aérienne vous fournira un vol de retour au point de départ, dans les meilleurs délais et vous remboursera les parties non effectuées du voyage. Si vous choisissez de ne pas poursuivre votre voyage et décidez de revenir à votre point de départ, l’acheteur de votre billet peut prétendre au remboursement d’une ou des partie(s) du voyage effectuées, à la condition de pouvoir prouver que le voyage n’a plus lieu d’être au regard de vos projets de voyage initiaux. Pour obtenir le remboursement d’un secteur voyagé, l’acheteur du billet doit faire la réclamation en même temps qu’il demande le remboursement des secteurs non effectués.

airlines-emirates-hotel.claim: offers a hotel only if the new flight leaves on a later date.
airlines-emirates-hotel.quote: If you are involuntarily denied boarding, you will be entitled to: Meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to waiting time together with two telephone calls, telexes, faxes or e-mails. Accommodation, if a stay of one or more nights, or a stay additional to that intended by you, becomes necessary when the reasonably expected time of departure of the new flight is one day or more later than the scheduled departure date of your canceled flight, you will be entitled to hotel accommodation and surface transport between the airport and such accommodation. Provision of the assistance described above will be free of charge. You will be entitled to such assistance only to the extent that we reasonably expect its provision would not cause delay.
airlines-emirates-hotel.example: A passenger is involuntarily denied boarding on an EU-departing 00:30 flight. The earliest replacement leaves at 08:00 on the same date, and overnight accommodation is necessary. Article 4/9 contains no later-date bar to that necessary care.
airlines-emirates-hotel.context: Eligibility, all three refund/rerouting options, full assistance bullet, the separate care-causes-delay qualification and neighbouring delay/cancellation notices were compared. Necessity of accommodation remains essential. Choosing a later convenient reroute does not provide open-ended hotel rights.
airlines-emirates-hotel.scope: Eligible passengers involuntarily denied boarding on Emirates-operated EU departures, awaiting earliest rerouting and needing hotel accommodation although the replacement departs later on the same calendar date. Reasonable health, safety/security or document-based refusal can fall outside statutory denied boarding.

Provision of the assistance described above will be free of charge. You will be entitled to such assistance only to the extent that we reasonably expect its provision would not cause delay.

Wenn Ihnen die Beförderung unfreiwillig verweigert wird, haben Sie Anspruch auf folgende Leistungen: Mahlzeiten und Getränke in angemessenem Verhältnis zur Wartezeit sowie zwei Telefonanrufe, Telexe, Faxe oder E-Mails. Falls ein Aufenthalt von einer oder mehreren Nächten oder ein zusätzlicher Aufenthalt als der von Ihnen beabsichtigte notwendig wird, wenn die vernünftigerweise erwartete Abflugzeit des neuen Flugs einen Tag oder mehr später als das geplante Abflugdatum liegt, an dem der Flug annulliert wurde, haben Sie Anspruch auf Unterbringung und Beförderung zwischen dem Flughafen und dem Ort der Unterbringung. Die Bereitstellung der oben beschriebenen Unterstützung ist kostenlos. Ihr Anspruch auf Unterstützungsleistungen gilt nur insoweit, als ihre Inanspruchnahme voraussichtlich nicht zu Verspätungen führt.
versions.tr: If you are involuntarily denied boarding, you are entitled to: Meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to waiting time and two telephone calls, telexes, faxes or emails. If a stay of one or more nights, or an additional stay beyond what you intended, becomes necessary when the reasonably expected departure time of the new flight is one day or more later than the scheduled departure date of your cancelled flight, you are entitled to accommodation and transport between the airport and that accommodation. The assistance described above is free. You are entitled to assistance only insofar as providing it is not expected to cause delay.

versions.quote: Si vous êtes involontairement refusé à l'embarquement, vous aurez droit à : Les repas et rafraîchissements raisonnablement liés au délai d'attente, ainsi que deux appels téléphoniques, telex, fax ou courriers électroniques. La fourniture de l'assistance décrite ci-dessus sera gratuite. Vous n'aurez droit à cette assistance que dans la mesure où celle-ci ne provoque pas de retards supplémentaires.

airlines-austrian-intra-eu-delay-care.claim: says care starts after four hours on flights over 3,500 km.
airlines-austrian-intra-eu-delay-care.quote: If a flight is reasonably expected to be delayed beyond its scheduled time of departure * (a) for two hours or more in the case of flights of 1,500 kilometres or less; or * (b) for three hours or more in the case of flights between 1,500 and 3,500 kilometres; or * (c) for four hours or more in the case of all flights of more than 3,500 kilometres, we offer you free of charge: * meals and refreshments in a reasonable relation to the waiting time; and * the option to contact your planned destination by telex, fax, telephone or email messages. When the reasonably expected time of departure is at least the day after the time of departure previously announced, we also offer you, subject to local availability: * hotel accommodation in cases where an unplanned stopover of one or more nights becomes necessary, and * transport between the airport and place of accommodation.
airlines-austrian-intra-eu-delay-care.law: On covered intra-EU flights longer than 1,500 km, an expected departure delay of at least three hours triggers reasonable meals/refreshments and two communications.
airlines-austrian-intra-eu-delay-care.example: An eligible passenger on an Austrian-operated intra-EU route above 3,500 km faces an expected departure delay of 3h30. The notice places that flight in its four-hour band; Article 6(1)(b) already requires meals/refreshments and two communications.
airlines-austrian-intra-eu-delay-care.context: Full EU scope, delay, cancellation, denied-boarding and downgrade text read. The compensation distance bands expressly mention intra-EU flights, but that statement concerns compensation amounts and does not repair the care-trigger list. Canadian material on /ca was excluded. The notice limits itself to Austrian as operating carrier.
airlines-austrian-intra-eu-delay-care.scope: Eligible passengers on Austrian-operated intra-EU flights longer than 3,500 km; a reasonable expected departure delay of at least three but less than four hours. Care is separate from fixed compensation and its extraordinary-circumstances defence.

versions.quote: If a flight is reasonably expected to be delayed beyond its scheduled time of departure * (a) for two hours or more in the case of flights of 1,500 kilometres or less; or * (b) for three hours or more in the case of flights between 1,500 and 3,500 kilometres; or * (c) for four hours or more in the case of all flights of more than 3,500 kilometres, we offer you free of charge: * meals and refreshments in a reasonable relation to the waiting time; and * the option to contact your planned destination by telex, fax, telephone or email messages. When the reasonably expected time of departure is at least the day after the time of departure previously announced, we also offer you, subject to local availability: * hotel accommodation in cases where an unplanned stopover of one or more nights becomes necessary, and * transport between the airport and place of accommodation.

airlines-lufthansa-intra-eu-reduction.claim: says compensation may be halved when rerouting on intra-EU flights over 3,500 km arrives up to four hours late.
airlines-lufthansa-intra-eu-reduction.quote: If you are offered an alternative flight and the arrival time is no later than two hours after the scheduled arrival time of the originally booked flight for flights of up to 1,500 km, no later than three hours after the scheduled arrival time for flights of between 1,500 and 3,500 km and no later than four hours after the scheduled arrival time for flights of more than 3,500 km, the compensation will only be 50% of the above amounts, i.e. €125.00, €200.00 or €300.00. You are not entitled to the compensation described above if you are justifiably denied boarding through your own fault, for health or safety-related reasons, or due to missing or insufficient travel documents.
airlines-lufthansa-intra-eu-reduction.law: The Article 7(2) rerouting reduction on intra-EU flights longer than 1,500 km requires arrival no more than three hours late.
airlines-lufthansa-intra-eu-reduction.example: An eligible passenger is involuntarily denied boarding on an intra-EU Lufthansa-operated flight above 3,500 km. Rerouting arrives 3h30 late. Article 7(2)(b) does not permit a 50% reduction; the notice's distance-only paragraph does.
airlines-lufthansa-intra-eu-reduction.context: Full notice reviewed. The preceding compensation amounts and the delay-care paragraph explicitly include the intra-EU category; the separate reduction paragraph omits it. Amounts table overlaps above 3,500 km, so do not assume an actual €200 payment or assert the carrier's applied amount. Narrowly allege an overbroad permission to halve the otherwise applicable Article 7 amount.

airlines-klm-third-country-scope.law: Article 3(1)(b), interpreted in van der Lans paragraphs 27–29, does not make any local regulation an automatic exclusion. The court requires an assessment of equivalent protection; actual receipt need not always be proved.

airlines-klm-intra-eu-delay-reduction.src: Passenger Rights, general Air France/KLM notice, 2.2 Delay compensation
airlines-klm-intra-eu-delay-reduction.claim: publishes a general Air France/KLM notice permitting a 50% delay-compensation reduction by distance alone above 3,500 km.
airlines-klm-intra-eu-delay-reduction.quote:
If your arrival has been delayed by 3 hours or more compared to the scheduled arrival time, you are entitled to compensation, except if the delay is caused by extraordinary circumstances which could not have been anticipated by the airline and if the airline has taken all reasonable measures to avoid the delay.
The compensation cannot be paid at the airport and therefore you need to contact our customer service team (ref. section 5). You can choose between compensation offered in non-refundable transportation credit voucher or cash compensation.
Non-refundable transportation credit voucher amounts:
A | Flights of 1500 km or less | EUR 350*
B | Flights within the EU of more than 1500 km, and all other flights between 1500 and 3500 km | EUR 500*
C | All other flights | EUR 800*
Cash compensation amounts:
A | Flights of 1500 km or less | EUR 250*
B | Flights within the EU of more than 1500 km, and all other flights between 1500 and 3500 km | EUR 400*
C | All other flights | EUR 600*
* This compensation may be reduced by 50% for flights of more than 3500 km if the arrival time of the delayed flight is between 3 and 4 hours after the scheduled arrival time.
This compensation scheme is based on EU Regulation 261/2004. If you are departing from an airport outside the EU (but to a destination in an EU country,) local regulations and other compensation schemes may apply. For more information, please contact our customer service team (ref. section 5).
airlines-klm-intra-eu-delay-reduction.law: Sturgeon paragraph 63 allows the long-flight delay reduction by reference to Article 7(2)(c), which excludes the intra-EU category. An intra-EU flight over 1,500 km arriving 3h30 late attracts the EUR 400 Article 7(1)(b) amount if otherwise eligible; distance over 3,500 km alone does not permit halving it.
airlines-klm-intra-eu-delay-reduction.example: Hypothetical: An eligible passenger on an Air France-operated Paris–Saint-Denis de la Réunion flight arrives 3h30 late for an ordinary operational reason. Both airports are within EU territory and the route exceeds 3,500 km. With no extraordinary-circumstances defence, Article 7(1)(b) gives EUR 400; the generic Air France/KLM notice published by KLM permits a 50% reduction despite Article 7(2)(b)’s three-hour limit being exceeded.
airlines-klm-intra-eu-delay-reduction.context: The opening eligibility conditions describe EU261 generally, and section 5 refers readers to Air France or KLM; the linked PDF also names both. The finding concerns KLM’s publication of that general notice for an Air France-operated journey. It does not assert that KLM operates Paris–Réunion. The cash table correctly puts all intra-EU flights over 1,500 km in band B at EUR 400, and the cancellation/denied-boarding footnotes use A/B/C categories. The delay footnote instead uses distance alone. Linked PDF physical page 4 repeats it; page 6 names Air France/KLM customer care. No actual payment is established.
airlines-klm-intra-eu-delay-reduction.scope: General EU261 notice published by KLM and referring to Air France/KLM, applied to an eligible Air France-operated intra-EU flight over 3,500 km arriving more than three and less than four hours late, absent a proven extraordinary-circumstances defence. Air France’s official summer 2026 network release establishes the Paris–Réunion route category; TFEU Article 355(1) places Réunion within Treaty territory. No KLM-operated route of this length within the EU is asserted.

airlines-chair-english-cancellation-or.law: Under Article 5(1)(c)(ii) and (iii), the applicable rerouting exception requires both departure and arrival limits to be met. For notice 7–14 days ahead, those limits are departure no more than two hours early and arrival less than four hours late. For notice under seven days, they are departure no more than one hour early and arrival less than two hours late. Article 5(3) extraordinary circumstances remains a separate defence.

Offered rerouting leaves at the original time but arrives six hours late. The departure limit is met and the arrival limit is not. The English or formulation excludes compensation, while the statutory rerouting exception does not. Actual Article 7 amount and all eligibility facts require separate assessment.

versions.tr: If the flight was cancelled because of extraordinary circumstances, the passenger has no right to compensation. There is likewise no right to compensation when informed of cancellation at least 14 days before the booked departure; when informed between 14 and 7 days before departure and the offered alternative departs no more than 2 hours before the original departure time, respectively arrives no more than 4 hours after the planned arrival time; and when informed less than 7 days before departure and departure is no more than 1 hour before the original departure time, respectively arrival no more than 2 hours after the planned arrival time. The responsible Swiss complaints body is the Federal Office of Civil Aviation, Passenger Rights, CH-3003 Bern. If the passenger books through a flight tour organiser and it supplies the Regulation 261/04 services for denied boarding, cancellation or delay, the passenger cannot require Chair Airlines to provide those services again.

airlines-air-europa-english-seven-hours-.claim: limits the short-notice rerouting exception to seven hours in English, while Spanish says seven days.
airlines-air-europa-english-seven-hours-.quote:
2. Flight cancellation
This is the non-execution of a scheduled flight for which a ticket has been purchased.
The following rights are applicable in the event of cancellation:
Rights to information, assistance and refund or alternative transport under the same terms as the denied boarding.
Right to be compensated in terms similar to denied boarding, unless:
You have been informed of the cancellation with 14 days or more prior notice of the scheduled flight, or
You have been informed of the cancellation between 7 and 14 days in advance with regard to the scheduled departure time and are offered an alternative transport arrangement that allows you to leave no more than two hours in advance of the scheduled departure time and reach your final destination fewer than four hours behind the expected arrival time, or
You have been informed of the cancellation fewer than seven hours in advance with regard to the scheduled departure time and are offered another flight that allows you to leave no more than one or two hours in advance of the scheduled departure time and reach your final destination fewer than two hours behind the expected arrival time, or
If the airline can prove that the cancellation was caused by extraordinary circumstances, such as political instability, weather conditions incompatible with the execution of the flight, safety risks, unexpected flight safety deficiencies, strikes affecting the operations of an airline tasked with executing the flight and repercussions of an air traffic management decision in relation to a specific aircraft on a specific date.
airlines-air-europa-english-seven-hours-.law: Article 5(1)(c)(iii) applies to cancellation notices less than seven days before departure, not merely notices within seven hours. It excludes compensation when offered rerouting permits departure no more than one hour early AND arrival less than two hours late. The other notice bands and extraordinary-circumstances defence remain separate.
airlines-air-europa-english-seven-hours-.example: Hypothetical: cancellation of a covered flight is notified two days before departure. Offered rerouting leaves 30 minutes early and arrives one hour late; all eligibility facts are satisfied and there are no extraordinary circumstances. Article 5(1)(c)(iii) removes cancellation compensation. The English list does not put a two-day notice in its fewer-than-seven-hours exception, whereas the Spanish list correctly does.
airlines-air-europa-english-seven-hours-.context: Current English official passenger-rights page links its Spanish market/language counterpart. The full exception lists and their extraordinary-circumstances clauses are retained. Spanish correctly says menos de 7 días and one hour early; the English one or two hours phrase is preserved but is not a separate allegation here.
airlines-air-europa-english-seven-hours-.scope: English guidance for a covered flight; notice between seven hours and seven days before departure; qualifying rerouting and ordinary eligibility. This wording can overstate compensation rights; no actual payment, refusal, harm or intent is inferred.

2. Cancelación de un vuelo
Es la no realización del vuelo programado para el cual ha comprado un billete.
Los derechos en caso de una cancelación son los siguientes:
Derechos a información, a asistencia y al reembolso o a transporte alternativo en los mismos términos que la denegación de embarque.
Derecho a ser compensado, en términos similares a la denegación de embarque a no ser que:
Se le haya informado de la cancelación con una antelación de 14 días o más con respecto al vuelo previsto, o

2. Cancellation of a flight
This is the non-operation of the scheduled flight for which you purchased a ticket.
The rights in case of cancellation are:
Rights to information, assistance, reimbursement or alternative transport on the same terms as denied boarding.
A right to compensation on terms similar to denied boarding, unless:
You were informed of cancellation 14 days or more before the scheduled flight; or
You were informed between 14 and 7 days before scheduled departure and offered alternative transport allowing departure no more than two hours early and arrival at the final destination less than four hours late; or
You were informed less than 7 days before scheduled departure and offered another flight allowing departure no more than one hour early and arrival at the final destination less than two hours late; or
The airline can prove cancellation was caused by extraordinary circumstances, such as political instability, weather incompatible with flight operation, security risks, unexpected flight-safety deficiencies, strikes affecting an operating carrier, or consequences of an air-traffic-management decision for a particular aircraft on a particular date.

airlines-swiss-mvp-cancellation-compensa.claim: uses alternative departure or arrival safeguards to exclude cancellation compensation.
airlines-swiss-mvp-cancellation-compensa.quote:
Cancellation

If your flight is cancelled, you also have the same rights to alternative transport, care services, reimbursement and compensation specified above.
However, you are not entitled to receive compensation under the EU Regulation if the event can be attributed to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken. This includes, for example, poor weather conditions, political instability, strikes, security risks and unexpected flight safety deficiencies.

There is also no right to compensation if:
• the passenger is informed of the cancellation at least 14 days before departure
• the passenger is informed of the cancellation between 14 and 7 days before departure and the alternative flight departs no more than 2 hours before the original departure time or arrives no more than 4 hours after the scheduled arrival time
• the passenger is informed of the cancellation less than 7 days before departure and the alternative flight departs no more than one hour before the original departure time or arrives no more than 2 hours after the scheduled arrival time.
airlines-swiss-mvp-cancellation-compensa.law: For cancellation notified seven to fourteen days before departure, Article 5(1)(c)(ii) requires both departure no more than two hours early and arrival less than four hours late. Under seven days, Article 5(1)(c)(iii) requires both departure no more than one hour early and arrival less than two hours late. A proven Article 5(3) extraordinary-circumstances defence remains separate. Article 7(2) compensation reduction is a different rule.
airlines-swiss-mvp-cancellation-compensa.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Swiss EU27 departure is cancelled ten days ahead for an ordinary operational reason. The replacement departs at the original time and arrives six hours late. The statutory notice exception fails; meeting the departure safeguard alone does not remove compensation.

airlines-easyjet-mvp-rerouting.claim: conditions other-carrier rerouting expenses on availability of its own later flights.
airlines-easyjet-mvp-rerouting.quote:
If your flight has been cancelled, we will try to get you an easyJet flight to your final destination within 24 hours of your original flight.
You can search for available flights and choose which one you want to transfer on to on Manage Bookings.

If there are no flights available to get you to your destination within 24 hours, you have the option to transfer to another airline, take a train, bus, or hire a car to complete your journey within that time.
The alternative transport must be under comparable transport conditions (e.g. economy or standard fare) to your destination, and you will be entitled to claim reasonable transport costs back. If you need additional support or special assistance, please contact our team.

Please ensure you obtain a detailed itemised receipt. For more information on how to claim back expenses or for further help please refer to our expenses page, alternatively, you can contact us.
Please note that you cannot claim for both a refund for your flight and rerouting on alternative transport.
airlines-easyjet-mvp-rerouting.law: For a covered cancellation, Articles5(1)(a) and8(1)(b) require re-routing under comparable transport conditions at the earliest opportunity. There is no general24-hour or same/next-day priority for the original carrier. Rusu C354/18 addresses informed choice and the carrier burden to prove earliest rerouting. TAP C74/19 concerns reasonable measures for the compensation defence and requires seeking earlier available other-carrier alternatives, subject to unavailability or intolerable sacrifice. This is not unconditional reimbursement of any chosen fare; availability, comparability, reasonable costs and opportunity to arrange assistance matter.
airlines-easyjet-mvp-rerouting.example: Hypothetical: eligible Paris–Rome cancellation; easyJet arrival23h later, practicable comparable competitor arrival4h later. Passenger promptly asks carrier to arrange it. Refusal solely because own flight arrives within24h fails earliest opportunity.

If we cancel your flight for reasons and there are no circumstances beyond our control, you are entitled to financial compensation. Please note that this does not apply if:

• We inform you of the cancellation of your flight between two weeks and seven days before the originally scheduled departure time and we offer you an alternative flight to your destination, for which the new departure time is no earlier than two hours before the scheduled departure time of the cancelled flight and the new arrival time is no more than four hours after the original arrival time.

• We inform you of your flight cancellation at least two weeks before the originally scheduled departure time.
• We inform you of the cancellation of your flight between two weeks and seven days before the originally scheduled departure time and we offer you an alternative flight to your destination, for which the new departure time is no earlier than two hours before the scheduled departure time of the cancelled flight and the new arrival time is no more than four hours after the original arrival time.
• We inform you of the cancellation of your flight within seven days before the originally scheduled departure time and we offer you an alternative flight to your destination, for which the departure time is no earlier than one hour before the scheduled departure time of the cancelled flight and the new arrival time is no more than two hours after the original arrival time;

airlines-iberia-mvp-cancellation-compens.claim: includes arrival exactly four hours late in the 7–14-day cancellation exception.
airlines-iberia-mvp-cancellation-compens.quote:
The Regulation provides for excluding obligations on operating air carriers paying compensation to passengers when:
• If it can be proven that the cancellation is due to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken, such as political instability, weather conditions incompatible with the operation of the flight concerned, security risks, unexpected flight safety shortcomings beyond the carrier’s control, and strikes, or other industrial action, affecting the operations of an operating air carrier.
• If passengers are informed of the cancellation at least two weeks before the scheduled time of departure.
• Passengers are informed of the cancellation between two weeks and seven days before the scheduled time of departure and are offered re-routing, allowing them to depart no more than two hours before the scheduled time of departure and to reach their final destination no more than four hours after the scheduled time of arrival.
• Passengers are informed of the cancellation less than seven days before the scheduled time of departure and are offered re-routing, allowing them to depart no more than one hour before the scheduled time of departure and to reach their final destination less than two hours after the scheduled time of arrival.
airlines-iberia-mvp-cancellation-compens.law: Article5(1)(c)(ii) excludes compensation for cancellation notified seven to fourteen days ahead only where offered rerouting departs no more than two hours early AND reaches the final destination less than four hours late. Arrival exactly four hours late does not meet that exception. A proven extraordinary-circumstances defence or notice at least fourteen days ahead independently excludes compensation; Article7(2) reduction is separate.
airlines-iberia-mvp-cancellation-compens.example: Hypothetical: Iberia cancels Madrid–Paris ten days before departure for an ordinary operational reason. A replacement departs at the original time and arrives exactly four hours late. The English notice's inclusive four-hour exception excludes compensation; Article5(1)(c)(ii) does not.
airlines-iberia-mvp-cancellation-compens.context: Complete governing exclusion list preserved. Under-seven-day band is correctly strict. Later50%compensation reduction is a separate provision and does not correct the preceding exclusion.
airlines-iberia-mvp-cancellation-compens.scope: English page only; eligible EU departure, cancellation notice7–14days, replacement arriving exactly four hours late, no independent extraordinary-circumstances defence.

airlines-asiana-airlines-mvp-delay-refun.claim: sets the departure-delay reimbursement threshold above five hours.
airlines-asiana-airlines-mvp-delay-refun.quote: In accordance with the EU Regulation a delay occurs when a flight is delayed beyond its scheduled departure time by 4 hours for flights of more than 3.500 km, by 3 hours for flights between 1.500 km and 3.500 km as well as intra-Community flights of more than 1.500 km, and by 2 hours for flights of up to 1.500 km. When your flight is expected to have a delay, passengers are entitled to receive care while waiting. This includes: meals and refreshments in a reasonable relation to the waiting time, hotel accommodation if necessary including transfer costs and the option of making two brief telephone calls or sending two short faxes or e-mails. Care for passengers while waiting may be declined if the provision of the care would itself cause further delay. In case of more than 5 hours you are entitled to a refund of your ticket within seven days for the parts not used or for those parts already used if your flight no longer serves its purpose, and when relevant, a return flight to your first point of departure.
airlines-asiana-airlines-mvp-delay-refun.law: Article6(1)(iii) requires the Article8(1)(a) reimbursement option when departure delay is at least five hours. The more-than wording excludes the exact five-hour point. A passenger must elect not to take the delayed flight; unused parts, already-flown parts that no longer serve the original plan, and relevant earliest return retain their statutory conditions.
airlines-asiana-airlines-mvp-delay-refun.example: Hypothetical: An eligible passenger on a Asiana Airlines-operated EU departure faces exactly five hours of departure delay and elects not to travel. Article6(1)(iii) already triggers the reimbursement option, although the English notice says more than five hours.
airlines-asiana-airlines-mvp-delay-refun.context: Full reimbursement passage retained. Extraordinary-circumstances language elsewhere concerns compensation. airlines-airbaltic-mvp-cancellation-comp.claim: Describes the under-seven-day compensation exception without its departure safeguard
airlines-airbaltic-mvp-cancellation-comp.quote:
The compensation does not apply at all if:

- the flight is cancelled by extraordinary circumstances, which could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken. Such circumstances may, in particular, occur in cases of political instability, metrological conditions incompatible with the operation of the flight concerned, security risks, unexpected flight safety shortcomings beyond air carrier's control and strikes that affect the operation of an operating air career and impact of an air traffic management decision; or
- you are informed of the cancellation at least two weeks before the scheduled time of departure; or
- you are informed of the cancellation between two weeks and seven days before the scheduled time of departure and are offered re-routing, allowing you to depart no more than two hours before the scheduled time of departure and to reach your final destination less than four hours after the scheduled time of arrival; or
- you are informed of the cancellation less than seven days before the scheduled time of departure and to reach your final destination less than two hours after the scheduled time of arrival.
airlines-airbaltic-mvp-cancellation-comp.law: Article5(1)(c)(iii) requires BOTH departure no more than one hour early AND arrival less than two hours late for the under-seven-day notice exception. Article5(3) separately permits an extraordinary-circumstances defence if all reasonable measures could not avoid cancellation. The published positive exception lists only arrival; it is also grammatically incomplete. Article7(2) reduction is separate.
airlines-airbaltic-mvp-cancellation-comp.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Riga departure is cancelled three days before travel; replacement leaves three hours early and arrives one hour late. Assume no extraordinary circumstances and no other defence. The replacement fails the departure safeguard despite satisfying arrival, so this notice exception cannot remove compensation.
airlines-airbaltic-mvp-cancellation-comp.context: A wording finding about the located English notice, not proof of any refusal in practice.
airlines-airbaltic-mvp-cancellation-comp.scope: Narrowly the English Flight cancellation exception accordion. Correct seven-to-fourteen-day rule is retained in the quote. The separate Flight delays accordion describes compensation but supplies no missing departure safeguard. Airline links full Regulation; that is contrary context, not proof a claim was refused. The final bullet is grammatically truncated; the finding concerns its published positive compensation exception, not intent, actual decisions, or an inference from wholly missing guidance.

airlines-kuwait-airways-mvp-delay-refund.claim: requires already-flown and unflown reimbursement claims to be made at the same time.
airlines-kuwait-airways-mvp-delay-refund.quote:
Right to reimbursement of part(s) of the journey already flown that no longer serve any purpose in relation to the passenger's original travel plans

If a cancellation or delay of five hours or more disrupts a connecting journey for which you hold a through ticket (with a planned connection time of 24 hours or less) and you no longer wish to continue to your destination, the operating carrier will provide a return flight to the original point of departure at the earliest opportunity as well as refunding the parts of the journey not flown. If you choose not to continue with your journey and decide to return to your point of departure, the purchaser of your ticket is entitled to receive a reimbursement for the part(s) of the journey which were flown, providing that you can prove that the journey no longer serves any purpose in relation to your original travel plans. To obtain a reimbursement of a flown sector, the purchaser of the ticket must make the claim at the same time as claiming the refund of the unflown sectors.
airlines-kuwait-airways-mvp-delay-refund.law: Article8(1)(a), applied to departure delays of at least five hours by Article6(1)(iii), provides reimbursement of already-flown parts when the journey no longer serves the original travel plan. It does not require that request to coincide with the unused-part claim. Valid procedural limitation periods and settlements can still matter.
airlines-kuwait-airways-mvp-delay-refund.example: Hypothetical: After an eligible Kuwait Airways EU-departing through journey is delayed five hours and loses its purpose, the passenger first claims unused sectors and later adds already-flown sectors within a valid limitation period. Article8 does not disqualify the second request solely because it was made later.
airlines-kuwait-airways-mvp-delay-refund.context: Page expressly identifies EC261 and EU departures and states the notice adds no contractual rights. Same drafting as BA does not establish shared hosted notice or separate independent drafting origin.
airlines-kuwait-airways-mvp-delay-refund.scope: Eligible Kuwait Airways-operated EU27 departures, purposeless already-flown journey after at least five-hour departure delay; ordinary procedural limits/settlements remain. airlines-discover-airlines-mvp-cancellat.claim: treats either replacement-flight departure or arrival safeguard as sufficient to remove cancellation compensation.
airlines-discover-airlines-mvp-cancellat.quote:
If the flight on which you had a confirmed booking has been canceled, you also have the same rights to alternative transportation, assistance, refund and compensation as listed above.
However, you are not entitled to compensation under the EU Regulation if the incident is due to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided had all reasonable measures been taken. For example, bad weather conditions, political instability, strikes, security risks or unexpected flight safety defects.
Similarly, there is no right to compensation if:
• you were informed of the cancelation at least 14 days prior to departure
• you were informed of about the cancelation between 14 days and 7 days before departure and where departure was no more than 2 hours before the original departure time, or the arrival was no more than 4 hours after the scheduled arrival time
• you were informed of the cancellation less than 7 days before departure and departure no more than 1 hour before the original departure time or the arrival was no later than 2 hours after the scheduled arrival time.
airlines-discover-airlines-mvp-cancellat.law: Article 5(1)(c)(ii) requires both departure no more than two hours early and arrival less than four hours late for seven-to-fourteen-day notice. Article 5(1)(c)(iii) requires both departure no more than one hour early and arrival less than two hours late for under-seven-day notice. Exactly four or two hours fails the corresponding exemption. Article5(3) extraordinary circumstances remains a separate defence; Article7(2) reduction has distinct inclusive limits.
airlines-discover-airlines-mvp-cancellat.example: Hypothetical: EW Discover GmbH cancels an eligible Frankfurt–Palma flight ten days before departure for an ordinary operational reason. Replacement leaves at the original time but arrives six hours late. The notice's departure alternative would remove compensation; Article5(1)(c)(ii) would not.
airlines-discover-airlines-mvp-cancellat.context: All material qualifications retained in main quotation and displayed scope. Independent review completed; narrow finding confirmed.

If a flight for which you hold a confirmed reservation is canceled, you are entitled to the same rights of re-routing, assistance, refund, and financial compensation as described above. Where possible, you will be offered re-routing on another flight operated by the carrier or alternative comparable travel solutions that allow you to reach your final destination as soon as possible or, subject to your agreement, a full refund of the ticket price.

airlines-tap-air-portugal-mvp-care-extra.claim: makes its delay-care and five-hour reimbursement notice inapplicable in extraordinary circumstances.
airlines-tap-air-portugal-mvp-care-extra.quote:
Delay Notice
The following provisions apply:
• To passengers on flights departing from EU airports and passengers on flights operated by Community carriers departing from airports outside the EU to an EU airport (unless they received benefits, compensation, or assistance in the country of the airport outside the EU);
• Provided that the passengers have a confirmed booking for the relevant flight and present themselves at the check-in as established and in advance, as instructed in writing (or electronically). Or up to forty-five minutes before the departure time, if there is no time specified, or the passengers are transferred, irrespective of the cause, by an air carrier or tour operator from the initially booked flight to another flight;
• Only to passengers with fares available to the public directly or indirectly or tickets issued through a frequent passenger program or other commercial program;
• For flights in which TAP Air Portugal is the operating air carrier.
Note: Not applicable if TAP Air Portugal can demonstrate that the delay was caused by unavoidable, extraordinary circumstances, even if implementing all reasonable measures.

Rules on compensation and assistance
1) When TAP Air Portugal has reasonable grounds to anticipate a flight's delay relative to the scheduled departure time:
1. For two or more hours, in flights up to 1,500 kilometers;
2. For three or more hours, in all intra-Community flights of more than 1 500 kilometers and all flights between 1 500 and 3 500 kilometers;
3. For four or more hours in flights not covered by the paragraphs above.
Note: distances must be measured using the great circle route method.
1.1) TAP Air Portugal will offer free of charge:
1. Meals and drinks in reasonable proportion to waiting time;
2. Telephone card, two telephone calls, or other means of communication.
1.2) When the reasonably expected dep time is at least the day after the previously announced dep time, TAP Air Portugal will also offer, free of charge and in addition to the assistance described above:
1. Hotel accommodation, if:
• The passengers need a stay of one or more nights; or
• The passengers need to extend their stay beyond the original schedule.
2. Transport between the airport and the accommodation (hotel or other).
1.3) When the delay is at least five hours, and the passenger decides not to travel on the delayed flight, TAP will also offer, in addition to the assistance described in paragraphs 1) and 1.1) above, a refund within seven days (in cash, by electronic bank transfer, bank payment order, bank cheques, or with the passenger's written consent, through trip vouchers or other services), of the ticket's whole purchase price or for the uncompleted trip segments.
The trip segments used are also eligible for a refund if the flight no longer suits the initial trip plan, and, in the latter case and where applicable, a return flight (at the earliest possible date) to the primary point of departure will be available.
Note: The above provisions also apply to passengers whose flights include a package trip, except for the right to refund established under the EU Directive 2015/2302.
2) The passenger will be responsible for any costs related to paragraphs a. and b. of 1) and 1.1) above, paid after the third hour before the return flight's dep time or the return flight referred to in paragraph 1.2) above.
3) TAP Air Portugal will provide the assistance referred to in this notice within the periods set out in paragraphs a. b. and c. of 1) above for every order of distance.
4) The assistance stipulated in this notice applies without prejudice to any rights conferred under the applicable legislation (in particular the Directive 90/314/CEE) relating to package trips to further compensation. Any such assistance may be deductible from the total compensation.
airlines-tap-air-portugal-mvp-care-extra.law: Article6 and Article9 require qualifying delay care, including necessary overnight accommodation and transfers when the Article6 overnight trigger is met. Article6(1)(iii) and8(1)(a) provide reimbursement at at least five hours. Extraordinary circumstances do not remove care or reimbursement; Article5(3) exempts qualifying compensation only. McDonagh C-12/11 confirms that even extraordinary events do not dispense with care, with necessary, appropriate and reasonable costs recoverable when care was not supplied.
airlines-tap-air-portugal-mvp-care-extra.example: Hypothetical: An ash-cloud closure delays a TAP Lisbon departure until next day. A passenger who still needs to travel is entitled to necessary hotel and airport transport; a passenger who abandons travel after five hours has the Article8 reimbursement choice. Extraordinary circumstances alone do not remove either right.
airlines-tap-air-portugal-mvp-care-extra.context: Original HTML retained. Cancellation notice independently states care; this candidate concerns Delay Notice blanket exclusion. General law references and without-prejudice-to-further-compensation clause do not clearly limit blanket exclusion to Article7.

airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-del.src: Lufthansa City Airlines English passenger-rights notice
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-del.claim: Sets the departure-delay refund threshold above five hours
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-del.quote:
According to Regulation (EC) 261/2004, a delay is deemed to have occurred when the scheduled departure time is delayed by at least four hours in the case of flights of more than 3.500 km, by at least three hours in the case of flights of between 1.500 and 3.500 km and flights of more than 1.500 km within the EU, and by two hours in the case of flights of up to 1.500 km. When your flight is expected to be significantly delayed, you have the right to receive care from the airline.
This includes: meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to the waiting time, possibly hotel accommodation including transport costs, and the opportunity to make two brief telephone calls or to send two faxes or e-mails. The airline is not required to provide this care if you are responsible for a further delay of your departing flight.
In the case of delays of more than five hours, you have the right to have the cost of your ticket refunded within seven days in the amount of the travel not completed or in the amount of the travel already completed if the purpose of the travel was not accomplished due to the delay, and, if applicable, to a return flight to the point of first departure at the earliest opportunity.
You have the right to compensation if your arrival at the destination airport is delayed by more than three hours and the delay cannot be attributed to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided by taking all reasonable measures; such circumstances include, for example, poor weather conditions, political instability, strikes, security risks, and unexpected deficiencies in flight safety.
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-del.law: Articles6(1)(iii) and8(1)(a) activate reimbursement at a departure delay of at least five hours. Unused parts are refundable; used parts qualify when travel no longer serves its original purpose, together with a relevant earliest return and payment within seven days. This is the choice to abandon the journey, not an automatic refund after flying.
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-del.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Munich departure is delayed exactly five hours and the passenger elects not to travel. The statutory refund is already available, while the notice's more-than threshold excludes that moment.

airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-del.scope: Only the exact-five-hour boundary. Care exclusions and arrival compensation in adjacent quoted paragraphs are outside this case. EU27 departure operated by Lufthansa City Airlines GmbH, ordinary Article3 eligibility.

versions.quote:
According to Regulation (EC) 261/2004, a delay is deemed to have occurred when the scheduled departure time is delayed by at least four hours in the case of flights of more than 3.500 km, by at least three hours in the case of flights of between 1.500 and 3.500 km and flights of more than 1.500 km within the EU, and by two hours in the case of flights of up to 1.500 km. When your flight is expected to be significantly delayed, you have the right to receive care from the airline.
This includes: meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to the waiting time, possibly hotel accommodation including transport costs, and the opportunity to make two brief telephone calls or to send two faxes or e-mails. The airline is not required to provide this care if you are responsible for a further delay of your departing flight.
In the case of delays of more than five hours, you have the right to have the cost of your ticket refunded within seven days in the amount of the travel not completed or in the amount of the travel already completed if the purpose of the travel was not accomplished due to the delay, and, if applicable, to a return flight to the point of first departure at the earliest opportunity.
You have the right to compensation if your arrival at the destination airport is delayed by more than three hours and the delay cannot be attributed to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided by taking all reasonable measures; such circumstances include, for example, poor weather conditions, political instability, strikes, security risks, and unexpected deficiencies in flight safety.

airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-can.src: Lufthansa City Airlines English passenger-rights notice
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-can.claim: Uses alternative departure or arrival safeguards for cancellation exemptions
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-can.quote:
If the flight for which you have a confirmed reservation is cancelled, you have the same rights to re-routing, care, reimbursement, and compensation as described above.
However, you are not entitled to compensation as per the EU Regulation if the incident can be attributed to extraordinary circumstances that could not have been avoided by taking all reasonable measures. Such circumstances include, for instance, poor weather conditions, political instability, third party strikes, security risks, and unexpected deficiencies in flight safety.
Likewise, you are not entitled to compensation if:
  * you are informed of the cancellation at least 14 days before departure,
  * you are informed of the cancellation between 14 days and 7 days before departure and your departing flight leaves no more than two hours before the original departure time and/or you arrive no more than four hours after the planned arrival time,
  * you are informed of the cancellation less than seven days before departure and your departing flight leaves no more than one hour before the original departure time and/or you arrive no more than two hours after the planned arrival time.
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-can.law: Article5(1)(c)(ii) requires departure no more than two hours early AND arrival less than four hours late for seven-to-fourteen-day notice; Article5(1)(c)(iii) requires departure no more than one hour early AND arrival less than two hours late for under-seven-day notice. Both safeguards must hold. Article5(3) extraordinary circumstances remains separate, and Article7(2) reduction has different inclusive limits.
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-can.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Munich departure is cancelled three days in advance for an ordinary operational reason. A replacement leaves three hours early but arrives one hour late. It meets the notice's arrival alternative but fails the statutory departure safeguard; assume no extraordinary defence.
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-can.context: Wording assessment of the located English guidance, without any inference of actual refusal or intent.
airlines-lufthansa-city-airlines-mvp-can.scope: English page only, notice-exception wording and exact-arrival boundaries. Existing Lufthansa notice has closely shared wording; separate operator/publication, not an independent drafting origin. No industry inference.

roaming-go-fair-use-or.claim: lets either time or use abroad trigger fair-use checks.
roaming-go-fair-use-or.quote: To prevent abusive or anomalous usage whilst roaming in EU Zone 1, a fair usage policy will apply when: i. Over a period of four (4) consecutive months the total number of days Your SIM card, on which these Tariff Plans are activated, is logged onto a foreign network whilst roaming in the EU Zone 1 is higher than the total number of days it is logged onto Our network in Malta, or ii. Over a period of four (4) consecutive months the total amount of usage in calls, SMS, and Data whilst roaming in the EU Zone 1 will be more than 50% of Your total usage in Malta and EU Zone 1, or iii. Your SIM card, on which these Tariff Plans are activated, is exclusively used whilst roaming in the EU Zone 1 and not used for making or receiving calls and SMS or for data usage whilst in Malta for multiple periods of four (4) weeks or a single continuous period of two (2) months in the previous consecutive four (4) months. d. In the event that either of the conditions in 9.c above are not met, We shall contact You and advise You on your anomalous usage and to reduce your usage to the limits indicated in 8.c above within two (2) weeks from the date of Our notification.
roaming-go-fair-use-or.example: An otherwise eligible active user spends 70% of the relevant days in Malta but makes 80% of usage while travelling in another EU state over four months. With no other abuse indicator, the domestic-presence safe harbour prevents usage alone from establishing abusive roaming.
roaming-go-fair-use-or.context: The full clause includes a separate SIM-inactivity indicator and a two-week warning followed by possible surcharging. versions.quote: V případě podezření na zneužití EU Roamingu Operátor sleduje současně oba výše uvedené ukazatele (tj. přítomnost a spotřebu) po dobu nejméně 4 měsíců, a je-li výsledkem tohoto sledování skutečnost, že u dotčeného Účastníka převládá spotřeba v EU Roamingu, a/nebo převládá-li přítomnost dotčeného Účastníka v jiných členských státech EU nad přítomností na území ČR, Operátor takového Účastníka upozorní na podezření ze zneužití EU Roamingu a vyzve jej ke zjednání nápravy, přičemž k tomuto mu stanoví lhůtu 2 týdnů. V případě, že Účastník ani přes toto upozornění nezjedná nápravu, je Operátor oprávněn ode dne doručení výzvy k nápravě účtovat Účastníkovi příplatek (vždy však pouze k té službě, která je ze strany Účastníka zneužívána), jehož výše je uvedena v platném Ceníku služeb v části Roamingové služby, a to až do doby, kdy Účastník zjedná nápravu. Má-li Účastník za to, že Operátor postupoval při aplikaci politiky přiměřeného využívání v rozporu s Nařízením EU a Podmínkami, je oprávněn podat u Operátora reklamaci, přičemž v takovém případě se přiměřeně použije postup pro uplatnění reklamace dle platných VPST.
