roaming-elisa-traffic-alone.claim: calls high roaming use alone misuse.
roaming-elisa-traffic-alone.quote: The aim of the roaming regulation is not to enable permanent roaming in EU/EEA countries. Elisa has the right to monitor the use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries and intervene in any misuse. Misuse will be understood as the uninterrupted use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months, and situations in which more than 50 per cent of subscription traffic takes place in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months. A notification of any suspected misuse can also be issued, demanding that the customer return to their domestic network within fourteen (14) days. The notification includes a description of the conditions required to continue roaming. Rather than returning to the domestic network, the customer may present written reasons for the uninterrupted use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries within fourteen (14) days. Such reasons include family relationships, studies or work. If acceptable reasons are not provided in writing by the deadline, Elisa has the right to collect additional charges for roaming.
roaming-elisa-traffic-alone.example: A Finnish resident logs into the domestic network on most days across four months but uses most data during several trips. Assuming no separate misuse ground, traffic alone cannot defeat the domestic-presence safe harbour.
roaming-elisa-traffic-alone.context: Read the full EU/EEA paragraph, four-month wording, 14-day notice, written-reasons alternative, agreement hierarchy and service-specific exceptions. Separate SIM inactivity, organised resale and sequential-SIM grounds must be assessed independently. Current Finnish prepaid terms repeat the pattern; they are retained as related context rather than another published case.
roaming-elisa-traffic-alone.scope: Elisa Oyj Finnish mobile subscriptions governed by these consumer-portfolio conditions, including business users where those conditions apply, during default regulated terrestrial EU/EEA roaming. Not a finding about permanent-roaming entitlement or a selected alternative tariff.

versions.quote: Verkkovierailuasetuksella ei ole tarkoitus mahdollistaa pysyvää verkkovierailua EU/ETA-maissa. Elisalla on oikeus seurata liittymän käyttöä EU/ETA-maissa ja puuttua mahdollisiin väärinkäytöksiin. Väärinkäytökseksi tulkitaan liittymän yhtäjaksoinen käyttö EU/ETA-maissa neljän (4) kuukauden seurantajakson aikana tai tilanteet, joissa yli 50 % liittymän liikenteestä tapahtuu EU/ ETA-maissa neljän (4) kuukauden seurantajakson aikana. Väärinkäytösepäilystä voidaan antaa ilmoitus, jossa asiakkaan edellytetään palaavan kotiverkkoon 14 vuorokauden sisällä. Ilmoituksessa kerrotaan verkkovierailukäytön jatkamisen edellytyksistä. Kotiverkkoon palaamisen sijaan asiakas voi osoittaa Elisalle perusteet jatkuvalle EU/ETA-maiden käytölle kirjallisesti 14 vuorokauden sisällä. Tällaisia perusteita voivat olla mm. perhesuhteet, opiskelu- tai työpaikka. Mikäli hyväksyttäviä perusteita ei toimiteta kirjallisesti määräajan puitteissa, on Elisalla oikeus periä ulkomaan käytöstä lisämaksuja.
versions.tr: The roaming regulation is not intended to enable permanent roaming in EU/EEA countries. Elisa may monitor use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries and intervene in misuse. Misuse means continuous use in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months or situations where more than 50% of subscription traffic takes place in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months. Notice of suspected misuse may require the customer to return to the home network within 14 days. The notice states the conditions for continuing roaming. Instead of returning to the home network, the customer may provide Elisa with written reasons for continued EU/EEA use within 14 days. Such reasons may include family relationships, study or work. If acceptable reasons are not provided in writing by the deadline, Elisa may charge additional fees for use abroad.

versions.quote: Roamingförordningen syftar inte till att möjliggöra bestående roaming i EU/EES-länderna. Elisa har rätt att följa upp användningen av abonnemanget i EU/EES-länderna och ingripa vid eventuellt missbruk. Som missbruk tolkas en oavbruten användning av abonnemanget i EU/EES-länderna under en uppföljningsperiod på fyra (4) månader eller situationer där över 50 % av abonnemangets trafik sker i EU/EES-länderna under en uppföljningsperiod på fyra (4) månader. Vid misstanke om missbruk kan ett meddelande ges, i vilket kunden förutsätts återgå till hemmanätet inom 14 dygn. I meddelandet beskrivs förutsättningarna för fortsatt roaminganvändning. I stället för att återgå till hemmanätet kan kunden för Elisa skriftligen lägga fram grunderna för fortsatt användning i EU/EES-länderna inom 14 dygn. Dylika grunder kan vara bland annat familjerelationer eller en studie- eller arbetsplats. Om godtagbara grunder inte lämnas in skriftligen inom tidsfristen, har Elisa rätt att debitera tilläggsavgifter för användningen utomlands.
versions.tr: The roaming regulation is not intended to enable permanent roaming in EU/EEA countries. Elisa may monitor use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries and intervene in misuse. Misuse means continuous use in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months or situations where more than 50% of subscription traffic takes place in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months. Notice of suspected misuse may require the customer to return to the home network within 14 days. The notice states the conditions for continuing roaming. Instead of returning to the home network, the customer may provide Elisa with written reasons for continued EU/EEA use within 14 days. Such reasons may include family relationships, study or work. If acceptable reasons are not provided in writing by the deadline, Elisa may charge additional fees for use abroad.

versions.quote: The aim of the roaming regulation is not to enable permanent roaming in EU/EEA countries. Elisa has the right to monitor the use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries and intervene in any misuse. Misuse will be understood as the uninterrupted use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months, and situations in which more than 50 per cent of subscription traffic takes place in EU/EEA countries during a monitoring period of four (4) months. A notification of any suspected misuse can also be issued, demanding that the customer return to their domestic network within fourteen (14) days. The notification includes a description of the conditions required to continue roaming. Rather than returning to the domestic network, the customer may present written reasons for the uninterrupted use of the subscription in EU/EEA countries within fourteen (14) days. Such reasons include family relationships, studies or work. If acceptable reasons are not provided in writing by the deadline, Elisa has the right to collect additional charges for roaming.

roaming-tim-business-traffic-alone.claim: allows a surcharge when roaming use alone exceeds home use.
roaming-tim-business-traffic-alone.quote: Il traffico roaming incluso nelle Offerte effettuato in Zona UE sviluppato dal Cliente su base mensile, per singola utenza, non potrà risultare superiore al traffico sviluppato dal Cliente in Italia. Nel caso in cui il traffico in roaming UE risulti, su base mensile, superiore al traffico nazionale per quattro mesi consecutivi, TIM si riserva la facoltà, previo contatto del Cliente, di applicare una surcharge ai sensi del Regolamento (UE) 2016/2292.
roaming-tim-business-traffic-alone.tr: The roaming traffic included in the offers used in the EU zone by the customer, per line and per month, may not exceed the traffic used by the customer in Italy. If monthly EU roaming traffic exceeds domestic traffic for four consecutive months, TIM reserves the right, after contacting the customer, to apply a surcharge under Regulation (EU) 2016/2292.
roaming-tim-business-traffic-alone.example: Hypothetical: in each of four months a worker spends most days in Italy but generates most mobile traffic during short EU trips. Higher roaming traffic alone does not overcome the domestic-presence safe harbour.
roaming-tim-business-traffic-alone.context: The full page presents domestic-plan use in the EU before separate optional weekly/monthly unlimited-Europe add-ons. The footnote is an express surcharge condition, beyond merely omitting a test. Current June 2026 Multibusiness terms and linked base-service annexes were checked; no correcting presence condition was found. This is one guidance finding, without asserting every individual contract follows it. The consecutive-month formulation and obsolete regulation number alone are not findings.
roaming-tim-business-traffic-alone.scope: Otherwise eligible Italian TIM Business users on default regulated terrestrial roaming in another EU state, with prevailing domestic presence, no separate abuse indicator and domestic benefits remaining. Extra Switzerland/UK coverage is a commercial promise outside this comparison.

roaming-vodafone-it-both-domestic.claim: requires both mostly home presence and low roaming use.
roaming-vodafone-it-both-domestic.quote: Un utilizzo corretto del traffico in roaming deve rispettare i seguenti parametri: Utilizzare il traffico dati incluso nella tua offerta (Fair Usage Policy) entro i limiti previsti dal Regolamento UE 2016/2286. Avere una presenza sul territorio nazionale prevalente rispetto a quella in Europa e un traffico roaming effettuato inferiore al 50% del tuo traffico totale. Vodafone potrà verificare il rispetto di questi parametri attraverso un monitoraggio di almeno 4 mesi (monitoring). Eventuali utilizzi non conformi ai parametri indicati sopra comporteranno l'applicazione dei sovrapprezzi previsti dalla regolamentazione.
roaming-vodafone-it-both-domestic.tr: Correct use of roaming traffic must meet these parameters: Use the data traffic included in your offer (Fair Usage Policy) within the limits of EU Regulation 2016/2286. Have a presence in Italy that predominates over presence in Europe and roaming traffic below 50% of your total traffic. Vodafone may check compliance through monitoring for at least 4 months. Use that does not meet these parameters will result in the surcharges provided by the regulation.
roaming-vodafone-it-both-domestic.example: Hypothetical: over the monitoring period an eligible user spends most days in Italy but uses most mobile data during short EU trips, within the roaming data allowance. Domestic presence is sufficient for this ordinary control; the page demands low roaming use as well.
roaming-vodafone-it-both-domestic.context: The complete FAQ separates a lawful open-data-bundle limit from ordinary monitoring and specifies at least four months. The June 2026 consumer mobile contract, Article 8, was also read and visually checked: it points back to roaming details and does not supply the missing domestic-presence alternative. Business contract wording and old tariffs were not substituted for this consumer guidance.
roaming-vodafone-it-both-domestic.scope: Otherwise eligible Italian home consumers on default regulated terrestrial EU roaming, with domestic presence prevailing and no separate abuse indicator. An exhausted data-FUP allowance is a distinct lawful charging ground; it is not the hypothetical here.

roaming-proximus-alert-and.claim: demands both domestic presence and use after a warning in the specified business-contract terms.
roaming-proximus-alert-and.quote: The Customer commits to make a fair use of the Roaming Services, within the meaning of the applicable Roaming regulation. Should Proximus observe any abusive or anomalous use of the Roaming Services during a period of four (4) subsequent months, Proximus reserves the right to notify the Customer by any appropriate means (SMS, email, mailing, call etc.). In such a case, the Customer has two (2) weeks to adjust his usage pattern and to provide evidence to Proximus of his actual domestic presence and consumption. Otherwise, Proximus reserves the right to charge the additional costs in force pursuant to the Roaming Regulation as from the date of notification until Customer’s usage no longer indicates a risk of abusive or anomalous use of the Roaming Services, based on a subsequent observation period of four (4) consecutive months.
roaming-proximus-alert-and.example: After a justified alert, a covered business user returns to Belgium for the response period, registers on the domestic network each day, and makes no calls, SMS or mobile-data use. This demonstrates actual domestic presence without domestic consumption. The law accepts the presence change; the quoted response instruction asks for both.
roaming-proximus-alert-and.context: The initial four-month test correctly combines roaming presence and consumption; this is not the finding. The clause also says surcharging ends when the risk ceases. Reviewers initially disagreed about whether that surrounding context cured the response instruction; after rereading the explicit AND followed by Otherwise, both agreed on this narrow mismatch. Separate volume rules in 5.6.7 were not conflated.
roaming-proximus-alert-and.scope: The 7 April 2026 Mobile Connectivity CSD for companies with at least ten employees and contracts concluded from that date. Business roaming users are covered by these rules too. This is not a finding about Proximus consumer contracts, actual enforcement, or an extra mandatory four-month wait.

versions.quote: The Customer commits to make a fair use of the Roaming Services, within the meaning of the applicable Roaming regulation. Should Proximus observe any abusive or anomalous use of the Roaming Services during a period of four (4) subsequent months, Proximus reserves the right to notify the Customer by any appropriate means (SMS, email, mailing, call etc.). In such a case, the Customer has two (2) weeks to adjust his usage pattern and to provide evidence to Proximus of his actual domestic presence and consumption. Otherwise, Proximus reserves the right to charge the additional costs in force pursuant to the Roaming Regulation as from the date of notification until Customer’s usage no longer indicates a risk of abusive or anomalous use of the Roaming Services, based on a subsequent observation period of four (4) consecutive months.

Le Client s'engage à respecter une politique d'utilisation raisonnable à l'égard des Services de roaming, au sens de la réglementation applicable en matière de roaming. En cas d'utilisation abusive ou anormale des Services de roaming constatée pendant une période de quatre (4) mois consécutifs, Proximus se réserve le droit d'en informer le Client par tout moyen approprié (SMS, e-mail, courrier, téléphone, etc.). Le Client dispose alors de deux (2) semaines pour adapter sa consommation et fournir à Proximus la preuve de sa présence et de sa consommation nationale réelle. Dans le cas contraire, Proximus se réserve le droit de facturer des frais supplémentaires conformément à la réglementation en matière de roaming, et ce, à partir de la date de notification jusqu'à la disparition de tout risque de consommation abusive ou anormale des Services de roaming par le Client, constatée sur la base d'une période d'observation ultérieure de quatre (4) mois consécutifs.
versions.tr: The customer undertakes to use roaming services fairly within the meaning of the applicable roaming regulation. If Proximus observes abusive or anomalous use for four (4) consecutive months, it may notify the customer by any appropriate means (SMS, email, post, telephone, etc.). The customer then has two (2) weeks to adjust their use and provide Proximus with evidence of actual domestic presence and consumption. Otherwise Proximus may charge the additional amounts permitted by the roaming regulation from notification until the customer’s use no longer indicates a risk of abusive or anomalous use, based on a subsequent observation period of four (4) consecutive months.

versions.quote: De Klant verbindt zich ertoe redelijk gebruik te maken van de Roamingdiensten, in de zin van de toepasselijke Roamingverordening. Mocht Proximus gedurende een periode van vier (4) opeenvolgende maanden misbruik of afwijkend gebruik van de Roamingdiensten vaststellen, dan behoudt Proximus zich het recht voor de Klant via elk gepast middel (sms, e-mail, mailing, telefonisch, enz.) op de hoogte te brengen. In een dergelijk geval heeft de Klant twee (2) weken de tijd om zijn gebruikspatroon aan te passen en Proximus het bewijs te leveren van zijn werkelijke aanwezigheid en verbruik thuis. Anders behoudt Proximus zich het recht voor om de extra kosten die gelden krachtens de Roamingverordening in rekening te brengen vanaf de datum van kennisgeving tot het ogenblik dat het gebruik van de Klant niet langer wijst op een risico van misbruik of afwijkend gebruik van de Roamingdiensten, op basis van een daaropvolgende observatieperiode van vier (4) opeenvolgende maanden.
versions.tr: The customer undertakes to use roaming services fairly within the meaning of the applicable roaming regulation. If Proximus observes abusive or anomalous use for four (4) consecutive months, it may notify the customer by any appropriate means (SMS, email, post, telephone, etc.). The customer then has two (2) weeks to adjust their use and provide Proximus with evidence of actual domestic presence and consumption. Otherwise Proximus may charge the additional amounts permitted by the roaming regulation from notification until the customer’s use no longer indicates a risk of abusive or anomalous use, based on a subsequent observation period of four (4) consecutive months.

ctx.quote: “Abusive or anomalous use of Roaming Services” under the Roaming Regulation, means: (a) presence and consumption of services prevailing in the other Member States, compared with the national presence and consumption of services in Belgium; or (b) the prolonged inactivity of a given SIM Card, associated with a very frequent or even exclusive use in roaming mode; or (c) the activation and serial use of multiple SIM Cards by a single roaming Customer.

Aux termes de la réglementation en matière de roaming, il convient d'entendre par "Utilisation abusive ou anormale des Services de roaming" : (a) une présence et une consommation des services essentiellement dans les autres États membres, par rapport à la présence et la consommation nationales des services en Belgique ou ; (b) l'inactivité prolongée d'une Carte SIM donnée, associée à une utilisation très fréquente, voire exclusive en roaming ou ; (c) l'activation et l'utilisation en série de multiples Cartes SIM par un même Client en roaming.
ctx.tr: Under the roaming regulations, “abusive or anomalous use of roaming services” means: (a) presence and consumption of services mainly in the other Member States compared with domestic presence and consumption in Belgium; or (b) prolonged inactivity of a given SIM card combined with very frequent or even exclusive roaming use; or (c) activation and serial use of multiple SIM cards by a single roaming customer.

ctx.quote: 'Misbruik of afwijkend gebruik van Roamingdiensten' krachtens de Roamingverordening, betekent: (a) aanwezigheid en verbruik van diensten in hoofdzaak in de andere lidstaten, vergeleken met nationale aanwezigheid en verbruik van diensten in België; of (b) langdurige inactiviteit van een bepaalde Simkaart, gepaard gaand met een zeer frequent of zelfs exclusief gebruik in roamingmodus; of (c) activering en serieel gebruik van meerdere Simkaarten door één roamende klant.

roaming-yoigo-warning-cessation-and.claim: requires both home presence and home use to end a warning.
roaming-yoigo-warning-cessation-and.quote: Si detectamos que tu uso del roaming en el espacio económico europeo infringe la política de uso razonable de Yoigo, según regulación aprobada por la UE, te enviaremos un SMS avisándote. A partir de ese momento, tendrás 2 semanas para cambiar tu patrón de uso, es decir, volver a hacer un uso razonable del roaming EEE. Esto significa que en esos 14 días después de la recepción del SMS de aviso, deberás haber tenido una presencia y consumo mayor en España que en roaming EEE. * Si tu patrón de uso en los 14 días no ha cambiado,recibirás otro SMS que te alertará del comienzo de los cargos adicionales en tu consumo de datos en roaming.
roaming-yoigo-warning-cessation-and.tr: If we detect that your EEA roaming use infringes Yoigo’s fair-use policy under EU-approved regulation, we will send you a warning SMS. From that moment you have 2 weeks to change your usage pattern, meaning return to reasonable use of EEA roaming. This means that in the 14 days after receiving the warning SMS you must have had greater presence and consumption in Spain than in EEA roaming. If your usage pattern has not changed during the 14 days, you will receive another SMS warning you that additional charges for roaming data use are starting.
roaming-yoigo-warning-cessation-and.example: Hypothetical: after a justified alert, an eligible user returns to Spain for the response period, registers domestically each day, and makes no calls, SMS or data use. The presence change is sufficient under the law; the help asks for both domestic indicators.
roaming-yoigo-warning-cessation-and.context: The initial four-month cumulative test is correct. The actual three-page policy linked by this FAQ correctly allows surcharging only while foreign presence AND use remain predominant. Spanish and Catalan general contracts expressly accept presence OR consumption as response evidence. These qualifications limit the finding to the contradictory help instruction, without asserting an invalid tariff or actual enforcement. A possible monthly review delay was withheld as ambiguous.
roaming-yoigo-warning-cessation-and.scope: Otherwise eligible Spanish Yoigo home customers on default regulated terrestrial EU roaming, responding to an ordinary presence/usage alert, with no separate SIM-misuse indicator. The cessation issue concerns that ordinary risk, not exhaustion of a data volume allowance.

versions.quote: Si detectamos que tu uso del roaming en el espacio económico europeo infringe la política de uso razonable de Yoigo, según regulación aprobada por la UE, te enviaremos un SMS avisándote. A partir de ese momento, tendrás 2 semanas para cambiar tu patrón de uso, es decir, volver a hacer un uso razonable del roaming EEE. This means that in the 14 days after receiving the warning SMS you must have had greater presence and consumption in Spain than in EEA roaming. If your usage pattern has not changed during the 14 days, you will receive another SMS warning you that additional charges for roaming data use are starting.

ctx.quote: Según la regulación europea, existen varios tipos de uso que se consideran abusivos y que implican una tarificación adicional para el uso del móvil en roaming EEE (Espacio Económico Europeo). Básicamente, se considerará que realizas un uso abusivo si cumples la siguiente condición: Tu consumo y tu presencia en roaming es prevalente sobre tu consumo y presencia nacional en los últimos cuatro meses Para que se entienda mejor, se observa tu uso del roaming en EEE en los últimos cuatro meses, y se verifica si se cumplen las siguientes dos condiciones simultáneamente: El consumo de voz, datos o SMS en roaming en EEE es mayor que el consumo en España. El número de días de presencia exclusiva en roaming EEE es mayor que el número de días con presencia en España. Recuerda que nunca empezaremos a aplicar cargos adicionales en roaming sin haberte enviado antes un SMS de aviso. Este recargo nunca se aplicará sobre el consumo realizado antes de este aviso, solamente se aplicará para el uso de datos roaming futuro.
ctx.tr: Under European regulations, various types of use are considered abusive and entail additional charges for mobile use while roaming in the EEA (European Economic Area). In essence, your use is considered abusive if your roaming consumption and presence prevail over your domestic consumption and presence during the last four months. To clarify, your EEA roaming use over the last four months is examined and both of the following conditions are checked simultaneously: voice, data or SMS consumption while roaming in the EEA is higher than consumption in Spain; and the number of days spent exclusively roaming in the EEA exceeds the number of days with presence in Spain. Remember that we will never begin applying additional roaming charges without first sending a warning text. This surcharge will never apply to consumption before the warning, only to future roaming-data use.

roaming-orange-es-warning-and.quote: Qué ocurre si detectamos un uso abusivo del Roaming Si detectamos un posible uso abusivo: Te enviaremos un SMS de aviso Dispondrás de 14 días para cambiar tu patrón de uso Durante este periodo, deberás volver a tener un uso y presencia mayor en España que en Roaming. Qué ocurre si se mantiene el uso abusivo Si tras los 14 días no cambias tu patrón de uso: Se te notificará mediante SMS el inicio de los cargos adicionales A partir de ese momento, el uso de datos en Roaming tendrá un coste adicional según la normativa europea Este recargo solo se aplica al consumo realizado después del aviso , nunca al anterior

During that period, your use and presence in Spain must again exceed those while roaming. What happens if abusive use continues. If you do not change your usage pattern after 14 days: You will be notified by SMS that additional charges are starting. From then on, roaming data use has an additional cost under European rules. This surcharge applies only to use after the warning, never before.
roaming-orange-es-warning-and.example: Hypothetical: a warned eligible business user resumes actual Spanish network presence during the response period without generating domestic traffic. Domestic presence alone can demonstrate a qualifying change; this instruction demands greater use as well.
roaming-orange-es-warning-and.context: The initial four-month test correctly combines foreign use and presence. The actual linked complete policy, a 2023 Spanish document, says to change use patterns within 14 days and stop surcharging when abusive use ends; it does not specifically correct the FAQ to OR. roaming-orange-es-warning-and.scope: Orange Spanish home business users using default regulated terrestrial roaming in another EU state, responding to the ordinary presence/usage alert and without a separate abuse indicator. During that period, your use and presence in Spain must again exceed those while roaming. What happens if abusive use continues. If you do not change your usage pattern after 14 days: You will be notified by SMS that additional charges are starting. From then on, roaming data use has an additional cost under European rules. ctx.quote: Qué se considera uso abusivo del Roaming Se considera que realizas un uso abusivo del Roaming cuando tu consumo y tu presencia en Roaming son mayores que en España durante un periodo de 4 meses Para determinarlo, se analizan simultáneamente estas dos condiciones: El consumo de datos en Roaming en Zona UE es mayor que el consumo en España El número de días de presencia en Roaming es mayor que el tiempo de presencia en España
ctx.tr: What counts as abusive roaming use. Roaming use is considered abusive when your roaming consumption and presence are greater than those in Spain over four months. To determine this, both of these conditions are assessed simultaneously: data consumption while roaming in the EU Zone exceeds consumption in Spain; and the number of days of presence in roaming exceeds the time spent in Spain.

roaming-vodafone-es-warning-and.claim: requires both home presence and home use during a warning.
roaming-vodafone-es-warning-and.quote: Cuando se observe que, en un periodo mínimo de cuatro (4) meses, el consumo y estancia por parte del Cliente/líneas en los citados países prevalezca sobre el consumo y estancia realizados en España. Vodafone informará al Cliente y éste dispondrá de quince (15) días naturales para modificar sus pautas de uso y hacer prevalecer su consumo y estancia en España frente a su consumo y estancia en los países citados. En los casos en los que se haga un uso abusivo de este beneficio, se aplica la Tarifa Recargo Regulado Roaming Zona 1. Todo ello sin perjuicio del resto de derechos que le puedan asistir a Vodafone en casos de fraude y/o uso ilícito del Servicio o contrario a las normas de uso razonable.
roaming-vodafone-es-warning-and.tr: When, over a minimum of four (4) months, the customer’s or lines’ consumption and presence in those countries exceed consumption and presence in Spain. Vodafone will inform the customer, who has fifteen (15) calendar days to change their usage pattern so that consumption and presence in Spain exceed consumption and presence in those countries. If this benefit is used abusively, the Regulated Zone 1 Roaming Surcharge Tariff applies. This is without prejudice to Vodafone’s other rights in cases of fraud and/or unlawful use of the service or use contrary to the fair-use rules.
roaming-vodafone-es-warning-and.example: Hypothetical: a warned user resumes actual Spanish network presence during the response period without generating domestic traffic. The changed presence can satisfy the statutory response; this instruction also requires predominant domestic consumption.
roaming-vodafone-es-warning-and.context: The initial four-month test correctly combines foreign consumption and stay. The actual legal link repeats the response instruction in its current Zone 1 section. ctx.quote: Utilisation raisonnable de votre forfait depuis l’Union européenne (y compris Monaco et Royaume Uni) et les DOM L’utilisation de votre forfait de SFR depuis l’Union européenne/DOM devra être «raisonnable» : une utilisation majoritaire ou exclusive de votre forfait depuis l’Union européenne/DOM entraînera la facturation de frais supplémentaires de vos futurs usages. En effet, au cours des 4 derniers mois : - SI un ou plusieurs usages (appels émis/reçus, SMS/MMS émis/reçus et/ou internet mobile) depuis l’Union européenne/DOM est/sont plus importants que le ou les mêmes usages depuis la France métropolitaine et l’étranger (hors Union européenne/DOM). ET - SI le nombre de jours passés en Union européenne/DOM est supérieur au nombre de jours passés en France et à l’étranger (hors Union européenne/DOM). Alors, vous recevrez un SMS d’alerte pour vous en informer et vous disposerez de 15 jours pour modifier l’utilisation de votre forfait. Au terme de ces 15 jours : - Si vous respectez au moins l’une des 2 règles ci-dessus, l’utilisation de votre forfait redevenant raisonnable, vous ne serez pas facturé de frais supplémentaires. - Si vous ne respectez toujours aucune des 2 règles ci-dessus, vous recevrez un nouveau SMS d’alerte vous informant de la facturation immédiate de frais supplémentaires du ou des futurs usages non raisonnables depuis l’Union Européenne/DOM.
ctx.tr: Reasonable use of your plan from the European Union (including Monaco and the United Kingdom) and the overseas departments. Use of your SFR plan from the European Union/overseas departments must be “reasonable”: using it mainly or exclusively from that area will result in additional charges for future usage. Over the last four months: IF one or more types of use (outgoing/incoming calls, outgoing/incoming SMS/MMS and/or mobile internet) from that area exceed the same types of use from metropolitan France and abroad outside that area, AND IF the number of days spent in that area exceeds the days spent in France and abroad outside that area, you will receive a text warning and have 15 days to change your use. At the end of those 15 days: if you comply with at least one of the two rules, so your use becomes reasonable again, you will not be charged extra. If you still comply with neither rule, you will receive a new text warning that additional charges apply immediately to future unreasonable usage from the European Union/overseas departments.

ctx.quote: I servizi possono essere utilizzati anche in roaming all’interno dell’Unione Europea (per comunicazioni all’interno della stessa, per esempio chiamate tra paesi europei o connessione dati in un paese europeo diverso dall’Italia) alle medesime condizioni economiche previste per i servizi in Italia, ai sensi dei Regolamenti UE n. 2015/2120 e 2016/2286. Tali condizioni si applicheranno nel caso in cui l’Utente sia abitualmente residente in Italia o abbia un legame stabile con l’Italia (ad esempio, in ragione di rapporti di lavoro a tempo pieno e duraturi, partecipazione a corsi di studio regolari, etc.) e, su richiesta di iliad, l’Utente dovrà fornire dimostrazione di tale residenza o legame stabile. Le suddette condizioni di fornitura del servizio di roaming nell’UE non saranno applicate nel caso in cui (i) l’Utente effettui un utilizzo sequenziale in roaming di più di una SIM, (ii) l’Utente effettui un traffico roaming superiore rispetto al traffico nazionale e, allo stesso tempo, abbia una presenza prevalente in altri Stati dell’UE in un arco temporale di 4 mesi; (iii) si verifichi un lungo periodo di inattività di una SIM associata a un uso preponderante, se non esclusivo, in roaming in un arco temporale di 4 mesi. Nel caso in cui le suddette condizioni non siano rispettate, iliad applicherà ai servizi in roaming un sovrapprezzo, calcolato sulla base delle tariffe massime previste dal Regolamento UE n. 2015/2120, come indicato qui e nello specifico alla colonna «Tariffa ‘Permanent’ Roaming».
ctx.tr: The services may also be used while roaming within the European Union (for communications within it, for example calls between European countries or a data connection in a European country other than Italy) on the same economic terms as services in Italy, under EU Regulations 2015/2120 and 2016/2286. These terms apply if the user is habitually resident in Italy or has a stable link to Italy (for example through full-time lasting employment or participation in regular courses of study), and the user must provide evidence of that residence or stable link at iliad’s request. Those terms for EU roaming do not apply if (i) the user sequentially uses more than one SIM in roaming, (ii) the user’s roaming traffic exceeds domestic traffic and, at the same time, the user is predominantly present in other EU states over four months; or (iii) a SIM is inactive for a long period combined with predominantly, if not exclusively, roaming use over four months. If these conditions are not met, iliad will apply a roaming surcharge calculated using the maximum rates under EU Regulation 2015/2120, as indicated here, specifically in the “Permanent Roaming Rate” column.

roaming-lebara-current-examples.claim: calculates data limits with the old 2023 price.
roaming-lebara-current-examples.quote: Bei Prepaid-Tarifen ohne inkludiertes Datenvolumen, bei denen die Datennutzung pro Einheit (MB oder GB) erfolgt, kann LEBARA alternativ zur Anwendung der Regelungen zu Aufschlägen gemäß Nr. 1 bis 3. das Datenvolumen bei RLAH begrenzen. Das dann nutzbare Datenvolumen entspricht mindestens dem Datenvolumen, das sich aus der Division des Gesamtbetrags (ohne Mehrwertsteuer) des vom Kunden an LEBARA zu Beginn der Roamingnutzung bereits bezahlten, verfügbaren Restguthabens durch das regulierte maximale Roamingvorleistungsentgelt nach Artikel 11 der Verordnung (EU) 2022/612 (bis 31.12. 2023: 1,80 €, für 2024: 1,55 €, für 2025: 1,30 €, für 2026: 1,10 €) ergibt. Beispiel: Beträgt das Restguthaben des Kunden beim Beginn des Roaming € 10,00 netto, steht dem Kunden derzeit (€ 10,00 dividiert durch € 1,80) = 5,56 GB Datenvolumen für RLAH zur Verfügung. Nach Verbrauch des so berechneten Datenvolumens erfolgt mit einer reduzierten Datengeschwindigkeit von 64 Kbit/s (für Download & Upload). Bei Tarifen mit offenen Datenpaketen (z.B. Datenflatrate) kann nur ein Teil des tariflichen Datenvolumens ohne Aufschläge im Rahmen von RLAH genutzt werden. Dieses Datenvolumen entspricht mindestens dem Zweifachen des Datenvolumens, das sich aus der Division des inländischen Endkundengesamtpreises (ohne Mehrwertsteuer) des von dem Kunden gebuchten Tarifs durch das regulierte maximale Roamingvorleistungsentgelt nach Artikel 11 der Verordnung (EU) 2022/612 (bis 31.12.2023: 1,80 €, für 2024: 1,55 €, für 2025: 1,30 €, für 2026: 1,10 €) bezogen auf den gesamten Abrechnungszeitraum ergibt. Beispiel: Beträgt der Tarifpreis € 12,00 netto pro Monat, steht dem Kunden derzeit (€ 12,00 dividiert durch € 1,80) x 2 = 13,3 GB Datenvolumen für RLAH zur Verfügung. Nach Verbrauch des so berechneten Datenvolumens wird der oben genannte Aufschlag für Datendienste erhoben.
roaming-lebara-current-examples.tr: For prepaid tariffs without an included data allowance, where data is charged per unit (MB or GB), LEBARA may limit RLAH data instead of applying the surcharge rules in items 1 to 3. The available volume is at least the customer’s prepaid remaining credit at the start of roaming, excluding VAT, divided by the regulated maximum wholesale roaming price under Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2022/612 (€1.80 until 31 December 2023, €1.55 for 2024, €1.30 for 2025, €1.10 for 2026). Example: With €10.00 net remaining credit at the start of roaming, the customer currently has (€10.00 divided by €1.80) = 5.56GB for RLAH. After that volume is used, data speed is reduced to 64 Kbit/s for download and upload. With open data bundles (for example a data flat rate), only part of the tariff’s data can be used without RLAH surcharges. That volume is at least twice the domestic retail price excluding VAT, divided by the regulated maximum wholesale roaming price under Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2022/612 (€1.80 until 31 December 2023, €1.55 for 2024, €1.30 for 2025, €1.10 for 2026), for the whole billing period. Example: At a net tariff price of €12.00 per month, the customer currently has (€12.00 divided by €1.80) × 2 = 13.3GB for RLAH. After that volume is used, the above data surcharge applies.
roaming-lebara-current-examples.example: Assuming the document’s hypothetical €12 net open bundle has unlimited domestic data or at least 21.82GB, the current formula yields approximately 21.82GB for periodic covered roaming in 2026. The example says 13.3GB. This does not identify a real €12 plan or a real customer who received that limit.
roaming-lebara-current-examples.context: The adjoining general formulas and year schedule are correct, as is the 2026 surcharge table. That counter-context limits the conclusion to explicitly current worked examples. It does not establish the actual allowances applied to any named tariff. The €10 threshold is not free data: domestic retail charges, use of credit for calls/SMS and credit exhaustion still matter.
roaming-lebara-current-examples.scope: Readers of the current German prepaid price list using either its hypothetical true per-unit prepaid calculation or a qualifying open-bundle calculation. Actual service price, discounts, domestic allowance, eligibility, alternative tariffs and permitted abuse controls remain relevant.

versions.quote: Bei Prepaid-Tarifen ohne inkludiertes Datenvolumen, bei denen die Datennutzung pro Einheit (MB oder GB) erfolgt, kann LEBARA alternativ zur Anwendung der Regelungen zu Aufschlägen gemäß Nr. 1 bis 3. das Datenvolumen bei RLAH begrenzen. Das dann nutzbare Datenvolumen entspricht mindestens dem Datenvolumen, das sich aus der Division des Gesamtbetrags (ohne Mehrwertsteuer) des vom Kunden an LEBARA zu Beginn der Roamingnutzung bereits bezahlten, verfügbaren Restguthabens durch das regulierte maximale Roamingvorleistungsentgelt nach Artikel 11 der Verordnung (EU) 2022/612 (bis 31.12. 2023: 1,80 €, für 2024: 1,55 €, für 2025: 1,30 €, für 2026: 1,10 €) ergibt. Beispiel: Beträgt das Restguthaben des Kunden beim Beginn des Roaming € 10,00 netto, steht dem Kunden derzeit (€ 10,00 dividiert durch € 1,80) = 5,56 GB Datenvolumen für RLAH zur Verfügung. Nach Verbrauch des so berechneten Datenvolumens erfolgt mit einer reduzierten Datengeschwindigkeit von 64 Kbit/s (für Download & Upload). Bei Tarifen mit offenen Datenpaketen (z.B. Datenflatrate) kann nur ein Teil des tariflichen Datenvolumens ohne Aufschläge im Rahmen von RLAH genutzt werden. Dieses Datenvolumen entspricht mindestens dem Zweifachen des Datenvolumens, das sich aus der Division des inländischen Endkundengesamtpreises (ohne Mehrwertsteuer) des von dem Kunden gebuchten Tarifs durch das regulierte maximale Roamingvorleistungsentgelt nach Artikel 11 der Verordnung (EU) 2022/612 (bis 31.12.2023: 1,80 €, für 2024: 1,55 €, für 2025: 1,30 €, für 2026: 1,10 €) bezogen auf den gesamten Abrechnungszeitraum ergibt. Beispiel: Beträgt der Tarifpreis € 12,00 netto pro Monat, steht dem Kunden derzeit (€ 12,00 dividiert durch € 1,80) x 2 = 13,3 GB Datenvolumen für RLAH zur Verfügung. Nach Verbrauch des so berechneten Datenvolumens wird der oben genannte Aufschlag für Datendienste erhoben.
versions.tr: For prepaid tariffs without an included data allowance, where data is charged per unit (MB or GB), LEBARA may limit RLAH data instead of applying the surcharge rules in items 1 to 3. The available volume is at least the customer’s prepaid remaining credit at the start of roaming, excluding VAT, divided by the regulated maximum wholesale roaming price under Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2022/612 (€1.80 until 31 December 2023, €1.55 for 2024, €1.30 for 2025, €1.10 for 2026). Example: With €10.00 net remaining credit at the start of roaming, the customer currently has (€10.00 divided by €1.80) = 5.56GB for RLAH. After that volume is used, data speed is reduced to 64 Kbit/s for download and upload. With open data bundles (for example a data flat rate), only part of the tariff’s data can be used without RLAH surcharges. That volume is at least twice the domestic retail price excluding VAT, divided by the regulated maximum wholesale roaming price under Article 11 of Regulation (EU) 2022/612 (€1.80 until 31 December 2023, €1.55 for 2024, €1.30 for 2025, €1.10 for 2026), for the whole billing period. Example: At a net tariff price of €12.00 per month, the customer currently has (€12.00 divided by €1.80) × 2 = 13.3GB for RLAH. After that volume is used, the above data surcharge applies.

lawMarks: Open-data bundles have a price-based data minimum; per-unit prepaid credit has a different calculation

roaming-play-four-month-maximum.claim: presents four months as the most time you can spend abroad.
roaming-play-four-month-maximum.quote: Oznacza to, że usługi w ramach roamingu są dostępne przez określony czas, ale nie dłużej niż 4 miesiące. Taki okres dla połączeń i wiadomości w cenie krajowych stawek jest dostępny w Play. Jeżeli telefon jest dłużej zalogowany do zagranicznej sieci, wówczas operator może naliczyć dodatkowe opłaty za korzystanie z roamingu.
roaming-play-four-month-maximum.tr: This means that roaming services are available for a specified period, but no longer than 4 months. That period for calls and messages at domestic rates is available at Play. If the phone remains registered on a foreign network longer, the operator may charge additional fees for roaming.
roaming-play-four-month-maximum.law: Four months is the minimum observation period for the ordinary presence-and-use test, not an automatic roaming expiry. Domestic predominance and separate abuse grounds still matter.
roaming-play-four-month-maximum.example: Hypothetical: an eligible regular traveller continues travelling across successive months but spends most relevant days registered in Poland. Under the ordinary test, continuing beyond four months does not remove the domestic-presence safe harbour.
roaming-play-four-month-maximum.context: The full article links current roaming guidance and later repeats the duration message. A January 2026 GRUPA/SOLO tariff, physical p.9, correctly requires predominant foreign presence AND consumption over at least four months, plus a two-week warning. That is material counter-context, not proof that every Play tariff or actual billing follows the article. The article’s dated data-price estimate is not a separate 2026 rate finding.
roaming-play-four-month-maximum.scope: Eligible Polish-home Play users on default regulated terrestrial roaming with no separate abuse ground. Neither an unconditional four-month allowance nor permanent roaming is promised.

roaming-orange-sk-additional-notice.claim: places the additional default-system data-spending notice above €102.50 excluding VAT.
roaming-orange-sk-additional-notice.quote: Ak roamingový zákazník, na ktorého sa podľa nariadenia Európskeho parlamentu a Rady (EÚ) 2022/612 zo 6. apríla 2022 vzťahuje štandardný finančný alebo objemový limit, spotrebúva v roamingu viac ako 102,50 € bez DPH počas svojho zúčtovacieho obdobia , na mobilné zariadenie tohto roamingového zákazníka zašle Orange dodatočné oznámenie o tejto skutočnosti a ďalšie dátové prenosy v roamingu budú pozastavené, vďaka čomu zákazníka neprekvapí vysoký účet na faktúre .
roaming-orange-sk-additional-notice.tr: If a roaming customer subject to a standard financial or volume limit under Regulation (EU) 2022/612 of 6 April 2022 spends more than €102.50 excluding VAT while roaming during their billing period, Orange sends an additional notification to that customer’s mobile device and further roaming data transfers are suspended, so the customer is not surprised by a high bill.
roaming-orange-sk-additional-notice.law: For customers in the default-limit system, the additional notification is required above €100 excluding VAT in a monthly billing period; absent the required response, data must stop.
roaming-orange-sk-additional-notice.example: Hypothetical: a standard-system customer has authorised continuation beyond the first limit, then reaches €101 net in monitored data-roaming spend without authorising further continuation. The law’s additional notice/stop process is already relevant; the help’s quoted threshold has not yet been reached.
roaming-orange-sk-additional-notice.context: The current tariff effective 7 October 2026, physical/printed p.50 note 3, correctly states a default €50 net (€61.50 gross) limit and optional chosen €102.50/€205/€512.50 gross limits, plus opt-out procedures. None corrects the help’s distinct €102.50 net additional threshold. No allegation is made that the default €50 protection is missing or that customers were actually charged.
roaming-orange-sk-additional-notice.scope: Orange Slovensko customers who remain subject to the default financial/volume limit system, including after authorising initial continuation, and have not selected a different limit or opted out. This is not an unconditional €100 bill ceiling. Wider non-terrestrial/non-EU application has statutory qualifications.

roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.src: Roaming en Europa: tarifas, cobertura y cómo funciona con cableworld
roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.claim: says EU law requires you to spend more time in your home country.
roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.quote: El roaming como en casa está pensado para viajes ocasionales o vínculos estables con España (trabajo, estudios). Si vas a pasar más de cuatro meses seguidos fuera de España sin volver, tu operador puede empezar a aplicar recargos tras un aviso previo por SMS: la regulación europea exige que pases más tiempo en tu país de residencia que en el extranjero dentro de una ventana móvil de 4 meses. Si no cumples ese equilibrio, el operador puede añadir el recargo mayorista al consumo en roaming después de darte 14 días para regularizar la situación.
roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.tr: Roam like at home is intended for occasional trips or stable links with Spain (work or studies). If you will spend more than four consecutive months outside Spain without returning, your operator may begin applying surcharges after an SMS warning: EU regulation requires you to spend more time in your country of residence than abroad within a rolling 4-month window. If you do not meet that balance, the operator may add the wholesale surcharge to roaming use after giving you 14 days to regularise the situation.
roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.law: The ordinary four-month control observes presence and consumption cumulatively. Prevailing domestic consumption is a safe harbour even when domestic presence does not predominate; separate residence/stable-links requirements and abuse grounds still apply.
roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Spanish-home periodic traveller has 70 days registered elsewhere in the EU and 50 days registered in Spain in the observed four months, but 70% of the relevant voice consumption occurs in Spain. With no separate abuse ground, domestic consumption prevents the ordinary warning/surcharge despite foreign presence predominating.
roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.context: The permanent-use section first discusses more than four continuous months abroad and then gives a wider categorical explanation of EU law based only on home presence. The linked October 2026 tariff pack, physical pages 35 and 87, instead correctly states cumulative foreign presence AND consumption. This narrows the finding to the explanatory guide.
roaming-cableworld-home-presence-require.scope: Default regulated terrestrial EU roaming for normally resident/stably linked Spanish-home customers engaged in periodic travel, under the ordinary presence-and-consumption control. Excludes permanent relocation, failure to establish eligibility, SIM inactivity/sequential-SIM abuse, alternative tariffs and lawful sustainability derogations.

roaming-konecta-traffic-alone.claim: describes higher roaming use alone as excessive use that can trigger a surcharge.
roaming-konecta-traffic-alone.quote: La normativa de este acuerdo de roaming explica que se considera uso excesivo cuando en un periodo seguido de 4 meses haces un mayor uso de tu línea en roaming que en España. Si se da ese caso, recibirás un aviso y pasados 15 días se podrán aplicar cargos extra si continúas usando la línea en roaming. También es posible presentar documentación que acredite que el titular de la línea es residente en España para continuar utilizando la línea en roaming sin cargos. Esta regulación se ha creado con el fin de evitar fraudes de contratación de líneas en países en los que el titular no reside.
roaming-konecta-traffic-alone.tr: The rules of this roaming agreement explain that use is excessive when, over 4 consecutive months, you use your line more in roaming than in Spain. In that case you will receive a warning and after 15 days extra charges may apply if you continue using the line in roaming. It is also possible to submit documents proving that the line holder resides in Spain to continue using roaming without charges. This regulation was created to prevent fraudulent contracting of lines in countries where the holder does not reside.
roaming-konecta-traffic-alone.law: Higher roaming consumption alone does not establish abuse under the ordinary four-month control. Prevailing domestic presence is a safe harbour. A mere continuation of some roaming after warning is also insufficient if changed use demonstrates domestic presence or consumption.
roaming-konecta-traffic-alone.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Spanish-home customer is registered in Spain for 85 of 120 relevant days but consumes 70% of the relevant data while on occasional EU trips. With no separate abuse ground, the domestic-presence safe harbour prevents an ordinary presence-and-use surcharge.
roaming-konecta-traffic-alone.context: The FAQ says higher roaming use over four months is excessive and extra charges can follow 15 days later if the customer keeps using the line abroad. It also allows residence documents. The full Orange-network terms are internally inconsistent: section 15 and SERVICIO EN ROAMING use single-indicator OR wording, while later CONDICIONES LEGALES ROAMING... item d correctly requires greater foreign consumption AND presence.

Excludes separate SIM abuse, residence-proof failures and valid open-bundle volume limits.

roaming-cableworld-ion-voice-cap.claim: publishes a €0.026-per-minute outgoing voice surcharge in its linked ION Mobile annex.
roaming-cableworld-ion-voice-cap.quote: De acuerdo con la política de utilización razonable, la compañía se reserva el derecho a poder controlar y comprobar tu actividad de roaming de los últimos cuatro meses. Si, durante ese periodo, has pasado más tiempo en el extranjero que en España y el roaming supera al uso nacional, podremos ponernos en contacto contigo para informarte sobre tu actividad de roaming y que puedas justificar que no has cambiado de residencia a otro país de la Zona UE que no sea España. Trascurrido este plazo, si sigues pasando más tiempo en el extranjero que en España y el roaming sigue superando tu consumo nacional, se aplicará un recargo a tu consumo en roaming. Los recargos (IVA incluido) tienen los siguientes límites: 0,026 €/minuto de llamada de voz efectuada y 1,57 € por GB.
roaming-cableworld-ion-voice-cap.tr: Under the fair-use policy, the company may monitor and check your roaming activity over the last four months. If during that period you spent more time abroad than in Spain and roaming exceeds domestic use, we may contact you about your roaming activity and allow you to show that you have not moved to another EU-zone country. After that period, if you continue spending more time abroad than in Spain and roaming continues to exceed domestic consumption, a surcharge applies to your roaming use. The surcharges (including VAT) have these limits: €0.026/minute for outgoing voice calls and €1.57 per GB.
roaming-cableworld-ion-voice-cap.law: For ordinary fair-use surcharges in 2025–2026 the outgoing-call ceiling is €0.019/minute excluding VAT, or €0.02299 with Spain’s 21% VAT. The annex says its €0.026/minute figure includes VAT. Its July 2025 date does not cure the voice overstatement, because the lower ceiling already applied from 1 January 2025.
roaming-cableworld-ion-voice-cap.example: Hypothetical: a customer subject to 21% Spanish VAT incurs a lawful fair-use outgoing-call surcharge for 100 regulated roaming minutes in October 2026. The surcharge ceiling is €2.299 before final bill rounding; the annex’s €0.026 figure yields €2.60. No actual charge is established.
roaming-cableworld-ion-voice-cap.context: Physical pages 35 and 87 repeat a section headed TARIFAS ROAMING ION MOBILE, marked Actualización: Julio 2025. The pack’s initial Cablemovil page is marked valid from October 2026 and the current roaming guide links the whole pack as its official rate list. The dated ION annex is a specific part of a mixed tariff pack, not proof that every Cableworld line uses this rate. Its separate data allowance is expressly labelled 2025 and is not treated as a new allowance shortfall.
roaming-cableworld-ion-voice-cap.scope: Published ION Mobile annex in Cableworld’s current linked official tariff pack; outgoing regulated terrestrial EU roaming fair-use surcharges for Spanish VAT customers. No allegation about which customers are contracted to the annex or actual billing.

roaming-eir-prepay-data-surcharges.claim: publishes prepay data surcharges based on €3.00 or €1.55 net per GB.
roaming-eir-prepay-data-surcharges.quote:
EU Roaming

Data allowances if available at the time of roaming can be used while roaming in the EEA subject to fair use limits where applicable. EU roaming fair use allowance is calculated in line with Regulation (EU) No 531/2012 (as amended) and Data wholesale roaming price caps. Where the domestic data allowance has not been fully consumed but the fair use allowance has been fully consumed, a surcharge rate of €3.63 per GB/€0.0035 per MB (based on Regulated rate of €3.00 per GB excl. VAT) will apply until the domestic allowance has been fully consumed. Standard domestic rates apply thereafter.
roaming-eir-prepay-data-surcharges.law: Regulation 2022/612 Articles 5(2), 8(1)(a) and 11(1) cap the data surcharge at €1.10 per GB excluding VAT from 1 January 2026. The prepay answers expressly identify €3.00 or €1.55 excluding VAT as their regulated basis. Both exceed that ceiling. Irish Revenue classifies telecommunications at the standard rate, 23% in 2026: the corresponding gross ceiling is €1.353 per GB. Domestic allowance exhaustion, a deliberately chosen alternative tariff and separately authorised sustainability charges have different rules.
roaming-eir-prepay-data-surcharges.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Irish prepay customer has domestic data remaining but has exhausted a valid EU data fair-use allowance while visiting France in October 2026. One extra GB permits at most €1.10 net (€1.353 with 23% VAT), rather than the €1.55 or €3.00 net basis described in these answers. The example concerns the surcharge alone, before any later domestic allowance exhaustion.
roaming-eir-prepay-data-surcharges.context: The activation page itself gives €1.91/€1.55 net in the separate Fair Usage Policy answer and €3.63/€3.00 net in EU Roaming. The add-ons page swaps those variants between its answers. Both variants are retained; they form one repeated stale-price issue. Each answer limits the surcharge to the period with domestic allowance remaining and then switches to standard domestic rates. The main roaming FAQ offers add-ons and day passes as alternatives. No claim that the displayed gross/MB pairs are arithmetically consistent or that eir actually bills those amounts.
roaming-eir-prepay-data-surcharges.scope: Irish prepay users eligible for default regulated terrestrial EU/EEA roaming after a valid data fair-use allowance has been used, with domestic data still available. No finding about non-EU roaming, premium services, alternative packages or domestic out-of-bundle charges.

roaming-vianova-fair-use-or.claim: makes either predominantly roaming use or foreign presence a breach in its general terms.
roaming-vianova-fair-use-or.quote:
Il Cliente potrà utilizzare i Servizi (voce, dati, sms) in roaming nei Paesi membri dell’Unione Europea (UE) e in Islanda, Lichtenstein, Svizzera, Regno Unito, Principato di Monaco, Albania, Moldavia e Ucraina (Roaming Internazionale UE), alle condizioni del proprio profilo nazionale nell’ambito di viaggi occasionali (Roaming-Like-At-Home, “RLAH”). Tale utilizzo è soggetto ai limiti sotto indicati ed è subordinato all’osservanza delle politiche di corretto utilizzo e del legame stabile con l’Italia (da dimostrare su eventuale richiesta di Vianova) ai sensi del Regolamento Europeo 2016/2286, parametri previsti per prevenire abusi e utilizzi anomali.

Per accedere a quanto sopra indicato, il Cliente deve soddisfare almeno uno dei seguenti requisiti:
• sia abitualmente residente in Italia;
• abbia legami stabili con l’Italia che comportino una presenza frequente e consistente sul territorio italiano.

In aggiunta, per poter usufruire del RLAH, non dovranno avverarsi le seguenti condizioni:
• utilizzo in roaming contestuale o sequenziale di più Carte SIM di cui il Cliente è titolare;
• lungo periodo di inattività della Carta SIM associato a periodi di uso preponderante o esclusivo in roaming in ambito UE, in un arco temporale di 4 (quattro) mesi;
• consumo in roaming in ambito UE prevalente rispetto al consumo nazionale o presenza prevalente in altri Stati membri dell’Unione Europea, in un arco temporale di 4 (quattro) mesi.

Nel caso in cui Vianova rilevi una delle condotte di cui ai punti a), b) o c), saranno applicate le tariffe previste in roaming in ambito UE (consultabile sul sito www.vianova.it nella sezione dedicata ai profili mobili).

In assenza delle condotte di cui ai punti a), b) o c), il superamento delle soglie massime di traffico utilizzabile in UE determinerà comunque l’applicazione delle condizioni economiche pubblicate in questa pagina e definite sulla base di quanto previsto dalla Regolamentazione Europea.

Previa autorizzazione da parte dell’AGCOM ed in conformità a quanto disposto dall’articolo 6 quater, paragrafo 2, del Regolamento (UE) n. 622/2022, Vianova si riserva di applicare un sovrapprezzo ai servizi in roaming nei paesi dell’Unione Europea. Le condizioni complete sono pubblicate in questa pagina dedicata ai profili mobili.
roaming-vianova-fair-use-or.tr:
The Customer may use the Services (voice, data, SMS) while roaming in EU Member States and Iceland, Liechtenstein, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Monaco, Albania, Moldova and Ukraine (EU International Roaming), at the conditions of their domestic profile during occasional travel (Roaming-Like-At-Home, “RLAH”). Such use is subject to the limits below and to compliance with fair-use policies and stable links with Italy (to be demonstrated if Vianova requests it), under European Regulation 2016/2286. These parameters are intended to prevent abuse and anomalous use.

To access the arrangements described above, the Customer must meet at least one of these requirements:
• normally reside in Italy;
• have stable links with Italy entailing frequent and substantial presence in Italy.

In addition, to use RLAH, none of these conditions must occur:
• simultaneous or sequential roaming use of multiple SIM cards held by the Customer;
• a long period of SIM inactivity associated with predominantly or exclusively EU roaming use over four months;
• roaming consumption in the EU prevailing over domestic consumption OR prevailing presence in other EU Member States over four months.

If Vianova detects any of the conduct in points (a), (b) or (c), the tariffs provided for EU roaming will apply (available at www.vianova.it in the section dedicated to mobile profiles).

Even without the conduct in points (a), (b) or (c), exceeding the maximum traffic allowances usable in the EU will in any event cause the economic conditions published on the linked page and defined on the basis of European rules to apply.

Subject to prior AGCOM authorisation and in accordance with Article 6c(2) of Regulation (EU) 622/2022 [number as published], Vianova reserves the right to apply a surcharge to roaming services in EU countries. Complete conditions are published on the linked page dedicated to mobile profiles.
roaming-vianova-fair-use-or.law: Implementing Regulation 2016/2286 Article 4(4) requires the ordinary presence and consumption indicators to be assessed cumulatively over at least four months. Either prevailing domestic presence or domestic consumption is proof of non-abusive use. The negative test in the general terms instead treats predominantly foreign presence OR predominantly roaming consumption as a breach. The separately linked RLAH guide uses a domestic-consumption OR domestic-presence structure, but also adds a parenthetical definition based on 50% of traffic. Both are retained as countercontext; the guide is not endorsed in full. This does not correct the general terms’ negative foreign OR test. Residence/stable-link checks, SIM inactivity and sequential SIM use remain separate grounds.
roaming-vianova-fair-use-or.example: Hypothetical: a business customer with established stable links spends 70% of relevant days in Italy but uses 80% of monitored mobile data while on EU trips over four months. There is no inactive SIM, sequential SIM scheme or other abuse ground. Domestic presence establishes non-abusive ordinary roaming even though foreign consumption predominates; the general terms’ alternative consumption test would incorrectly classify it as a breach.
roaming-vianova-fair-use-or.context: The complete provision includes residence/stable links, two separate SIM abuse indicators, independent data allowance exhaustion and an AGCOM-authorised sustainability mechanism. Those grounds are preserved. The current homepage links both the general terms and the separate RLAH guide, whose positive domestic OR test contradicts the general terms’ negative foreign OR test. The finding is limited to this conflict; it does not allege every Vianova roaming passage is wrong. Extra nonregulated destinations voluntarily included in Vianova’s offer are outside the legal comparison.
roaming-vianova-fair-use-or.scope: Italian-home Vianova business customers eligible for default regulated terrestrial EU/EEA roaming, with stable links and no separate abuse indicator. The ordinary four-month presence/use test only; no conclusion about actual enforcement or individually negotiated alternative tariffs.

roaming-freenet-presence-time-limit.claim: describes a stay over four months or mostly foreign presence as sufficient for roaming surcharges.
roaming-freenet-presence-time-limit.quote: Neben einem Limit des Datenvolumens im Rahmen der FUP können Mobilfunkanbieter auch eine zeitliche Begrenzung geltend machen. Wichtig ist hierbei ebenfalls, dass Kunden vorab darauf hingewiesen werden müssen. Konkret bedeutet dieses zeitliche Limit, dass bei einem Aufenthalt im EU-Ausland von mehr als vier Monaten trotz Wegfall der Roaming-Gebühren Zuschläge erhoben werden können. Die Regelung greift außerdem, wenn Du Dich in einem Zeitfenster von mindestens vier Monaten mehr im Ausland als in Deutschland aufhältst. In diesen Fällen können Mobilfunkanbieter im Jahr 2025 für im EU-Ausland verbrauchtes Datenvolumen 1,55 Euro pro Gigabyte in Rechnung stellen. Ab 2026 gilt ein Preis von 1,31 Euro inklusive Mehrwertsteuer als Höchstsatz.
roaming-freenet-presence-time-limit.tr: Besides a data-volume limit under the FUP, mobile providers can also impose a time limit. Customers must likewise be informed in advance. Specifically, this time limit means that surcharges may be charged during a stay in another EU country of more than four months despite the abolition of roaming fees. The rule also applies if, during a period of at least four months, you spend more time abroad than in Germany. In these cases mobile providers can charge €1.55 per GB for data used in the EU abroad in 2025. From 2026 the ceiling is €1.31 including VAT.
roaming-freenet-presence-time-limit.law: Implementing Regulation 2016/2286 Article 4(4) requires cumulative presence and consumption observation over at least four months for the ordinary abuse control. Either prevailing domestic consumption or domestic presence is a safe harbour. A four-month stay is not itself a maximum entitlement, and predominantly foreign presence alone cannot establish ordinary abusive roaming. The article’s separate data-volume rules concern valid allowance exhaustion and do not supply the missing consumption condition for its explicit time-limit explanation.
roaming-freenet-presence-time-limit.example: Hypothetical: an eligible German customer with established stable links spends 60% of days in France over the observation period but uses 70% of monitored mobile data while in Germany. No separate abuse indicator applies and the EU data allowance remains available. The domestic-consumption safe harbour prevents an ordinary abuse surcharge, even though the article’s foreign-presence condition is met.
roaming-freenet-presence-time-limit.context: The maintained tips index links this carrier-published article with date 28 May 2025; the article expressly describes 2026 prices. Separate sections explain data-volume fair-use limits, domestic tariffs, international calls, non-EU destinations and Wi-Fi calling. No alternative cumulative presence-and-consumption qualification was found in the full article. The approximately €1.31 gross 2026 data figure is not challenged: €1.10 × 1.19 = €1.309. No claim about freenet’s own operative tariff terms or actual charging.
roaming-freenet-presence-time-limit.scope: German-home users eligible for default regulated terrestrial EU/EEA roaming, with residence/stable links established, within any applicable data allowance, and no separate abuse ground. The ordinary time/presence control described in this explanatory article.

roaming-unomobile-eu-selector-data.law: For an ordinary 2026 open data bundle, Implementing Regulation 2016/2286 Article 4(2) requires at least twice the mobile bundle price excluding VAT divided by the €1.10/GB wholesale ceiling. At the ordinary €8.99 renewal price, taking Italy’s 22% VAT off gives a floor of about 13.398 GB. A fixed-period top-up bundle is not merely per-unit prepaid credit. The selected 12 GB allowance is lower, while the linked contract summary correctly gives 13.40 GB. Separately, Regulation 2022/612 Articles 8(1) and 11 cap the data fair-use surcharge at €1.10/GB excluding VAT in 2026, or €1.342 including 22% VAT. The listed €0.0025/Mb is above that cap even on the favourable interpretation of Mb as megabytes and the assumption that the figure includes VAT. If Mb means megabits, or if the rate is net, the difference is larger. The finding is contradictory public guidance, not actual billing or an allegation about the unmarked voice/SMS rows.
roaming-unomobile-eu-selector-data.example: Hypothetical: a customer who subscribed to Flash 5G 320 in June 2026 pays the ordinary €8.99 monthly renewal in October 2026, after the one-off promotional credit is exhausted. They make an occasional covered terrestrial EU trip and still have ample unused domestic 320 GB. The 2026 statutory roaming floor is about 13.40 GB, as the linked June contract summary states, rather than the selector’s 12 GB. After a lawful EU allowance is exceeded, a further 1000 MB cannot attract a data fair-use surcharge above €1.342 including 22% VAT; on the favourable interpretation of its displayed Mb as megabytes, the page’s €0.0025/Mb would describe €2.50. If Mb instead means megabits, the difference is larger. Assume all other fair-use/stable-link conditions are met and no deliberately chosen alternative tariff or authorised sustainability derogation. No actual invoice or denied allowance is asserted.
roaming-unomobile-eu-selector-data.context: Current homepage links roaming hub, which directly links the EU page. Current homepage also directly offers Flash 5G 320 until 19 October 2026; its current product page directly links the retained June 2026 summary. That summary has an express June 8–15 subscription window and is retained honestly as a dated linked document, not relabelled a newly issued October contract. Its 13.40 GB and legally prevailing surcharge are material correct countercontext. The example uses an existing June subscriber in an ordinary later paid month, avoiding the first-month discount and one-off free-month credit. The complete published price rows, units and billing footnotes remain; only data pricing and selected allowance are challenged.
roaming-unomobile-eu-selector-data.scope: Published Italian guidance for ordinary periodic EU terrestrial roaming on the specified active fixed-period mobile bundle in a full-price 2026 renewal month, with domestic data remaining. Excludes domestic allowance exhaustion, first/free promotional months, non-EU and maritime/satellite networks, deliberate alternative tariffs and any valid derogation. No finding that the current contract or actual app/billing implements the defective guide.

package-exoticca-transfer.src: ¿Puedo transferir mi viaje a otra persona?
package-exoticca-transfer.claim: says a trip can never be transferred once booked.
package-exoticca-transfer.quote: No, no puedes transferir tu viaje a otra persona una vez comprado.
package-exoticca-transfer.tr: No, you cannot transfer your trip to another person once purchased.
package-exoticca-transfer.example: An eligible traveller gives durable notice at least seven days before departure to transfer a qualifying package to a friend who meets its conditions, accepting reasonable actual transfer costs. The FAQ categorically says this cannot be done.
package-exoticca-transfer.context: Four languages share the same article ID. They are one repeated drafting family, not four independent errors. Non-English wording and translations were independently checked. No separate company copy of this specific sentence was established.
package-exoticca-transfer.scope: Effective dates: German and French package rules apply to contracts from 1 July 2018. Spain’s recast Article 157 applies from 28 December 2018. The EU implementation date was 1 July 2018; this does not backdate Spain’s enactment. Exceptions: Under the EU/German rule, seven days is always reasonable notice. Spain requires at least seven calendar days; France normally requires at least seven-day notice unless more favourable terms apply. A substitute failing the trip requirements may be rejected. Airline reissue can be expensive. This does not guarantee free name changes or a change of destination/date.

package-exoticca-refund.claim: says non-refundable flight costs are deducted from organiser-cancellation refunds.
package-exoticca-refund.quote: Stornierung der Reise durch Exoticca Die Stornierung der Reise aus einem Grund, der nicht dem Kunden zugeschrieben werden kann, berechtigt den Kunden, den Vertrag mit den in diesen Geschäfts- und Reisebedingungen vorgesehenen Rechten zu kündigen. In den folgenden Fällen besteht keine Verpflichtung zur Entschädigung: Wenn die Stornierung auf die Tatsache zurückzuführen ist, dass die erforderliche Teilnehmerzahl für eine Durchführung der Pauschalreise nicht erreicht wurde. In diesem Fall wird Exoticca dem Nutzer die Stornierung mindestens 7 Tage vor dem geplanten Reisebeginn mitteilen. Wenn die Stornierung der Reise auf höhere Gewalt zurückzuführen ist. Höhere Gewalt sind Umstände, die außerhalb der Kontrolle von Exoticca liegen, oder ungewöhnliche und unvorhersehbare Umstände, deren Folgen trotz aller Sorgfalt nicht hätten vermieden werden können. Das Exoticca-Reiseguthaben ist ein nicht erstattungsfähiger digitaler Gutschein, der für jede auf unserer Website angebotenen Reise und zu jedem vom Kunden gewünschten Zeitpunkt eingelöst werden kann (das Exoticca-Reiseguthaben hat kein Verfallsdatum). Wenn der Betrag der neuen Reise geringer ist als das verfügbare Guthaben, wird die Differenz in der Exoticca Wallet des Nutzers gespeichert und kann für eine weitere Reise verwendet werden. Ist der Betrag der neuen Reise jedoch höher als das verfügbare Guthaben, muss der Kunde die Differenz gemäß den im Abschnitt „Zahlung“ festgelegten Zahlungsbedingungen begleichen. Sollte der Kunde das Exoticca-Reiseguthaben als Erstattungsmethode ablehnen, kann er sich für eine Auszahlung des Reisebetrages entscheiden. Für die Rückerstattung des Reisebetrages gelten folgende Bedingungen: Die Kosten für nicht erstattungsfähige Flüge werden als Entschädigung abgezogen.
package-exoticca-refund.tr: Cancellation of the trip by Exoticca. Cancellation for a reason not attributable to the customer entitles the customer to terminate the contract with the rights provided in these terms and conditions. There is no obligation to pay compensation in the following cases: If the cancellation is due to the number of participants required to operate the package not being reached. In that case Exoticca will notify the user of the cancellation at least 7 days before the scheduled start of the trip. If the cancellation is due to force majeure. Force majeure means circumstances outside Exoticca’s control, or unusual and unforeseeable circumstances whose consequences could not have been avoided despite all due care. Exoticca travel credit is a non-refundable digital voucher that can be redeemed for any trip offered on our website whenever the customer wishes (Exoticca travel credit has no expiry date). If the new trip costs less than the available credit, the difference is stored in the user’s Exoticca Wallet and can be used for another trip. If the new trip costs more than the available credit, the customer must pay the difference under the payment conditions in the “Payment” section. If the customer declines Exoticca travel credit as the refund method, they may choose payment of the travel price. The following conditions apply to the refund of the travel price: The costs of non-refundable flights will be deducted as compensation.
package-exoticca-refund.example: An organiser cancels a qualifying package for too few participants. The full refund includes the flight component, even if the airline’s ticket was non-refundable.
package-exoticca-refund.context: Spanish §10.2 instead provides full repayment and credit only with express acceptance. This regional difference has no lawful German exception for non-refundable supplier airfares. General statutory safeguards in German §14 were checked.
package-exoticca-refund.scope: Effective dates: BGB §§651h and 651y apply to contracts from 1 July 2018. CJEU C-407/21 (8 June 2023) confirms that the statutory refund is money; it did not decide this company’s clause. Exceptions: Appropriate fees can apply to an ordinary voluntary cancellation by the traveller. This finding concerns organiser cancellation, particularly the low-number/extraordinary-circumstance grounds in the surrounding passage. Damages have distinct exceptions. The terms do offer cash, so a voucher-only allegation would be inaccurate.

package-gestravel-minimum.tr: If the organising agency or, where applicable, the retail agency cancels the contract for reasons not attributable to the traveller, it must refund all payments made by the traveller within no more than 14 calendar days after termination. The agency is not liable for additional compensation if cancellation occurs because: a) The number registered for the package is below the contractual minimum and the organising or retail agency notifies the traveller within the contractual period, no later than: 15 days before departure for trips lasting more than 6 days; 7 days for trips lasting between 2 and 6 days; 48 hours for trips lasting less than 2 days. b) The organiser cannot perform the contract because of unavoidable and extraordinary circumstances and notifies the traveller of cancellation without undue delay before the package begins.
package-gestravel-minimum.example: A ten-day tour is cancelled ten days before departure for low bookings. The organiser must refund it and cannot rely on the low-number exemption alone to defeat any additional compensation claim; an award still depends on the claim’s requirements.

package-reisewelt-insolvency.tr: Under the Package Travel Regulation (PRV), customer funds for package travel and linked travel arrangements of Reisewelt GmbH are protected under the following conditions: The deposit is paid no earlier than eleven months before the agreed end of the trip and is at most 20% of the travel price. Deposits or balance payments exceeding these amounts or paid early may not be demanded and are also not protected. The guarantor is Raiffeisenlandesbank Oberösterreich Aktiengesellschaft, Europaplatz 1a, 4020 Linz. All claims must be registered with the administrator (call us Assistance International GmbH, Waschhausgasse 2, A-1020 Vienna) within 8 weeks of any insolvency, otherwise the claim is lost. Travellers may contact this institution or, where applicable, the responsible authority (Federal Ministry of Labour and Economy, Stubenring 1, 1010 Vienna, tourism@bmaw.gv.at, telephone 43 1 7110080759) if services are refused because of Reisewelt GmbH’s insolvency.
