package-beltrame-itinerary.claim: rules out cancellation when outside events change the route.
package-beltrame-itinerary.quote: Nous nous réservons le droit d’apporter toutes les modifications utiles jugées nécessaires pour le bon déroulement d’un voyage. Nous pouvons être amenés à inverser des journées de visites, de modifier les itinéraires et l’ordre des excursions, et de remplacer un moyen de transport par un autre. Nous réservons le droit aux conducteurs, si les circonstances l’exigent (impossibilité technique, politique…), de modifier ou supprimer, à tout instant, les itinéraires de nos programmes. Cette suppression, n’étant pas le fait de notre simple volonté, ne peut donner lieu à aucune indemnité et ne constitue pas non plus un motif légitime d’annulation. Toutes les mentions relatives aux parcours et horaires, dans les programmes, ne sont fournies qu’à titre indicatif. Toutefois, en cas de panne, d’embouteillage, de retard dû aux difficultés de circulation, notre personnel fera le maximum pour éviter les perturbations dans le déroulement du programme.
package-beltrame-itinerary.tr: We reserve the right to make any useful changes considered necessary for the smooth running of a trip. We may have to reverse sightseeing days, change itineraries and the order of excursions, and replace one means of transport with another. We reserve the right for drivers, if circumstances require it (technical or political impossibility, etc.), to change or remove the itineraries in our programmes at any time. Such removal, not being solely of our own choosing, cannot give rise to any compensation and does not constitute a legitimate ground for cancellation either. All route and timetable information in the programmes is indicative only. However, in the event of a breakdown, traffic jam or delay caused by traffic difficulties, our staff will do everything possible to avoid disruption to the programme.
package-beltrame-itinerary.example: Before departure, the organiser drops an essential itinerary element because of an external event and cannot perform the agreed package. A qualifying traveller may choose fee-free termination; during-trip rights have additional conditions.
package-beltrame-itinerary.context: Full surrounding responsibility, maritime, insurance and complaints passages and brochure pages 42–43 were read. Optional medical insurance is separate. The minimum-participant paragraph alone was rejected as a finding: it promises refund but does not expressly deny additional compensation. HTML/PDF are one company wording occurrence.
package-beltrame-itinerary.scope: Effective dates: L211-13 since 1 July 2018; L211-16 VI protection introduced in the 2018 regime, current article version since 24 May 2019. R211-9 governs the predeparture change refund; R211-10 governs Article L211-14 cancellations. Exceptions: Minor reorderings do not automatically give a cancellation right. During travel, a reasonable chance to remedy normally comes first. Suitable alternatives matter. Extraordinary circumstances may exclude damages; they do not categorically erase cancellation, refund or price-reduction rights.

package-exo-tours-return-costs.quote: § 651 j: (1) Wird die Reise infolge bei Vertragsabschluss nicht vorhersehbarer höherer Gewalt (z.B. durch Krieg, innere Unruhen, Naturkatastrophen usw.) erheblich erschwert, gefährdet oder beeinträchtigt, so können sowohl der Reiseveranstalter als auch der Reisende den Vertrag kündigen. Die Rechtsfolgen ergeben sich aus dem Gesetz § 651 e Abs. 3 BGB. Danach kann der Reiseveranstalter für erbrachte oder noch zu erbringende Reiseleistungen eine angemessene Entschädigung verlangen. Der Reiseveranstalter ist verpflichtet, die notwendigen Maßnahmen zu treffen, insbesondere, falls der Vertrag die Rückbeförderung umfasst, den Reisegast zurückzubefördern. Die Mehrkosten für diese Rückbeförderung sind von den Parteien je zur Hälfte zu tragen. Im übrigen fallen die Mehrkosten dem Reisenden zur Last.
package-exo-tours-return-costs.tr: §651j(1): If force majeure unforeseeable when the contract was concluded (for example war, civil unrest or natural disasters) substantially hinders, endangers or impairs the trip, both the organiser and the traveller may terminate the contract. The legal consequences follow from §651e(3) BGB. The organiser may then demand reasonable compensation for travel services already provided or still to be provided. The organiser must take the necessary measures, in particular returning the traveller if the contract includes return transport. The parties must each bear half of the additional costs of that return transport. The other additional costs fall to the traveller.

versions.quote: § 651 j: (1) Wird die Reise infolge bei Vertragsabschluss nicht vorhersehbarer höherer Gewalt (z.B. durch Krieg, innere Unruhen, Naturkatastrophen usw.) erheblich erschwert, gefährdet oder beeinträchtigt, so können sowohl der Reiseveranstalter als auch der Reisende den Vertrag kündigen. Die Rechtsfolgen ergeben sich aus dem Gesetz § 651 e Abs. 3 BGB. Danach kann der Reiseveranstalter für erbrachte oder noch zu erbringende Reiseleistungen eine angemessene Entschädigung verlangen. Der Reiseveranstalter ist verpflichtet, die notwendigen Maßnahmen zu treffen, insbesondere, falls der Vertrag die Rückbeförderung umfasst, den Reisegast zurückzubefördern. Die Mehrkosten für diese Rückbeförderung sind von den Parteien je zur Hälfte zu tragen. Im übrigen fallen die Mehrkosten dem Reisenden zur Last.
versions.tr: §651j(1): If force majeure unforeseeable when the contract was concluded (for example war, civil unrest or natural disasters) substantially hinders, endangers or impairs the trip, both the organiser and the traveller may terminate the contract. The legal consequences follow from §651e(3) BGB. The organiser may then demand reasonable compensation for travel services already provided or still to be provided. The organiser must take the necessary measures, in particular returning the traveller if the contract includes return transport. The parties must each bear half of the additional costs of that return transport. The other additional costs fall to the traveller.

package-kneissl-insolvency-payment-exclu.claim: excludes excess deposits and early balance payments from insolvency protection.
package-kneissl-insolvency-payment-exclu.quote:
Kundengeld-Absicherung gemäß Verordnung der Bundesministerin für Digitalisierung und Wirtschaftsstandort über Pauschalreisen und verbundene Reiseleistungen (Pauschalreiseverordnung – PRV) BGBl. II Nr. 260/2018
Die Veranstalternummer (Eintragungsnummer im Veranstalterverzeichnis beim Bundesministerium für Digitalisierung und Wirtschaftsstandort) ist 1998 / 0261, GISA-Zahl: 17465083 (digitale Gewerbelizenz).
Für die bei Kneissl Touristik gebuchten Pauschalreisen sind
• bereits entrichtete Zahlungen, soweit diese Reiseleistungen gänzlich oder teilweise infolge Insolvenz des Reiseveranstalters nicht erbracht werden und

durch eine Bankgarantie der Oberbank Wels abgesichert (Nr. 028-20-00873).

Im Insolvenzfall sind sämtliche Ansprüche bei sonstigem Anspruchsverlust innerhalb von 8 Wochen ab Eintritt einer Insolvenz anzumelden bei:
Redion SA - Niederlassung Österreich, Dr.-Adolf-Schärf-Platz 10, 1220 Wien, Tel.: 01/3172500, prv.at@redion.com
package-kneissl-insolvency-payment-exclu.tr:
Customer funds protection under the Ministerial Regulation on package travel and linked travel arrangements (PRV), Federal Law Gazette II No.260/2018. The organiser number is 1998/0261, GISA number 17465083. For packages booked with Kneissl Touristik, the following are secured by an Oberbank Wels bank guarantee(No.028-20-00873):
• payments already made, insofar as the travel services are wholly or partly not provided because of the organiser’s insolvency; and
• necessary return-travel expenses arising from the organiser’s insolvency.
Kneissl Touristik accepts deposits earlier than two weeks before departure(no more than eleven months before the trip ends), up to 20% of the trip price. Deposits or balance payments exceeding this are not protected and may not be demanded. In insolvency, all claims must be notified within eight weeks of the insolvency, otherwise they are lost, to: Redion SA, Austrian branch, Dr.-Adolf-Schärf-Platz 10,1220 Vienna, telephone 01/3172500,prv.at@redion.com.
package-kneissl-insolvency-payment-exclu.law: Austrian PRV §3(1) requires protection for accepted package payments where insolvency prevents services. §3(4) expressly includes customer funds accepted contrary to §4(4)–(5). Those provisions restrict when money may be accepted; breaching them does not remove accepted money from the required insolvency protection. The page’s categorical exclusion of excess or premature payments confuses those two rules.
package-kneissl-insolvency-payment-exclu.example: Hypothetical: for an otherwise qualifying €2000 package, the organiser actually accepts €1000 two months before departure, then insolvency prevents all services. Subject to the scheme’s other claim conditions, the required protection includes the accepted €1000; the €600 exceeding a 20% deposit is not excluded merely because its acceptance breached the payment restriction. This does not establish a particular guarantee or actual payout.
package-kneissl-insolvency-payment-exclu.context: The home page currently links Reisebedingungen. That page states tariff information as of 28 August 2026 and expressly applies PRG/PRV to packages. Its separate payment paragraph repeats the exclusion; that materially relevant text is retained below. No recent review of each clause is inferred from the tariff date.
package-kneissl-insolvency-payment-exclu.scope: Current qualifying packages organised by this Austrian business within the Austrian PRV scheme, involving customer funds actually accepted and subsequently unperformed services because of insolvency. Excludes merely intermediated services, unrelated insurance, and historic transactions governed by the old RSV transition. This is a statement about the mandatory scope of protection, not an audit of the company’s guarantee, actual insolvency, deadline compliance or recovery amount.

package-hubert-schwarz-claims-deadline.src: Hubert Schwarz – Reisebedingungen, 12 February 2026, physical page 4
package-hubert-schwarz-claims-deadline.claim: sets a one-month claim cutoff and a one-year limitation period.
package-hubert-schwarz-claims-deadline.quote: Ansprüche wegen nicht vertragsgemäßer Erbringung der Reise können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach vertraglich vorgesehener Beendigung der Reise uns gegenüber geltend machen. Nach Ablauf der Frist können Sie Ansprüche nur geltend machen, wenn Sie ohne Verschulden an der Einhaltung der Frist verhindert waren. In Ihrem eigenen Interesse sollten Sie die Ansprüche schriftlich geltend machen. Ihre Ansprüche nach den §§ 651 c bis 651 f BGB verjähren in einem Jahr. Die Verjährung beginnt mit dem Tage, an dem die Reise dem Vertrag nach enden sollte. Haben Sie Ansprüche geltend gemacht, so ist die Verjährung bis zu dem Tag gehemmt, an dem wir die Ansprüche schriftlich zurückweisen.
package-hubert-schwarz-claims-deadline.tr: You may assert claims against us for travel not performed according to the contract within one month after the contractual end of the trip. After that period you may assert claims only if you were prevented from meeting it without fault. In your own interests, claims should be made in writing. Your claims under BGB §§651c–651 f become time-barred after one year. Limitation begins on the day the trip should have ended under the contract. If you asserted claims, limitation is suspended until the day we reject them in writing.
package-hubert-schwarz-claims-deadline.law: BGB §651j gives statutory defect remedies a two-year limitation period beginning with the contractual end of the trip. For post-1-July-2018 contracts, the former one-month exclusion period was removed; BGB §651y prevents reducing those rights by contract. The quoted one-month cutoff and one-year period retain former law. Travellers still owe prompt defect notification under §651o; culpable failure limits reduction and damages only insofar as it prevented a remedy.
package-hubert-schwarz-claims-deadline.example: Hypothetical: on a package contracted in 2026, a traveller promptly reports a hotel defect during travel and permits a remedy, but first submits the remaining statutory claim two months after the contractual end. It is not excluded merely because one month passed. Its merits and the statutory two-year limit must still be checked.

Physical page 4 is expressly Reisebedingungen, separate from event-space terms on pages 1–3. The offer is a 12-day own guided trek with hotel/tent accommodation and local transfers, and links a 20-page brochure carrying the same clauses on physical page 19 (date 22 December 2023). International flights are expressly excluded from that package price. The brochure’s 18th page gives a ten-person minimum and incorporates the attached conditions. All relevant pages and the full conditions were read; dated current incoming links, rather than the old template wording alone, establish ongoing publication.

package-hubert-schwarz-return-costs.src: Hubert Schwarz – Reisebedingungen, 12 February 2026, physical page 4
package-hubert-schwarz-return-costs.claim: makes the traveller pay half the additional return-transport cost after force-majeure termination.
package-hubert-schwarz-return-costs.quote: Wird die Reise infolge bei Vertragsschluss nicht voraussehbarer höherer Gewalt erheblich erschwert, gefährdet oder beeinträchtigt, so können sowohl Sie als auch wir den Vertrag kündigen. Wird der Vertrag gekündigt, so können wir für die bereits erbrachten oder zur Beendigung der Reise noch zu erbringenden Reiseleistungen eine angemessene Entschädigung verlangen. Wir sind verpflichtet, die notwendigen Maßnahmen zu treffen, insbesondere, falls der Vertrag die Rückbeförderung umfasst, Sie zurückzubefördern. Die Mehrkosten für die Rückbeförderung sind von Ihnen und uns je zur Hälfte zu tragen. Im Übrigen fallen die Mehrkosten Ihnen zur Last.
package-hubert-schwarz-return-costs.tr: If unforeseeable force majeure substantially impedes, endangers or adversely affects the trip, both you and we may terminate the contract. On termination, we may demand appropriate compensation for travel services already provided or still to be provided to end the trip. We must take the necessary measures, in particular returning you if return carriage is included in the contract. You and we each bear half the additional return-transport costs. Otherwise the additional costs fall on you.
package-hubert-schwarz-return-costs.law: For a qualifying termination under BGB §651l(1) because a substantial travel defect remains after the required remedy period(or a statutory exception to that period), §651l(3) makes the organiser arrange equivalent return transport and bear its additional cost where the package includes carriage. §651y prevents shifting half that cost to the traveller. A force-majeure event alone does not establish every condition for statutory termination; this finding covers cases satisfying those conditions.
package-hubert-schwarz-return-costs.example: Hypothetical: a package includes local return transport to its starting point. A storm makes contracted accommodation and essential activities unusable, substantially impairing the package. Assume no acceptable alternative and that the statutory remedy-period conditions for §651l termination are met. Equivalent return transport costs €600 more. The organiser bears that additional €600 under §651l(3); the clause assigns €300 to the traveller. This does not assume an international flight is included.
package-hubert-schwarz-return-costs.context: The live home page, current travel index and January 2027 Kilimandscharo offer link the four-page conditions dated 12 February 2026. Physical page 4 is expressly Reisebedingungen, separate from event-space terms on pages 1–3. The offer is a 12-day own guided trek with hotel/tent accommodation and local transfers, and links a 20-page brochure carrying the same clauses on physical page 19 (date 22 December 2023). International flights are expressly excluded from that package price. The brochure’s 18th page gives a ten-person minimum and incorporates the attached conditions. All relevant pages and the full conditions were read; dated current incoming links, rather than the old template wording alone, establish ongoing publication.

Excludes pre-reform contracts under EGBGB Art.229 §42, standalone services, merely intermediated packages and the statutory business-travel/nonprofit/day-trip exceptions. Current public terms only; no actual contractual incorporation, claim denial, loss or independent drafting origin is established. Limited to §651l terminations satisfying its conditions, with contractual carriage. It does not allocate every emergency expense or insurance cost.

package-hubert-schwarz-minimum.claim: allows minimum-participant cancellation until two weeks before departure.
package-hubert-schwarz-minimum.tr:
We may withdraw from the travel contract before the trip, or terminate it after the trip begins, in the following cases:
c. Without notice if, despite our warning, the traveller persistently disrupts the trip or breaches the contract so seriously that immediate termination is justified. If we terminate, we retain the price claim, but must deduct saved expenses and benefits from alternative use of unused services, including credits from suppliers.
d. Until two weeks before departure, if an advertised or officially stipulated minimum number of participants is not reached, provided the trip description gives a minimum for that trip. In every case, we must inform you without delay once the conditions for not operating the trip arise, and send you the withdrawal declaration without delay. You receive the trip price paid back without delay. If it becomes apparent earlier that the minimum cannot be reached, we will inform you.
package-hubert-schwarz-minimum.law: For a package longer than six days, BGB §651h(4)(1)(a) requires the contractually specified minimum number and deadline plus notice no later than 20 days before departure. A general two-week cutoff is too late for that particular exemption. Seven days and 48 hours apply to the two shorter duration bands. Late notice does not itself establish a fixed damages award.
package-hubert-schwarz-minimum.example: Hypothetical: a qualifying 12-day package has the specified ten-person minimum and contractual deadline but only eight bookings. The organiser announces cancellation 14 days before departure. That does not meet the 20-day requirement for the long-trip low-number exemption. It must refund; any additional remedy requires its own legal conditions.

package-goetten-defect-notice-causation.claim: excludes price reduction and damages for culpable nonnotification without the statutory causal limit.
package-goetten-defect-notice-causation.quote:
1. Sollten wir die Reise nicht vertragsgemäß erbringen, haben Sie nur dann die gesetzlichen Ansprüche auf Minderung des Reisepreises und Schadensersatz gem. § 651m, 651n BGB, wenn Sie es nicht schuldhaft unterlassen haben, uns den aufgetretenen Mangel unverzüglich anzuzeigen (§651o BGB).
2. Selbstabhilfe und Kündigung des Reisevertrags sind erst nach Ablauf einer uns gesetzten angemessenen Frist zur Abhilfeleistung zulässig. Dieser Frist bedarf es nicht, wenn die Abhilfe unmöglich ist oder von uns verweigert wird oder die sofortige Abhilfe bzw. Kündigung durch ein in der Person des Reiseteilnehmers liegendes Interesse geboten ist.
3. Eine Mängelanzeige nimmt unsere örtliche Reiseleitung entgegen. Sollten Sie diese wider Erwarten nicht erreichen können, so wenden Sie sich direkt an uns: Anton Götten GmbH, Faktoreistraße 1, 66111 Saarbrücken, Telefon 0681 3032-00, Fax 0681 3032-217, E-Mail info@goetten.de.
4. Sämtliche Ansprüche, insbesondere Gewährleistungsansprüche, die Ihnen im Zusammenhang mit der Buchung und Durchführung der Reise gegen uns zustehen, verjähren in zwei Jahren nach dem vertraglichen Reiseende.
package-goetten-defect-notice-causation.tr:
1. If we do not perform the trip according to the contract, you have the statutory rights to a price reduction and damages under BGB §§651m and 651n only if you have not culpably failed to notify us of the defect without undue delay(§651o BGB).
2. Self-remedy and termination of the travel contract are permitted only after a reasonable remedy period set for us has expired. No period is required if a remedy is impossible or refused by us, or if immediate remedy or termination is justified by an interest specific to the traveller.
3. Our local tour manager receives defect notices. If you unexpectedly cannot reach them, contact us directly: Anton Götten GmbH, Faktoreistraße 1,66111Saarbrücken, telephone 06813032-00,fax 06813032-217,info@goetten.de.
4. All claims against us connected with booking and performing the trip, particularly warranty claims, become time-barred two years after the contractual end of the trip.
package-goetten-defect-notice-causation.law: BGB §651o(1) requires the traveller to notify a travel defect without undue delay. Under §651o(2), culpable failure limits price reduction and damages only insofar as the organiser could not provide a remedy because of that failure. Fault alone does not establish that causal loss of rights. Section 651y prevents contractual reduction of the statutory rights. The guidance states a categorical exclusion for culpable nonnotification, without the causal qualification.
package-goetten-defect-notice-causation.example: Hypothetical: a traveller culpably fails to report a defect promptly. Assume the organiser could not have remedied that defect even with prompt notification, and that the other requirements for a statutory reduction are met. The failure therefore did not prevent a remedy. Section 651o(2) does not itself exclude that reduction; the published fault-only condition does. No automatic damages award is assumed.
package-goetten-defect-notice-causation.context: The current home page links the exact AGB page. Its visible date is 1 June 2025 and it identifies the Saarbrücken organiser and current BGB package rights. The full J section is retained, including the adjacent remedy-period exceptions and correct two-year limitation. The general statement of statutory liability in I(1) is separate context below; neither passage states the causal condition omitted by J(1).
package-goetten-defect-notice-causation.scope: Qualifying German-law package contracts concluded on or after 1 July 2018. Only the consequence of culpable failure to notify a travel defect is compared. Prompt notification remains a duty; entitlement and amounts depend on the other statutory requirements. package-giratur-minimum.law: Spanish RDL 1/2007 Article 160(3)(a)(1) requires notice at least 20 calendar days before departure for the low-number exemption from additional compensation on packages lasting more than six days, together with the specified contractual minimum and notice period. The brochure instead gives 15 days without distinguishing length. Its separate special-service withdrawal-cost sentence concerns traveller cancellation, not organiser low-number cancellation; the general statutory incorporation clause is retained as adverse context. Late notice defeats reliance on this exemption alone; no automatic damages or amount is asserted.
package-giratur-minimum.example: Hypothetical: a traveller contracts now under Spanish Book IV for a ten-day Giratur hotel-and-transport package in this current brochure. The contract specifies a valid minimum number and cancellation deadline. The organiser cancels solely for insufficient registrations and gives notice 15 days before departure. Assume no unavoidable extraordinary circumstances. The organiser owes the full refund and cannot rely on the low-number exemption alone to bar additional compensation, because notice for a trip exceeding six days had to be at least 20 calendar days. Any compensation claim still depends on its other requirements.

package-radtouren-pause-claims-deadline.claim: imposes a one-month claims deadline and a one-year limitation period for ordinary package claims.
package-radtouren-pause-claims-deadline.quote:
Verjährung
Ansprüche an Radtouren mit Pause müssen innerhalb eines Monats nach vertragsgemäßen Ende der Reise möglichst schriftlich an uns gestellt werden, es sei denn, Sie waren an der Einhaltung der Frist schuldlos gehindert oder es handelt sich um Personenschäden. Alle Ansprüche aus dem Reisevertrag verjähren 1 Jahr nach dem vertraglich vorgesehenen Ende der Reise, wobei schwebende Verhandlungen eine Hemmung der Frist bewirken. Ansprüche aus unerlaubter Handlung verjähren 3 Jahre nach Beendigung der Reise.
package-radtouren-pause-claims-deadline.tr:
Limitation
Claims against Radtouren mit Pause must be submitted to us within one month after the contractual end of the trip, preferably in writing, unless you were prevented from meeting the deadline without fault or the claim concerns personal injury. All claims under the travel contract become time-barred one year after the contractually scheduled end of the trip, with pending negotiations suspending the period. Tort claims become time-barred three years after the trip ends.
package-radtouren-pause-claims-deadline.law: For current qualifying package contracts, BGB 651j gives the traveller two years for BGB 651i(3) claims and starts that period when the package should end. BGB 651y bars a contractual restriction to the traveller’s disadvantage. A general one-month post-trip claims cutoff no longer applies to these after 2018 package claims. The words möglichst schriftlich make written form preferable; müssen innerhalb eines Monats still makes the time limit mandatory. Personal-injury/no-fault exceptions, negotiation suspension and a separate tort period are retained but do not make these ordinary package restrictions valid.
package-radtouren-pause-claims-deadline.example: Hypothetical: a traveller already booked the advertised May 2027 Erkner–Zittau package, including accommodation, the essential cycling/tour programme and agreed included return transport. After a non-personal-injury package defect, properly notified during the trip with all other remedy conditions satisfied, the traveller asserts a price-reduction claim 40 days after the contractual end and sues 14 months after that end. The claim is within651j’s two years; neither a one-month cutoff nor the blanket one-year contractual period can bar it. No actual claim, refusal or loss is alleged.

ctx.tr: These travel conditions, accepted with your booking, govern the contractual relationship between you as traveller and Radtouren mit Pause as organiser. They supplement the German Civil Code provisions651etseq on general travel-contract law. Please read the following terms carefully.

ctx.quote:
Gewährleistungen
Wird die Reiseleistung nicht vertragsgemäß erbracht, können Sie Abhilfe verlangen. Wir können auch derart Abhilfe schaffen, dass wir gleich- oder höherwertige Ersatzleistungen erbringen. 11.1 Customer/traveller claims under BGB 651c–f arising from injury to life, body or health caused by an intentional or negligent breach by terranova, its legal representative or vicarious agent become time-barred in two years. The same applies to other damage caused by intentional or grossly negligent breach by those persons.
11.2 All other claims under BGB 651c–f become time-barred in one year.
11.3 The limitation under12.1and12.2 begins the day after the contractual end. If the last day is Sunday, a generally recognised public holiday at the place of declaration, or Saturday, the next working day replaces it.
11.4 If you and terranova negotiate the claim or underlying circumstances, limitation is suspended until either side refuses to continue. Limitation occurs at the earliest three months after suspension ends.

ctx.quote: 8.2Mängelanzeige / Abhilfeverlangen: Wird die Reise nicht vertragsgemäß erbracht, so kann der Reisende Abhilfe verlangen. The traveller must immediately inform terranova’s representative; if none exists and none is contractually owed, notify terranova at its registered office. Contact details are provided in the description or, at latest, the travel documents. The representative is tasked with arranging a remedy where possible, but cannot acknowledge claims.

package-terranova-return-costs.tr: 7c)Because of unavoidable, extraordinary circumstances: If circumstances at the destination that were unforeseeable when the contract was made make the trip substantially more difficult, endanger or impair it, both organiser and traveller may terminate the contract. If terminated, the organiser may demand reasonable compensation for services already provided or still needed to end the trip. The organiser must also take necessary measures, in particular returning the traveller if the contract includes return transport. The parties must each bear half the additional return-transport costs. Other additional costs are borne by the traveller.
package-terranova-return-costs.law: For a trip already begun that is substantially impaired by a package defect and validly terminated under BGB 651l(1),651l(3) requires the organiser to take necessary termination measures, including immediate contracted return transport, and bear the additional return costs. This can apply where unavoidable extraordinary circumstances cause the substantial impairment, provided all statutory termination/remedy conditions are met. The fixed half-cost rule in7c is therefore too broad. Current8.3 termination conditions and9.2 exclusion of clearly intermediated third-party services are retained; the example expressly concerns included return carriage and satisfies current 651l conditions. This is not an unlimited entitlement to return transport outside the contract or every extra expense.
package-terranova-return-costs.example: Hypothetical: on the advertised eight-day Provence package, category A expressly includes a private return transfer to Orange or Avignon. An extraordinary flood substantially impairs the contracted package after departure; notice and reasonable remedy opportunity have been given, no remedy is provided, and the traveller validly terminates under 651l. Necessary contracted return transport costs 600 euros more than planned. The organiser bears the additional 600 euros under 651l(3); the fixed half-cost clause would put 300 euros on the traveller. No separate international flight or self-booked unrelated transport is included in the comparison.

The complete source paragraph retains service-provider statutory limitations and separate tort period; neither makes the ordinary six-month rule valid. The example gives timely on-trip notice and asserts the claim within one month, isolating limitation from the HTML7 assertion clause.

ctx.quote:
7 Gewährleistung
Sollte eine Reiseleistung nicht oder nicht vertragsgemäß erbracht werden, so können Sie innerhalb angemessener Zeit Abhilfe verlangen. Beruht die Nichterbringung oder die nicht vertragsgemäße Erbringung der Reiseleistung auf einem Umstand, der nach Vertragsabschluss eingetreten und von uns nicht wider Treu und Glauben herbeigeführt worden ist, sind wir berechtigt, durch die Erbringung einer gleich- oder höherwertigen Ersatzleistung Abhilfe zu schaffen.
Sollten wir auf Ihr Abhilfeverlangen die Reiseleistungen nicht oder nicht vertragsgemäß erbringen können, er rechnet sich ein eventueller Minderungsanspruch aus der Wertdifferenz zwischen den gebuchten und erhaltenen Reiseleistungen.
Sollte durch Nichterbringung oder nicht vertragsgemäße Erbringung der Reiseleistungen die Durchführung Ihrer Reise erheblich beeinträchtigt werden, können Sie durch schriftliche Erklärung den Reisevertrag kündigen. Wird der Vertrag wirksam gekündigt, behalten Sie den Anspruch auf Rückführung und schulden uns den auf die in Anspruch genommenen Leistungen entfallenden Teil des Reisepreises.
Sollten wir die uns obliegenden Pflichten aus dem Reisevertrag schuldhaft verletzen, sind wir verpflichtet, Ihnen den daraus entstandenen Schaden zu ersetzen.
Sollten Sie Beanstandungen haben, für die wir einstehen können, so wenden Sie sich sofort an unsere Reiseleitung/Busfahrer.
Können Ihre Beanstandungen auch von Reiseleitung/Busfahrer nicht hinreichend behoben werden, sollten Sie zusammen mit Reiseleitung/Busfahrer die für eine Geltendmachung von Ansprüchen grundsätzlich geforderte Niederschrift über die Beanstandung abfassen. Die Niederschrift wird zur Entscheidung von Reiseleitung/Busfahrer an uns weitergeleitet. Irgendwelche Ansprüche können von der Reiseleitung/Busfahrer nicht anerkannt werden.
Sollte jedoch die Niederschrift ohne Ihr Verschulden nicht ausgestellt worden sein, muss Ihre eventuelle Mängelanzeige oder Anspruchstellung innerhalb eines Monats nach der vereinbarten Rückkehr schriftlich bei uns vorliegen, sonst verfallen Ihre Ansprüche.
ctx.tr:
7 Warranty
If a travel service is not provided or not provided as agreed, you may request a remedy within a reasonable time. If this results from a circumstance arising after contract formation that we did not cause contrary to good faith, we may remedy it with an equivalent or higher-value substitute.
If we cannot provide the travel services as agreed after your request for remedy, any price-reduction claim is calculated from the difference in value between the booked and received services.
If non-performance or non-contractual performance substantially impairs your trip, you may terminate the contract by written declaration. Upon effective termination you retain the right to return transport and owe us the part of the travel price attributable to services used.
If we culpably breach contractual duties, we must compensate the resulting damage.
For complaints for which we can be responsible, contact our tour guide/bus driver immediately.
If they cannot sufficiently resolve the complaint, you should draw up with them the written record generally required for asserting claims. They forward it to us for a decision; they cannot acknowledge any claims.
If the record was not drawn up without fault on your part, any notice of defects or assertion of claims must reach us in writing within one month after the agreed return, otherwise your claims expire.

package-schwerin-return-costs.law: Where a package already begun is substantially impaired by a defect and validly terminated under BGB651l(1),651l(3) requires the organiser to take necessary termination measures, particularly immediate contracted return carriage, and bear the additional return costs. Extraordinary circumstances may cause that impairment but do not eliminate the statutory conditions. The fixed half-cost clause wrongly shifts part of those costs to the traveller. Complete6 preserves the trigger and return guarantee; complete7 preserves remedy and termination provisions. The example assumes all current statutory notice/remedy/termination conditions and contracted return carriage, excluding separate third-party air/ship services.
package-schwerin-return-costs.example: Hypothetical: during the advertised11day Bautzen bus/hotel package, an unforeseen flood substantially impairs the contracted package. The traveller gives proper notice and reasonable remedy opportunity, no remedy is provided, and validly terminates under651l. The agreed included return bus requires necessary alternative carriage costing600euros more. The organiser bears the additional600euros under651l(3); the equal-split clause would charge the traveller300euros. No unrelated self-booked journey or automatic right on every disruption is assumed.

package-schwerin-ten-percent-price-trigg.quote:
4 Leistungs- und Preisänderungen
Abweichungen einzelner Reiseleistungen von dem vertraglich vereinbarten Inhalt des Reisevertrages, die nach Vertragsabschluss notwendig werden und die von uns nicht wider Treu und Glauben herbeigeführt wurden, sind gestattet, soweit die Abweichungen nicht erheblich sind und den Gesamtzuschnitt der gebuchten Reise nicht beeinträchtigen. Eventuelle Gewährleistungsansprüche bleiben unberührt.
Von wesentlichen Leistungsänderungen werden Sie, so weit möglich, unverzüglich von uns in Kenntnis gesetzt. In diesen Fällen ermöglichen wir Ihnen eine kostenlose Umbuchung oder einen kostenlosen Rücktritt.
Aus wichtigen Gründen sind wir berechtigt, z. B. die Streckenführung, Fahrpläne und Termine abzuändern.
Unsere Kalkulation basiert unter anderem auf dem mit den Leistungsträgern vor Drucklegung des Kataloges abgeschlossenen Verträgen. Sollten sich nachträglich Veränderungen der behördlich festgelegten oder genehmigten Beförderungstarife, der Steuern, der Treibstoffe oder öffentlichen Abgaben ergeben, sind wir zu einer auch nachträglichen Anpassung unserer Preise berechtigt. Dasselbe gilt für den Fall, dass wir gezwungen sind, unseren Leistungsträgern Zugeständnisse zu machen und wenn zwischen Zugang unserer Reisebestätigung/Rechnung bei Ihnen und dem Reiseantritt mehr als 4 Monate liegen. Sollten diese Zugeständnisse an die Leistungsträger eine Preiserhöhung von mehr als 10 % des von uns bestätigten Reisepreises erforderlich machen, sind Sie innerhalb von 10 Tagen (Posteingangsstempel entscheidet) zum gebührenfreien Rücktritt von der Reise berechtigt.
package-schwerin-ten-percent-price-trigg.tr:
4 Changes to services and prices
Changes to individual contracted travel services that become necessary after contract formation and were not caused by us contrary to good faith are permitted if they are insignificant and do not impair the overall character of the booked trip. Any warranty claims remain unaffected.
We will inform you of significant service changes immediately where possible. In these cases we allow a free rebooking or free withdrawal.
For important reasons we may change, for example, routes, timetables and dates.
Our calculation is based, among other things, on contracts with service providers made before the catalogue was printed. If officially fixed or approved transport tariffs, taxes, fuel costs or public charges subsequently change, we may adjust our prices, including after booking. The same applies where we are forced to make concessions to our service providers and more than4months lie between your receipt of our confirmation/invoice and departure. If these concessions require a price increase of more than10percent of our confirmed travel price, you may withdraw without a fee within10days; the incoming-post stamp decides.
package-schwerin-ten-percent-price-trigg.law: Under BGB651g(1), a reserved price rise exceeding8percent cannot be imposed unilaterally. The organiser may offer it and require a choice between acceptance and withdrawal within a reasonable period. Under651g(3) and651h(1)sentence2/(5), withdrawal carries no ordinary cancellation fee and payments must be refunded within14days.651f independently restricts valid price reservations, permitted reasons, calculation, reciprocal reductions and notice, and651y bars adverse derogation. The source’s specific price paragraph instead sets the fee-free-withdrawal trigger above10percent. Full preceding general free-withdrawal wording for significant service changes is retained as material counterevidence; it does not state or correct the8percent price threshold. The narrow example isolates a9percent rise and assumes all other statutory price-change and notification conditions. No finding about the source’s10day acceptance period or every minor price change is made.
package-schwerin-ten-percent-price-trigg.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise valid current qualifying Bautzen bus/hotel package was booked more than4months before departure for1,960euros. Assume a valid651f reservation, reciprocal price-reduction right and all other required contract information. Higher post-contract fuel costs support a calculated9percent proposed increase of176.40euros, offered on a durable medium30days before departure with all required information and a reasonable10day choice period. The traveller rejects it and withdraws within that period.651g gives the fee-free-withdrawal choice because9percent exceeds8percent, although it is below the source’s more-than10percent trigger. No actual price demand or refusal is asserted.

Abweichungen einzelner Reiseleistungen von dem vertraglich vereinbarten Inhalt des Reisevertrages, die nach Vertragsabschluss notwendig werden und die von uns nicht wider Treu und Glauben herbeigeführt wurden, sind gestattet, soweit die Abweichungen nicht erheblich sind und den Gesamtzuschnitt der gebuchten Reise nicht beeinträchtigen. Eventuelle Gewährleistungsansprüche bleiben unberührt.
Von wesentlichen Leistungsänderungen werden Sie, so weit möglich, unverzüglich von uns in Kenntnis gesetzt. In diesen Fällen ermöglichen wir Ihnen eine kostenlose Umbuchung oder einen kostenlosen Rücktritt.
Aus wichtigen Gründen sind wir berechtigt, z. B. die Streckenführung, Fahrpläne und Termine abzuändern.
Unsere Kalkulation basiert unter anderem auf dem mit den Leistungsträgern vor Drucklegung des Kataloges abgeschlossenen Verträgen. Sollten sich nachträglich Veränderungen der behördlich festgelegten oder genehmigten Beförderungstarife, der Steuern, der Treibstoffe oder öffentlichen Abgaben ergeben, sind wir zu einer auch nachträglichen Anpassung unserer Preise berechtigt. Dasselbe gilt für den Fall, dass wir gezwungen sind, unseren Leistungsträgern Zugeständnisse zu machen und wenn zwischen Zugang unserer Reisebestätigung/Rechnung bei Ihnen und dem Reiseantritt mehr als 4 Monate liegen. Sollten diese Zugeständnisse an die Leistungsträger eine Preiserhöhung von mehr als 10 % des von uns bestätigten Reisepreises erforderlich machen, sind Sie innerhalb von 10 Tagen (Posteingangsstempel entscheidet) zum gebührenfreien Rücktritt von der Reise berechtigt.
versions.tr:
4 Changes to services and prices
Changes to individual contracted travel services that become necessary after contract formation and were not caused by us contrary to good faith are permitted if they are insignificant and do not impair the overall character of the booked trip. Any warranty claims remain unaffected.
We will inform you of significant service changes immediately where possible. In these cases we allow a free rebooking or free withdrawal.
For important reasons we may change, for example, routes, timetables and dates.
Our calculation is based, among other things, on contracts with service providers made before the catalogue was printed. If officially fixed or approved transport tariffs, taxes, fuel costs or public charges subsequently change, we may adjust our prices, including after booking. The same applies where we are forced to make concessions to our service providers and more than4months lie between your receipt of our confirmation/invoice and departure. If these concessions require a price increase of more than10percent of our confirmed travel price, you may withdraw without a fee within10days; the incoming-post stamp decides.

rail-oebb-rerouting-costs.claim: Says there is no refund or reimbursement of costs when rerouting gets the passenger to the destination less than 60 minutes late.
rail-oebb-rerouting-costs.quote: KEIN Anspruch auf Entschädigung, Erstattung oder Ersatz von Kosten aufgrund von Zugsverspätungen besteht in folgenden Punkten: Wenn Reisende vor Kauf des Beförderungsausweises über mögliche Verspätungen informiert wurden, Wenn bei der Fortsetzung der Reise mit einem anderen Verkehrsdienst oder über eine andere Strecke die Verspätung bei der Ankunft am Zielort weniger als 60 Minuten beträgt, Wenn die Verspätung auf Verkehrsleistungen zurückzuführen ist, die nicht Teil des Beförderungsvertrages sind.
rail-oebb-rerouting-costs.tr: There is NO entitlement to compensation, refund or reimbursement of costs due to train delays in the following cases: If passengers were informed of possible delays before buying the ticket; if, when continuing the journey with another transport service or via another route, the delay on arrival at the destination is less than 60 minutes; if the delay is attributable to transport services that are not part of the contract of carriage.
rail-oebb-rerouting-costs.law: The quoted exclusion combines three different remedies. Article 19(9) does exclude the percentage-of-fare delay compensation when rerouting keeps the final arrival delay below 60 minutes. It does not withdraw the separate Article 18 right to qualifying alternative transport without extra cost or reimbursement of qualifying self-arranged transport. This finding concerns that overbroad exclusion of rerouting costs; it does not claim that an original ticket must also be refunded after the passenger completes the replacement journey.
rail-oebb-rerouting-costs.example: Hypothetical: cancellation of an EU long-distance train means arrival at the contractual destination is expected to be at least 60 minutes late. The railway company authorises the passenger to buy a €40 replacement ticket with another transport provider under comparable conditions. That faster alternative gets them to the destination 30 minutes late. Article 18(3) requires repayment of the authorised €40 costs. The 30-minute final delay means no Article 19 percentage compensation; it does not remove the qualifying €40 cost claim.
rail-oebb-rerouting-costs.context: The main passenger-rights page first promises compensation and assistance subject to the limitations below, links separate delay, cancellation and last-connection pages, then states the quoted blanket exclusion. Its English version repeats the exclusion. The directly linked cancellation/delay page separately and correctly promises necessary and appropriate alternative public transport costs if no onward-travel information is received within 100 minutes. That conflicting, more accurate guidance qualifies the finding but does not correct the main page’s express all-costs exclusion.
rail-oebb-rerouting-costs.scope: Published wording for qualifying long-distance journeys within the EU, including domestic Austrian long-distance and intra-EU international services. Excludes urban, suburban and regional services where national exceptions may alter individual remedies. The original disruption must satisfy Article 18 and the alternative journey must satisfy the authorisation or 100-minute information conditions; no finding about actual refusals or payments.

rail-westbahn-rerouting-costs.claim: Its compensation conditions exclude refunds and costs when an alternative route gets the passenger to the destination less than 60 minutes late.
rail-westbahn-rerouting-costs.quote: c. Hilfeleistung und sonstige Entschädigungen Ist die Fortsetzung der Reise wegen Ausfall, Verspätung oder Versäumnis des letzten Anschlusses am selben Tag für den Fahrgast nicht möglich oder zumutbar, so erstattet die Westbahn, sofern sie nicht selbst für den Kunden eine Hotelübernachtung organisiert und direkt bezahlt, die entstandenen angemessenen Kosten für das Hotel. Auch die Kosten der Beförderung zwischen dem Bahnhof und der Unterkunft werden übernommen. Ist das Erreichen des Zielorts laut Ticket mit einem anderen öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel oder mit dem Taxi kostengünstiger als eine Hotelnächtigung, ersetzt die Westbahn die angefallenen angemessenen Kosten. Kein Anspruch auf Entschädigung, Erstattung oder Ersatz von Kosten aufgrund von Zugsverspätungen besteht in folgenden Punkten: • Wenn Reisende vor Kauf des Beförderungsausweises über mögliche Verspätungen informiert wurden, • Wenn bei der Fortsetzung der Reise mit einem anderen Verkehrsdienst oder über eine andere Strecke die Verspätung bei der Ankunft am Zielort weniger als 60 Minuten beträgt, • Wenn die Verspätung auf Verkehrsleistungen zurückzuführen ist, die nicht Teil des Beförderungsvertrages sind.
rail-westbahn-rerouting-costs.tr: c. Assistance and other compensation. If, because of cancellation, delay or a missed final connection, continuing the journey on the same day is impossible or unreasonable for the passenger, Westbahn reimburses reasonable hotel costs unless it organises and pays for an overnight hotel stay itself. Transport costs between the station and accommodation are also covered. If reaching the destination on the ticket by another public transport service or taxi costs less than an overnight hotel stay, Westbahn reimburses the reasonable costs incurred. There is no entitlement to compensation, refund or reimbursement of costs due to train delays in the following cases: If passengers were informed of possible delays before buying the ticket; if continuing the journey by another transport service or route results in an arrival delay of less than 60 minutes; if the delay is attributable to transport services that are not part of the contract of carriage.
rail-westbahn-rerouting-costs.law: The quoted exclusion combines three different remedies. Article 19(9) does exclude the percentage-of-fare delay compensation when rerouting keeps the final arrival delay below 60 minutes. It does not withdraw the separate Article 18 right to qualifying alternative transport without extra cost or reimbursement of qualifying self-arranged transport. This finding concerns that overbroad exclusion of rerouting costs; it does not claim that an original ticket must also be refunded after the passenger completes the replacement journey.
rail-westbahn-rerouting-costs.example: Hypothetical: cancellation of an EU long-distance train means arrival at the contractual destination is expected to be at least 60 minutes late. The railway company authorises the passenger to buy a €40 replacement ticket with another transport provider under comparable conditions. That faster alternative gets them to the destination 30 minutes late. Article 18(3) requires repayment of the authorised €40 costs. The 30-minute final delay means no Article 19 percentage compensation; it does not remove the qualifying €40 cost claim.
rail-westbahn-rerouting-costs.context: The current AGB hub links this seven-page PDF. The exclusion appears in § 3(c), under the wider heading fare compensation for delays, after promises to repay appropriate accommodation and cheaper onward transport costs. Earlier § 3(b) correctly states the threshold for percentage delay compensation, and § 2(a)(iv) says the journey can continue without an additional fare. That structure supports a narrower publisher reading and is counterevidence. The later exclusion nevertheless expressly includes reimbursement and cost replacement, with no exception for qualifying Article 18 alternatives. The FAQ links these conditions. The PDF identifies its latest amendment as 9 June 2025, effective 10 June 2025; the hub labels the dates 10/11 June 2025. The hub also links general carriage conditions effective 1 August 2026, whose § 2 incorporates the compensation conditions without replacing this wording. Current availability does not establish fresh editorial review.
rail-westbahn-rerouting-costs.scope: Qualifying WESTbahn long-distance journeys within the EU; the original disruption and alternative transport must meet Article 18. This finding is about the broad exclusion of rerouting costs, not automatic payment for any voluntarily chosen alternative, and it does not assert actual claim refusals.

rail-flixtrain-four-euro-threshold.claim: Says delay compensation is paid only when it is more than €4, excluding an otherwise valid amount of exactly €4.
rail-flixtrain-four-euro-threshold.quote: Entschädigungen werden nur ausgezahlt, wenn der berechnete Betrag höher als 4 EUR ist.
rail-flixtrain-four-euro-threshold.tr: Compensation is only paid if the calculated amount is higher than EUR 4.
rail-flixtrain-four-euro-threshold.law: Article 19(8) permits nonpayment below a minimum threshold, and that threshold cannot be more than €4 per ticket. Exactly €4 is not below the maximum lawful threshold. FlixTrain’s passenger-rights page and §15.3 of its conditions both instead require more than €4; §15.3 explicitly attributes that rule to Article 19(8). The discrepancy is the boundary at exactly €4, not the lawful exclusion of smaller amounts.
rail-flixtrain-four-euro-threshold.example: Hypothetical: a passenger pays €16 for a one-way FlixTrain journey entirely within Germany and reaches the ticketed destination 90 minutes late. Assume no Article 19(9) or 19(10) exclusion, no ticket-price refund and a valid timely request. The 25% minimum compensation is €4. Article 19(8) does not permit rejecting that €4 amount as below the payment threshold, but the published wording requires an amount higher than €4.
rail-flixtrain-four-euro-threshold.context: The railway section of the rights page gives the 25% and 50% rates, lists compensation exclusions, then states the quoted payment boundary. The bus section begins only afterwards. The company’s current conditions refer readers to the rights page in §15.1 and repeat the more-than-€4 rule in §15.3 with a direct legal attribution. The homepage footer links both current pages. The conditions label the relevant clause approved 8 June 2023 and published 17 June 2023; current navigation establishes present availability, not a recent legal review.
rail-flixtrain-four-euro-threshold.scope: An otherwise valid Article 19 compensation claim of exactly €4 per ticket on FlixTrain long-distance services within the EU. The worked example is domestic Germany, where no long-distance Article 19 exemption is recorded in the Commission table. Other eligibility conditions and the exceptional-circumstances defence still apply.

versions.quote: Entschädigungen werden nur ausgezahlt, wenn der berechnete Betrag höher als 4 EUR ist.
versions.tr: Compensation is only paid if the calculated amount is higher than EUR 4.

versions.quote: 15.3 Entschädigungen werden nur ausgezahlt, wenn der berechnete Betrag höher als 4 Euro ist. Dies richtet sich nach Artikel 19 Absatz 8 der VO (EU) 2021/782.
versions.tr: 15.3 Compensation is paid only if the calculated amount is greater than €4. This is governed by Article 19(8) of Regulation (EU) 2021/782.

lawMarks: Exactly €4 is not below the maximum lawful threshold

rail-renfe-adif-speed-limits.claim: Tickets and passes bought from 31 January 2026 earn no compensation when delay is caused by Adif’s temporary speed limits.
rail-renfe-adif-speed-limits.quote: ¿Tengo derecho a indemnización por limitaciones temporales de velocidad? Con motivo de las limitaciones temporales de velocidad establecidas por Adif en distintos puntos de la red ferroviaria, algunos servicios pueden experimentar retrasos cuya causa es ajena a Renfe. Los billetes y abonos adquiridos desde el 31 de enero de 2026 no generarán derecho a indemnización cuando el retraso se deba a estas limitaciones de velocidad.
rail-renfe-adif-speed-limits.tr: Am I entitled to compensation for temporary speed restrictions? Because of temporary speed restrictions imposed by Adif at various points on the railway network, some services may experience delays whose cause is outside Renfe. Tickets and passes purchased since 31 January 2026 will not create an entitlement to compensation when the delay is due to these speed restrictions.
rail-renfe-adif-speed-limits.law: The current page applies its exclusion to tickets and passes bought since 31 January 2026 because the infrastructure manager imposed temporary speed limits. Article 19 does not exempt an ordinary infrastructure-related delay merely because its cause lies outside Renfe. The mismatch is the blanket exclusion of the EU minimum. A passenger who was informed of the relevant delay before buying, or whose delay was directly caused by a qualifying external extraordinary event, may still fall within an exception.
rail-renfe-adif-speed-limits.example: Hypothetical: a traveller pays €80 for a covered AVE journey affected by an ordinary Adif speed restriction of the kind described in Renfe’s notice and arrives 75 minutes late. Assume the ticket was bought after 31 January 2026, the passenger was not informed of the relevant delay before purchase, the ticket was not refunded under Article 18, and no Article 19(10) exception applies. The EU minimum is €20. Merely identifying Adif’s restriction as the cause does not remove that minimum.
rail-renfe-adif-speed-limits.context: The opening notice and the final FAQ both state the exclusion. The FAQ immediately before it accurately refers to the Article 19(10) force-majeure grounds. The page discusses both current statutory rules and Renfe’s more generous punctuality commitments; it does not reserve the EU minimum when withdrawing compensation for speed limits. The captured site footer includes a current incoming link to this punctuality page. This records published wording, not proof of an actual refused claim. The current general conditions, effective 7 September 2026, state that compensation is due under applicable legislation, exclude passengers informed of the delay before purchase, and set higher 50%/100% bands subject to statutory exceptions. That correct contractual framing conflicts with the punctuality page’s unqualified speed-limit wording; this review does not establish which approach Renfe follows in individual claims.
rail-renfe-adif-speed-limits.scope: Limit to ordinary infrastructure operational restrictions within the set described by the notice, on covered Spanish services, and to the minimum EU right. Article 19(9) removes compensation when the passenger was informed of a delay before purchase, and Article 19(10) can cover an underlying qualifying extraordinary external event if its requirements are proved. No conclusion is drawn that every Adif restriction is compensable, that general news alone always suffices or never suffices as pre-purchase notice, or that Renfe must preserve every voluntary uplift. The Commission’s current table lists no Spanish exemption; it is an information table rather than an authoritative decision.

rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.src: General transport conditions — scope of liability and compensation
rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.claim: A purchaser without a Visa or Mastercard is told they cannot convert a refundable compensation voucher to money.
rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.quote: Con independencia de si la compra se ha realizado a través de un Canal de Distribución Directa o Indirecta, para poder reemplazar un vale de compra reembolsable entregado por OUIGO por un crédito en su tarjeta bancaria, el Comprador deberá aportar los datos de una tarjeta VISA o Mastercard. Si el Comprador no dispone de ninguno de estos medios, no podrá recibir el crédito de su vale de compra reembolsable, que quedará disponible, por el tiempo de validez correspondiente, para ser canjeado en los Canales de Distribución Directa.
rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.tr: Regardless of whether the purchase was made through a direct or indirect distribution channel, to replace a refundable purchase voucher supplied by OUIGO with a credit to a bank card, the buyer must provide the details of a VISA or Mastercard. If the buyer has neither of these means, the refundable purchase voucher cannot be credited; it remains available for its applicable validity period to be redeemed through direct distribution channels.
rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.law: Section 3.2.2 requires Visa or Mastercard details to convert a refundable voucher into a card credit, and says that someone without either receives only a voucher for future direct bookings. Section 3.2.5.2 applies refundable vouchers to statutory delay compensation. Article 19(7) requires the statutory amount to be paid in money when the passenger asks. The company may set practical payment arrangements, but the stated absence of a card cannot erase the money option.
rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.example: Hypothetical: a traveller who is also the purchaser holds a valid €80 paid OUIGO España ticket and arrives 75 minutes late. Assume a timely valid Article 19 claim, no Article 19(9) or (10) defence, no Article 18 refund, and that the purchaser has neither a Visa nor a Mastercard when requesting payment. They ask for money. At least the €20 EU minimum must remain payable in money; the published clause leaves only a future-booking voucher. This does not establish how the company would handle an alternative payment request.
rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.context: The current conditions state an effective date of 21 August 2026. Section 3.2.2 applies the card condition to both direct and authorised-distributor bookings. Its next sentence leaves the voucher valid for direct bookings if neither card is available. Section 3.2.5 distinguishes compensation required by law from voluntary amounts and links the payment mechanism to both. The finding does not allege that every initial voucher is unlawful or that a voluntary voucher uplift must be paid in cash.
rail-ouigo-spain-compensation-card.scope: Only an eligible statutory delay-compensation amount under Article 19 is compared. Money is required on the passenger’s request, not automatically. Minimum-payment thresholds up to €4 and Article 19(9)–(10) eligibility exceptions remain applicable. No case of voucher-funded purchase, expired or already-used compensation voucher, or non-statutory goodwill payment is assumed. Spain has no listed applicable exemption. The research does not establish actual handling of a request for an alternative money payment method. The illustrated traveller is also the purchaser; the published card condition is addressed to the purchaser requesting conversion.

rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.claim: Describes a qualifying OUIGO cancellation reimbursement as payable only in a purchase voucher.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.quote: Si votre train a été supprimé, la compagnie vous proposera plusieurs options : Premièrement, une réallocation à bord d’un autre TGV ou train classique OUIGO ayant des horaires proches En cas d’impossibilité, un échange de billet, uniquement pour un autre trajet OUIGO Si l’impossibilité se confirme, vous obtiendrez un remboursement intégral de votre billet OUIGO, en bon d’achat uniquement
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.tr: If your train has been cancelled, the company will offer several options: First, reallocation aboard another OUIGO high-speed or conventional train with similar departure times. If this is impossible, a ticket exchange, only for another OUIGO journey. If that too proves impossible, you will receive a full refund of your OUIGO ticket, in a purchase voucher only.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.law: For a covered cancellation that triggers Article 18(1), the passenger has the statutory reimbursement option. Under Article 18(5), reimbursement may take the form of a sufficiently flexible voucher only if the passenger agrees. The cancellation bullet instead describes the full reimbursement as voucher-only. This finding concerns the form of reimbursement; the separate cancellation-choice case concerns when that option is offered. OUIGO’s own FAQ allows eligible cancellation vouchers to be recredited to the payment account.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.example: Hypothetical: a passenger paid €80 by bank card for a covered France–Belgium OUIGO journey. The operator cancels the train and confirms that the replacement or exchange options described by SNCF Connect are unavailable. Assume arrival at the contractual destination is reasonably expected to be at least two hours late. The passenger has travelled no part, requests full reimbursement and does not agree to a voucher. Article 18(5) does not permit voucher-only reimbursement; the cancellation bullet describes precisely that payment form even after its own fallback conditions are met. No actual refusal or claim-handling practice is assumed.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.context: The statement appears under “Que faire en cas de retard ou suppression sur son train OUIGO ?”. After a 25%/50% delay scale and an automatic-voucher description, the cancellation bullets end with a full reimbursement “en bon d’achat uniquement”. The preceding sentence excludes reimbursement by bank transfer or physical cash; that wording alone does not exclude bank-card recredit and is not the basis of this narrowed finding. OUIGO’s own FAQ permits eligible cancellation and delay vouchers to be recredited to the original bank account, subject to its stated payment conditions.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.scope: Published SNCF Connect French guidance about a cancellation on a journey covered by Regulation (EU) 2021/782 where the Article 18(1) trigger is met. The example uses a France–Belgium international OUIGO service outside the local/regional exemptions, a wholly unused bank-card-paid ticket and no agreement to a voucher. It does not establish a general right to physical cash or a particular money-transfer method, and it does not allege actual refusals, losses or payment practice.

If this is impossible, a ticket exchange, only for another OUIGO journey. If that too proves impossible, you will receive a full refund of your OUIGO ticket, in a purchase voucher only.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-refund-fallback.law: For a cancellation causing an expected arrival delay of at least 60 minutes, Article 18(1) gives the passenger an immediate choice. Reimbursement under Article 18(1)(a) is available even when comparable continuation or rerouting is possible. The page instead orders the options as reallocation, exchange if that is impossible, and reimbursement if impossibility persists.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-refund-fallback.example: Hypothetical: an eligible Paris–Brussels OUIGO service is cancelled and the next suitable train would arrive 90 minutes after the original arrival time. Assume the passenger has not travelled any part of the journey. They can abandon it and choose a full ticket reimbursement even though space is available on that later train.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-refund-fallback.context: Under the cancellation heading, three successive bullets present reallocation, then an OUIGO-only exchange if impossible, and finally reimbursement. The refund method is a separate issue recorded in rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-voucher-only.
rail-sncf-connect-ouigo-refund-fallback.scope: Cancellation with a reasonably expected destination delay of at least 60 minutes on a covered service. This does not assert a statutory refund for every cancellation irrespective of the resulting delay. Wording only; no evidence of an actual refusal.

rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.src: Wheelchair services and current assistance-booking form
rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.claim: Requires at least 36 hours’ notice for assistance on international rail journeys, although the EU extension allowing that period expired on 30 June 2026.
rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.quote: Pro hladký průběh vaší cesty, včetně všech přestupů, si prosím zajištění cesty nebo asistence objednejte nejpozději 24 hodin předem. Pokud jedete do zahraničí nebo je nutné mimořádně zařadit do vlaku vůz se zvedací plošinou, objednejte si prosím cestu alespoň 36 hodin předem. Požadavek na zajištění přepravy (asistenci) do nebo ze zahraničí se automaticky aktivuje použitím zahraniční železniční stanice ve vyhledávači spojení. Takovou objednávku je třeba uplatnit minimálně 36 hodin před odjezdem vlaku. Při pozdějším odeslání nelze službu u zahraničních partnerů zajistit a garantovat. V rámci mezinárodní přepravy je možné požádat též o zajištění jízdního dokladu, a to zatržením požadavku v objednávkovém formuláři, nebo si můžete mezinárodní jízdní doklady zakoupit u kterékoliv mezinárodní pokladny nebo v e-shopu popř. v mobilní aplikaci Můj vlak. V případě požadavku na zakoupení jízdních dokladů se prodlužuje termín objednání na 5 pracovních dnů.
rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.tr: For a smooth journey, including all transfers, please request travel arrangements or assistance at least 24 hours in advance. If you are travelling abroad or a vehicle with a lifting platform must exceptionally be added to the train, please request the journey at least 36 hours in advance. A request for transport arrangements (assistance) to or from abroad is activated automatically by using a foreign railway station in the journey planner. Such a request must be made at least 36 hours before the train departs. If sent later, the service cannot be arranged and guaranteed with foreign partners. For international travel, you may also request a ticket by ticking the request in the order form, or buy international tickets at any international ticket counter, in the e-shop or in the Můj vlak mobile app. If ticket purchase is requested, the booking deadline is extended to five working days.
rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.law: The detail page says that including a foreign station activates the international assistance request, that it must be submitted at least 36 hours before departure, and that later submission cannot secure or guarantee the foreign partners’ service. Article 24(a) instead permits notification at least 24 hours before assistance is needed; its temporary national extension to 36 hours ended on 30 June 2026. For an otherwise eligible journey with trained staff, Article 23(1)(e) requires timely notified assistance to be ensured. This finding addresses the international-journey notice condition, not adding a specially equipped carriage or obtaining tickets through the assistance desk.
rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.example: Hypothetical: after 30 June 2026, a wheelchair user with a valid ticket for an already accessible ČD cross-border train from Czechia to Germany requests ordinary boarding and alighting assistance 30 hours before departure, more than 24 hours before the first assistance is needed. Assume available wheelchair capacity, accessible stations, trained staff on duty and timely attendance at the designated meeting point. The 24-hour EU notice condition is met; the published 36-hour international cut-off cannot turn that into a late request. No additional carriage or ticket-procurement service is requested.
rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.context: The current wheelchair-services page links the live booking form. The page first gives a 24-hour general notice period, then imposes 36 hours for journeys abroad and says later requests cannot be secured or guaranteed with foreign partners. Its actual booking form repeats 36 hours for travel abroad. The overview still says 48 hours for foreign travel, creating a further inconsistency; the finding uses the narrower 36-hour condition also present in the current form. The detail page separately says carriage may be arranged under immediate operating conditions without a prior order and preserves infrastructure, capacity and equipment limits. These qualifications do not change which notice period counts as timely for an otherwise eligible trip.
rail-cd-international-assistance-36-hour.scope: Ordinary disability/mobility assistance for an intra-EU ČD international journey after 30 June 2026, with Article 23 staffing and access conditions met. Czechia–Germany avoids Czech exemptions for services beginning or ending in certain third countries. Excludes adding accessible rolling stock, a five-working-day ticket-procurement service and any actual capacity/access barrier. Records public wording, not a demonstrated rejected request.

rail-leoexpress-rebooking-departure-dead.src: Current Conditions of Carriage, § 4.1(7) Czech / § 4.1(10) English
rail-leoexpress-rebooking-departure-dead.claim: Requires a free replacement-travel request by the original scheduled departure time, even in its section on delayed and cancelled services.
rail-leoexpress-rebooking-departure-dead.quote: (9) The request for a Compensation or Refund of Fare shall be exercised by the entitled Passenger within 6 months of date of departure stated on the ticket by filling in the application form available on the website le.cz/refund. (10) The request for a free re-booking of a ticket must be exercised by the entitled passenger by the time of the regular departure time indicated on the ticket, and on the nearest possible connection, by filling in the application form available on the website le.cz/refund.
rail-leoexpress-rebooking-departure-dead.law: The current conditions first give a refund or free rebooking when transport is not performed for reasons on Leo Express’s side, then say the free-rebooking request must be exercised by the scheduled departure time shown on the ticket. For a covered cancellation that triggers Article 18, that time limit cannot remove the statutory continuation/rerouting choice. A cancellation may be announced only after the original departure time; Article 18 still requires the operator to offer the choice and make arrangements. This finding concerns the specific original-departure deadline, not voluntary changes to an operating train.
rail-leoexpress-rebooking-departure-dead.example: Hypothetical: a paid domestic Czech Leo Express service is cancelled because of a mechanical failure ten minutes after its scheduled departure. Without replacement travel, arrival at the ticketed destination would be at least 60 minutes late. The passenger then asks for comparable continuation on the next suitable Leo Express train, rather than a refund. Article 18 requires that choice and the necessary arrangements; the conditions’ deadline has already passed before the cancellation was announced. The example does not assume the passenger can select any operator or fare without the applicable arrangements.
rail-leoexpress-rebooking-departure-dead.context: The live terms hub links the multilingual conditions identified as valid from 28 September 2026. The deadline appears in the dedicated delay/cancellation section, not in the voluntary cancellation section. It follows a six-month deadline for compensation/refund requests, making the distinct rebooking cut-off explicit. Czech and English repeat it with different paragraph numbering. The separately linked passenger-rights leaflet correctly describes continuation/rerouting at the earliest opportunity or later at the passenger’s wish, so it is retained as conflicting counterevidence. The contract generally states compliance with Regulation 2021/782; that does not explain the restrictive specific deadline.
rail-leoexpress-rebooking-departure-dead.scope: A covered Leo Express rail cancellation within the EU triggering Article 18, illustrated by domestic Czech travel and replacement travel requested after scheduled departure. Excludes voluntary passenger changes, Ukrainian bus legs and nationally exempt services. Does not claim both refund and replacement travel are due or establish actual refusal.

rail-vr-sweden-rounded-payment-threshold.claim: Its €4 minimum-payment threshold is converted to Swedish kronor and rounded up to the next ten kronor.
rail-vr-sweden-rounded-payment-threshold.quote: 15.3 Lägsta belopp för utbetalning av ersättning är det belopp som vid utbetalningstillfället motsvarar 4 EUR i SEK, avrundat uppåt till närmaste tiotal kronor. Detta belopp grundar sig på EU-förordningens bestämmelser.
rail-vr-sweden-rounded-payment-threshold.tr: 15.3 The minimum compensation payment is the amount that, at the time of payment, corresponds to €4 in Swedish kronor, rounded up to the nearest ten kronor. This amount is based on the provisions of the EU Regulation.
rail-vr-sweden-rounded-payment-threshold.law: Section 15.3 converts €4 into kronor at the payment date and rounds the result upwards to the next ten kronor. Whenever the conversion is not already a multiple of ten, that makes the payment threshold higher than €4. Article 19(8) does not permit withholding an otherwise eligible compensation amount above €4 merely because it falls below that inflated threshold. The error is the threshold rounding, not the use of kronor for payment.
rail-vr-sweden-rounded-payment-threshold.example: Hypothetical, using an assumed exchange rate rather than a current market quotation: at payment, €1 equals SEK 11. The €4 cap is SEK 44; rounding it up makes the stated threshold SEK 50. A valid SEK 184 single ticket on a Stockholm–Göteborg long-distance train delayed by 90 minutes yields SEK 46 at 25%. That is worth more than €4 and must not be rejected under a SEK 50 payment threshold. Assume no Article 19(9)–(10) exception and no Article 18 ticket refund.
rail-vr-sweden-rounded-payment-threshold.context: Both current Swedish and English conditions repeat the upward-rounding rule and explicitly attribute it to EU provisions. They state entry into force on 9 October 2025. The live homepage links to the ticket-conditions hub, which links the Swedish conditions; its language switch leads to the English version. Both versions also contain a general mandatory-law savings clause. The English introduction still cites the former 1371/2007 Regulation; that obsolete citation alone is not a separate finding.
rail-vr-sweden-rounded-payment-threshold.scope: Otherwise valid Article 19 claims on covered VR Snabbtåg long-distance services. The illustration uses Stockholm–Göteborg, outside the Swedish exemption for domestic services whose total route is shorter than 150 km. The hypothetical rate is only for transparent arithmetic; no claim is made about today’s rate, actual processing, or rounding of an amount already being paid.
