banking-beobank-belgium-principal-reside.claim: contradicts its own EU-residence guidance by adding a principal home in Belgium as a statutory-account condition.
banking-beobank-belgium-principal-reside.quote: De Basisbankdienst Rekening is een betaalrekening met een beperkt dienstenaanbod die wordt aangeboden tegen een forfaitair tarief waarvan het maximumbedrag 1 wettelijk 2 is vastgelegd. Bij Beobank, bedraagt het tarief € 20,28/jaar (inclusief btw) of € 1,69/maand. Elke inwoner van een lidstaat van de Europese Unie heeft recht op deze dienst om zijn inkomsten en uitgaven te beheren, op voorwaarde dat hij voldoet aan bepaalde voorwaarden, met name dat zijn hoofdverblijfplaats zich in België bevindt.Om deze zichtrekening te openen moet u langsgaan in een kantoor. Deze zal onderzoeken of u recht heeft op deze dienst.
banking-beobank-belgium-principal-reside.tr: The Basic Banking Service Account is a payment account with a limited range of services offered at a flat fee whose maximum amount¹ is set by law². At Beobank the fee is €20.28/year (including VAT), or €1.69/month. Every resident of an EU Member State has a right to this service to manage income and expenses, provided they meet certain conditions, in particular that their principal residence is in Belgium. To open this current account you must visit a branch, which will examine whether you are entitled to this service.
banking-beobank-belgium-principal-reside.law: CDE VII.57 § 2 grants the statutory basic banking service to consumers lawfully resident in an EU Member State; VII.56/1 prohibits nationality/residence discrimination and VII.59 sets the refusal grounds. A principal home in Belgium is not a separate condition. The Dutch product-page sentence expressly adds that condition even though the same page’s later eligibility list says residence in the EU. The linked July 2026 information sheet and French product version give the broader EU rule. The finding is this internal inconsistency in Dutch guidance, not a conclusion that Beobank’s whole application route or contract requires Belgian residence.
banking-beobank-belgium-principal-reside.example: Hypothetical: An adult French citizen lawfully resident in France wants Beobank’s Belgian statutory basic account for personal payments. They have no usable equivalent Belgian payment account, no disqualifying credit or savings balance, provide the required identity information, pass AML checks and meet all other statutory conditions. Their French principal home does not itself remove the Belgian statutory right, although the quoted Dutch sentence says the principal home must be in Belgium.
banking-beobank-belgium-principal-reside.context: The current Dutch account listing links the statutory product. Its introduction describes the legally regulated basic-account fee and expressly states Belgium as principal residence. The next eligibility list states that the applicant lives in the EU. The current French page has no Belgium-principal-home requirement. The directly linked original July 2026 information sheet expressly covers lawful residence in an EU Member State (and the statutory limited Belgian-national-abroad extension); the July 2026 application has no Belgium-home declaration.
banking-beobank-belgium-principal-reside.scope: Reviewed finding limited to the contradictory Dutch Beobank product-page statement. The nearby EU criterion, French text and linked July 2026 documents are material counterevidence. No actual refusal, bank intent or market-wide rate inferred.

banking-revolut-be-immediate-residence-t.tr: We may unilaterally (i.e. without your consent) decide to close or suspend your account with immediate effect and without prior notice when one or more of the following conditions is met: you have been convicted of fraud, breach of trust, fraudulent bankruptcy or forgery; you knowingly use your basic banking account for unlawful purposes; you gave us incorrect information when applying for the basic banking account, and if you had given us the correct information we would not have opened it for you; you no longer reside legally in an EU Member State. We may unilaterally close or suspend your banking account with two months’ notice (unless such notice would conflict with national security or public order) when one or more of the following conditions is met: no transaction has taken place on your banking account for more than 24 consecutive months; you no longer reside legally in the European Union; and you have opened another payment account in Belgium.
banking-revolut-be-immediate-residence-t.law: CDE VII.59 § 2 permits termination on specified grounds. Where residence conditions cease (4°), inactivity exceeds 24 consecutive months (2°), or another usable Belgian account or a disqualifying balance exists (5°), termination of the framework contract requires at least two months’ notice. Immediate effect under this paragraph is reserved for 1° (the listed convictions within the last five years, or intentional illegal use) and 3° (eligibility-changing false information). The five-year limit was inserted by Article 7 of the Law of 20 April 2026, effective 17 May 2026. This comparison preserves the statutory Belgian-national-abroad residence extension and does not deny separate AML, sanctions, fraud-control or legally required payment/instrument suspension powers; the hypothetical excludes such a ground.
banking-revolut-be-immediate-residence-t.example: Hypothetical: A non-Belgian consumer’s lawfully opened Belgian basic account remains active and correctly disclosed. The consumer later ceases to meet the statutory EU-residence condition. There is no qualifying conviction within the last five years, fraud, intentional illegal use, misleading application information, AML/sanctions ground or other lawful immediate suspension requirement. Residence loss can justify terminating the account, but under VII.59 § 2 (4°) the framework-contract termination still requires at least two months’ notice.
banking-revolut-be-immediate-residence-t.context: The current Dutch contract lists loss of lawful EU residence under immediate closure/suspension. A following list in the same contract repeats residence loss under two months’ notice. Current English text has the same contradiction. This is an express contradictory notice rule in published contractual guidance, not evidence that Revolut has closed an account without notice.
banking-revolut-be-immediate-residence-t.scope: Reviewed finding concerning contractual framework-account closure for residence loss only, excluding operational suspension under other law. Same Revolut origin as the asset-ceiling case; not an additional independent publisher.

banking-n26-supported-country.src: Konto gemäß §§30 ff. ZKG — Why can’t I get a basic account?
banking-n26-supported-country.claim: says it may refuse the statutory basic account because the applicant lives outside its supported markets.
banking-n26-supported-country.quote:
Unter bestimmten Umständen kann N26 deinen Antrag auf ein Basiskonto ablehnen. Das ist der Fall, wenn:
du außerhalb eines von uns unterstützten Landes lebst.
du bereits ein N26 Bankkonto oder ein anderes Bankkonto in Deutschland hast und es in vollem Umfang nutzen kannst.
du innerhalb der letzten 3 Jahre wegen einer Straftat gegen die Bank, ihre Mitarbeiter oder ihre Kunden verurteilt wurdest.
du bereits in der Vergangenheit ein Basiskonto bei N26 unterhalten hast, das wegen Überziehung oder unzulässiger Nutzung geschlossen wurde.
du die Mindestanforderungen gemäß des Geldwäsche- und Kreditwesengesetzes nicht erfüllst.
banking-n26-supported-country.tr:
Under certain circumstances N26 may reject your application for a basic account. This is the case if:
• you live outside one of our supported countries.
• you already have an N26 bank account or another bank account in Germany and can use it in full.
• you have been convicted within the last three years of an offence against the bank, its employees or its customers.
• you previously held an N26 basic account that was closed because of overdrawing or prohibited use.
• you do not meet the minimum requirements under money-laundering and banking legislation.
banking-n26-supported-country.law: ZKG § 31(1) gives each consumer lawfully staying in the EU the right to a German basic-account contract with an institution offering consumer payment accounts. §§ 32 and 34–37 limit additional conditions and refusal grounds; a commercial supported-market list is not among them. Existing usable domestic accounts, specified prior misconduct or lawful prior termination, and required identity and anti-money-laundering checks can still justify refusal.
banking-n26-supported-country.example: Hypothetical: An adult legally resident in Romania applies to N26 Bank SE for its German statutory basic account. Romania is absent from the linked supported-country list. Assume a complete application, successful required identification and anti-money-laundering checks, the ability to use the offered app services, no usable German payment account and no other statutory refusal ground. Romanian residence alone does not permit refusal, yet the FAQ lists unsupported-country residence as a reason to refuse.
banking-n26-supported-country.context: The current statutory FAQ expressly distinguishes the account from N26 Standard and lists unsupported-country residence as a refusal ground. The linked supported-country list omits Romania. The separate indexed statutory information recognises lawful EU stay generally, and the current application country field does not restrict address countries. These contrary passages are material; this is a wording discrepancy rather than evidence of actual refusals.
banking-n26-supported-country.scope: German statutory Basiskonto published guidance checked 25 October 2026. Only wording assessed; no customer contact, actual refusal, closure, loss or intent tested.

ctx.quote: Das Konto gemäß §§ 30 ff. ZKG ist kein N26 Standardkonto. Das Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG) gibt allen Verbrauchern, die sich rechtmäßig in der Europäischen Union aufhalten, das Recht, ein Basiszahlungskonto zu führen. Dies gilt für Personen, die in einem unterstützten Land leben.
ctx.tr: The account under §§ 30 ff ZKG is not an N26 Standard account. The Payment Accounts Act gives all consumers lawfully staying in the European Union the right to hold a basic payment account. This applies to people who live in a supported country.

ctx.quote: Seit Einführung des Zahlungskontengesetzes (kurz ZKG) im Juni 2016 hat jeder Verbraucher mit rechtmäßigem Aufenthalt in der Europäischen Union grundsätzlich den Anspruch auf ein Zahlungskonto, das grundlegende Funktionen zur Erfüllung der täglichen Zahlungsgeschäfte bietet. Dieses Konto nennt sich Basiskonto, die Eröffnung erfolgt über den unten beschriebenen Prozess. Voraussetzung dafür ist, dass du nicht schon ein Zahlungskonto bei N26 oder einer anderen Bank in Deutschland hast. Antragsberechtigt sind bspw. Personen ohne festen Wohnsitz und Asylsuchende. Das bedeutet, ein Wohnsitz im Sinne des Meldegesetzes ist nicht erforderlich und die postalische Erreichbarkeit über Angehörige, Freunde oder eine Beratungsstelle reicht demnach zur Kontoeröffnung aus.
ctx.tr: Since the Payment Accounts Act (ZKG) was introduced in June2016, every consumer lawfully staying in the European Union is generally entitled to a payment account offering basic functions for daily payments. This is called a basic account and is opened through the process described below. A condition is that you do not already hold a payment account at N26 or another bank in Germany. Eligible applicants include people without a fixed home and asylum seekers. This means a residence within the meaning of registration law is not required and postal reachability through relatives, friends or an advice centre is sufficient for account opening.

banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.src: Basic-account application — background information, printed page 1
banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.claim: says in its currently supplied application guidance that one year without turnover can justify closing a statutory basic account.
banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.quote:
Das Kreditinstitut ist nicht verpflichtet, ein Girokonto für den Antragsteller zu führen, wenn der Antragsteller keinen Anspruch auf ein Basiskonto hat oder dies für das Kreditinstitut unzumutbar ist. In diesem Fall darf die Bank auch ein bestehendes Konto kündigen. Unzumutbar ist die Eröffnung oder Fortführung einer Kontoverbindung insbesondere, wenn
○​ der Kunde die Leistungen des Kreditinstitutes missbraucht, insbesondere für gesetzwidrige Transaktionen, z.B. Betrug, Geldwäsche o.ä.
○​ der Antragsteller Falschangaben macht, die für das Vertragsverhältnis wesentlich sind
○​ der Antragsteller Mitarbeiter oder Kunden grob belästigt oder gefährdet
○​ die bezweckte Nutzung des Kontos zur Teilnahme am bargeldlosen Zahlungsverkehr nicht gegeben ist, weil z.B. das Konto durch Handlungen vollstreckender Gläubiger blockiert ist oder ein Jahr lang umsatzlos geführt wird
○​ nicht sichergestellt ist, dass das Institut die für die Kontoführung und -nutzung vereinbarten üblichen Entgelte erhält
○​ der Kunde auch im Übrigen die Vereinbarungen nicht einhält.
banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.tr:
The credit institution is not obliged to maintain a current account for the applicant if the applicant has no entitlement to a basic account or if doing so is unreasonable for the institution. In that case the bank may also terminate an existing account. Opening or continuing an account is unreasonable in particular if:
• the customer abuses the institution’s services, especially for unlawful transactions such as fraud or money laundering.
• the applicant gives false information material to the contractual relationship.
• the applicant seriously harasses or endangers employees or customers.
• the intended use of the account to participate in cashless payments is absent, for example because enforcement by creditors blocks the account or it has been maintained without turnover for one year.
• payment of the agreed customary account maintenance and use fees is not assured.
• the customer otherwise fails to comply with the agreements.
banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.law: Under ZKG § 42(1), only the specified statutory termination grounds apply. For inactivity alone, § 42(2)(1) requires more than 24 consecutive months without a holder-initiated payment, an agreed termination right, and at least two months’ notice. One year without turnover is insufficient by itself. Separate misconduct, unpaid-fee, false-information and other statutory grounds can still permit termination.
banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.example: Hypothetical legal comparison: Assume the application guidance’s no-turnover condition is met for 13 months and there is no other statutory termination ground. That period alone is too short: ZKG § 42(2)(1) requires more than 24 consecutive months without a holder-initiated payment. The example assumes the source condition is met; it does not equate bank-fee postings with no turnover or assume a particular N26 fee arrangement. Current contract terms separately incorporate the statutory rule.
banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.context: The current statutory FAQ and current ZKG legal-document index each link an application bundle whose background page expressly says an existing account may be terminated for unreasonableness, including a year without turnover. The legacy-looking device list is disclosed. Current account terms expressly apply § 42(2) ZKG for basic-account holders, contradicting that guidance; actual closure practice was not tested. The operative PDF begins Version 3.0 dated 19 June 2026; the override is in its appended supplementary terms, section 6.3.
banking-n26-one-year-inactivity.scope: German statutory Basiskonto published guidance checked 25 October 2026. Only wording assessed; no customer contact, actual refusal, closure, loss or intent tested.

banking-activobank-obsolete-transfer-all.claim: contradicts its current terms by stating an annual included homebanking-transfer limit of 24 instead of 48.
banking-activobank-obsolete-transfer-all.quote: • Realização de Transferências Interbancárias (isto é, Transferências para Contas abertas noutras instituições) através de caixas automáticas, sem restrição quanto ao número de operações que podem ser realizadas, e de homebanking, caso em que existe um máximo, por cada ano civil, de 24 Transferências Interbancárias nacionais e na União Europeia. • Realização, por cada mês, de cinco Transferências através de aplicações de pagamento operadas por terceiros de montante igual ou inferior a 30 euros por operação.
banking-activobank-obsolete-transfer-all.tr: • Interbank transfers (that is, transfers to accounts at other institutions) through ATMs, without restriction on the number of transactions, and through home banking, for which there is a maximum of 24 domestic and EU interbank transfers per calendar year. • Five transfers per month through payment applications operated by third parties, each for an amount of 30 euros or less.
banking-activobank-obsolete-transfer-all.law: Article 3(2) of DL 27-C/2000 includes 48 interbank transfers per calendar year via homebanking or the bank’s own apps within the capped package. Lei 24/2023 Art. 6 doubled the earlier 24 allowance; Art. 12(3) made it effective 90 days after 29 May 2023, on 27 August 2023. The FAQ understates the statutory bundle. The bank’s main product page, current FIN, DIC, general terms and statutory information document correctly state 48. banking-revolut-de-cash-deposit-prerequi.law: ZKG § 38(2) lists basic payment services, but § 38(4) limits the required services to the extent the institution generally offers them to ordinary consumer payment-account holders. ctx.tr:
Who has a right to a basic account?
Every consumer lawfully staying in the European Union (EU), regardless of where they live, has the right to open and use a basic account with us. This right also belongs to consumers without a fixed address, asylum seekers and consumers without a residence right who cannot be deported for legal or practical reasons. A basic account does not depend on buying additional services or bank products. However, we may refuse to open a basic account for certain reasons (see below).

Within ten business days after receiving a complete application we will open the account or refuse the application.

When opening and operating basic accounts, we must observe duties to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing. To establish identity the consumer must provide official photo identification meeting legal requirements. Where no other official photo identification is available, asylum seekers can prove identity using a procedural or residence-entitlement card issued under Austrian asylum law, and consumers without a residence right using a tolerated-person card.

In what cases may we refuse a basic account?
We may refuse the consumer’s application if:

• The consumer already has a payment account with a credit institution established in Austria and can use the basic-account services through it (unless the consumer declares having received notice of termination). We may require a signed declaration on honour that the consumer does not hold such an account.

• Criminal proceedings for an intentional offence to our detriment or an employee’s detriment are pending against the consumer and an indictment has been brought.

• The consumer was convicted of an intentional offence to our detriment or an employee’s detriment and the conviction has not yet been expunged.

If we refuse, we will inform the consumer promptly in writing and free of charge of the refusal and, where legally permitted, its reasons.

banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.src: Current-account FAQ — how many current accounts may I have?
banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.claim: states that legislation permits only one basic account per person nationwide.
banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.quote:
Die kurze Antwort lautet: Sie dürfen so viele Konten besitzen, wie Sie möchten. Es gibt kein Gesetz und keine Vorgabe seitens der Banken oder Sparkassen in Deutschland, die eine maximale Anzahl von Konten vorgeben würde. Für unterschiedliche Zwecke ist es oft sogar sinnvoll, verschiedene Konten bei ein und derselben Sparkasse zu führen.

Allerdings ist zu beachten, dass laut gesetzlicher Regelung nur ein Basis- sowie Pfändungsschutzkonto bundesweit pro Person zu unterhalten ist.
banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.tr:
The short answer is: you may hold as many accounts as you like. There is no law or rule of banks or savings banks in Germany prescribing a maximum number of accounts. For different purposes it is often even sensible to hold different accounts at the same savings bank.

However, it must be noted that legislation permits only one basic account and one attachment-protection account per person nationwide.
banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.law: ZKG section 35(1) permits refusal where a usable German payment account already exists, but expressly prohibits refusal on that ground once that account has been terminated or its closure notified. This permits a temporary overlap while an old basic account runs to its notified closure date. That limited compulsory-opening exception contradicts a universal statutory prohibition on holding two Basiskonten. The separate one-P-Konto rule in ZPO section 850k(3) is correct and is not disputed.
banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise qualifying consumer has received notice that an old German basic account will close at the end of next month, and submits a complete application for a new basic account today. Assume all other eligibility, identity/AML requirements and refusal rules are satisfied. ZKG section 35(1) prevents refusal merely because the old account remains open until its notified closure. For that transitional period the consumer may lawfully have both basic accounts. The FAQ’s statutory one-account prohibition excludes this possibility. Neither account is a P-Konto.
banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.context: The current overview FAQ expressly calls a nationwide one-Basiskonto limit a legal rule, alongside the distinct and correct one-P-Konto rule. The current statutory product/application route remains separately available: the form accommodates existing German accounts, multiple accounts and cancellation/closure/use exceptions. Those correct qualifications do not turn the FAQ’s asserted legal prohibition into a statutory rule. Only published wording is assessed.
banking-rheinhessen-one-basic-account.scope: German statutory Basiskonto published guidance checked 25 October 2026. Only wording assessed; no customer contact, actual refusal, closure, loss or intent tested.

banking-gls-minimum-age-fourteen.law: ZKG section 31(1) grants the basic-account right to every qualifying consumer lawfully staying in the EU and imposes no general minimum age of 14. Section 34 limits individual refusals to sections 35–37. Civil capacity and representation still matter: BGB sections 106–107 permit a minor aged 7 or above to make a contract with the necessary legal representative consent, and section 1629 governs parental representation. A properly represented 13-year-old meeting the other statutory and identity/AML conditions is not excluded merely by age. This comparison addresses the expressly labelled minimum-age row, not independent contractual capacity for every child.
banking-gls-minimum-age-fourteen.example: Hypothetical: a 13-year-old lawfully staying in the EU applies for a German statutory basic account with the necessary parental consent and representation. Assume no usable existing German payment account, no other statutory refusal ground, and all identity/AML requirements are satisfied. The published minimum-age 14 row excludes the applicant solely by age, although the statutory right has no such age cutoff. This does not establish that the bank would actually refuse or that its separately advertised U18 account is unavailable.
banking-gls-minimum-age-fourteen.context: The current product expressly ties the GLS Basiskonto to the ZKG, says it is offered from 14 and labels 14 as the minimum age in the complete new-customer table. The same page separately advertises an ordinary free GLS Konto U18 for ages 7–17 and gives a Basiskonto requirements list without an age item. The current price table does not establish a statutory 14 minimum. The product directs applicants to telephone contact; no current public statutory form was located. The comparison assumes proper legal representation and all other requirements.
banking-gls-minimum-age-fourteen.scope: German statutory Basiskonto published guidance checked 25 October 2026. Only wording assessed; no customer contact, actual refusal, closure, loss or intent tested.

banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.pub: GrifoFinance — Consulenza e Mediazione Creditizia S.r.l.
banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.claim: uses net pension income for the statutory 18,000 euro free-account threshold.
banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.quote: Conto di base: previsto dalla Convenzione tra il Ministero dell’economia e delle finanze, la Banca d’Italia, l’Associazione Bancaria Italiana, Poste italiane S.p.A. e l’Associazione italiana istituti di pagamento e di moneta elettronica. Prevede un numero limitato di operazioni gratuite e solo determinati servizi. Si addice pertanto a un tipo di clientela con esigenze finanziarie limitate. Il prodotto presenta alcune peculiarità (gratuità del servizio e, in determinati casi, esenzione dal pagamento dell’imposta di bollo) per le fasce socialmente svantaggiate (ISEE inferiore ad € 8.000) e per i titolari di trattamenti pensionistici che percepiscono fino a 1.500 euro mensili netti o 18.000 euro annui netti.
banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.tr: Basic account: provided for by the Convention between the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Bank of Italy, the Italian Banking Association, Poste Italiane S.p.A. and the Italian Association of Payment and Electronic Money Institutions. It provides a limited number of free transactions and only certain services. It therefore suits customers with limited financial needs. The product has certain special features (free service and, in certain cases, exemption from stamp duty) for socially disadvantaged groups (ISEE below 8,000 euros) and for recipients of pensions who receive up to 1,500 euros monthly net or 18,000 euros annually net.
banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.law: Under Ministerial Decree 70/2018 Article 5(1), the pension-specific free basic-account route uses total gross annual pension entitlement up to 18,000 euros, for people outside the separate Article 4 low-ISEE route. It covers AnnexB services and transaction numbers, with additional services/transactions potentially chargeable. Article 5(2)–(4) requires the account/declaration and annual pension information conditions. A net-income threshold can include someone whose gross pension exceeds 18,000 euros. The current Bank of Italy 24 September 2026 explanation independently confirms the gross basis. A provider remains free to offer an account voluntarily without charges; this comparison concerns the statutory pension-specific exemption described as a basic-account feature.
banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.example: Hypothetical: an otherwise qualifying Italian consumer receives 20,000 euros gross annual pension and 17,000 euros net, has ISEE at least 11,600 euros, no other basic account, and supplies all required identity and declaration information. The consumer requests only the services/transactions within AnnexB. The article’s net 18,000 euro description places this consumer within the pension-based free-service group, but the gross 20,000 euro pension exceeds Article 5’s statutory ceiling. This does not establish an actual charge, refusal or entitlement to a stamp-duty exemption, and does not exclude a voluntary free commercial offer.
banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.context: The complete basic-account list item is retained, including limited services, the old convention reference, both ISEE and pension routes, and qualified stamp-duty language. It is part of an actively linked general current-account educational sheet, visibly updated 15 August 2025; it is not labelled a historical account of the old convention. The narrow allegation concerns net versus gross annual pension, not a claim that everyone below 8,000 ISEE is wrongly included or that all basic-account services are unlimited/free. GrifoFinance is a registered credit-broker company (its own identity page states OAMM 538), not the account-opening bank. No actual account process was tested.
banking-grifo-pension-net-threshold.scope: Current Italian statutory free basic-account pension route under DM 70/2018 Article 5; financial-company educational guidance. Separate low-ISEE relief, stamp duty and voluntary free products are not independently alleged.

banking-dkb-minimum-age-eighteen.claim: states that applicants for its statutory Basiskonto must be at least 18.
banking-dkb-minimum-age-eighteen.quote:
Voraussetzungen für die Eröffnung
• du bist Verbraucher*in mit rechtmäßigem Aufenthalt in der EU
• du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt
• du hast noch kein Zahlungskonto bei uns oder bei einer anderen Bank
• das Konto wird ausschließlich privat genutzt (eine geschäftliche Nutzung ist nicht möglich)
banking-dkb-minimum-age-eighteen.tr:
Requirements for opening
• you are a consumer lawfully staying in the EU
• you are at least 18 years old
• you do not yet have a payment account with us or another bank
• the account is used exclusively privately (business use is not possible)
banking-dkb-minimum-age-eighteen.law: ZKG § 31(1) gives qualifying consumers a right to a Basiskonto without a general minimum age of 18. Under § 34(1), refusal is limited to §§ 35–37. The ordinary capacity, consent and representation rules still apply: BGB §§ 106–107 and 1629 permit a properly represented 17-year-old to enter the account contract. An ordinary online adult-account route may have its own age condition; this FAQ and the BFSG passage expressly apply 18 to the statutory Basiskonto.
banking-dkb-minimum-age-eighteen.example: Hypothetical: A 17-year-old consumer lawfully staying in the EU applies through the postal statutory route with the necessary legal representative acting and consenting. Assume complete required information, successful identity/AML checks, no usable German payment account and no other statutory refusal ground. Being 17 alone does not remove the statutory entitlement, but the FAQ and BFSG information require 18.
banking-dkb-minimum-age-eighteen.context: The same current statutory opening FAQ links a paper application, so its age condition is not merely an age gate for app self-service. The current BFSG information repeats 18 specifically for the Basiskonto and says postal applicants must meet those section 1.3 conditions. The application itself has no stated age cutoff; its generic third-party identity sheet includes an under 16 birth-certificate option, preserved as counterevidence. Separate Girokonto u 18 instructions do not expressly create an exception to the published Basiskonto age rule.
banking-dkb-minimum-age-eighteen.scope: German statutory Basiskonto published guidance checked 25 October 2026. Only wording assessed; no customer contact, actual refusal, closure, loss or intent tested.

banking-bbva-one-year-inactivity.src: BBVA background information on the Basiskonto — one-year inactivity
banking-bbva-one-year-inactivity.claim: says in its currently supplied statutory-account background information that one year without turnover can justify closing an account.
banking-bbva-one-year-inactivity.quote:
Das Kreditinstitut ist nicht verpflichtet, ein Girokonto für den Antragsteller zu führen, wenn der Antragsteller keinen Anspruch auf ein Basiskonto hat oder dies für das Kreditinstitut unzumutbar ist. In diesem Fall darf die Bank auch ein bestehendes Konto kündigen. Unzumutbar ist die Eröffnung oder Fortführung einer Kontoverbindung insbesondere, wenn:
● Kund*innen die Leistungen des Kreditinstitutes missbrauchen, insbesondere für gesetzwidrige Transaktionen, z.B. Betrug, Geldwäsche o.ä.,
● Antragstellende Falschangaben machen, die für das Vertragsverhältnis wesentlich sind,
● Antragstellende die BBVA-Mitarbeitenden oder Kund*innen grob belästigen oder gefährden,
● die bezweckte Nutzung des Kontos zur Teilnahme am bargeldlosen Zahlungsverkehr nicht gegeben ist, weil z.B. das Konto durch Handlungen vollstreckender Gläubiger blockiert ist oder ein Jahr lang umsatzlos geführt wird,
● nicht sichergestellt ist, dass das Institut die für die Kontoführung und -nutzung vereinbarten üblichen Entgelte erhält,
● Kund*innen auch im Übrigen die Vereinbarungen nicht einhalten.
banking-bbva-one-year-inactivity.law: ZKG § 42(1) makes the statutory termination grounds exhaustive. For inactivity alone, § 42(2)(1) requires more than 24 consecutive months without a payment transaction ordered by the holder, an agreed termination right and at least two months’ notice. One year without turnover is insufficient by itself. Other statutory grounds for termination remain possible under their own conditions; a general unreasonableness formula cannot replace them.
banking-bbva-one-year-inactivity.example: Hypothetical legal comparison: Assume BBVA’s background information’s no-turnover condition is met for 13 months and there is no other statutory termination ground. Assume the holder remains entitled, has supplied accurate information, owes no qualifying unpaid fees, has no other usable German account and has not used the account unlawfully or committed relevant misconduct. That period alone is too short: ZKG §42(2)(1) requires more than 24 consecutive months without a holder-ordered payment, an agreed termination right and at least two months’ notice. The example assumes the source condition is met; it does not equate bank-fee postings with no turnover or assert BBVA’s actual charging or closure practice.
banking-bbva-one-year-inactivity.context: The one-page background sheet is currently linked under documents and applications under ZKG, and expressly identifies the statutory Basiskonto. Its legacy Jedermann-style drafting is disclosed and shares the N26 template. Current separate account explanation says banks may terminate a Basiskonto only where the ZKG permits it; the statutory form preserves existing-account exceptions. These broader correct passages do not remove the express one-year example, and the case does not infer actual closure practice.
banking-bbva-one-year-inactivity.scope: German statutory Basiskonto published guidance checked 25 October 2026. Only wording assessed; no customer contact, actual refusal, closure, loss or intent tested.

ctx.quote: Verbraucherinnen oder Verbraucher können den Basiskontovertrag jederzeit kündigen. Banken können den Basiskontovertrag nur kündigen, wenn das Zahlungskontengesetz dies erlaubt.
ctx.tr: Consumers can terminate the basic-account contract at any time. Banks can terminate a basic-account contract only where the Payment Accounts Act permits it.

ctx.quote: Jedem Institut ist es freigestellt, darüber hinausgehende Bankdienstleistungen anzubieten. Die Bereitschaft zur Kontoführung ist grundsätzlich gegeben, unabhängig von Art und Höhe der Einkünfte, z.B. Arbeitslosengeld, Sozialhilfe. Eintragungen bei der SCHUFA, die auf schlechte wirtschaftliche Verhältnisse des Kunden bzw. der Kundin hindeuten, sind allein kein Grund, die Führung eines Girokontos zu verweigern.
ctx.tr: Each institution is free to offer additional banking services. Willingness to maintain the account generally exists regardless of the type or amount of income, such as unemployment benefit or social assistance. SCHUFA entries indicating the customer’s poor economic circumstances are not alone a reason to refuse to maintain a current account.

banking-bunq-de-p-konto-licence-exemptio.src: Current German statutory Basiskonto application — P-Konto notice
banking-bunq-de-p-konto-licence-exemptio.claim: says its Dutch banking licence exempts its German statutory basic account from P-Konto duties.
banking-bunq-de-p-konto-licence-exemptio.quote: Hinweis: Pfändungsschutzkonto (P-Konto) bunq B.V. ist ein in den Niederlanden zugelassenes Kreditinstitut (Vergunning De Nederlandsche Bank). Als ausländisches Institut, das in Deutschland im Wege des Europäischen Passes tätig ist, unterliegt bunq nicht der deutschen Verpflichtung zur Führung eines Pfändungsschutzkontos nach § 850k ZPO. Die Eröffnung eines P-Kontos ist bei bunq daher nicht möglich. Zur Einrichtung eines Pfändungsschutzkontos wenden Sie sich bitte an ein in Deutschland zugelassenes Kreditinstitut.

banking-bunq-de-p-konto-licence-exemptio.law: ZKG § 33(1) expressly allows a qualifying applicant to require that the Basiskonto be operated as a P-Konto already at application. Section 30(3) makes the foreign company the bearer of the German branch’s rights and duties under this statutory-account chapter; a Dutch licence is not an exemption for that German branch product. ZPO § 850k(1)–(3) separately provides conversion on request and the one-P-Konto rule. The finding is limited to the initial request for bunq’s current German statutory Basiskonto, rather than every account held directly in the Netherlands.

returns-mercedes-original-packaging.claim: makes undamaged original packaging a condition for returns.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.quote: Nur ungetragene Artikel in unbeschädigter Originalverpackung und ohne Gebrauchsspuren können retourniert werden.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.tr: Only unworn items in undamaged original packaging and without signs of use can be returned.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.law: The page expressly covers returns after withdrawal, yet states an unqualified original-packaging condition. For ordinary goods, missing or damaged original packaging does not itself remove the statutory right. Examination is allowed; any diminished-value claim depends on actual loss, unnecessary handling and the information required by BGB § 357a(1). The linked withdrawal notice correctly states that narrower diminished-value rule, so the finding concerns contradictory returns guidance, not an assertion that every Mercedes-Benz notice is wrong.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.example: Hypothetical: A consumer orders an ordinary, unpersonalised accessory online, opens its packaging to inspect it, and sends a clear withdrawal declaration within 14 days of receipt. The accessory remains undamaged, but the original packaging is unavailable. Assuming no statutory exception applies, the missing packaging alone does not justify refusing withdrawal. Any separate claim for actual lost value must meet the statutory conditions.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.context: The first paragraph says the page applies to a return following withdrawal or a warranty claim. The packaging condition is in the first bullet under the returns instructions. The separate footer-linked Widerrufsbelehrung correctly explains that only loss caused by handling beyond necessary examination is chargeable. The current homepage links both pages.
returns-mercedes-original-packaging.scope: German consumer distance sales of ordinary goods, with timely withdrawal and no statutory exception. returns-shr-unopened-packaging.claim: requires consumer returns to be unopened and in their original packaging.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.quote: 1. Widerrufsrecht für Privatkunden (B2C) Verbraucher haben das Recht, binnen 14 Tagen ohne Angabe von Gründen diesen Vertrag zu widerrufen. Die Frist beginnt ab dem Tag, an dem Sie oder ein von Ihnen benannter Dritter die Waren in Besitz genommen haben. Voraussetzung für die Rücknahme: Die Ware muss sich im ungeöffneten, unbenutzten Originalzustand befinden und in der Originalverpackung an uns zurückgesendet werden. 2. Ausschluss des Widerrufsrechts Das Widerrufsrecht erlischt bei Verträgen zur Lieferung versiegelter Waren, die aus Gründen des Gesundheitsschutzes oder der Hygiene nicht zur Rückgabe geeignet sind. Dies gilt insbesondere für: Parfüms & Düfte: Sobald die Versiegelung oder die Schutzfolie der Umverpackung entfernt wurde, ist eine Rückgabe ausgeschlossen. Geöffnete oder getestete Parfüms werden nicht zurückgenommen. Sämtliche Hygieneartikel Hyaluron Pens & Hyaluron Filler Geräte, die aufgrund ihrer Beschaffenheit oder Bestimmung für gewerbliche Zwecke konzipiert sind.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.tr: 1. Right of withdrawal for private customers (B2C). Consumers have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving reasons. The period begins on the day on which you or a third party named by you took possession of the goods. Condition for accepting returns: The goods must be in their unopened, unused original condition and returned to us in their original packaging. 2. Exclusion of the right of withdrawal. The right of withdrawal expires for contracts for the supply of sealed goods that are unsuitable for return for reasons of health protection or hygiene. This applies in particular to: Perfumes and fragrances: Once the seal or protective film of the outer packaging has been removed, returns are excluded. Opened or tested perfumes are not accepted. All hygiene products. Hyaluron pens and hyaluron fillers. Equipment designed for commercial purposes because of its nature or intended use.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.law: This condition appears as a general requirement directly under the statutory 14-day right for private consumers. Ordinary goods can be opened and examined without losing that right. BGB § 357a(1) addresses any actual loss caused by unnecessary handling; it does not make unopened packaging a universal condition. The hygiene exception can apply to particular sealed goods, but cannot justify this general condition for ordinary products such as handbags.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.example: Hypothetical: A private customer orders an ordinary handbag online for personal use. She opens its packaging to inspect the bag, leaves it undamaged and unused, and declares withdrawal within 14 days of receipt. Assuming the bag is not personalised and no statutory exception applies, opening the packaging does not remove her right. Any alleged loss of value must satisfy BGB § 357a(1).
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.context: The policy separates section 1, Widerrufsrecht für Privatkunden (B2C), from section 3, voluntary handling of business-customer returns. The challenged sentence sits in section 1 beneath the stated 14-day right. Section 2 separately lists claimed exceptions. Linked AGB § 21 expressly recognises statutory consumer withdrawal and lists the specific hygiene and mixing exceptions. The shop currently lists ordinary handbags, alongside beauty products.
returns-shr-unopened-packaging.scope: Timely statutory withdrawal by consumers buying ordinary physical goods online in Germany. The finding does not decide whether particular cosmetics, sealed hygiene goods or commercial purchases qualify. It concerns the general condition, rather than actual return handling, losses or intent.

returns-cwt-original-seal.claim: requires an intact original seal and original packaging for returns.
returns-cwt-original-seal.quote: Unser Rückgaberecht gilt für 14 Tage. Wenn Ihr Kauf mehr als 14 Tage zurück liegt, können wir Ihnen leider keine Rückerstattung und keinen Umtausch anbieten. Um für eine Rücksendung infrage zu kommen, muss Ihr Artikel unbenutzt und in demselben Zustand sein, in dem Sie ihn erhalten haben. Falls Sie den Artikel aus der Originalverpackung entnommen haben und das dazugehörige Siegel durchtrennt haben, behalten wir uns vor, die Rücknahme zu verweigern! Der Artikel muss sich in der Originalverpackung befinden und das Original Siegel muss unbeschädigt sein.
returns-cwt-original-seal.tr: Our return policy lasts 14 days. If more than 14 days have passed since your purchase, unfortunately we cannot offer a refund or exchange. To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition in which you received it. If you have removed the item from its original packaging and broken the associated seal, we reserve the right to refuse the return! The item must be in its original packaging and the original seal must be undamaged.
returns-cwt-original-seal.law: A normal product seal is not a general statutory exception. For ordinary vehicle parts bought by consumers at a distance, opening a package to inspect the goods does not by itself remove withdrawal. Article 14(2) and BGB § 357a(1) instead permit liability for qualifying actual loss of value from unnecessary handling. Specific exceptions for hygiene goods or sealed media do not cover ordinary vehicle parts merely because their packaging has a seal.
returns-cwt-original-seal.example: Hypothetical: A consumer orders a standard ignition coil for his own car online, opens its sealed carton only to inspect the part without installing it, then declares withdrawal within 14 days of receipt and returns it promptly. Assuming no statutory exception applies, the broken ordinary carton seal alone does not justify refusing withdrawal. Any separate lost-value claim requires the statutory conditions.
returns-cwt-original-seal.context: The live policy is titled Widerrufsrecht and describes a 14-day return right. The preceding sentence reserves a right to refuse returns if an article is removed from its packaging and the seal is cut; a later list allows only partial refunds where an original seal has been cut. The linked AGB direct online-product returns to this policy. The shop also links a separate withdrawal form but no second substantive statutory notice was found in the reviewed pages.
returns-cwt-original-seal.scope: Ordinary unpersonalised vehicle parts bought online for personal use by German consumers, with timely withdrawal. This does not address installation damage, value lost through use, dangerous-goods shipping or specific statutory exceptions. The page uses Rückgaberecht in the body beneath its Widerrufsrecht heading; the finding concerns the conditions presented in that statutory-facing policy, not an actual refusal.

returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.claim: excludes the listed standard-size duvet from withdrawal for hygiene reasons without requiring removal of a seal.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.quote: Dieses Produkt ist im Best Nature Shop ein Hygieneartikel und daher vom Widerrufsrecht ausgeschlossen.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.tr: This product is a hygiene item at Best Nature Shop and is therefore excluded from the right of withdrawal.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.law: The product rule gives hygiene classification as an unconditional reason to exclude withdrawal. BGB § 312g(2) no. 3 and Article 16(e) require qualifying sealed goods and removal of their seal after delivery. That exception cannot defeat an otherwise eligible withdrawal while any seal remains intact. The manufacturer’s current linked catalogue lists the same 8206/8207/8208 models and standard size table, separately distinguishing special sizes. The observed 8207 Ganzjahresdecke, 135 × 200 cm selection reached a cart and initial unsubmitted checkout as a fixed catalogue item, without a personal measurement or design requirement. The comparison is limited to that ordinary advertised selection, excluding separately requested special manufacture. The general withdrawal notice gives the seal-removal condition and the genuine-bespoke exception, contradicting the product rule.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer orders the advertised ProNatura model 8207 Ganzjahresdecke in its listed 135 × 200 cm size through the observed ordinary selection, without separately requested special sizing or personalisation. Five days after delivery they give clear withdrawal notice and leave the duvet unused, unopened and with any seal intact. Assuming no other statutory exception, hygiene classification alone does not remove withdrawal.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.context: The product lists catalogue models and sizes, includes Bio-Milbenstopp, gives a three-to-four-week lead time and says ProNatura dispatches the goods. ProNatura’s current linked catalogue independently lists these models and standard dimensions, and separately offers special sizes without Bio-Milbenstopp. A research selection of model 8207, 135 × 200 cm reached the cart at €296 and the initial Germany checkout without requiring individual product specifications. A third required product selector has only the option vom Widerrufsrecht ausgeschlossen; it records the hygiene rule rather than a bespoke measurement. The general notice grants 14 days and states both the genuine-bespoke and removed-seal hygiene exceptions. No order or personal/payment data was submitted, and the research item was removed.
returns-bestnature-duvet-hygiene.scope: German consumer distance purchases of the advertised ProNatura 8207 Ganzjahresdecke in the listed 135 × 200 cm standard size, with timely withdrawal, unused unopened goods, any seal intact and no separately requested special sizing, personalisation or other exception. No conclusion about every variant, used or unsealed duvets, production timing, actual refusals or loss.

returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.quote: Bitte beachte, dass unsere Period Panties, aus hygienischen Gründen, vom Widerrufsrecht ausgeschlossen sind und können nicht retourniert werden können.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.tr: Please note that, for hygiene reasons, our period panties are excluded from the right of withdrawal and cannot be returned.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.law: The quoted product rule excludes statutory withdrawal for the whole category. Article 16(e) and BGB § 312g(2) no. 3 require a suitable sealed product and removal of that seal after delivery. Even if a particular period product could qualify once unsealed, that cannot exclude an otherwise eligible return while its seal remains intact. This finding does not decide whether worn or unsealed period underwear can lawfully be excluded.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer orders the standard Shorty online and changes their mind after delivery. They notify withdrawal within five days and leave the product unused with any hygiene seal intact. Assuming no other exception, the product category alone does not remove the statutory right.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.context: The live period-underwear category FAQ repeats a blanket exclusion after purchase. By contrast, the product also advertises 14-day returns; the general terms’ section 11 gives a 14-day statutory withdrawal right and contains no category exclusion. Those broader rights are important counterevidence to the product-specific statement.
returns-chantelle-period-panties-hygiene.scope: German consumer online purchases of standard period underwear with any hygiene seal intact, within the statutory period and with no other exception. Used or unsealed goods, goodwill extensions and defect remedies are outside this finding.

returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.src: Retoure — final FAQ on how long to return an order
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.claim: sets the return dispatch period at 14 days after receipt, although withdrawal starts a separate return period.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.quote: Wie lange habe ich Zeit, meine Bestellung zurücksenden? Du kannst deine Artikel ab Erhalt innerhalb von 14 Tagen zurücksenden
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.tr: How long do I have to return my order? You can send your items back within 14 days of receipt
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.law: A consumer can declare a timely statutory withdrawal near the end of the normal 14-day cooling-off period and then send the goods back without undue delay within the following 14 days. Espadrij’s returns FAQ instead measures the dispatch period from receipt. Its separate statutory notice gives the correct period after withdrawal; the finding concerns these contradictory customer instructions.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer receives ordinary, non-personalised shoes, declares withdrawal on day 13, and dispatches them on day 15. Assume the dispatch is without undue delay and within 14 days of that declaration. The statutory return deadline is met, although the FAQ’s period from receipt has ended.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.context: The Retoure page also labels the return period as 14 days from receipt in step 1. No longer voluntary period or express statutory-rights carve-out is stated there. The separately linked Widerrufsrecht notice correctly permits any unequivocal withdrawal declaration, makes its form optional, and gives 14 days from the declaration to dispatch the goods. It also permits lawful withholding of the refund pending goods or dispatch evidence. Those qualifications prevent an allegation that the shop provides no correct notice or necessarily refuses later returns.
returns-espadrij-dispatch-after-delivery.scope: German consumer distance purchases of ordinary goods subject to statutory withdrawal, with timely unequivocal notice and no statutory exception. Published instructions only; no actual rejection or loss established.

returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.src: Widerrufsrecht — Folgen des Widerrufs, first sentence
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.claim: excludes delivery charges from the statutory withdrawal refund.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.quote: Wenn Sie diesen Vertrag widerrufen, haben wir Ihnen alle Zahlungen, die wir von Ihnen erhalten haben, ausschließlich der Lieferkosten unverzüglich und spätestens binnen vierzehn Tagen ab dem Tag zurückzuzahlen, an dem die Mitteilung über Ihren Widerruf dieses Vertrags bei uns eingegangen ist. Für diese Rückzahlung verwenden wir dasselbe Zahlungsmittel, das Sie bei der ursprünglichen Transaktion eingesetzt haben, es sei denn, mit Ihnen wurde ausdrücklich etwas anderes vereinbart; in keinem Fall werden Ihnen wegen dieser Rückzahlung Entgelte berechnet. Wir können die Rückzahlung verweigern, bis wir die Waren wieder zurückerhalten haben oder bis Sie den Nachweis erbracht haben, dass Sie die Waren zurückgesandt haben, je nachdem, welches der frühere Zeitpunkt ist.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.tr: If you withdraw from this contract, we must repay all payments received from you, excluding delivery costs, without undue delay and no later than fourteen days from the day on which we received notice of your withdrawal from this contract. For repayment we use the same payment method that you used for the original transaction, unless expressly agreed otherwise with you; you will never be charged fees for this repayment. We may withhold repayment until we have received the goods back or you have provided evidence that you sent the goods back, whichever is earlier.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.law: For withdrawal from the whole purchase, Article 13 and BGB § 357(2) require repayment of the cheapest standard outbound delivery charge. Espadrij’s statutory notice excludes delivery costs without limiting the exclusion to an express-delivery supplement. This is distinct from return postage, which may be borne by a properly informed consumer.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.example: Hypothetical: A consumer pays €60 for ordinary shoes and €5 for the shop’s cheapest standard delivery, then validly withdraws from the whole purchase. Assume no diminished value or other lawful deduction. The refund is €65, subject to the lawful goods-or-dispatch-evidence withholding rule. A blanket exclusion of delivery costs would instead describe €60. Return postage is separate.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.context: The words appear in the statutory notice, not merely an optional extended return policy. The surrounding sentence promises repayment within 14 days after receipt of withdrawal; later clauses correctly preserve the original payment method, allow withholding until goods or dispatch evidence, and say the customer bears direct return postage. None of those clauses narrows the outbound-delivery exclusion to supplementary express costs.
returns-espadrij-excludes-outbound-deliv.scope: Whole-contract statutory withdrawal from an ordinary German consumer online goods purchase. Limited to standard outbound delivery already paid, not an optional delivery upgrade, partial returns, or the separate cost of sending goods back.

versions.quote: Wenn Sie diesen Vertrag widerrufen, haben wir Ihnen alle Zahlungen, die wir von Ihnen erhalten haben, ausschließlich der Lieferkosten unverzüglich und spätestens binnen vierzehn Tagen ab dem Tag zurückzuzahlen, an dem die Mitteilung über Ihren Widerruf dieses Vertrags bei uns eingegangen ist. returns-shr-excludes-outbound-delivery.claim: excludes delivery charges from the withdrawal refund.
returns-shr-excludes-outbound-delivery.quote: 21.6 Folgen des Widerrufs 21.6.1 Rückzahlungsmodalitäten: Bei Widerruf des Vertrags erstatten wir alle von Ihnen geleisteten Zahlungen, abzüglich der Lieferkosten. 21.6.2 Rückzahlungsfrist: Die Rückzahlung erfolgt innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Eingang Ihrer Widerrufserklärung. 21.6.3 Wareneingangsprüfung: Nach Erhalt der zurückgesandten Ware wird diese von uns auf Vollständigkeit und Funktionsfähigkeit überprüft. 21.6.4 Kosten der Rücksendung: Die Kosten der Rücksendung liegen grundsätzlich bei Ihnen, es sei denn, die gelieferte Ware entspricht nicht der bestellten Ware oder weist Mängel auf.
returns-shr-excludes-outbound-delivery.tr: 21.6 Consequences of withdrawal. 21.6.1 Repayment arrangements: On withdrawal from the contract, we refund all payments you made, minus delivery costs. 21.6.2 Repayment period: Repayment takes place within 30 days after receipt of your withdrawal declaration. 21.6.3 Goods inspection: After receiving the returned goods, we check them for completeness and functionality. 21.6.4 Return costs: You generally bear the return costs, unless the delivered goods do not correspond to those ordered or are defective.
returns-shr-excludes-outbound-delivery.law: The consumer-withdrawal section of the AGB excludes delivery charges from repayment. Article 13(1)–(2) and BGB § 357(2) instead include the cheapest standard outbound delivery charge when the consumer withdraws from the whole purchase. An optional delivery upgrade need not be refunded, and properly disclosed direct return postage is separate. The clause contains no such standard-delivery qualification.
returns-shr-excludes-outbound-delivery.example: Hypothetical: A consumer pays €30 for ordinary goods and €5 for the cheapest standard delivery, then declares withdrawal from the whole purchase within 14 days of receipt. Assume no exception or diminished value, and that the shop has the goods back. On these assumed prices, the repayment is €35. The delivery-cost exclusion would describe €30; return postage is separate.
returns-shr-excludes-outbound-delivery.context: The phrase is in AGB § 21.6.1, immediately after the express recognition of statutory withdrawal for consumers under BGB in §§ 21.1–21.2. § 21.6.4 separately allocates return postage. The other linked withdrawal/returns page distinguishes private consumers from business customers and gives a different refund-timing statement, but does not qualify the AGB delivery-cost exclusion. The shop sells ordinary fashion goods alongside beauty products.
returns-shr-excludes-outbound-delivery.scope: Whole-contract statutory withdrawal declared within the initial 14-day period after delivery by a consumer in Germany, for ordinary goods with no exception. Only cheapest standard outbound delivery paid for that purchase is considered; optional delivery upgrades, partial returns, properly disclosed return postage and voluntary later returns are outside this finding. No actual refund or loss was observed.

returns-shr-thirty-day-refund.quote: 21.6 Folgen des Widerrufs 21.6.1 Rückzahlungsmodalitäten: Bei Widerruf des Vertrags erstatten wir alle von Ihnen geleisteten Zahlungen, abzüglich der Lieferkosten. 21.6.2 Rückzahlungsfrist: Die Rückzahlung erfolgt innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Eingang Ihrer Widerrufserklärung. 21.6.3 Wareneingangsprüfung: Nach Erhalt der zurückgesandten Ware wird diese von uns auf Vollständigkeit und Funktionsfähigkeit überprüft. 21.6.4 Kosten der Rücksendung: Die Kosten der Rücksendung liegen grundsätzlich bei Ihnen, es sei denn, die gelieferte Ware entspricht nicht der bestellten Ware oder weist Mängel auf.

returns-shr-thirty-day-refund.law: AGB § 21.6.2 gives 30 days from receipt of withdrawal. For statutory withdrawal, Article 13(1) and BGB §§ 355(3), 357(1) require repayment without undue delay and no later than 14 days after the trader receives that notice. The trader may withhold while it lacks both the returned goods and dispatch evidence under Article 13(3) and BGB § 357(4), unless it offered collection. That is a qualified withholding right, not a general 30-day repayment period.
returns-shr-thirty-day-refund.example: Hypothetical: A consumer declares withdrawal within 14 days after receiving ordinary goods. The shop receives the declaration that day and receives the undamaged goods four days later. Assume no exception or lawful deduction. Repayment must follow without undue delay and by 14 days after receipt of the declaration at the latest. The AGB state an outer limit 16 days later, even though the goods are already back; that does not remove the separate duty to repay without undue delay.
returns-shr-thirty-day-refund.context: This is AGB § 21.6.2, directly under the consumer-withdrawal provisions. The separately linked Widerrufsbelehrung & Retourenbedingungen § 6 says repayment is initiated after receipt and successful checking and may take up to 14 days. That shorter operational statement differs from the AGB 30-day promise; it does not identify the statutory 14-day period from notice or its dispatch-proof alternative. The case challenges the AGB statement, rather than claiming every page uses 30 days.
returns-shr-thirty-day-refund.scope: Timely statutory consumer withdrawal in Germany from ordinary online goods purchases, where goods or adequate dispatch evidence are held before the 14-day repayment deadline and no exception or lawful deduction applies. The example has the goods back on day four. No claim that the trader must repay before the lawful withholding condition is met or that it actually delayed a refund.

A shop can extend the declaration period to 30 days, but cannot thereby take away the minimum repayment rights for withdrawal declared within the statutory first 14 days.
returns-kraus-excludes-outbound-delivery.example: Hypothetical: A consumer pays €80 for an ordinary bicycle accessory and €6.95 for its cheapest standard delivery, then withdraws from the whole purchase within 14 days after receipt. Assume the goods are returned intact, no exception or diminished value, and return postage has been separately paid. The repayment is €86.95; excluding delivery would describe €80.
returns-kraus-excludes-outbound-delivery.context: The phrase appears in the first paragraph under Folgen des Widerrufs in the formal notice. The separate Widerruf & Retoure guide repeats the exclusion prominently and its FAQ calls the 30-day declaration period statutory. The notice offers 30 days for withdrawal and for returning goods, but states no separate first-14-day statutory-cost safeguard. The AGB recognise consumer contracts. The shipping page currently lists standard accessory delivery at €6.95 and also repeats the exclusion.
returns-kraus-excludes-outbound-delivery.scope: Whole-contract statutory withdrawal declared within the initial 14-day period after delivery by a consumer in Germany, for ordinary goods with no exception. Only cheapest standard outbound delivery paid for that purchase is considered; optional delivery upgrades, partial returns, properly disclosed return postage and voluntary later returns are outside this finding. No actual refund or loss was observed.

returns-kraus-thirty-day-refund.law: In the formal notice this 30-day period is measured from the trader’s receipt of withdrawal. Article 13(1) and BGB §§ 355(3), 357(1) require repayment without undue delay and within 14 days for statutory withdrawal. The correctly stated goods-or-dispatch-proof withholding right can postpone repayment while both are absent, but does not justify a general 30-day deadline once that condition is satisfied. The case is limited to withdrawal declared within the initial statutory 14 days; the shop’s additional declaration period does not reduce those minimum rights.
returns-kraus-thirty-day-refund.example: Hypothetical: A consumer withdraws from an ordinary accessory purchase on day seven after delivery. The trader receives that notice immediately and has the intact goods back four days later. Assume no exception or lawful deduction. Repayment must follow without undue delay and at the latest 14 days after notice receipt, rather than up to 30 days. The goods are already held before that deadline, so withholding does not change the comparison.
returns-kraus-thirty-day-refund.context: The quotation is from the first repayment sentence under Folgen des Widerrufs, whose surrounding text starts the period when the trader receives notice. The next paragraph correctly permits withholding until goods or dispatch evidence, whichever is earlier. The separate returns guide also says up to 30 days after receipt of withdrawal. The offered 30-day declaration/return periods are recorded as a benefit; the allegation concerns refund timing for withdrawal within the initial statutory period.
returns-kraus-thirty-day-refund.scope: German consumer online purchases of ordinary goods, with withdrawal declared within the first 14 days after receipt and goods or adequate dispatch proof already held by the trader before the refund deadline. The example concerns returned ordinary accessories, no bulky return fee, no loss of value and no observed delay. Voluntary withdrawal first declared on days 15–30 is outside the finding.

returns-elektor-return-risk.quote: Wenn Sie ein oder mehrere Produkte aus Ihrer Bestellung zurücksenden/stornieren möchten, können Sie dies ganz einfach über die Website unseres Fulfillment-Partners hier tun. Sie benötigen Ihre Bestellnummer, die Sie auf Ihrem Paket oder in Ihrem Account finden, sowie die E-Mail-Adresse, die Sie für die Bestellung verwendet haben. Bitte beachten Sie, dass Sie die Kosten und das Risiko der Rücksendung der Ware tragen. Für Kunden außerhalb der EU bedeutet dies, dass Ihnen neben den Versandkosten auch die Zollgebühren in Rechnung gestellt werden.
returns-elektor-return-risk.tr: If you wish to return/cancel one or more products from your order, you can easily do so through our fulfilment partner’s website here. You need your order number, which you can find on your package or in your account, and the email address used for the order. Please note that you bear the costs and risk of returning the goods. For customers outside the EU, this means that customs charges will be charged in addition to shipping costs.
returns-elektor-return-risk.law: Under Germany’s BGB § 355(3), the trader bears accidental return-transit risk after statutory consumer withdrawal. It may require adequate evidence that the goods were dispatched and can withhold repayment until goods or that evidence under BGB § 357(4), unless it offered collection. The consumer must still use reasonable care, including suitable packaging and the correct address; a claim based on the consumer’s own fault is separate. This is a comparison with German national law: the Consumer Rights Directive does not itself settle accidental return-transit risk across the EU.
returns-elektor-return-risk.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer validly withdraws within 14 days after receipt of an ordinary printed technical book bought directly from Elektor. They promptly return it to the correct instructed address, suitably packed through an established postal service, and supply adequate proof of dispatch. The parcel is accidentally lost without any fault by the consumer. German withdrawal law places that transit risk on the trader; the consumer’s separately disclosed return postage may still be payable.
returns-elektor-return-risk.context: The sentence is in Kundenservice > Widerruf, in the second numbered item about returning or cancelling ordered products through the fulfilment partner. The first numbered item concerns defects; the challenged sentence is in the separate ordinary-return item. The linked AGB § 10 recognises withdrawal and allocates return costs, but does not correct the return-risk claim. The FAQ discusses return costs and statutory refund timing without expressly shifting the risk back. The linked withdrawal page contains a form. The AGB separately explain that purchases made through affiliate links to Eleshop have a different seller.
returns-elektor-return-risk.scope: Statutory withdrawal under German law from ordinary physical goods bought directly from Elektor for personal use, with proper packing, correct address, suitable carrier, timely dispatch and adequate proof, and no consumer fault. The example uses an ordinary printed book, not digital content, unsealed software/media, a periodical or an affiliate purchase. No actual lost parcel or refusal was established.

returns-xenial-return-risk.quote: Im Falle eines Widerrufs (Rückgabe ohne Mangel oder Falschlieferung) trägt der Kunde die Kosten und das Risiko der Rücksendung – ausgenommen bei persönlicher Abgabe. returns-xenial-return-risk.tr: In the event of withdrawal (a return without a defect or incorrect delivery), the customer bears the costs and risk of returning the goods, except when handing them over in person. If there is a defect, damage or an incorrect delivery, we cover the return shipping costs in full.
returns-xenial-return-risk.law: Under Germany’s BGB § 355(3), the trader bears accidental return-transit risk after statutory consumer withdrawal. It may require adequate evidence that the goods were dispatched and can withhold repayment until goods or that evidence under BGB § 357(4), unless it offered collection. The consumer must still use reasonable care, including suitable packaging and the correct address; a claim based on the consumer’s own fault is separate. This is a comparison with German national law: the Consumer Rights Directive does not itself settle accidental return-transit risk across the EU.
returns-xenial-return-risk.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer timely withdraws from an online purchase of an ordinary, standard, unopened product. They return the goods promptly to the instructed address, properly packed with a suitable established carrier and in compliance with any applicable transport requirements, and provide adequate dispatch proof. The parcel is accidentally lost without consumer fault. Under BGB § 355(3), that loss is the trader’s transit risk; return postage is a separate question.

It excepts personal handover and separately says the seller pays for defective or wrong goods. The separately linked Widerrufsrecht repeats the same risk allocation, and AGB > Produktrückgabe repeats it again. The AGB offer goods to natural persons in Germany as well as legal persons and choose German substantive law; no business-only limitation was found in these reviewed pages.
returns-xenial-return-risk.scope: Statutory withdrawal by German consumers from ordinary online goods, with no exception, correct packing/address, lawful suitable transport, prompt provable dispatch and no consumer fault. This comparison uses Germany’s national risk rule, not an EU-wide rule. Faulty packing, misaddressing, missing dispatch proof, defective-goods remedies and personal handover are outside the hypothetical. No actual loss or refusal was observed.

returns-montredo-own-carrier-risk.claim: places return-transit loss and damage risk on consumers who do not use its return label.
returns-montredo-own-carrier-risk.quote: Hochwertige Uhren sind unter Verwendung des von MONTREDO bereitgestellten Versand- etiketts und gemäß unseren Rücksendeanweisungen zurückzusenden. Nutzen Sie nicht das MONTREDO-Rücksendeetikett und/oder weichen Sie von den Anweisungen ab, ist die Rücksendung nicht über MONTREDO versichert. In diesem Fall tragen Sie das Risiko des Verlusts und der Beschädigung während des Rücktransports sowie etwaige hieraus entstehende Kosten.
returns-montredo-own-carrier-risk.tr: High-value watches must be returned using the shipping label supplied by MONTREDO and in accordance with our return instructions. If you do not use the MONTREDO return label and/or depart from the instructions, the return shipment is not insured through MONTREDO. In that case you bear the risk of loss and damage during return transport and any resulting costs.
returns-montredo-own-carrier-risk.law: Section 6 applies after the consumer does not use MONTREDO’s label and/or departs from its return instructions. For German statutory withdrawal, choosing a different return carrier does not by itself move accidental transit risk to the consumer: BGB § 355(3), sentence 4 allocates it to the trader. A lack of cover under MONTREDO’s insurance is a different question. Proper packaging, addressing, reasonable care and proof of dispatch remain relevant. The EU Directive leaves this particular risk question to national law.
returns-montredo-own-carrier-risk.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer timely withdraws from an ordinary, unpersonalised watch purchase. They pay an established carrier for an appropriately insured return, pack the watch safely, address it correctly, and prove proper timely dispatch. The only departure from the shop’s process is using their own carrier and label. If the package is accidentally lost without consumer fault, German statutory law places that transit risk on MONTREDO; the missing MONTREDO label does not by itself reverse it.
returns-montredo-own-carrier-risk.context: The policy explicitly covers the consumer’s 14-day statutory withdrawal, then makes label use relevant to return costs and, in § 6, to loss/damage risk. The AGB § 10 grants statutory withdrawal and contains the usual repayment and dispatch-proof terms; the FAQ offers free insured DHL/FedEx collection. Those broader rights and the collection option are counterevidence, but neither states that § 6 is confined to a voluntary late return. This finding addresses legal risk allocation, not whether MONTREDO’s own insurance covers another carrier or whether an optional free-return arrangement covers postage.
returns-montredo-own-carrier-risk.scope: German consumer statutory withdrawal from ordinary, unpersonalised online goods purchases, with proper proven dispatch, safe packing, correct address and reasonable care. returns-dropsize-underwear-intact-seal.law: Section 8 names underwear and boxer shorts, cites BGB §312g(2) no.3, and says no withdrawal right exists even if the article appears unopened or unworn. The reference to apparent condition does not establish whether an actual hygiene seal was removed. But the section gives a blanket category exclusion without making actual seal removal a condition. That exception requires qualifying sealed goods and removal of the seal after delivery, so it cannot defeat an otherwise eligible consumer’s withdrawal where the goods are in fact unopened and any hygiene seal is intact. Whether particular unsealed intimate products satisfy the exception is not decided here.
returns-dropsize-underwear-intact-seal.example: Hypothetical: A German consumer orders standard boxer shorts online, receives them and gives clear notice of withdrawal after five days. The packaging is unopened, the goods unused and any hygiene seal intact. Assuming no other statutory exception, the category alone cannot defeat withdrawal.
returns-dropsize-underwear-intact-seal.context: The current footer-linked AGB section 8 is headed Hinweis zum Widerruf – Ausschluss von Unterwäsche / Boxershorts. It cites the statutory hygiene exception and gives a category exclusion even where an article appears unopened or unworn. The separate withdrawal notice correctly requires actual removal of a seal after delivery, creating a material contradiction. The standard two-pack product also has a general FAQ saying unworn articles can be returned within 14 days. The AGB display an old 27 October 2020 update label; current retrieval and linking do not prove recent editorial review.
returns-dropsize-underwear-intact-seal.scope: German consumer online purchases of standard underwear, with timely withdrawal, intact seals and no other exception. No conclusion about worn or unsealed goods, actual refusals or consumer loss.

If you withdraw from this contract, we refund all payments received from you, including delivery costs (except additional costs resulting from your choosing a delivery method different from the standard delivery offered by us).

returns-pp-berlin-refund-clock-after-goo.law: BGB § 355(3) and § 357(1) set the trader’s latest repayment point at 14 days after it receives the withdrawal notice. Under § 357(4), unless collection was offered, the trader may withhold repayment until it receives the goods or dispatch evidence, whichever occurs first. Receiving or inspecting the returned goods does not start a new 14 day period. Repayment must still be without undue delay.
returns-pp-berlin-refund-clock-after-goo.example: Hypothetical: a German consumer sends a valid statutory withdrawal notice for an ordinary online goods contract. The seller receives that notice on day 1 and the undamaged returned goods on day 3. The statutory maximum is 14 days after receipt of the notice, with no continuing withholding ground. The policy instead states up to 14 days after day 3. Its separate average processing time of 5 working days does not correct that stated maximum.
returns-pp-berlin-refund-clock-after-goo.context: The current homepage links this statutory withdrawal notice. Its first section expressly distinguishes legal 14 days from an additional voluntary 30 day return period. The full consequences section applies generally to withdrawal. The later complete processing section states an average 5 workingdays after goods receipt, retained as qualifying context; an average is not a correction of the stated outer deadline. The operational 30 day-return page is separately retained and not the basis of this statutory finding.
returns-pp-berlin-refund-clock-after-goo.scope: German consumer statutory withdrawal for ordinary goods; valid timelynotice and goods/dispatch evidence available before the original 14 day deadline, no collection/withholding issue, no voluntary-only extension or actual delayed payment claim.
