returns-tischlereijache-refund-after-con.quote:
5. Erstattung
Sobald die Rücksendung eingegangen und geprüft wurde, erfolgt die Rückerstattung innerhalb von maximal 14 Tagen nach Bestätigung der Rücksendung.
Die Erstattung erfolgt grundsätzlich über dasselbe Zahlungsmittel, das bei der ursprünglichen Bestellung verwendet wurde, sofern nichts anderes mit dem Kunden vereinbart wurde.
Im Falle eines Widerrufs können wir die Rückzahlung verweigern, bis wir die Ware zurückerhalten haben oder der Kunde einen Nachweis über die Rücksendung erbracht hat, je nachdem, welcher Zeitpunkt früher eintritt.
returns-tischlereijache-refund-after-con.tr:
5. Refund
Once the return has arrived and been checked, the refund is made within a maximum of 14 days after confirmation of the return.
Refund is normally made through the same payment method used for the original order unless something else is agreed with the customer.
In the event of withdrawal, we may withhold repayment until we have received the goods or the customer has supplied proof of return dispatch, whichever occurs first.
returns-tischlereijache-refund-after-con.law: BGB § 355(3) and § 357(1) set the trader’s latest repayment point at 14 days after it receives the withdrawal notice. Under § 357(4), unless collection was offered, the trader may withhold repayment until it receives the goods or dispatch evidence, whichever occurs first. Receiving or inspecting the returned goods does not start a new 14 day period. Repayment must still be without undue delay.
returns-tischlereijache-refund-after-con.example: Hypothetical: a German consumer sends a valid statutory withdrawal notice which the seller receives on day 1 for an ordinary nonpersonalised catalogue item. The seller receives, checks and confirms the intact return on day 3. The legal 14 day maximum runs from the notice, while the policy gives 14 days after its day 3 confirmation. No remaining withholding ground creates a new 14 day clock.
returns-tischlereijache-refund-after-con.context: The current homepage directly links this policy. The September 2026 AGB expressly cover consumer and business orders and refer consumer statutory withdrawal to this policy. The policy’s complete § 1 identifies the legal 14 day right; § 5 itself expressly addresses withdrawal and accurately states the goods-or-dispatch-evidence withholding option. That option is retained and does not create a fresh 14 days after checking/confirmation. A longer 30 day return-dispatch instruction elsewhere is not itself challenged.
returns-tischlereijache-refund-after-con.scope: Germany-governed consumer withdrawal from ordinary eligible goods, not business orders, genuinely customised goods, defect remedies or a voluntary-only return. Notice and returned goods/evidence arrive before the original 14 day maximum. No actual transaction, entity verification or payment delay inferred.

returns-trigema-further-use-refusal.quote:
Wenn Sie die zurückgesendeten Produkte bereits bezahlt haben, schreiben wir Ihnen den entsprechenden Betrag umgehend wieder gut.
Zurückgesendete Ware wird nur akzeptiert, wenn diese sich in einem neuen und unbenutzten Zustand befindet und mit den Original-Etiketten versehen ist.
Bei einer Beeinträchtigung der Ware durch einen weitergehenden Gebrauch behalten wir uns vor, die Ware nicht zurückzunehmen und entsprechend in Rechnung zu stellen.
Wir behalten uns die Rückzahlung vor, bis wir die Waren wieder zurückerhalten haben oder bis Sie den Nachweis erbracht haben, dass Sie die Waren zurückgesandt haben, je nachdem, welche Bedingung zuerst erfüllt ist.
returns-trigema-further-use-refusal.tr:
If you have already paid for the returned products, we credit the corresponding amount back without delay.
Returned goods are accepted only if they are in new and unused condition and have the original labels attached.
If the goods are impaired through further use, we reserve the right not to take the goods back and to invoice accordingly.
We reserve repayment until we have received the goods back or you have supplied proof that you sent them back, whichever condition is met first.
returns-trigema-further-use-refusal.law: For a German consumer’s statutory withdrawal from ordinary goods, use beyond necessary examination can create liability for actual diminished value under BGB §357a(1), provided the required withdrawal information was given. Such use does not itself end the right to withdraw. BGB §361(1)–(2) prevents additional adverse withdrawal consequences beyond the statutory scheme. The current separate formal notice correctly describes value-loss liability; the service guide also states that the goods may be refused.
returns-trigema-further-use-refusal.example: Hypothetical: a German consumer timely withdraws from an online purchase of an ordinary, nonpersonalised T-shirt. After wearing it for a day, they return it within the statutory dispatch period. Assume proper withdrawal information and a measurable loss of value, with the shirt still worth more than zero. The seller may claim the actual loss of value; the extra use does not itself remove the consumer’s withdrawal right.
returns-trigema-further-use-refusal.context: The current homepage links both the service guide and the formal withdrawal notice. The guide’s Germany section concerns returns within 14 days of receipt and does not label the disputed refusal as a separate voluntary return benefit. Its preceding refund sentence and following lawful goods-or-proof withholding rule are retained. The formal notice expressly applies to consumers and correctly preserves withdrawal with diminished-value liability, creating a published inconsistency. The complete personalisation and unsealed hygiene exceptions are retained separately. No allegation is made about the EUR 2.50 label contribution, other countries, exchange-only requests or genuinely excluded goods.
returns-trigema-further-use-refusal.scope: Germany; statutory consumer withdrawal for ordinary goods, properly notified and returned; positive remaining value after actual use beyond examination. No actual refused return or financial loss is inferred.

returns-kukkamari-contract-start.law: BGB §355(2) gives a default start at contract conclusion only where no special rule applies. For an ordinary consumer distance sale of goods, §356(2)(1)(a) instead starts the period when the consumer or their designated non-carrier third party receives the goods. Section 356(3) additionally requires proper withdrawal information. The source quotes its AGB, which expressly permit acceptance before delivery; contract acceptance cannot replace the statutory receipt trigger.
returns-kukkamari-contract-start.example: Hypothetical: an online seller expressly accepts a German consumer’s order for an ordinary stock mug on day 1. The consumer receives the mug on day 5 and sends an unequivocal withdrawal email on day 17. Assume no special exception and no earlier consumer possession. That is within 14 days after receipt, even though more than 14 days have passed since acceptance. Any separate consequence of inadequate information is not needed for this comparison.
returns-kukkamari-contract-start.context: Current homepage and customer-information navigation directly link the withdrawal notice and AGB. The complete notice paragraph and declaration instructions are retained; the referenced AGB §2(1)–(3) distinguish order acknowledgment from acceptance and permit an express acceptance declaration. The shop sells ordinary mugs and other physical household goods. The finding concerns a German consumer’s distance purchase, not digital content, services, foreign delivery exclusions or withdrawal before delivery.
returns-kukkamari-contract-start.scope: Germany; ordinary single-delivery, nonpersonalised physical goods bought at a distance by a consumer. No finding about an actual transaction or a guaranteed extended period from defective information.

§ 2 Zustandekommen des Vertrages
(1) Die Präsentation der Waren im Internet-Shop stellt kein bindendes Angebot des Anbieters auf Abschluss eines Kaufvertrages dar. Der Kunde wird hierdurch lediglich aufgefordert, durch eine Bestellung ein Angebot abzugeben.
(2) Durch das Absenden der Bestellung im Internet-Shop gibt der Kunde ein verbindliches Angebot gerichtet auf den Abschluss eines Kaufvertrages über die im Warenkorb enthaltenen Waren ab. Mit dem Absenden der Bestellung erkennt der Kunde auch diese Geschäftsbedingungen als für das Rechtsverhältnis mit dem Anbieter allein maßgeblich an.
(3) Der Anbieter bestätigt den Eingang der Bestellung des Kunden durch Versendung einer Bestätigungs-E-Mail. Diese Bestellbestätigung stellt noch nicht die Annahme des Vertragsangebotes durch den Anbieter dar. Sie dient lediglich der Information des Kunden, dass die Bestellung beim Anbieter eingegangen ist. Die Erklärung der Annahme des Vertragsangebotes erfolgt durch die Auslieferung der Ware oder eine ausdrückliche Annahmeerklärung.

Exchanges and returns for online shop purchases
You can exchange or return your order up to 14 days after receipt. You are credited the full order amount including shipping costs, provided the entire order is returned. Only the cost of returning from your home address to us is at your expense. Please note: Dress for less / outlet / sale items are not exchanged or taken back!

returns-dresses-boutique-sale-exclusion.law: Dutch Civil Code 6:230 o(1)(b) provides the ordinary distance-sale withdrawal right from goods receipt;6:230 p lists specific exceptions. A reduced price or sale/outlet label alone is not an exception. Eligible ordinary stock clothing remains subject to statutory withdrawal. Directive 2011/83/EU Articles 9 and 16 set the corresponding framework. Return postage, actual diminished value and genuine customised or unsealed unsuitable hygiene goods remain separate.
returns-dresses-boutique-sale-exclusion.example: Hypothetical: a Dutch consumer buys an ordinary ready-made dress online at a reduced price, without individual alterations or personalisation. It is not an excluded hygiene product. The consumer timely declares statutory withdrawal and returns the unused dress within the applicable dispatch period. The discount alone does not remove withdrawal. No actual refusal or entitlement under a separate voluntary exchange policy is inferred.
returns-dresses-boutique-sale-exclusion.context: The current homepage directly links the online-purchase returns guide, dated 8 August 2026. It expressly distinguishes physical-store conditions elsewhere. The full governing first item retains refund/delivery costs and return postage; its sale exclusion is repeated under online return rules. Complete current separate AGB exceptions and the operational rules, including actual diminished value and special-product exceptions, are retained. No allegation is made about an in-store purchase or the listed special goods. The currently linked AGB bear version 19 June 2023; current availability is not described as a new 2026 editorial revision.
returns-dresses-boutique-sale-exclusion.scope: Dutch consumer statutory withdrawal for ordinary eligible nonpersonalised clothing bought at a distance. Sale status alone is the challenged reason. returns-dresses-boutique-arrival-fourtee.law: Dutch Civil Code 6:230 o(1)(b), (3) provides the ordinary 14-day period after goods receipt to declare withdrawal. Under 6:230 s(1), unless the trader offered collection, the consumer then sends back the goods without undue delay and within 14 days after the declaration. Directive 2011/83/EU Article 14(1) expressly treats timely dispatch as meeting the deadline. The seller need not receive the return within 14 days after the original delivery. Return postage and proof of sending are separate.
returns-dresses-boutique-arrival-fourtee.example: Hypothetical: a Dutch consumer receives an ordinary stock dress on day 1, sends an unequivocal statutory withdrawal notice on day 13, and dispatches the unused dress on day 20. The seller receives it on day 22. Assume ordinary eligibility, adequate notice, correct packaging/address, paid return postage and dispatch proof. Withdrawal and return dispatch are timely, although arrival is later than 14 days after original delivery. The shop’s stated arrival cutoff would refuse this return.

returns-dresses-boutique-payment-start.claim: starts the goods withdrawal period on the day the order is paid.
returns-dresses-boutique-payment-start.quote:
ARTIKEL 5 HERROEPINGSRECHT
Bij levering van producten:
1. Bij de aankoop van producten heeft de consument de mogelijkheid de overeenkomst zonder opgave van redenen te ontbinden gedurende 14 dagen. Deze termijn gaat in op de dag van betaling van de bestelling door of namens de consument.
2. Tijdens deze termijn zal de consument zorgvuldig omgaan met het product en de verpakking. Hij zal het product slechts in die mate uitpakken of gebruiken voor zover dat nodig is om te kunnen beoordelen of hij het product wenst te behouden. Indien hij van zijn herroepingsrecht gebruik maakt, zal hij het product met alle geleverde toebehoren en – indien redelijkerwijze mogelijk – in de originele staat en verpakking aan de ondernemer retourneren, conform de door de ondernemer verstrekte redelijke en duidelijke instructies. Bij levering van diensten:
3. Bij levering van diensten heeft de consument de mogelijkheid de overeenkomst zonder opgave van redenen te ontbinden gedurende ten minste 14 dagen, ingaande op de dag van het aangaan der overeenkomst (bij betaling).
4. Om gebruik te maken van zijn herroepingsrecht, zal de consument zich richten naar de door de ondernemer bij het aanbod en/of uiterlijk bij de levering ter zake verstrekte redelijke en duidelijke instructies.
returns-dresses-boutique-payment-start.tr:
ARTICLE5 RIGHT OF WITHDRAWAL
For delivery of products:
1. When buying products, the consumer can withdraw without giving reasons for 14 days. This period starts on the day of payment of the order by or for the consumer.
2. During this period the consumer must handle the product and packaging carefully and unpack or use it only as necessary to assess whether to keep it. If withdrawing, the consumer must return it with all supplied accessories and, where reasonably possible, in the original condition and packaging, in accordance with the trader’s reasonable and clear instructions. For delivery of services:
3. For services, the consumer can withdraw without giving reasons for at least 14 days, starting on contract conclusion (on payment).
4. To exercise withdrawal, the consumer must follow the trader’s reasonable and clear instructions supplied with the offer or at the latest on delivery.
returns-dresses-boutique-payment-start.law: For an ordinary Dutch consumer distance sale, Civil Code 6:230 o(1)(b)(1) starts the 14-day withdrawal period on receipt of the goods by the consumer or a designated third party other than the carrier. Payment does not start the goods period. Special delivery patterns and missing withdrawal information can affect the start or extension separately. The source’s Article 5 expressly applies its payment trigger to products, before its separate service provisions.
returns-dresses-boutique-payment-start.example: Hypothetical: a Dutch consumer pays for an ordinary online stock dress on day 1 and receives it on day 5. The consumer sends an unequivocal withdrawal notice on day 17. Assume no exception and no earlier possession. The notice is within 14 days after receipt, despite being more than 14 days after payment. No additional extension from defective information is needed for the comparison.
returns-dresses-boutique-payment-start.context: The current homepage footer links the AGB directly; the legal index also links them. Complete Article 5 includes product care, original-packaging where reasonably possible, and separate service rules. The current returns guide instead says 14 days after receipt; that material contrary wording is retained in full. The finding is the inconsistency in the products clause, not a claim that the trader’s entire website uses the payment trigger. The currently linked AGB bear version 19 June 2023; current availability is not described as a new 2026 editorial revision.
returns-dresses-boutique-payment-start.scope: Dutch consumer distance purchase of ordinary eligible physical goods. Not a services contract, shop purchase or customised-goods order. No actual withdrawal refusal or automatic extended legal period alleged.

The outer statutory refund period remains 14 days after notice, while the policy allows 30 days after that notice. No actual late payment is alleged.

returns-clothes-to-me-sale-exclusion.quote:

returns-clothes-to-me-sale-exclusion.tr:
Returns are made only after contacting customer service by email. Returns for any reason are at the customer’s expense and must be sent to Rue du Temple 65B, 7011 Ghlin, addressed to Hélène Caufriez.
Promotional, clearance/outlet or sale items are neither exchangeable nor refundable. Accessories such as tights, belts and jewellery are not taken back or exchanged for hygiene reasons, nor are care products, body perfumes or home fragrances.
returns-clothes-to-me-sale-exclusion.law: Belgian Code of Economic Law ArticleVI.47 grants the ordinary distance-sale withdrawal right, subject to the specific exceptions inVI.53. Reduced prices, clearance and sale labels are not exceptions by themselves. Ordinary stock clothing remains eligible. Genuine customisation or unsuitable unsealed hygiene goods are separateVI.53 exceptions; they do not justify excluding every discounted item. Directive 2011/83/EU Articles 9 and 16 provide the corresponding framework.
returns-clothes-to-me-sale-exclusion.example: Hypothetical: a Belgian consumer buys an ordinary ready-made jacket online at a reduced price, with no personalisation or alterations. It is not a hygiene product or another statutory exception. The consumer timely declares withdrawal and returns it unused within the statutory dispatch period. The sale label alone does not remove withdrawal. No in-store purchase or actual refused refund is assumed.
returns-clothes-to-me-sale-exclusion.context: The current homepage directly links the return policy and general sales conditions. The shop identifies itself as the online shop of Chic Madame in Ghlin, Belgium; its CGV choose Belgian law. The policy expressly grants statutory fourteen-calendar-day withdrawal without reasons or penalties. The complete CGV Article XIII repeats the policy’s refund and administrative-fee wording; its full unit is retained as context. This is current availability, not a claim of a newly edited 2026 policy. No actual customer transaction, refusal or intent is inferred. The separate nearby hygiene exclusion is retained verbatim but is not another finding here. The example uses an ordinary jacket rather than tights, belts, jewellery, perfumes or cosmetics.
returns-clothes-to-me-sale-exclusion.scope: Belgian consumer statutory withdrawal for ordinary discounted stock clothing bought online. No challenge to all special-product categories, in-store exchange rules or a genuinely voluntary-only return benefit.

mobile-de-vodafone-outage-working-days.claim: Delays complete-outage compensation by counting working days
mobile-de-vodafone-outage-working-days.quote: Der Kunde kann von Vodafone verlangen, dass eine Störung seiner vertraglich vereinbarten Telekommunikationsdienste unverzüglich und unentgeltlich beseitigt wird, es sei denn, der Kunde hat diese selbst zu vertreten. Dies gilt nicht für nummernunabhängige inter personelle Telekommunikationsdienste oder die Bereitstellung von Übertragungsdiensten für Dienste der Maschine-Maschine-Kommunikation. Der Kunde hat bei der Entstörung eine Mitwirkungspflicht. Meldet der Kunde Vodafone eine Störung der vertraglich vereinbarten Telekommunikationsdienste gem. Satz 1 und wird diese nicht innerhalb von zwei Arbeitstagen nach Eingang der Störungsmeldung des Kunden beseitigt, kann der Kunde ab dem Folgetag eine Entschädigung verlangen, es sei denn, er hat die Störung zu vertreten. Eine Entschädigung kann beginnend mit dem dritten Arbeitstag pro Tag des vollständigen Ausfalls des Dienstes verlangt werden. Die Höhe der Entschädigung beträgt am dritten und vierten Tag 5 € oder 10 % und ab dem fünften Tag 10 € oder 20 % der vertraglich vereinbarten Monatsentgelte bei Verträgen mit gleichbleibendem monatlichem Entgelt, je nachdem, welcher Betrag höher ist. Beruht die vollständige Unterbrechung des Dienstes auf gesetzlich festgelegten Maßnahmen nach dem Telekommunikationsgesetz, der Verordnung (EU)2015/2120 oder sicherheitsbehördlichen Anordnungen, steht dem Kunden eine Entschädigung nicht zu.
mobile-de-vodafone-outage-working-days.tr: The customer may require Vodafone to remedy a fault in the contractually agreed telecommunications services without delay and free of charge, unless the customer is responsible. This does not apply to number-independent interpersonal telecommunications services or transmission services for machine-to-machine communication. The customer must cooperate with fault repair. If the customer reports a fault in the services under sentence 1 and it is not remedied within two working days after receipt of the fault report, the customer may demand compensation from the following day, unless responsible for the fault. Compensation may be demanded from the third working day for each day of complete failure of the service. Compensation on the third and fourth days is €5 or 10%, and from the fifth day €10 or 20% of the contractually agreed monthly charges for contracts with a fixed monthly charge, whichever is higher. No compensation is due where the complete interruption results from statutory measures under the Telecommunications Act, Regulation (EU)2015/2120 or security-authority orders.
mobile-de-vodafone-outage-working-days.law: TKG § 58(3) starts compensation after two calendar days following receipt of the fault report, for each further day of complete failure of the service. For contracts with a fixed monthly charge, days 3–4 pay the higher of €5 or 10% of that charge; from day 5, the higher of €10 or 20%. Consumer responsibility, statutory measures, security orders and force majeure are excluded. Related price reductions and damages are offset. The clause substitutes working days for calendar days, delaying eligibility across weekends or holidays. The amount formula itself is not challenged.
mobile-de-vodafone-outage-working-days.example: Hypothetical: a consumer on a fixed €30 monthly plan reports complete failure of a covered service on Friday; the provider receives the report that day and the service stays completely unavailable through Tuesday. Counting the next two calendar days as Saturday and Sunday, Monday is the first compensable day (€5), subject to no statutory exclusion and offset. Counting Monday and Tuesday as the two working days defers the first payment day until Wednesday.
mobile-de-vodafone-outage-working-days.context: Full clause2.6 retained. Ordinary mobile voice/data contracts are included; this is distinct from temporary poor signal in one location or interrupted switching.
mobile-de-vodafone-outage-working-days.scope: Only actual complete failure of a covered consumer service lasting past the statutory two-calendar-day period after receipt of a report. Consumer responsibility, statutory measures, security orders, force majeure, sufficient replacement service and offset rules must be considered. Worked amount is for fixed monthly charge, not pure usage-credit prepaid. General terms share material wording across Vodafone, SIMon, otelo and LIDL Connect; this is one policy family published for four cohort brands.

mobile-de-freenet-outage-working-days.tr: 11.3 In the event of complete failure of the service, the customer may demand compensation from the third working day on which the fault could not be resolved, unless the consumer is responsible for the fault or its continuation, or the complete interruption of the service is due to statutory measures under the Telecommunications Act (TKG), Regulation (EU) 2015/2120, security-authority orders or force majeure. The compensation is €5 or 10 percent on the third and fourth day and €10 or 20 percent from the fifth day of the contractually agreed monthly charges for contracts with a constant monthly charge, whichever amount is higher. If the customer claims a reduction under section 12, that reduction is offset against compensation under this section.
mobile-de-freenet-outage-working-days.law: TKG §58(3) permits compensation if the fault is not remedied within two calendar days after receipt of the fault report, for each subsequent day of complete service failure. It uses calendar days, not working days. Days 3–4 are the higher of €5 or 10% of the fixed monthly charge; day 5 onward the higher of €10 or 20%. The consumer-responsibility, statutory/security measures and force-majeure exclusions apply; reductions and overlapping damages are offset.
mobile-de-freenet-outage-working-days.example: Hypothetical: a consumer pays a constant €30/month; freenet receives a fault report on Thursday and the relevant mobile service remains completely unavailable through Sunday, with no sufficient replacement and none of the statutory exclusions. After the two calendar days following receipt, Sunday is a compensable day at €5 (higher than €3). A third-working-day trigger can postpone that entitlement beyond Sunday. No double recovery is assumed.
mobile-de-freenet-outage-working-days.context: Current download hub links June2026 Credit and Prepaid originals. Credit11.2 discusses report receipt/response;11.3 supplies the working-day trigger and correct amounts/exclusions. This is not the distinct switching-outage provision in10.3, which lawfully uses working days.
mobile-de-freenet-outage-working-days.scope: Complete failure of the relevant consumer service continuing after two calendar days following receipt of a fault report, subject to statutory exclusions and offsets. Main worked amount concerns constant monthly charge postpaid contracts. Prepaid text repeats the timing wording; no fictional monthly charge is assigned to pure usage credit or 28-day bundles. This assesses wording, not actual refusals or payment.

mobile-de-simon-outage-working-days.claim: Delays complete-outage compensation by counting working days
mobile-de-simon-outage-working-days.quote: Der Kunde kann von Vodafone verlangen, dass eine Störung seiner vertraglich vereinbarten Telekommunikationsdienste unverzüglich und unentgeltlich beseitigt wird, es sei denn, der Kunde hat diese selbst zu vertreten. Dies gilt nicht für nummernunabhängige inter personelle Telekommunikationsdienste oder die Bereitstellung von Übertragungsdiensten für Dienste der Maschine-Maschine-Kommunikation. Der Kunde hat bei der Entstörung eine Mitwirkungspflicht. Meldet der Kunde Vodafone eine Störung der vertraglich vereinbarten Telekommunikationsdienste gem. Satz 1 und wird diese nicht innerhalb von zwei Arbeitstagen nach Eingang der Störungsmeldung des Kunden beseitigt, kann der Kunde ab dem Folgetag eine Entschädigung verlangen, es sei denn, er hat die Störung zu vertreten. Eine Entschädigung kann beginnend mit dem dritten Arbeitstag pro Tag des vollständigen Ausfalls des Dienstes verlangt werden. Die Höhe der Entschädigung beträgt am dritten und vierten Tag 5 € oder 10 % und ab dem fünften Tag 10 € oder 20 % der vertraglich vereinbarten Monatsentgelte bei Verträgen mit gleichbleibendem monatlichem Entgelt, je nachdem, welcher Betrag höher ist. Beruht die vollständige Unterbrechung des Dienstes auf gesetzlich festgelegten Maßnahmen nach dem Telekommunikationsgesetz, der Verordnung (EU)2015/2120 oder sicherheitsbehördlichen Anordnungen, steht dem Kunden eine Entschädigung nicht zu.
mobile-de-simon-outage-working-days.tr: The customer may require Vodafone to remedy a fault in the contractually agreed telecommunications services without delay and free of charge, unless the customer is responsible. This does not apply to number-independent interpersonal telecommunications services or transmission services for machine-to-machine communication. The customer must cooperate with fault repair. If the customer reports a fault in the services under sentence 1 and it is not remedied within two working days after receipt of the fault report, the customer may demand compensation from the following day, unless responsible for the fault. Compensation may be demanded from the third working day for each day of complete failure of the service. Compensation on the third and fourth days is €5 or 10%, and from the fifth day €10 or 20% of the contractually agreed monthly charges for contracts with a fixed monthly charge, whichever is higher. No compensation is due where the complete interruption results from statutory measures under the Telecommunications Act, Regulation (EU)2015/2120 or security-authority orders.
mobile-de-simon-outage-working-days.law: TKG § 58(3) starts compensation after two calendar days following receipt of the fault report, for each further day of complete failure of the service. For contracts with a fixed monthly charge, days 3–4 pay the higher of €5 or 10% of that charge; from day 5, the higher of €10 or 20%. Consumer responsibility, statutory measures, security orders and force majeure are excluded. Related price reductions and damages are offset. The clause substitutes working days for calendar days, delaying eligibility across weekends or holidays. The amount formula itself is not challenged.
mobile-de-simon-outage-working-days.example: Hypothetical: a consumer on a fixed €30 monthly plan reports complete failure of a covered service on Friday; the provider receives the report that day and the service stays completely unavailable through Tuesday. Counting the next two calendar days as Saturday and Sunday, Monday is the first compensable day (€5), subject to no statutory exclusion and offset. Counting Monday and Tuesday as the two working days defers the first payment day until Wednesday.
mobile-de-simon-outage-working-days.context: Full clause2.6 retained. Ordinary mobile voice/data contracts are included; this is distinct from temporary poor signal in one location or interrupted switching.
mobile-de-simon-outage-working-days.scope: Only actual complete failure of a covered consumer service lasting past the statutory two-calendar-day period after receipt of a report. Consumer responsibility, statutory measures, security orders, force majeure, sufficient replacement service and offset rules must be considered. Worked amount is for fixed monthly charge, not pure usage-credit prepaid. General terms share material wording across Vodafone, SIMon, otelo and LIDL Connect; this is one policy family published for four cohort brands.

mobile-de-otelo-portability-old-provider.claim: Says the old operator may charge for number portability
mobile-de-otelo-portability-old-provider.quote: Für die Mitnahme der Rufnummer zur Nutzung mit otelo wird kein Entgelt erhoben. Der abgebende Netzbetreiber kann aber ein Entgelt für die Rufnummernmitnahme erheben. Sofern die Rufnummer vor Beendigung des bislang beim abgebenden Anbieter bestehenden Mobilfunk-Dienstleistungsvertrages portiert wird, hat dieses auf den Bestand des bestehenden Vertrages zwischen dem Kunden und dem bisherigen Anbieter keinen Einfluss. Dieser bleibt bestehen.
mobile-de-otelo-portability-old-provider.tr: No charge is made for transferring the number for use with otelo. However, the relinquishing network operator may charge a fee for number portability. If the number is ported before the existing mobile service contract with the relinquishing provider ends, this has no effect on the existing contract between the customer and their previous provider. That contract continues.
mobile-de-otelo-portability-old-provider.law: TKG § 59(5)–(7): mobile numbers may be ported before the old contract ends; a request remains possible until one month after termination. Early porting does not end the old contract or its payment obligations. No direct charges may be imposed on the end user for porting. The footnote is about ordinary German mobile porting into otelo; its permission for the relinquishing operator to charge a porting fee conflicts with the prohibition on direct customer porting charges. Continuing contract payments are separate and accurately preserved.
mobile-de-otelo-portability-old-provider.example: Hypothetical: a German consumer transfers a mobile number from another German operator to otelo while the old fixed-term contract continues. The old monthly charges remain payable, but the old provider cannot charge an additional €10 porting fee; the footnote says such a fee may be imposed.
mobile-de-otelo-portability-old-provider.context: Footnote14 read in full, including continuing old-contract obligation. Price table and adjacent early-port terms read.
mobile-de-otelo-portability-old-provider.scope: Direct customer fees for ordinary German mobile number portability; not outstanding old-contract bills, device instalments or a distinct voluntary number-change service. Incoming portability text attributes possible fees to another operator; it does not prove otelo actually bills such a fee.

pflege-de-kkh-advice.claim: Prescribes quarterly advice visits for care grades 4 and 5 in a currently linked brochure
pflege-de-kkh-advice.quote:
Der Anspruch auf Pflegegeld ist mit regelmäßigen Pflegepflichteinsätzen (Beratungsbesuche) durch professionelle Pflegefachkräfte verbunden.

Für Pflegebedürftige der Pflegegrade 2 und 3 sind sie halbjährlich, für Pflegebedürftige der Pflegegrade 4 und 5 vierteljährlich vorgeschrieben. Pflegebedürftige des Pflegegrades 1 können den Beratungsbesuch halbjährlich in Anspruch nehmen.
pflege-de-kkh-advice.tr:
Entitlement to care allowance is linked to regular compulsory care visits (advisory visits) by professional care staff.

For people in care grades 2 and 3 these are prescribed every half-year; for people in care grades 4 and 5 they are prescribed quarterly. People in care grade 1 may use the advisory visit every half-year.
pflege-de-kkh-advice.law: Since 1 January 2026, §37(3) SGB XI requires recipients of Pflegegeld in care grades 2–5 to obtain advice once per half-year. People in grades 4 and 5 may additionally use quarterly advice; it is optional. The brochure prescribes quarterly visits for grades 4 and 5, carrying forward the previous compulsory frequency. The linked KKH webpage gives the current half-yearly requirement, so the finding concerns inconsistent currently offered guidance.
pflege-de-kkh-advice.example: Hypothetical: A KKH member with care grade 4 receives only Pflegegeld and has one qualifying advice visit in each half of 2026. The statutory compulsory frequency is met even without four visits that year. This example assumes the visits and other Pflegegeld conditions are valid.
pflege-de-kkh-advice.context: A currently offered publication is assessed as at 25 October 2026. The live Pflegegeld page links this exact PDF under Downloads/Leistungen der KKH-Pflegekasse. The webpage correctly states half-yearly advice; that counterevidence is retained.
pflege-de-kkh-advice.scope: Recipients of Pflegegeld in care grades 4–5; compulsory visit frequency after 1 January 2026; brochure currently linked from the KKH Pflegegeld webpage.

pflege-de-dak-advice.claim: Requires one advice visit per calendar quarter for care grades 4 and 5
pflege-de-dak-advice.quote: Wenn Sie ausschließlich Pflegegeld erhalten, müssen Sie in bestimmten zeitlichen Abständen eine Beratung (häuslicher Beratungseinsatz) durch einen zugelassenen Pflegedienst oder eine anerkannte Beratungsstelle nutzen. Beim Pflegegrad 2 und 3 ist das einmal im Kalenderhalbjahr, beim Pflegegrad 4 und 5 einmal im Kalendervierteljahr. Die Kosten übernimmt Ihre DAK-Gesundheit-PFLEGEKASSE. Diese gesetzliche Vorschrift zielt darauf ab, Sie und Ihre Pflegeperson zu unterstützen. Außerdem sollen mögliche Pflegefehler frühzeitig erkannt werden.
pflege-de-dak-advice.tr: If you receive only care allowance, you must use advice (a home advisory visit) from an approved care service or recognised advice centre at specified intervals. In care grades 2 and 3 this is once per calendar half-year; in care grades 4 and 5 it is once per calendar quarter. Your DAK-Gesundheit care insurance fund pays the costs. This statutory rule aims to support you and your caregiver. It also aims to identify possible care mistakes at an early stage.
pflege-de-dak-advice.law: Since 1 January 2026, §37(3) SGB XI requires recipients of Pflegegeld in care grades 2–5 to obtain advice once per half-year. People in grades 4 and 5 may additionally use quarterly advice; it is optional. The DAK information sheet expressly presents quarterly visits for grades 4 and 5 as compulsory.
pflege-de-dak-advice.example: Hypothetical: A DAK member with care grade 5 receives only Pflegegeld and obtains a qualifying advice visit in March and September 2026. The half-yearly compulsory frequency is met. Quarterly visits remain available voluntarily; other eligibility and proof requirements are assumed satisfied.
pflege-de-dak-advice.context: A currently offered publication is assessed as at 25 October 2026. The current downloads page, updated 1 October 2026, links this exact PDF as the information accompanying Antrag auf Pflegeleistungen. The PDF is image-only; the complete paragraph was read visually in a temporary rendering. The currently linked Pflege kompakt brochure page 10 gives the same old quarterly frequency. The short current FAQ says regular advice without specifying frequency.
pflege-de-dak-advice.scope: Current compulsory advice frequency for recipients of only Pflegegeld in care grades 4–5.

pflege-de-dak-relatives.src: Informationen über Leistungen der Pflegeversicherung (2026 download)
pflege-de-dak-relatives.claim: Lists €1,800 as the ordinary reimbursement amount for relative care in Pflegegrad 4, despite describing a two-month cap
pflege-de-dak-relatives.quote:
Verhinderungspflege: Voraussetzung für die Nutzung der Verhinderungspflege ist, dass die private Pflegeperson wegen Urlaub, Krankheit oder aus sonstigen Gründen an der Pflege gehindert ist. Die zeitweilige Pflege kann von Privatpersonen oder Pflegediensten durchgeführt werden. Für Angehörige bis zum 2. Grad sowie für Personen, die im gleichen Haushalt leben, gelten besondere Regelungen. Hier ist der maximale Erstattungsbetrag für die Verhinderungspflege auf das 2-fache* des monatlichen Pflegegeldes begrenzt. Zusätzlich notwendige Kosten für Verdienstausfall oder Fahrkosten können bis zu maximal 3539 Euro erstattet werden.

Pflegegrad | Erstattungsbetrag*
Pflegegrad 2 | 694 Euro
Pflegegrad 3 | 1.198 Euro
Pflegegrad 4 | 1.800 Euro
Pflegegrad 5 | 1.980 Euro
pflege-de-dak-relatives.tr:
Replacement care: Use of replacement care requires the private caregiver to be prevented from providing care because of holiday, illness or other reasons. Temporary care can be provided by private individuals or care services. Special rules apply to relatives up to the second degree and people living in the same household. Here the maximum reimbursement for replacement care is limited to twice* the monthly care allowance. Additional necessary costs for lost earnings or travel can be reimbursed up to a maximum of 3539 euros.

Care grade | Reimbursement amount*
Care grade 2 | 694 euros
Care grade 3 | 1,198 euros
Care grade 4 | 1,800 euros
Care grade 5 | 1,980 euros
pflege-de-dak-relatives.law: Under §39(3) SGB XI, noncommercial replacement care by relatives or in-laws within the second degree or household members normally has a cap equal to two months of the applicable Pflegegeld. Monthly Pflegegeld for grade 4 is €800 under §37(1), so the normal two-month amount is €1,600. Documented necessary expenses can be reimbursed above that amount, within the unused €3,539 shared annual budget; commercially provided care has a separate rule. The information sheet says twice the allowance but its grade 4 table gives €1,800. The other currently linked respite leaflet gives the correct €1,600.
pflege-de-dak-relatives.example: Hypothetical: In 2026 a care-grade 4 member uses noncommercial replacement care by an adult child. The member pays €1,800 for care, has no separately evidenced necessary travel costs or lost earnings, no circumstances departing from the normal cap, and an unused annual budget. The normal two-month amount is €1,600, so the table overstates that amount by €200. This does not predict the decision on a real claim.
pflege-de-dak-relatives.context: A currently offered publication is assessed as at 25 October 2026. Both PDFs are currently linked from the same downloads page. The disputed general PDF is image-only and was read visually. Its own Pflegegeld table on physical page 2 correctly lists €800 for grade 4. The specific respite leaflet lists €1,600. This is an internal numerical inconsistency, not evidence of a particular grant or refusal. The PDF uses asterisks after the twice-Pflegegeld statement and table heading, but no accompanying explanatory footnote was found on its six physical pages.
pflege-de-dak-relatives.scope: Ordinary noncommercial replacement care in care grade 4 by the specified close relatives, in-laws or household members; additional necessary expenses and commercial care are outside the disputed base amount.

pflege-de-aok-sachsen-anhalt-relatives.claim: Caps relatives’ replacement care including documented extra expenses at €1,685
pflege-de-aok-sachsen-anhalt-relatives.quote:
Gibt es einen Unterschied, ob mich der Pflegedienst oder eine Privatperson pflegt?

Ja. Der Pflegedienst und Privatpersonen, die nicht mit dem Pflegebedürftigen bis zum 2. Grad verwandt oder verschwägert sind, können für die Verhinderungspflege bis zu 3.539 Euro bei uns abrechnen.

Übernimmt eine private Person die Verhinderungspflege, die mit im Haushalt lebt oder mit dem Pflegebedürftigen bis zum 2. Grad verwandt oder verschwägert ist, erstatten wir die Kosten in Höhe des 2-fachen Pflegegeldes.

Weisen Sie zusätzliche Kosten wie Fahrkosten oder Verdienstausfälle nach, kann die Leistung bis auf maximal 1.685 Euro aufgestockt werden.
pflege-de-aok-sachsen-anhalt-relatives.tr:
Is there a difference between care by a care service and care by a private individual?

Yes. Care services and private individuals who are not related to the person needing care by blood or marriage up to the second degree can bill us for up to 3,539 euros for replacement care.

If a private individual who lives in the same household or is related to the person needing care by blood or marriage up to the second degree provides replacement care, we reimburse costs equal to twice the care allowance.

If you provide evidence of additional costs such as travel costs or lost earnings, the benefit can be topped up to a maximum of 1,685 euros.
pflege-de-aok-sachsen-anhalt-relatives.law: Under §39(3) SGB XI, noncommercial replacement care by close relatives, in-laws or household members normally has a two-month Pflegegeld cap. Documented necessary expenses may be reimbursed above that amount. The combined ceiling is the unused €3,539 shared annual budget under §42a, rather than €1,685. The FAQ correctly describes the two-month amount but then gives an obsolete €1,685 ceiling for additional expenses.
pflege-de-aok-sachsen-anhalt-relatives.example: Hypothetical: A person with Pflegegrad 3 needs replacement care in 2026. An adult child provides it noncommercially. The member properly evidences €1,198 for care and €800 in necessary travel costs or lost earnings, has an unused annual budget, and meets all other requirements. The total €1,998 is below the €3,539 ceiling. The FAQ’s €1,685 figure would suggest €313 less available. This illustrates wording and predicts no actual reimbursement decision.
pflege-de-aok-sachsen-anhalt-relatives.context: A currently offered publication is assessed as at 25 October 2026. Discovered through the national AOK portal’s Sachsen-Anhalt link to deine-gesundheitswelt.de, then Krankheit, Behandlung und Pflege > Verhinderungspflege. The same page’s introduction correctly gives the €3,539 common budget and the twice-Pflegegeld table. It does not elsewhere correct the specific €1,685 FAQ ceiling.
pflege-de-aok-sachsen-anhalt-relatives.scope: Documented necessary additional expenses for noncommercial replacement care by relatives or in-laws up to the second degree, or household members; within the unused common annual budget.

pflege-de-big-hospital.claim: Says Pflegegeld stops from the 29th hospital day
pflege-de-big-hospital.quote:
Wenn du ins Krankenhaus musst, wird das Pflegegeld nicht sofort gestrichen.

Grundsätzlich gilt:
• Für die ersten 28 Tage eines Krankenhausaufenthalts wird das Pflegegeld weitergezahlt.
• Ab dem 29. Tag ruht die Zahlung.

Der Hintergrund: Während des Klinikaufenthalts übernimmt das Krankenhaus die Versorgung. Nach deiner Entlassung lebt der Anspruch automatisch wieder auf.
Gut zu wissen: Informiere deine Pflegekasse über längere Krankenhausaufenthalte. So vermeidest du Rückfragen oder mögliche Rückforderungen.
pflege-de-big-hospital.tr:
If you have to go to hospital, Pflegegeld is not stopped immediately.

The general rule is:
• Pflegegeld continues for the first 28 days of a hospital stay.
• Payment is suspended from the 29th day.

The reason: the hospital provides care during the stay. Your entitlement automatically resumes after discharge.
Good to know: Inform your care insurance fund about longer hospital stays. This avoids queries or possible repayment demands.
pflege-de-big-hospital.law: Under §34(2) SGB XI, an existing entitlement to full Pflegegeld under §37 or proportionate Pflegegeld under §38 continues for the first eight weeks of qualifying fully inpatient hospital treatment. This replaced four weeks on 1 January 2026. People who employ special carers and receive the specified social assistance support can receive payment beyond eight weeks. The page instead says payment is suspended from day 29.
pflege-de-big-hospital.example: Hypothetical: A person already entitled to Pflegegeld receives six continuous weeks of qualifying inpatient hospital treatment in 2026. Assume ordinary statutory coverage and no separate entitlement problem. The page says payment stops after day 28; §34(2) preserves the existing payment throughout this six-week stay.
pflege-de-big-hospital.context: The hospital section is on the current general Pflegegeld benefit page. Its separate advice sections contain conflicting frequencies. The hospital statement has no date limiting it to care before 2026. This finding concerns published wording, not actual payment decisions.
pflege-de-big-hospital.scope: Existing Pflegegeld during qualifying fully inpatient hospital treatment in 2026. The separate half-rate rules for replacement care do not apply. The exception for people employing special carers with the specified social assistance support allows longer continuation; it does not justify suspension from day 29.

pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.src: IKK classic: Ihre Pflege. Unsere Unterstützung (current linked brochure)
pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.claim: Limits proportionate Pflegegeld during hospital treatment to four weeks
pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.quote:
Kombinationsleistung
Der in diesem Fall anteilige Betrag an Pflegegeld wird bei Unterbrechung durch stationäre Behandlung dann ebenfalls für vier Wochen fortgezahlt; bei Unterbrechung durch Verhinderungs- oder Kurzzeitpflege wird die Hälfte des zuvor gezahlten Pflegegeldes für acht Wochen weitergezahlt.
pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.tr:
Combination benefit
In this case, the proportionate amount of Pflegegeld also continues for four weeks when care is interrupted by inpatient treatment; when interrupted by replacement care or short-term residential care, half the previously paid Pflegegeld continues for eight weeks.
pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.law: From 1 January 2026, §34(2) SGB XI preserves both full Pflegegeld under §37 and proportionate Pflegegeld under §38 for the first eight weeks of qualifying fully inpatient hospital treatment. Combining Pflegegeld with care services does not reduce that period to four weeks. Longer continuation is possible for people who employ special carers and receive the specified social assistance support.
pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.example: Hypothetical: A person receives proportionate Pflegegeld as part of a combination benefit and spends six weeks in qualifying fully inpatient hospital treatment in 2026. Assume the payment entitlement otherwise continues. The combination row would end payment after four weeks; the statute preserves its existing proportionate level throughout the six weeks.
pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.context: The brochure is currently linked from the fund’s benefit page. In the same table the general hospital and rehabilitation row correctly says “bis zu 8 Wochen” and notes the exception for people who employ special carers with social assistance support. The specific combination row still says four weeks. The finding concerns that specific residual statement within conflicting guidance.
pflege-de-ikk-classic-hospital.scope: Proportionate Pflegegeld under §38 during qualifying inpatient hospital treatment in 2026. The same brochure gives the correct eight-week general rule; this finding is confined to the shorter period stated for combination benefits.

pflege-de-bahn-advice.claim: Requires quarterly advice visits for Pflegegrad 4 or 5
pflege-de-bahn-advice.quote:
Pflegebedürftige, die ihre Pflege selbst sicherstellen, müssen sich einmal halbjährlich - bei Pflegegrad 4 oder 5 einmal vierteljährlich - durch einen Pflegedienst beraten lassen. Die Kosten übernimmt die Pflegekasse.
Liegt der Pflegegrad 1 vor, kann pro Halbjahr ebenfalls ein Beratungseinsatz abgerufen werden. Dieser Beratungseinsatz ist freiwillig und kostenfrei.
pflege-de-bahn-advice.tr:
People needing care who ensure their own care must obtain advice from a care provider once every half-year—or once every quarter for Pflegegrad 4 or 5. The care insurance fund covers the cost.
A person with Pflegegrad 1 can also request an advice visit each half-year. That visit is voluntary and free.
pflege-de-bahn-advice.law: From 1 January 2026, §37(3) SGB XI requires people in Pflegegrade 2–5 receiving Pflegegeld without concurrent outpatient benefits in kind to obtain advice once per half-year. People in Pflegegrade 4 and 5 may choose quarterly advice, but the additional visits are voluntary. The page still says they must obtain advice every quarter. Recipients of outpatient benefits in kind, including ordinary combination benefits, have a voluntary advice entitlement. Section 45a(4) also applies the advice rules to conversion of the benefits-in-kind budget for recognised everyday support.
pflege-de-bahn-advice.example: Hypothetical: A person with Pflegegrad 4 receives only Pflegegeld and has a qualifying advice visit in February 2026. Assume care at home is otherwise ensured. That visit fulfils the statutory duty for January–June 2026; the page’s quarterly rule implies another compulsory visit in April–June.
pflege-de-bahn-advice.context: The current Pflegegeld page uses mandatory wording for the differentiated frequency. The immediately following paragraph expressly makes visits for Pflegegrad 1 voluntary, but adds no such qualification to quarterly visits for grades 4 and 5. Current benefit rates elsewhere on the page are €347, €599, €800 and €990.
pflege-de-bahn-advice.scope: Compulsory advice frequency under §37(3) for people in Pflegegrade 4–5 receiving Pflegegeld without concurrent outpatient benefits in kind from 1 January 2026. Quarterly advice remains available voluntarily; this finding concerns presenting it as mandatory.

pflege-de-bosch-relatives.quote: Wird die Verhinderungspflege von einer Person erbracht, die mit Dir bis zum zweiten Grade verwandt oder verschwägert ist oder mit Dir in häuslicher Gemeinschaft lebt, ist die Leistung auf das 2-fache Pflegegeld für im jeweiligen Pfleggrad begrenzt.
pflege-de-bosch-relatives.tr: If replacement care is provided by someone related to you by blood or marriage within the second degree, or who lives with you in the same household, the benefit is limited to twice the Pflegegeld for the relevant Pflegegrad.
pflege-de-bosch-relatives.law: Under §39(3) SGB XI, non-commercial replacement care by relatives or in-laws within the second degree, or household members, normally has a limit of two months of Pflegegeld. Documented necessary expenses connected with the care can be covered above that amount, with the combined reimbursement limited by the available shared annual budget of €3,539. Commercial care by those people can also use the shared budget. The page gives an unqualified cap of twice Pflegegeld.
pflege-de-bosch-relatives.example: Hypothetical: A person with Pflegegrad 3 receives non-commercial replacement care from their daughter. Assume €1,198 of eligible care costs and €100 of documented necessary travel costs, enough remaining shared budget, and all other conditions met. The statute permits covering the necessary expenses above €1,198; the page’s unqualified cap omits that possibility. This does not guarantee that every expense claim succeeds.
pflege-de-bosch-relatives.context: The preceding paragraph gives the €3,539 shared annual budget and Pflegegrad 2 eligibility; the following paragraphs concern hourly care and Pflegegeld continuation. No separate qualification allowing additional necessary expenses was located in this page or the bounded search of the fund’s site. Directly linked forms from Mobil and BAHN-BKK did supply such a qualification, and those apparent discrepancies were excluded.
pflege-de-bosch-relatives.scope: The express cap on non-commercial replacement care by the specified relatives or household members where documented necessary expenses arise. The finding does not rest only on omission of the less common commercial-care exception. It does not infer actual reimbursement decisions.

pflege-de-mkk-hospital.quote:
Wird Pflegegeld auch bei Krankenhausaufenthalt gezahlt ?
Die Zahlung ruht nach 28 Tagen stationärem Aufenthalt (z.B. Krankenhaus oder Reha).
pflege-de-mkk-hospital.tr:
Is Pflegegeld also paid during a hospital stay?
Payment is suspended after 28 days of inpatient treatment (for example hospital or rehabilitation).
pflege-de-mkk-hospital.law: Since 1 January 2026, §34(2) SGB XI continues an existing Pflegegeld entitlement for the first eight weeks of fully inpatient hospital treatment, at its existing full or proportionate level. Payment does not ordinarily stop after 28 days. The provision also allows continuation beyond eight weeks for the specified people employing special care workers under §63b(6), sentence 1, SGB XII.
pflege-de-mkk-hospital.example: Hypothetical: a person already receiving full Pflegegeld enters hospital for six weeks in October 2026. Assuming ordinary qualifying fully inpatient treatment and continuing insurance entitlement, Pflegegeld continues throughout those six weeks. The FAQ's 28-day rule would suggest payment stops during weeks five and six.
pflege-de-mkk-hospital.context: The question concerns the care recipient's own hospital admission. The distinct half-rate rule during replacement or short-term care does not set this hospital continuation period. No actual suspension or loss is alleged.
pflege-de-mkk-hospital.scope: Current German Pflegegeld FAQ; ordinary fully inpatient hospital treatment in 2026. The special employed-carer exception can extend payment further.

pflege-de-energie-hospital.claim: Limits ordinary hospital continuation of Pflegegeld to four weeks
pflege-de-energie-hospital.quote: Bei einer vollstationären Krankenhausbehandlung oder Aufnahme in eine Vorsorge- oder Rehabilitationseinrichtung wird das Pflegegeld für die ersten vier Wochen weitergezahlt. Danach ruht der Anspruch. In bestimmten Fällen – etwa bei beschäftigten Pflegekräften – gibt es Ausnahmen von dieser zeitlichen Begrenzung.
pflege-de-energie-hospital.tr: During fully inpatient hospital treatment or admission to a preventive or rehabilitation facility, Pflegegeld continues for the first four weeks. Entitlement is then suspended. In certain cases—for example where care workers are employed—there are exceptions to this time limit.
pflege-de-energie-hospital.law: Since 1 January 2026, §34(2) SGB XI continues existing Pflegegeld for the first eight weeks of fully inpatient hospital treatment. The existing full or proportionate level continues; four weeks is the old ordinary period. The quoted exception for employed care workers does not correct the ordinary limit, and the statutory special-care-worker exception can continue payment beyond eight weeks.
pflege-de-energie-hospital.example: Hypothetical: a person receiving full Pflegegeld spends six weeks in a qualifying hospital in October 2026. Assuming the normal conditions continue and no other suspension ground applies, the existing Pflegegeld continues for all six weeks. The published four-week rule would leave weeks five and six apparently unpaid.
pflege-de-energie-hospital.context: The page is labelled updated 25 September 2026 and presents the paragraph as a current benefit rule. It retains an exception for certain employed carers, which is preserved in the quotation. No decision on an actual claim is inferred.
pflege-de-energie-hospital.scope: Current benefit page; ordinary qualifying fully inpatient hospital admission from 1 January 2026. The existing level may be proportionate where the person receives combined benefits.

pflege-de-linde-relatives.claim: Makes twice Pflegegeld an absolute ceiling for replacement care by close relatives
pflege-de-linde-relatives.quote:
Wird die Ersatzpflege von Verwandten/Verschwägerten bis zum 2. Grad (Kinder, Enkelkinder, Eltern, Großeltern, Geschwister, Schwiegerkinder, Schwiegerenkel, Schwiegereltern, Schwager / Schwägerin, Großeltern des Ehegatten, Stiefeltern, Stiefgroßeltern, Stiefkinder, Stiefenkelkinder) übernommen, dürfen die Aufwendungen den 2 fachen Betrag des Pflegegeldes nicht übersteigen.
Unser Hinweis für Sie: Bei den 3.539 Euro handelt es sich um ein gemeinsames Jahresbudget der Kurzzeit- und der Verhinderungspflege. Die Leistungen werden aufeinander gerechnet und aus einem Budget finanziert.
pflege-de-linde-relatives.tr:
If replacement care is provided by relatives or relatives by marriage within the second degree (children, grandchildren, parents, grandparents, siblings, children-in-law, grandchildren-in-law, parents-in-law, brothers-/sisters-in-law, the spouse's grandparents, stepparents, stepgrandparents, stepchildren, stepgrandchildren), expenses may not exceed twice the Pflegegeld amount.
Our note for you: the €3,539 is a common annual budget for short-term and replacement care. The benefits count towards each other and are financed from one budget.
pflege-de-linde-relatives.law: For non-commercial replacement care by close relatives or household members, §39(3) SGB XI normally uses two months’ Pflegegeld as the reimbursement limit. It expressly allows proved necessary expenses above that amount, within the remaining common annual budget of up to €3,539. Saying expenses may not exceed twice Pflegegeld excludes that route. Commercial substitute care by the specified relatives or household members is governed by the common annual amount instead.
pflege-de-linde-relatives.example: Hypothetical: a Pflegegrad 2 recipient's sister supplies necessary non-commercial replacement care in October 2026 while the usual carer is on holiday. Assume €694 of eligible care compensation, €100 of necessary proved travel expenses, and enough shared budget remaining. Reimbursement of the additional expenses can take the total above €694; the page's absolute limit would exclude that possibility.
pflege-de-linde-relatives.context: The page correctly identifies the shared €3,539 budget in the adjoining note. The current linked application could not be retrieved by either researcher or reviewer, so possible qualifications in that form remain unresolved. This finding concerns only the webpage’s explicit statement that expenses may not exceed twice Pflegegeld; it does not assess claims handling.
pflege-de-linde-relatives.scope: Current benefit webpage; necessary non-commercial replacement care by close relatives, with proved additional expenses and sufficient unused annual budget. The current application could not be checked.

pflege-de-scheufelen-relatives.claim: Caps relatives’ replacement-care reimbursement at twice Pflegegeld
pflege-de-scheufelen-relatives.quote:
Welche Kosten übernehmen wir für Sie?
Es steht Ihnen ein großzügiger Jahresbetrag von 3.539 € zur Verfügung, den Sie flexibel für Kurzzeit- und Verhinderungspflege nutzen können. Dieser Betrag gilt für bis zu acht Wochen im Jahr und kann nach Bedarf auf beide Leistungen aufgeteilt werden – ganz nach Ihrer individuellen Situation. So sind Sie bestens abgesichert, egal ob es um eine vorübergehende stationäre Pflege oder die Unterstützung bei der Verhinderungspflege geht.
Für Ersatzpflegepersonen bis zum 2. Verwandtschaftsgrad verringert sich der Höchstanspruch, bis zum zweifachen Betrag des Pflegegeldes des jeweiligen Pflegegrades.
pflege-de-scheufelen-relatives.tr:
Which costs do we cover for you?
You have a generous annual amount of €3,539 available, which you can use flexibly for short-term and replacement care. This amount applies for up to eight weeks a year and can be divided between both benefits according to your needs and individual situation. You are thus well covered, whether for temporary residential care or support with replacement care.
For replacement carers related within the second degree, the maximum entitlement is reduced to twice the Pflegegeld amount for the relevant care grade.
pflege-de-scheufelen-relatives.law: For non-commercial replacement care by relatives within the second degree, §39(3) SGB XI normally uses two months’ Pflegegeld as the reimbursement limit. Proved necessary expenses may be reimbursed above that amount, within the remaining shared annual budget of up to €3,539. The webpage describes twice Pflegegeld as the reduced maximum entitlement without this qualification. Commercial replacement care by the specified relatives can instead be reimbursed within the common annual amount.
pflege-de-scheufelen-relatives.example: Hypothetical: a person with Pflegegrad 3 needs non-commercial replacement care from a daughter who is not the usual carer. Assume €1,198 of eligible care compensation, €100 of necessary proved travel expenses and sufficient shared annual budget remaining. The law allows consideration of the €100 above the ordinary two-month amount; describing €1,198 as the maximum would exclude it.
pflege-de-scheufelen-relatives.context: The adjoining €3,539 budget paragraph is retained. The current Download Center links a two-page application dated 23 February 2026; it asks about relatives and household membership but gives no additional-expense qualification. The finding concerns the webpage’s stated maximum, not the separate duration wording or an actual claim decision.
pflege-de-scheufelen-relatives.scope: Current additional-ambulant-benefits page; necessary non-commercial replacement care by a close relative with proved additional expenses and unused annual budget.

pflege-de-faber-relatives.src: BKK Faber-Castell & Partner — current linked Antrag Verhinderungspflege
pflege-de-faber-relatives.claim: Caps reimbursement of close relatives’ proved necessary expenses at €1,685
pflege-de-faber-relatives.quote: Bei einer Ersatzpflege durch Pflegepersonen, die mit dem Pflegebedürftigen bis zum zweiten Grade verwandt oder verschwägert sind, oder mit ihm in häuslicher Gemeinschaft leben, wird vermutet, dass die Ersatzpflege nicht erwerbsmäßig ausgeübt wird. In diesen Fällen dürfen die Aufwendungen der Pflegekasse den Betrag des Pflegegeldes des festgelegten Pflegegrades nicht überschreiten. In Einzelfällen ist eine Erhöhung bis zu 1685,00 € möglich, wenn entsprechend hohe notwendige Aufwendungen der Pflegeperson, z. B. Verdienstausfall oder Fahrkosten, nachgewiesen werden.
pflege-de-faber-relatives.tr: If replacement care is provided by carers related or related by marriage to the person receiving care within the second degree, or living in the same household, replacement care is presumed to be non-commercial. In these cases, the care fund's expenses may not exceed the Pflegegeld amount for the assigned care grade. In individual cases an increase up to €1,685.00 is possible if correspondingly high necessary expenses of the carer, such as lost earnings or travel costs, are proved.
pflege-de-faber-relatives.law: Section 39(3) SGB XI allows proved necessary expenses connected with non-commercial replacement care by close relatives or household members above the ordinary two-month Pflegegeld limit, within the remaining shared annual budget of up to €3,539. The currently linked form instead caps that route at €1,685. The general webpage correctly describes the common €3,539 budget but does not correct the form’s specific lower ceiling. Commercial replacement care by the specified relatives or household members is subject to the common annual amount instead.
pflege-de-faber-relatives.example: Hypothetical: an adult with Pflegegrad 3 needs necessary replacement care from a daughter who is not the usual carer during the usual carer’s holiday in October 2026. Assume non-commercial care, €2,000 of necessary proved lost earnings, the other statutory conditions and enough unused shared annual budget. Section 39(3) permits consideration of those expenses above €1,685; the form’s stated ceiling would exclude part of them. This does not guarantee payment on an actual claim.
pflege-de-faber-relatives.context: The current Pflegeleistungsarten page links this exact application and correctly describes the shared €3,539 budget. Its general budget explanation does not correct the application's specific relatives limits. The form also asks about six months of prior care, recorded separately as ambiguous because a question alone does not establish a current eligibility condition.
pflege-de-faber-relatives.scope: Current-linked replacement-care application, PDF physical page 2. Non-commercial necessary replacement care from 1 July 2025, with the specific relatives/household conditions and cost proof.

qs.title: When benefits start
qs.q: Does the Jobcenter say your benefit starts from the first of the month you apply, or only from the day you apply?
qs.law: 1st of the month

qs.title: Keeping part of your wages
qs.q: How much of your earnings can you keep? We look at the share left free between €520 and €1,000.
qs.law: For employable claimants who work, 30% of monthly earnings between €520 and €1,000 stays free, at any age. Other slices have other rates.
qs.lawText: A claimant who works keeps part of each month’s earnings free. Normally there is a basic allowance of €100. On top of it, 20% of the slice above €100 and up to €520 stays free, 30% of the slice above €520 and up to €1,000 (at most €144), and 10% of the slice above €1,000 and up to €1,200. The upper limit is €1,500 if the claimant has a child under 18 or lives with one in the same benefit household (Bedarfsgemeinschaft). The 30% band has no age condition. For claimants under 25 who are in a training course that qualifies for BAföG or SGB III support, in voluntary service, or at school outside the holidays, the €100 is replaced by a higher allowance (the minijob earnings limit) and the 20% slice does not apply; the 30% and 10% slices still do. The 2026 reform (Grundsicherungsgeld from 1 July 2026) did not change these rules.

qs.title: One-off support
qs.q: Can you get one-off help, for example for furniture, when your regular costs are already covered?
qs.law: Yes, but only for listed needs, such as first equipment of a home, and only if you cannot pay for it yourself. Ordinary replacement of worn furniture is not covered; at most a loan.
qs.lawText: Some one-off needs are not part of the standard rate and are paid separately: first equipment for a home including household appliances; first clothing and first equipment for pregnancy and birth; and orthopaedic shoes (purchase and repair), repair of therapeutic devices and rental of therapeutic devices. The law names no individual items, so furniture counts only where it is part of the first equipment of a home. These benefits are also paid to people who need no ongoing benefit for living costs and rent, if they cannot cover the need fully from their own income and means; the Jobcenter may then count income earned in up to six months after the month it decides. They may be given in kind or as money, including lump sums. For other needs that the standard rate already covers, such as replacing worn furniture, the law allows at most a loan if the need is unavoidable. Under-25s who move out of their parents’ home need the municipality’s prior assurance of housing costs before first-home equipment is paid, unless that requirement can be waived. One-off benefits must be applied for separately.

qs.title: Repaying a deposit loan
qs.q: How much of your benefit is kept each month to repay a rental-deposit loan?
qs.law: 5% a month

qs.title: Holiday jobs for pupils
qs.q: Do a pupil’s earnings from holiday jobs count against the family’s benefit?
qs.law: No limit

ents.name: Jobcenter Brandenburg an der Havel, Stadt

qs.title: Age limit
qs.q: Until what age can you start studying and still get BAföG?
qs.law: Under 45 when the course section starts; from 45 only under the listed exceptions
qs.lawText: BAföG is not paid if you have already turned 45 when the course section you apply for begins. The limit is measured at the start of the section, so turning 45 during a Bachelor’s does not end funding. The law lists the following exceptions that allow a start at 45 or older: you got your university entrance through a second-chance route (an evening school or Kolleg, an external school-leaving exam or a university entrance exam) or were enrolled without the Abitur on the strength of a vocational qualification; you start a further course under §7(2) no. 2 or 3 (one legally required for your intended profession, or one that continues your previous training in the same direction); you turned 45 during a Bachelor’s and start a qualifying Master’s straight away; personal or family reasons kept you from starting in time, in particular raising your own child under 14 without interruption from reaching the age limit until you start (working no more than 30 hours a week on average, or more as a single parent avoiding basic-income benefits); or a drastic change in your circumstances left you in need and you have not yet completed a vocational qualification that BAföG could fund. Except for the enrolment-without-Abitur exception, each of these applies only if you start promptly (after reaching the entry requirements, after the obstacle ends or after the need arises). All other BAföG conditions still apply.

qs.title: Changing subject
qs.q: Until when can you switch your degree subject and keep BAföG?
qs.law: Important reason: until the 5th subject semester begins; later only for an unavoidable reason
qs.lawText: If you drop a course or switch your subject, BAföG is paid for another course if you had an important reason. At a university, academy or higher technical school this works only until the fifth subject semester begins. From then on only an unavoidable reason counts, and the law sets no semester limit for it. For a first switch or drop-out up to the start of the fourth subject semester, an important reason is normally presumed. When counting the subject semester, semesters that the school credits to the new course are subtracted. For a Master’s programme the important-reason route does not apply; an unavoidable reason is needed. After a switch, funding beyond the standard period of study for the new course (shortened by the semesters of the abandoned one) is paid fully as a loan, unless it was your first switch or drop-out for an important or unavoidable reason.

qs.title: Savings and assets
qs.q: How much savings can you have and still get BAföG?
qs.law: €15,000 of savings, or €45,000 from age 30 at application; more is counted against the payment
qs.lawText: The first €15,000 of your own assets stays uncounted. If you have turned 30 when you apply, the allowance is €45,000 instead. It rises by €2,300 for a spouse or registered partner and by €2,300 for each of your children. Your age and your assets are taken as they stand on the day you apply, and debts are deducted from the assets first (not the BAföG loan you already received). Assets above the allowance do not rule BAföG out: the excess is divided by the months of the approval period (normally one year) and subtracted from your monthly need, so a high balance lowers the payment or cuts it to nothing. To avoid undue hardship, a further part of the assets can stay uncounted. Only your own assets count; the assets of your parents or spouse are not counted, although their income can be.

qs.title: Childcare
qs.q: How much extra does BAföG pay for a child under 14 living with you?
qs.law: €160 a month is added to your need for each of your own children under 14 living in your household; only one parent gets it for the same period
qs.lawText: If you live in one household with at least one of your own children who has not yet turned 14, your assessed need rises by €160 a month for each such child. Only one parent gets the supplement for the same period; if both parents are eligible and share a household, they decide who. The supplement is added to your need, so income and assets are still set against the total. It is paid as a grant, not as a loan. It is not counted as income for other social benefits, except that for childcare fees under §90 SGB VIII it is left out only where the fee is charged for weekday childcare during regular hours.

qs.title: Application timing
qs.q: Is applying early a rule or only a recommendation?
qs.law: No deadline for a first application, but no payment for months before the one you apply in; a follow-up application filed two months before the period ends keeps payments running
qs.lawText: The law sets no deadline for applying, so applying early is not a rule. But the date still matters: BAföG is paid from the start of the month in which the course begins, and at the earliest from the start of the month in which you apply. If you apply before the course starts, payment runs from the month the course begins. If you apply later, the months before your application month are not paid. For a follow-up application, the law adds a timing condition: if the approval period ends before the new decision, payments continue on the old basis, subject to repayment, only if you filed an essentially complete application two months before the period ends. The decision is made on a written or electronic application.
