districts.claim: Lists a national passport with a residence title as mandatory for naturalisation, but the surrounding EU-right explanation leaves the document requirement unresolved.
districts.q:
Welche Unterlagen brauchen Sie?
Diese Unterlagen müssen Sie vorlegen:
• Antrag auf Einbürgerung
• ein aktuelles Lichtbild
• Ihre Geburtsurkunde, gegebenenfalls Heiratsurkunde oder Scheidungsurkunde (bei Dokumenten in nicht-deutscher Sprache: Übersetzung des Dokumentes durch amtlich beeidigten Dolmetscher)
• gültiger Nationalpass mit Aufenthaltstitel
• Nachweis über Deutschkenntnisse (z.B. Schulzeugnisse, Zertifikate, abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung)
• Nachweis über den bestandenen Einbürgerungstest
• Nachweis über Einkommen der Familie
Informieren Sie sich vorher, wie viel Geld die Einbürgerung für Sie und Ihre Familie kostet. Sie ziehen den Antrag zurück? Oder Antrag zur Einbürgerung wird abgelehnt? Dann müssen Sie trotzdem noch die Kosten übernehmen.
districts.tr:
What documents do you need?
You must present these documents:
• Naturalisation application
• A current photograph
• Your birth certificate and, where applicable, marriage or divorce certificate (for documents not in German: a translation by an officially sworn interpreter)
• Valid national passport with a residence title
• Evidence of German language skills (for example school reports, certificates or completed vocational training)
• Evidence of passing the naturalisation test
• Evidence of the family’s income
Find out beforehand how much naturalisation costs for you and your family. If you withdraw the application, or the naturalisation application is rejected, you must still pay the costs.
districts.why:
Unresolved concern: a literal physical-document reading of the checklist would impose an unnecessary residence-title requirement. Independent review found a reasonably supported alternative: the linked guide colloquially calls the permanent right itself an Aufenthaltstitel and describes ordinary proof and a confirming card. A separate compulsory physical permit cannot therefore be established from this publication with sufficient confidence. No misrepresentation is confirmed.

The page is expressly located under EU-Bürgerinnen und Bürger and says the listed documents must be presented, including a national passport with a residence title. Current FreizügG/EU §2a(1) expressly states that EU citizens need no residence title for their stay; §4a(1) grants permanent residence by law after five years of continuous lawful residence. StAG §10(1) no.2 accepts an unlimited right of residence. A lawful requirement to establish identity and the qualifying residence right is different from making an Aufenthaltstitel compulsory. The worked example assumes adequate alternative evidence and does not waive proof duties. The linked guide calls a permanent-right confirmation a card and sometimes colloquially a title; that competing reading must be weighed independently.

Primary-law wording:
(1) Unionsbürger bedürfen für die Einreise keines Visums und für den Aufenthalt keines Aufenthaltstitels. Für ihren Aufenthalt von bis zu drei Monaten ist der Besitz eines gültigen Personalausweises oder Reisepasses ausreichend. Satz 2 gilt auch für Familienangehörige, die nicht Unionsbürger sind, wenn sie im Besitz eines anerkannten oder sonst zugelassenen Passes oder Passersatzes sind und sie den Unionsbürger begleiten oder ihm nachziehen. Soweit nach dem Europäischen Übereinkommen über die Regelung des Personenverkehrs zwischen den Mitgliedstaaten des Europarates vom 10. Februar 1959 (BGBl. 1959 II S. 389, 390) günstigere Regelungen Anwendung finden, bleiben diese unberührt.

(1) Unionsbürger, die sich seit fünf Jahren ständig rechtmäßig im Bundesgebiet aufgehalten haben, haben unabhängig vom weiteren Vorliegen der Voraussetzungen des § 2 Abs. 2 das Recht auf Einreise und Aufenthalt (Daueraufenthaltsrecht). Ihre Familienangehörigen und nahestehenden Personen, die Inhaber eines Rechts nach § 3a Absatz 1 sind, die nicht Unionsbürger sind, haben dieses Recht, wenn sie sich seit fünf Jahren mit dem Unionsbürger ständig rechtmäßig im Bundesgebiet aufgehalten haben.

English translation:
(1) Union citizens require no visa for entry and no residence title for their stay. For a stay of up to three months, possession of a valid identity card or passport is sufficient. The second sentence also applies to family members who are not Union citizens if they possess a recognised or otherwise approved passport or substitute and accompany or join the Union citizen.
More favourable provisions under the European Agreement on Regulations governing the Movement of Persons between Member States of the Council of Europe of 10 February 1959 remain unaffected.

(1) Union citizens who have resided continuously and lawfully in Germany for five years have the right of entry and residence regardless of whether the conditions in section 2(2) continue to be met (permanent right of residence). Their family members and close persons holding a right under section 3a(1) who are not Union citizens have this right if they have resided continuously and lawfully in Germany with the Union citizen for five years.

Scope: An otherwise eligible EU citizen whose permanent residence is adequately proved without a residence-title document; no waiver of identity/status evidence and no assessment of every third-country applicant.

Context: Earlier conditions accept a permanent right of residence, and the directly linked permanent-residence guide describes evidence and a confirming card. This is material counterevidence: Aufenthaltstitel might be used colloquially for proof of residence. The later checklist nevertheless says the document must be presented without an alternative-proof route. Linked state naturalisation main site returns404; the state citizen-service link reaches a bot-verification gateway. No content behind those barriers is asserted. Only the district-published guide path is in audit scope.

Additional source passage (Complete ordinary conditions list and next loyalty paragraph): To be naturalised, you must meet several conditions:
• Lawful habitual residence in Germany for five years
• A permanent right of residence, for example an EU Blue Card, settlement permit, permanent right of residence or residence permit
• A valid identity card or passport proving identity and nationality
• Good German language skills (at least B1)
• Evidence of passing the naturalisation test (Living in Germany)
• Commitment to the democratic constitutional order
• Enough income to support yourself and your family
• No previous convictions
You must also give a loyalty declaration stating that you do not pursue anti-constitutional activities and will not do so in future: you must do nothing contrary to democracy’s fundamental values. [Source: https://integreat.app/altmarkkreis-salzwedel/de/rechtliches-und-rechte/eu-b%C3%BCrgerinnen-und-b%C3%BCrger/einb%C3%BCrgerung]

Additional source passage (Complete Wie erhalten Sie das Daueraufenthaltsrecht? evidence and confirming-card section): How do you obtain the permanent right of residence?
The Foreigners Authority needs evidence that you have already lived continuously in Germany for five years. Evidence may include:
• Your local registration office’s registration certificate (issued after arrival)
• Tenancy agreements and water, gas or electricity bills
• Payslips, bank statements and tax returns
The Foreigners Authority issues a card confirming your permanent right of residence. To obtain it, you must have your residence certified. You can apply through the Altmarkkreis Salzwedel service portal, or email the Foreigners Authority for an appointment. [Source: https://integreat.app/altmarkkreis-salzwedel/de/rechtliches-und-rechte/eu-b%C3%BCrgerinnen-und-b%C3%BCrger/daueraufenthaltsrecht/]
districts.unc: Independent review retained Ambiguous because a reasonably supported colloquial status-proof reading remains; source context and concern are preserved, no actual practice inferred.

districts.claim: Describes the cash allowance as a ceiling on all assets for care assistance.
districts.q:
Voraussetzungen der Hilfegewährung
Rechtzeitige Antragstellung vor der Heimaufnahme, denn die Sozialhilfe kann erst ab dem Bekanntwerden gewährt werden kann, sofern die weiteren Voraussetzungen erfüllt sind. Eine telefonische Bekanntgabe des Sachverhaltes ist zur Wahrung eines Anspruches möglich.
Die Einkünfte der pflegebedürftigen Person und ggf. auch des Ehepartners sowie die Leistung der Pflegekasse reichen zur vollständigen Deckung der Heimkosten nicht aus.
Das gesamte Vermögen der pflegebedürftigen Person darf die Freigrenze in Höhe von 10.000,00 € nicht übersteigen. Für Ehepaare liegt der Vermögensfreibetrag seit 01.01.2023 bei 20.000,00 €.
districts.tr:
Requirements for assistance
Apply in good time before entering the home, because social assistance can be provided only from when the authority becomes aware of the need, provided the other conditions are met. You may notify the facts by telephone to preserve a claim.
The care recipient’s income, and where applicable their spouse’s income, together with care-insurance payments, are insufficient to cover the home’s costs fully.
The care recipient’s entire assets must not exceed the allowance of EUR 10,000. For married couples the asset allowance has been EUR 20,000 since 1 January 2023.
districts.why:
SGB XII § 90(2) protects several classes of assets separately from smaller cash amounts. The implementing ordinance sets EUR 10,000 per relevant adult for cash or other monetary values. The page instead says the care recipient’s entire assets must stay below that figure, or EUR 20,000 for couples. An appropriate home meeting § 90(2)8 can remain protected despite having a higher value. The comparison must distinguish protected assets from assets actually available and required for support; the page’s earlier reference to income/assets for meeting need is relevant counterevidence.

Scope: The unqualified phrase entire assets, not the correctness of the stated cash allowances or entitlement regardless of means.

Context: Whole live care page read, including home, day and residential branches, insurance priority, tables, telephone notification and form links. The linked general application could not be retrieved after bounded attempts by both researchers. Independent reviewer a read the complete article and current primary law, and retained the reasonable reading that only legally available assets are meant. The candidate remains unresolved; this is not a finding that protected property must be sold.

districts.claim: Presents alternative maintenance-advance requirements for children aged 12–17 as cumulative.
districts.q:
Um Unterhaltsvorschussleistungen beantragen zu können, gelten folgende Voraussetzungen:
• Ihr Kind hat seinen Wohnsitz oder gewöhnlichen Aufenthalt in Deutschland
• Sie und das Kind müssen in einem Haushalt leben
• der Elternteil, bei dem das Kind lebt, ist ledig, verwitwet oder geschieden oder lebt von seinem Ehegatten oder Lebenspartner dauernd getrennt
• das andere Elternteil zahlt keinen, nur teilweise oder unregelmäßige Unterhalt
• bei Kindern ab 12 Jahre müssen zusätzlich folgende Bedingungen erfüllt sein:
  • Ihr Kind selbst erhält kein Bürgergeld
  • Durch den Unterhaltsvorschuss kann die Hilfebedürftigkeit Ihres Kindes vermieden werden
  • Sie haben ein Brutto-Monatseinkommen von mindestens 600,00 €
districts.tr:
The following requirements apply to applying for maintenance advance:
• Your child resides or habitually stays in Germany.
• You and the child must live in the same household.
• The parent with whom the child lives is single, widowed or divorced, or lives permanently separated from their spouse or civil partner.
• The other parent pays no maintenance, pays only part of it or pays irregularly.
• For children aged 12 or over, the following additional conditions must be met:
 • Your child itself receives no Bürgergeld.
 • Maintenance advance can avoid your child’s need for assistance.
 • You have gross monthly income of at least EUR 600.
districts.why:
UhVorschG § 1(1a) provides alternative routes for otherwise qualifying children aged 12–17: no SGB II benefits, avoidance of the child’s need, or qualifying parental income of at least EUR 600. The HTML instead says that the additional conditions must be met and lists all three without an alternative conjunction. This may deter a single parent with lower income whose child meets the no-benefits alternative. The linked application PDF correctly states the alternatives and is retained as material corrective context. The finding concerns the HTML formulation; the general statutory conditions remain.

Scope: The additional age 12–17 conditions only, not all UVG requirements or every linked publication.

Context: The complete current main service was read, including general eligibility, exclusions, the 2026 amount table, application instructions, documents and change-reporting. The main list contains no alternative conjunction. The directly linked 15-page application was checked selectively for the relevant application/signature passages and complete attached leaflet, including the correct alternatives on printed page 9 and its duplicate on page 11. That wording is retained as strong counterevidence. No actual practice is inferred.

Additional source passage (Printed page 9, leaflet section 1, age 12–17 paragraph; duplicate on page 11): For a child aged 12 to 17, entitlement exists only if
• the child receives no SGB II benefits, or maintenance advance can avoid the child’s need, or
• the single parent has income of at least EUR 600 alongside SGB II benefits. [Source: https://www.salzlandkreis.de/buergerservice/formulare/22-fachdienst-jugend-und-familie/unterhaltsvorschuss/slk-12-51-561-antrag-auf-unterhaltsleistungen-nach-unterhaltsvorschussgesetz-2020-03-12-mit-hinweisblatt-datenschutz-zf.pdf?cid=7vd]

districts.claim: Requires two measles doses for nursery entry from the first birthday.
districts.q:
Seit dem 1. März 2020 gilt das Masernschutzgesetz. Das Gesetz soll den Schutz vor Masern in Kindergärten, Schulen und anderen Gemeinschaftseinrichtungen sowie medizinischen Einrichtungen fördern.
Daher müssen bestimmte Personengruppen nachweisen, dass bei ihnen alle Masernimpfungen (2) erfolgt sind. Diese Personengruppen sind:
• alle Kinder ab dem vollendeten ersten Lebensjahr vor Eintritt in eine Kita oder Schule
• alle nach 1970 geborenen Personen, die in einer Gemeinschaftseinrichtung tätig sind oder dort betreut werden
• alle nach 1970 geborenen Personen, die in medizinischen Einrichtungen arbeiten
• Asylbewerber und Geflüchtete spätestens vier Wochen nach Aufnahme in eine Gemeinschaftsunterkunft.
districts.why:
IfSG § 20(8), sentence 2, defines sufficient vaccination protection as one measles dose from the first birthday and two from the second. The district explicitly inserts “(2)” and applies that proof statement to all children from their first birthday before nursery entry. For a child aged one but under two, a documented single dose can satisfy the vaccination route. Immunity and medical-contraindication alternatives also exist, but this finding concerns only the dose/age requirement. The linked federal guidance correctly distinguishes the ages and is retained as material counterevidence.

Scope: The explicit two-dose condition for children aged one but under two, rather than every statement in the list or medical vaccination recommendations.

Context: The complete measles subsection and relevant neighbouring health-service text were read. There is no age-specific one-dose qualification in the district subsection. The district links masernschutz.de, which redirects to the current federal measles page; its parent FAQ gives the correct age distinction and immunity/medical alternatives. That guidance is preserved below. The general overview could be intended to summarise the usual two-dose schedule, but the precise parent-facing first-birthday threshold makes a narrower legal-entry error plausible. Independent review confirmed that this explicit age/number combination is materially different from the statutory proof threshold.

Additional source passage (FAQ Was genau müssen die betroffenen Personen nachweisen? complete four-paragraph answer; stated date 23 June 2025): Everyone covered who is at least one year old must prove one measles vaccination or immunity.
Children from age two and adults born after 1970 must prove at least two measles vaccinations or provide a medical certificate of sufficient immunity. Immunity can be determined by a blood test. Patients usually have to pay for a medical certificate themselves.
The legal requirements follow the recommendations of the Standing Committee on Vaccination (STIKO). If vaccination status is unclear, vaccinations should be caught up. STIKO does not recommend antibody testing.
Anyone who cannot be vaccinated because of a medical contraindication must prove this with a medical certificate (IfSG § 20(8), sentence 4, and § 20(9), sentence 1, No. 2). [Source: https://www.infektionsschutz.de/themen/masernschutz/eltern-und-erziehungsberechtigte/]
districts.prov: IfSG § 20(8), sentence 2, with § 20(9) proof rules and exceptions

districts.claim: Offers the repealed one-year right to revoke a paternity acknowledgment.
districts.q:
Zur wirksamen Vaterschaftsanerkennung ist die Zustimmung der Mutter erforderlich. Gegen den Willen der Mutter könnte zwar ein Mann die Vaterschaft zu dem Kind anerkennen, diese Erklärung bliebe aber ohne rechtliche Wirkungen.
Für die Abgabe der Zustimmungserklärung gibt es keine Frist. Es empfiehlt sich, sie zeitgleich oder möglichst umgehend nach der Vaterschaftsanerkennung abzugeben. Falls die Zustimmung der Mutter ein Jahr nach der Vaterschaftsanerkennung noch nicht beurkundet ist, kann der Mann seine Anerkennung widerrufen.
In besonderen Fällen, wenn beispielsweise die Mutter noch minderjährig ist, ist zusätzlich die Zustimmung der gesetzlichen Vertreter und des Kindes erforderlich. Bei einem Kind unter 14 Jahren geschieht diese Zustimmung durch den Vormund bzw. vor Geburt durch den Beistand.
districts.tr:
The mother’s consent is necessary for an effective acknowledgment of paternity. A man could acknowledge paternity against the mother’s will, but that declaration would have no legal effects.
There is no deadline for giving the consent declaration. It is recommended to give it simultaneously with acknowledgment or as soon as possible afterwards. If the mother’s consent has still not been notarised one year after the acknowledgment of paternity, the man can revoke his acknowledgment.
In special cases, for example if the mother is still a minor, consent from the legal representatives and the child is also necessary. For a child under 14, this consent is given by the guardian, or before birth by the assistance representative.
districts.why:
Article 1 No. 3(c) of BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 83 deleted BGB § 1597(3), the former one-year revocation right. Article 6 made the repeal effective on 1 April 2026, the day after promulgation. Current § 1597 shows subsection 3 as repealed. The current service nevertheless promises revocation if maternal consent remains unnotarised after one year. This finding concerns new acknowledgments governed by the current law; it does not decide transitional treatment of declarations made before repeal, other invalidity grounds or judicial paternity procedures.

Scope: The stated one-year revocation right for new acknowledgments under current law only.

Context: The complete current main service was read, including all five substantive accordions and document lists. The revocation sentence is presented as current advice, without a historical date or archive label. The page has no substantive external leaflet or qualifying law link in this section. No claim is made that every other sentence is wrong. The complete six-page enacted law was read; it contains no preservation of this revocation right for new declarations. The official bill explains the repeal separately; it also defeats a different apparent error about representative consent for minor fathers.
districts.prov: BGB § 1597(3), repealed by Article 1 No. 3(c), effective under Article 6 of BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 83

districts.claim: Extends a four-week advance notice rule to temporary water supplies.
districts.q:
Die Betreiber von Wasserversorgungsanlagen sind gesetzlich dazu verpflichtet, dem Gesundheitsamt folgendes anzuzeigen:
• Die Errichtung der Wasserversorgungsanlage
• Die Wiederinbetriebnahme bzw. die Inbetriebnahme
• Bauliche oder auch betriebstechnische Veränderungen an der Wasserversorgungsanlage
• Übergang des Eigentums der Wasserversorgungsanlage
• Stilllegung der Wasserversorgungsanlage
Bei zeitweiligen Wasserversorgungsanlagen ist die voraussichtliche Dauer des Betriebs zu melden.
Diese Anzeigen haben vier Wochen vor Beginn der Errichtung, Inbetriebnahme oder Veränderung zu erfolgen.
districts.tr:
Operators of water-supply facilities are legally obliged to notify the health authority of the following:
• Construction of the water-supply facility
• Restarting or commissioning it
• Structural or operational changes to the water-supply facility
• Transfer of ownership of the water-supply facility
• Closure of the water-supply facility
For temporary water-supply facilities, the expected operating duration must be reported.
These notifications must be made four weeks before construction, commissioning or modification begins.
districts.why:
TrinkwV § 11(3) requires the ordinary construction and commissioning notices for temporary supplies immediately after learning of the reportable circumstances. It imposes no four-week advance period for that class. The district expressly mentions temporary facilities immediately before saying these notifications must precede construction, commissioning or modification by four weeks. The four-week rules for other classes under § 11(1)–(2) do not replace the distinct temporary-supply rule. The special postponement for danger-prevention, civil-protection or defence measures remains. All other safety, quality and notification duties also remain.

Scope: Only the four-week advance period as applied to ordinary construction or commissioning notifications for temporary supplies.

Context: The whole current main health page was previously read; the complete water section was reread against full current TrinkwV §§ 2, 11 and 31. The statement appears in a brief task overview, a material argument for reading it as condensed general guidance. Nevertheless, temporary facilities are expressly named immediately before the unqualified four-week sentence. The sentence is not framed as a non-binding planning recommendation. Its wording about construction, commissioning and modification does not extend clearly to closure; no closure-deadline claim is made. The water subsection links the Infektionsschutzgesetz, not a corrective detailed temporary-supply notice. No testing, permission or local sanitary-approval issue is confirmed.

districts.claim: States a maximum of 14 months of parental allowance without preserving the longer basic allowance entitlement for qualifying premature births.
districts.q:
Bundeselterngeld- und Elternzeitgesetz (BEEG)
Das Elterngeld nach dem Bundeselterngeld- und Elternzeitgesetz erreicht alle Eltern, die sich Zeit für ihr Neugeborenes nehmen und auf Einkommen verzichten. Das Elterngeld wird an Mutter und Vater für maximal 14 Monate gezahlt, beide können den Zeitraum frei untereinander aufteilen. Ersetzt werden 67 oder 65 Prozent des wegfallenden bereinigten Nettoeinkommens, maximal 1800 € im Monat. Der Mindestbetrag, den Eltern erhalten, die vor der Geburt des Kindes nicht erwerbstätig waren, beträgt 300 €. Leben in der Familie Geschwisterkinder, die das 3. Lebensjahr noch nicht vollendet haben, erhöht sich das Elterngeld um einen Geschwisterbonus von mindestens 75 €. Das Elterngeld kann, im Rahmen des Elterngeld Plus, bei gleichem Gesamtbudget auch auf den doppelten Zeitraum gestreckt werden.
Die Elterngeldstelle des Landkreises prüft und entscheidet über die eingereichten Anträge auf Bundeselterngeld. Des Weiteren wird zu den entsprechenden gesetzlichen Regelungen des Elterngeldes und der Elternzeit informiert und beraten. Elterngeldanträge sind auf der Wochenstation des Eichsfeld-Klinikums Heiligenstadt sowie bei der Elterngeldstelle des Landkreises Eichsfeld und auf folgender Seite erhältlich:
Beantragung
Download der Antragsformulare
Hinweis
Bitte achten Sie beim Download darauf, den gültigen Antrag mit der Bezeichnung „Elterngeld-Antrag für Geburten ab dem 01.09.2021“ herunterzuladen.
districts.tr:
Federal Parental Allowance and Parental Leave Act (BEEG)
Parental allowance under the BEEG reaches all parents who take time for their newborn and forego income. Parental allowance is paid to mother and father for a maximum of 14 months; they can freely divide the period between them. It replaces 67 or 65 percent of lost adjusted net income, at most€1,800 per month. The minimum for parents who were not employed before birth is€300. If siblings under 3 live in the family, allowance increases by a sibling bonus of at least€75. Under ElterngeldPlus, the same total budget can also be spread over twice the period.
The district parental-allowance office checks and decides applications and advises on parental allowance and leave. Forms are available on the maternity ward at Eichsfeld hospital in Heiligenstadt, at the district office and on the following page:
Application
Download application forms
Note
When downloading, please ensure you download the valid form labelled “Parental-allowance application for births from 1 September 2021”.
